reviews.title: Your home away from home in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Fortunate to have  stayed  in a 1 BR unit for the 2025 F1 Race week. Close enough to the action when you  want it yet a place of respite from the hub-bub when you need a break. from it.  Responsive housekeeping and maintenance, who fixed a slow drain in the bathroom. Only complaint is our unit 3119 was rated for 4 guests but the only entry to the only bathroom required our guests to traipse through our bedroom to get to the bathroom instead of having an entrance from the "common area" so if your sleep cycles don't match up your early bird is disturbing your late sleeper each day.  You pay for the washer and dryer - each building had a pay per use laundry requiring an APP to activate that wasn't easiest for this old gal to figure so likely just me but got 'er done. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Great experience!
reviews.text: This resort is great! Friendly staff. Very quiet and lots of parking. Great location and very close to the strip.

reviews.title: Just off the strip and great for families
reviews.text: Stayed here for a recent conference and was pleasantly surprised by how decent the property was. Considering all of the exorbitant prices being charged by the main hotels on the strip, the Desert Rose was a breath of fresh air with very reasonable pricing. The resort is literally next door to where the new baseball stadium will be built so we'll see how long it lastsPros- no resort fees and free parking- rooms are in good shape and quite big with a full kitchen- good size pool and hot tub with some other nice amenities like fire pits and bbq'sCons- some of the hallways were a bit worn and dirty- not great soundproofing if loud guests were walking outside- housekeeping is not really an option While the property is more geared towards families, I enjoyed my stay there and indeed there were a number of other conference attendees staying there as well.

reviews.title: Recommended for solo travel.
reviews.text: I stayed to go to a music festival.I'm alone, so I chose this one out of concern for price, cleanliness and safety.First, there is no resort fee.From the airport, it was about 10 minutes if it wasn't crowded by lift or Uber, about 20 minutes if the road was crowded, about $10 if it was cheap, and $20-30 if it was expensive.The rooms are quite large.There is a solid refrigerator, microwave, toaster, coffee maker and kitchen (pots, plates and cutlery are available) for long stays.Amenities included towels for three nights, so no problem.(Only wipes were enough for a day.)It seems that there is no bed making during the basic stay. It was three nights, so I didn't ask.The room was beautiful, and there was some stranger hair left in the bathtub...Also, the shower head was a non-moving type.Hot water was also provided and stored, so there was no problem.The land is so vast that it is a maze to go to your room.It is said to be $250 with a deposit at check-in, but if there is nothing, you will come back.There was a bathtub, shampoo, conditioner, body soap, hand soap and body cream. Please bring anything else. If you need slippers, you should bring your own.There is a bus stop nearby, and you can take that bus for $2 to get to the Strip.You should download the app in advance and buy a 24-hour pass or something. I can pay in cash. All buses through the Strip can be boarded with that 24-hour pass. It was $8.I didn't understand the monorail because I didn't ride it after all.It takes about 10 minutes to get to the nearest DUCE stop on the Strip.I turned on the heater because it was cold. I didn't spend much time in the hotel during my stay, but there was no problem. I could hear people coming through and talking and rattling suitcases.I didn’t feel scared when I came back from the festival at night.

reviews.title: Vacation & wedding week
reviews.text: The resort is in a nice area. One block from the strip. We had a 1 and 2 bedroom unit which is very clean and comfortable. We were in building 3 which currently has construction behind it, and resort is near the airport but neither of those had any noise problems.Nice pool, bar, bar food choices. Staff was very friendly. Great time!

reviews.title: Everything is amazing
reviews.text: The hotel is great Beach is so good and so kind pepole  and good Food , entertaiment team is amazing , sure we will come back again

reviews.title: Great Experience Wonderful Customer Service
reviews.text: This was one of the best experiences that we have had at any resort over the past several years. We would highly recommend staying at the Desert Rose Resort. Close to all the action on the Las Vegas Strip but quiet and away from the hustle and bustle.

reviews.title: Great resort. Don't hesitate!
reviews.text: The resort is clean, rooms are very nice and staff is great. Short walk to MGM and location was perfect for us as we also visited family. The pool and surroundings are beautiful.  We will be going back!

reviews.title: Not what we was expecting
reviews.text: Not impressed, chose this resort due to good reviews and near strip. We arrived late Friday evening, checked in then had to go over to get welcome pack. The lady was very pushy trying to sell shows and dinners. When we said we weren’t interested she said why not you are in vegas. We know full well where we were. She was so pushy and wanted an answer and made us feel like we shouldn’t be there. Not a good start.We were on floor 2, but was actually 1st floor. Could hear every movement upstairs including bath being ran. Balcony looked over the back of the lift.On the Sunday I did some laundry. The machines said $2.50 each, it took $8 off my card each. I questioned the next morning about this at reception and was told it was a hold. Not a problem but 2 weeks later no hold has been lifted. Can’t contact the hotel as I can’t find an email address. We live in the UK so calling is not an option. They don’t make it easy to contact them.

reviews.title: Great experience
reviews.text: Ease of check in and overall service was incredible. Very friendly staff that was eager to please. Wish I could have stayed longer

reviews.title: Not an RCI
reviews.text: No housekeeping daily. Outdated. Bathroom in the main room so tiny I could barely dry my hair. No shuttle to the Las Vegas strip.

reviews.title: Nice apartments in Good location off Strip…
reviews.text: Two bedroom apartment, large beds, lots of space, with en suite bathrooms. Very comfortable open plan lounge/kitchen area well provisioned items. Easy access, safe parking, nice pool area. Staff were very efficient and friendly providing good service and helpful advice on Las Vegas. Located close to MGM Grand and 2 blocks from the Strip (NYNY / MGM intersection). Yes this is a Wyndham ‘timeshare/ownership’ property but there is NO pressure or sales pitch forced upon you. You are invited should you wish to find out more at checkin. Thats it. We enjoyed 2 nights in this nice property - not overwhelming in size or numbers like the massive hotels on The Strip. No noisy slot machines to contend with! Easy free parking to explore Vegas. Recommended stay.(At time of stay Sept 25 there’s is a large construction site next to the property. Strip view apartments overlook it. Construction starts early and through the day. If that bothers you take a room at the front of the property. Bedrooms have noise cancelling to help reduce any noise but we found it was not excessive. The helicopters make more noise!)

reviews.title: Honest about fees
reviews.text: Deposit was told of 250 for incidental buy nothing about fees or half will get back not all was deposited back into guest acct.

reviews.title: Great accomodations
reviews.text: Great experience. Friendly and helpful staff. Clean and comfortable accommodations. Kitchen generously stocked with eating and cooking items. Close to the strip.

reviews.title: Quiet, luxury, and clean hotel.
reviews.text: A wonderful and luxury hotel, pool was clean, environment was awesome. Rooms are large and clean and new. No complaints. Price was great too! Although its next to an airport you cant hear any planes.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: Room was nice and the pool was great. I wish there were more choices for food nearby but MGM is a short walk from here.

reviews.title: Wow!
reviews.text: I will recommend to all my friends who will come to Vegas! Near the strip (8-9 minutes walk from the MGM Grand and the monorail). Our two bedroom suite was very clean. We had everything we needed to cook. We were even treated to small bowls of free ice cream every day! There is even a day in the week when the hotel pays you a glass of beer!We have only one negative point. Employees at the timeshare office can be quite tenacious.They tried to hook us up right from the check-in.Two hours later, the lobby calls and says they forgot to give us our bracelets. When they arrived at the lobby, they directed us directly to the sales office.Don't hesitate to say no so as not to waste your vacation time! It is so precious!

reviews.title: Would come back again!  Nice pool area
reviews.text: Nice apartment style places.  Very good having your own kitchen.  Staff are great.  Pool open to 11.  Would definitely stay again

reviews.title: A great hotel off the Strip, yet close enough
reviews.text: We had an app. with 2 bedrooms and it was big enough. The kitchen is equipped with everything, so nothing stands in the way of a homemade meal. At the pool there were always loungers and even daybeds and umbrellas free of charge (this is not always the case at the hotels on the Strip). 5 min walk is a Dennys dinner and also a scooter. You walk to the Strip (MGM) for about 10 minutes. Parking is free.We felt very comfortable and would recommend the place at any time.

reviews.title: Fix Or Repair Daily.
reviews.text: I began to hate this place shortly after I arrived.  My family and I were tired and after being assigned a second-floor room, we discovered that the elevator was broken and only worked intermittently.  Since we had a lot of baggage, I had to walk all the way to the end of the building.  Several times.  Later, when using the swimming pool,  I discovered that the gate was not working.  I complained and it was fixed.  The next day the gate was broken again.  I complained again, explaining that I considered the gate to be a "health and safety" issue.  The staff member looked at me incredulously as if I were lying and challenged my opinion that the gate was in fact broken.  Really.

reviews.title: Stayed 1 week in June 2025 .. overall nice stay
reviews.text: Nice clean apartment. Good location. Layout of apartment very goodCommon areas can be better. Good staff at reception, very efficient.

reviews.title: Really good view of the strip and Vegas.  Close to the strip
reviews.text: The location of this resort is really great and views are good if you request strip views other wise you'll get the parking lot or pool views.  Room was clean except maintence gloves and dirty underwear in the safe.  Room was well equiped and the ammenities were good there.  Small bedrooms but it was what we needed for 3 nights.

reviews.title: Well located good value family accommodation
reviews.text: The staff are friendly at this resort and the apartment was clean and well appointed. The air-conditioning worked well despite the very high temperatures outside. The apartment itself is a little bit dated, but everything was clean and comfortable.Appoint loss was for the very thin rules between the apartments which meant you could hear anybody walking past and also the bar staff seemed grumpy and the beer was very overpriced

reviews.title: Few gripes but good place to stay
reviews.text: Good size suite that was fairly well equippedNice and clean.Comfy bed.Short walk to main Vegas strip while being in a quiet location.Suite was large but shower / toilet were small.Constant smell of cigarettes and weed despite none smoking hotel. We did complain.Terrible noise and vibration in the bedroom from the air con unit as it was sat on the roof and we were on the top floor. We had the hotel maintenance man in and stated it was directly above us.The corridors were a bit "grey" and the lift had seen better days.Overall though pretty decent.

reviews.title: Mix of Good and Not-So-Good.  Would return if room rate were close to same.
reviews.text: Good to ExcellentVery nice size room (5*) for price. Kitchen very well equipped (5*)  appliances, utensils, plates, etc Plenty of hot water, very good parking, location of was very good for us. 4.5*Check-in was prompt (and NOT charged extra for 50 min early check-in!).  5*NO RESORT FEE!  5*Not so Good (not using word BAD as we didn't think any thing at this resort/facility was  BAD (following not in any particular order, just as we thought of it.)1.  bathroom sink stopper was stuck, very very slow drain.  I used a kitchen spoon to pry up the sink stopper.  Then worked fine for us will in the room (3 nights).2.  Room was handicap access.  The shower did not have  a light, the shower area got very wet (outside the shower the floor got very wet from taking a shower with curtain slightly closed).  3.5*3. very little counter space in bathroom (2*), very Large bathroom area.4. limited electrical outlets (as compared to other lodging used on 3 week trip) 2*.5. WOW !  The entry door was heavy, difficult for us to open, keep open 2*.6.  little black hairs found (likely a dog).  found in bathroom sink and ice maker. 1.0*7. put extra towels on patio table (w 2 chairs).  Table was so dirty (dusty?) that made towels soiled with towels being wet.  2*8. hair dryer barely worked (used  our own). 1.0*9.  drapes in living area, and bedroom are electric open/close.  New to us.  Took      some time to figure out.  3*10.  Went to pool area several times.  Very nice looking (4*),  but seating/reclining seating was insufficient for the number of people using.  3*11.   We had a ground floor room.  moderate amount of foot noise from above. And table/chair noise from furniture being moved around.  3.0*Summary:  believe this resort maybe be (or was) part of a Time-Share resort.Value for $  4*We would consider returning, now knowing the 'not so good' =  3.5*

reviews.title: Relaxing welcoming hotel
reviews.text: Oh you guys are the best. Treated so well by staff, reception, housekeeping and bar.A perfect sanctuary away fro. Razz matazz in the strip.Lovely pool and sundowners.Great location joining thecsyrip but soo chilledPlus from previous tips managed to swerve concierge hard sell

reviews.title: Safety and Cleanliness Concerns*
reviews.text: *Disappointing Stay at Rose Desert*"Our stay at Rose Desert was disappointing. Broken glass on the floor injured my daughter's foot, and the issue wasn't properly addressed. Additionally, when we requested room cleaning, we were told it couldn't be done until the next day. The bathrooms were dirty, and there were crumbs of food on the nightstand, so I had to clean the room before letting my family in. The pool area was also noisy, making it difficult to sleep in the morning if your room faces the pool. This lack of attention to safety and cleanliness fell short of our expectations. Hopefully, the hotel will take steps to improve."

reviews.title: Bad experience
reviews.text: I’m an RCI member, and this was one of the worst resort experiences I’ve ever had.Let me start by asking why are we paying an $89 daily cleaning fee when we’re staying for a week? That’s nearly $600 just for someone to come in and tidy up, which barely happened, by the way.The front desk staff? Absolutely terrible. We asked for basic things like towels and washcloths, and the woman working there acted like we were a problem. Full of attitude, unprofessional, and rude. I don’t know what’s going on with their customer service, but it was one of the worst welcomes I’ve received at any resort ever.Then, we asked a male housekeeper for help. He clearly understood us, but suddenly said, “I don’t speak English.” It was obvious he did, and it honestly felt disrespectful. If you work in hospitality, at the very least, pretend to care.To top it off, the resort itself is outdated. It looks old, tired, and in desperate need of renovation. Nothing about this place feels like a vacation it feels like a mistake.Do yourself a favor and skip Desert Rose Resort. RCI should be ashamed to have this on their list.

reviews.title: great choice
reviews.text: Very friendly employees and helpful. The place was very clean.  We saw people mopping the floors every day. The place we stayed was very roomy with full kitchen, living room/dining room, bedroom with king bed and nice bathroom with outer powder room.  We had two closets and even a dishwasher.The balcony was great and looked at the heated pool.  The employees were seen cleaning the pool area with gas grills and games area every morning and evening. Not in the middle of the strip but was quiet which we liked.

reviews.title: Off-center apartment on the Strip, in nice residence. Noisy
reviews.text: 20 minutes from the Strip, because it's a little off. The hotel offers small apartments with kitchen. Possibility to order by Uber Eat. Very loud. The apartment is clean, bedding ok. Nice pool. Parking outside the hotel. We had a problem with the air conditioning which made a huge noise: instead of offering to change rooms, earplugs were given to us😖

reviews.title: Superb stay
reviews.text: We had a very pleasant experience from start to finish. The hotel is charming and there were four of us in a studio with one bedroom, perfectly equipped, including a functional kitchen and air conditioning. The staff is extremely attentive and attentive. The pool is beautiful, and we were even treated to a drink and ice cream by it, a much appreciated attention. The location is ideal, just a 10-minute walk from the beginning of the Strip, yet in a very quiet location. A superb resort that I highly recommend to those looking for a peaceful stay.

reviews.title: Very satisfied
reviews.text: Very welcome.The rezidance is very well placed quiet without being far from the Strip.The suite well equipped. Rezidance well cared for and clean. Installation of the rezidance very practical.We were very satisfied with our trip and would also recommend it for families with children.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort Las Vegas
reviews.text: We booked this accommodation through RCI for a five week stay. The resort is outdated and they have made some renovations, however the renovations were cheap and shauty. When we arrived the pool and sauna were undergoing repairs which were supposed to be completed in seven days. Neither the pool or the hot tub were available for use until the last week of our five week stay. We were told we could use the pool facilities at The Wynn (as the Desert Rose is now owned by Wyndham), however shuttle service was not provided and the two resorts were a 54 minute walk apart! Not convenient for starting or ending your day with a nice hot tub! The condo itself was quite adequate, however even after paying for a wifi upgrade we were constantly loosing service. In the master bedroom the wifi was mostly non existant. The resort has four separate buildings and our building number 3 had water issues with the laundry room the second week we were there. For the remainder of our stay we had to take our laundry to building 3 across the parking lot. Also, the exit door to the stairs on the second floor of building 3 was almost always left open as the door didn't shut properly, leaving our building unsecured the majority of the time. The staff that we had any dealings with were professional and accommodating but there seemed to be some lack of communication amongst themselves. We have been RCI owners for 15 plus years using the service almost every year and I  believe this is the first time we have given a resort a poor review. I guess it's unfortunate that Wyndham now owns RCI. Their standards are mediocre  at best!

reviews.title: Super establishment
reviews.text: I don't regret booking Desert Rose. I have only one positive:- the apartment is spacious, clean and all amenities are almost new (dishwasher, stove, microwave, hair dryer, iron),- the location less than 5 minutes walk from the entrance to the MGM,- free parking and no resort fees, - super nice pool and mattresses with barbecue area,- the kindness and professionalism of all staff. If I come back to Las Vegas, I book this hotel again.

reviews.title: The best place to stay off strip!!
reviews.text: Everything from the moment we arrived was fantastic. The hotel is clean, the staff are super friendly and the space in the rooms was incredible. A fully functional kitchen and a spacious living area with a huge bedroom and lots of storage will be found here. The pool was closed for maintenance when we stayed but I was given the sister hotels details of we wanted to use the pool over there or the hot tubs.It is in a quiet area, about 15 mins off strip. Anything we needed the staff at the front desk had with us immediately. Would definitely recommend staying at the Desert Rose!!

reviews.title: Amazing Place
reviews.text: We cannot believe how lucky we were to have stayed at this amazing condo. We stayed in a two bedroom unit on the third floor and it was beyond perfect. Spacious,clean, well equipped, comfy beds and pillows - fabulous location right across from the MGM.  We were able to walk everywhere but we did have a car (did I mention ample free parking??). We will never stay anywhere else in Las Vegas!

reviews.title: Worst hotel ever!
reviews.text: I stayed with my husband at this hotel.  I have alot of experience staying in Las Vegas hotels because I visit family in the area. This is the biggest dump you can ever imagine!  So disappointing.  The room was filthy, the service bad, and in particular, you could hear your neighbors arguing next door.  Whatever you do, do not stay here.

reviews.title: Spacious resort
reviews.text: The resort is one street back from the Strip which is within walking distance. The rooms were spacious with a kitchenette, bedroom, bathroom and  sitting room. The kitchenette contained a fridge and a microwave so you didn't have to dine out if you didn't wish too. Only criticism no shuttle service to and from resort to airport.

reviews.title: Fantastic location, super hotel and really friendly team.
reviews.text: The hotel is located five minutes walk from main strip. This is ideal as you are in an oasis of calm but only a short hop from all that vegas has to offer.The rooms are a great size, suites well appointed with everything you could need, effective air con/heating as required, and beds are super comfortable.The reception team are really lovely and helpful, Moses the maintenance man is great as he even helped fix a small issue with my car which I am sure is not on his job description.Other reviewers mention an issue with time share sellers in reception….they are part of the concierge team, and are very easy to put off with a polite “no thanks”.Plenty of parking and it’s free!Quick heads up, the demolition of the Tropicana hotel site next door is underway, but is well controlled and caused no disruption to our stay.For the price I think this is the hotel to stay at.

reviews.title: Ideal for families
reviews.text: Very pleasant hotel with family, a short distance from the Strip, to enjoy it while being quieter. Well equipped suite, ideal with children. Staff helpful and welcoming. A very nice small terrace and a nice swimming pool complete the whole.

reviews.title: Some Inconsistencies but Generally a Great Stay
reviews.text: We stayed for a week at a 2-bedroom and enjoyed our stay although there were some glitches.  Check in was very easy, and the clerk even gave my husband a birthday smoothie from the bar.  The negative part is that we "had" to pick up our "welcome packet" from the "concierge" which was really an encounter with potential timeshare sales.  We're not hostages, so I suppose we could have declined the package, but we're also nice and compliant, so we went by.  We declined the opportunity to schedule a time to listen to the spiel as we had the entire week planned with no extra time to spare.I had called and requested Building 1 top floor, but we were given Building 4, top floor.  Unfortunately, it was right next to the imploded Tropicana, where there was major construction removing rubble.  While we were fine through Monday morning, the 5:30AM start on Tuesday morning forced me to call to do a room move.  Lucky for me, they had a room available back in Building 1 on the top floor and was told that I could take my time to make the exchange.  It was a pain to repack especially when we were so tired and half asleep (we went to bed around 3:00AM), plus there was some miscommunication with the staff, so Housekeeping knocked on the door when we finally fell asleep that morning, and about 30 minutes later, the front desk called to find out what time we could change rooms; I guess they didn't really mean take our time.In our new room, we never heard the construction noise again, but we were kind of shocked that they thought it was okay to rent out those rooms closest to the construction area.  While there were noise machines in the room, it would have to be on a high level to drown out that noise.Rooms were fairly clean, although there was obvious crumbs and old crusted "stuff" on the counters.  In general, the ACs are pretty loud and weak in the master bedrooms.  This would probably be more of an issue in the summer.  In our new room, there was a food smell.  Maintenance sprayed some commercial odor-eliminating liquid, so that was good until the next time we entered the room again.  They did have a machine that would have worked better, but we had to vacate the room and didn't want to... plus by then we were checking out soon.  We used the public washers and dryers; they work fine but the process is a little difficult... you insert your credit card, and it'll deduct $8.  You press the settings on the washer, and it'll go between different prices, which leads you think you're paying more, but the $8 is a hold.  When you use the dryer, you'll insert the same credit card, and it'll recognize that it already has an $8 hold, and you choose your settings.  Once you're done w/all the loads, your credit card will be charged the correct amount, but there are no signs that tell you this.  I only know because I called them thinking my wash was going to cost $8.  It's $2.50/each for washer and dryer.  The front desk will give you laundry pod(s).I appreciated the great location, free parking, and no resort fee.  In general, it was quiet; I didn't hear the next door neighbors from the bedrooms.  When in the living room, you will hear people loudly talking as they walk by the front door (why do they it's okay at 1:00AM?!).  Our unit was next to Reno Street, so we could hear sirens, trucks/hot rods, and some general road noise.  Since the airport is nearby, you can hear the planes as well.  Check out was easy.

reviews.title: A real letdown
reviews.text: The 1.5 blocks is a bit of a stretch the area is not walkable and they don't offer shuttles like many other resorts not immediately on the strip. Unfortunately we learned the hard way to not stay here without your own vehicle. We have a beautiful few of a brink wall. The pool and very small hot tub is fine but not at all what you would see at the nicer vegas resorts. It more in line with a mid range hotel pool. Our one bedroom suite is the smallest I have ever seen and lacks amenities. We came for some luxurious time away and didn't find that here.

reviews.title: Beware the time share concierge
reviews.text: Beware the concierge. They will offer you reduced price tickets and take money on your credit card only to inform you after the fact that we you are signing up for is a couple of hours of time share selling. As soon as we realised we cancelled and were told we would get a refund. Of course this never came and now the hotel are fobbing us off and saying it’s a marketing team issue but they won’t supply contact details for the marketing team.  It soured the stay for us which was a shame because the hotel itself was very nice

reviews.title: Convenient hotel, but ...
reviews.text: A very comfortable low rise hotel at the southern end of The Strip. The crew are friendly, the rooms large and the AC works really well, which is important in the +40 degree heat. We got a quiet inner-block room which was great. The pool area is well maintained. There’s no restaurant, but the bar does snacks.Prices are reasonable for the accommodation and I’d love to rate this place 5 stars, but can’t, because of an unnecessary sharp practice that I suggest the leadership team stop. After checking in you are sent to the Concierge who give a hard sell on timeshare. They try and sell it on the basis of giving you a “free gift”. Very underhand, totally unnecessary and poor customer service transparency which is not consistent with the great customer service given by the crew at the hotel.

reviews.title: Indeed a hidden gem
reviews.text: We saw in some review that this place is a hidden gem. It indeed is! We had a family vacation here at June and loved the place. The room was spacious and in excellent condition and also the pool area was into our liking. There’s plenty of parking space as well. Will definitely consider staying over if ever visiting Las Vegas again:-)

reviews.title: Handy location, walking distance from strip, good facilities in the room.
reviews.text: We stayed here for 5 nights.  We picked this hotel because we wanted all of the facilities e.g. dishwasher, oven, fridge freezer, microwave, toaster etc.  It delivered.  The kitchen/dining/living area and bedroom were a good size.  The reception gave us more dishwasher tablets as needed.  The hotel has laundry facilities at $2.50 per load to wash and $2.50 per load to dry.  Also the receptionist provided us with washing powder.  So handy.  Our room was on the first floor and faced inwards so there was not a view however the balcony was south facing and got the sunshine.  It was nice and quiet.  The lift in our block broke on the second day of our stay but they were quick to get it repaired.  We did not use the pool which was quite small.  The location of this hotel is excellent, walking distance from the strip.  We found it easy to get to the MGM etc.  The only thing to be wary of is if reception mention to get your "welcome pack" and point to a group opposite reception.  They try to suck you into a timeshare.  It starts with a bribe of a free steak dinner or show tickets, then they say you need to collect them from another casino via uber, then it becomes apparent you have to do this so that you go on a 90 minute timeshare presentation/tour.  We did not have time for this or the money to even think about it and they were quite rude when they realised we were not going to take them up on their offer.

reviews.title: Resort pushing it but reasonable
reviews.text: The pool is nice but small. It does have outdoor fire pits and grills right by the pool that can be used.  The restaurant is very limited and is the bar.  The room was nice with a separate area for the bed.  Elevator was out of order so had to carry luggage up steps.  The front was nice.  We Ubered to different locations. I’d recommend it if it was at the right price.

reviews.title: Great staff, property showing its age.
reviews.text: We enjoyed our 1 week stay. All the staff were excellent and helpful. Our unit was nice but the elevator broke and my disabled husband had trouble walking up and down 2 floors of stairs. We couldn’t find a cart when we needed one. The unit and amenities were clean and functional but the property shows its age and could use a refresh.

reviews.title: Very disappointed
reviews.text: Unfortunately, my recent stay at Desert Rose Resort was a major disappointment. The lack of basic amenities like housekeeping, coupled with poor soundproofing, made for a very uncomfortable experience. The constant noise from the room above, including stomping adults and running children 24/7, made it impossible to sleep, even with earplugs.The bathroom was also in a state of disrepair, especially the toilet with dark stains inside. The overall condition of the furniture and decor also felt more like a motel than a hotel.For just a slightly higher price, you can find a much better 4 or 5 star hotel on the strip (with a casino and housekeeping).

reviews.title: Marketing spill needs to stop
reviews.text: It was ok.  Clean and convenient.  The only issue we had is as soon as we walked in and checked in, we got roped into paying $100 USD for half price tickets to see a show with a spill on going to view someNew apartments so we can give good review.  When people areOn holidays they don’t need toBe marketed to see apartments.  When we got into our room I was not happy ,  we had just driven from LA to Vegas exhausted and we’reBlind sighted.  So my husband rang front desk and explained we have changed our minds and wouldLike $100 back.  We still haven’t received.We noticed that this was done to all new people that wereStaying with this resort.  I have emailedAbout the $100 refund but no one has got back to us

reviews.title: Ants, hairs and brown smears!
reviews.text: I recently stayed at the Desert Rose Hotel in Las Vegas, but unfortunately, will not be returning. There were dozens of ANTS crawling in the bathroom sink, which I flushed down at night only to find back in the morning in full force! Additionally, there was a hair on the bathroom door and a brown unknown substance smeared on my friend's bedroom door when we entered the room. (See photos) I did make the staff aware of these issues.The bathtub was rundown and in desperate need of updating. Although not a big issue, the refillable bottle of conditioner in the shower was empty, showing that amenities are not checked regularly.The hallways are not well lit. They are also an indoor/outdoor combination which is creepy at night given anyone could lurk around a corner.We were placed in a room in the last building of the resort (with a breathtaking view of the dumpster) and at the very end of the hallway. It felt very isolated and we were uncomfortable walking back to the room at night. Security was not visible in the outdoor courtyard at night, which we had to walk through to get to our room. I also discovered there are no security cameras. Given these issues, I would advise travelers to steer clear of this resort! (Unless you’re an ant.)

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Easy walking distance to the strip.  Very comfortable accommodation fully equipped with everything you need.  Free parking and no resort fee.Would certainly recommend Desert Rose.  If we ever come to Las Vegas again, we will stay here for sure.

reviews.title: Trip ruined due to room Robbery @ 10 PM
reviews.text: Check-in was smooth and there were no issues on night one, my friends and I felt safe since the only way into the building was via a door that required a key card, then a key card to get into your actual room. We left the following night for dinner at around 9:40PM and returned 1:01 AM to the hotel to find that our room was left open with the door propped open with the deadbolt lock. Upon entering the room, we were greeted to the place in shambles with clothes all over the floor, drawers opened, bathroom in disarray, water on the floor, water bottles missing, airpods missing from one of our backpacks, stolen clothes and hats and dirty/smelly socks left on the bed (a potent smell you were greeted with as you walked into the master bedroom). After complaining to the front desk, Kai, the standing manager at that time informed me that they don't have cameras surveilling the building to where you could see who came into the area (he also didn't seem like there was much that could be done); additionally, he gave us a 50$ food/drink (this didn't do anything for us in the long run). Kai sent one of their security guards to the room to gather a report, and even he didn't look like he wanted to be there. He collected all the information we gave him and the best management could do for us was move us to the third floor in another building (we were on the first floor when the robbery took place). Due to us feeling unsafe, we decided to leave the property and go elsewhere. General manger the next day (named Sara) called me and informed me that they were going to conduct an internal investigation to try and figure out how the individual entered the room. She later called me and told me that their door readings showed that the door was never closed after we left (I still don't believe thats the case). Due to the inconvenience, she ended up giving us a 7-Day free trip to any RCI location in Las Vegas. Although this was a generous compensation package, we will not be staying here again, especially considering they don't have the proper security measures to even review footage of someone that shouldn't be in the area.

reviews.title: Absolutely love the Desert Rose
reviews.text: This is our 2ndt ime here and we stayed for 5 days this time. Absolutely love this place and would recommend this to everyone i know.It's both home-ly and yet has its' luxurious feel as living in a suiteIn Malaysia, suites like these are for the 'rich and famous'. Absolute loves : 1) Amazingly equipped kichen 2) Sofa bed is as good as a normal bed! 3) Peaceful environment facing the poolside4) Free games like pool/board games5) Great housekeeping service of providing us anything & everything we needed (via phonecall)6) Because it's off-strip, it feels like we are in a small neighbourhood, although it's just a shortwalk to MGM Grand / The StripWishlist/Could-be-better : 1) a kettle (haha)2) theres the convenience of a laundry but maybe the selfish part of me wishes it could be included in the room 3) in asian countries, we have gotten so used to the concierge coming to bring our luggage up and down from rooms, but in the US, unfortunately this is a luxury that isn't given haha 4) A water filter for larger bottles filling would be great (there are drinking stations around but slightly more difficult for filling up bottles)If we come to Vegas again, we'll probably be back here!

reviews.title: A True Rose in the Desert
reviews.text: Accommodated early check-in after a redeye flight. Quiet, spacious, comfortable and clean. On sight bar in lobby with varied food choices. Alex was top notch in service and food prep. Convenient local. A nice change from boisterous Vegas!

reviews.title: Convenient and amazing staff
reviews.text: We were able to check in one hour before the checking time without any problems. The staff was excellent and always ready to help.

reviews.title: Only pay in cash
reviews.text: The Hotel itself is great, the kitchen is equipped with everything you need, the pool is lovely. However - please be aware that the Hotel prebooks double the charging rate pf the room as security deposit on your credit card. This unfortunately wiped out my credit card. I was reassured I will get it back, but of course sometimes in the future. A bit inconvenient if you are not a millionaire. And they have a massive IT security issue - we received phishing mails after we paid in this resort with our credit card. I personally would only recommend this Hotel if you are loaded or if you pay in cash. My credit card I would never hand over to this Hotel again

reviews.title: Cozy hotel close to the Strip
reviews.text: This is a cozy hotel with everithing you need for a good vacation. Rooms are clean and large, with friendly stuff and a very big parking lot (free for guests). It is less than 10 min walk from MGM Grand. The AC is too loud (the only topic which we did not like)

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: We loved this hotel. Having been on 3 week road trip and being in motels, this suite gave us so much more space. Facilities good, kids loved pool and pool food and drinks were decent and reasonably priced. We loved the craziness of the strip but was good to walk back to tranquility to escape it all…although was only a 10 min walk to strip. It was my sister’s wedding, and the hotel gave  us some complimentary bubbly to help start celebrations (shout out to Ms G for that) - helped make our stay extra special. Also with late flight they gave us complimentary late check out.

reviews.title: Ghetto Resort
reviews.text: This was my Fiancée and my wonderful treasure in Las Vegas, Nevada. However, as in life, everything changes and so did the Desert Rose Resort. I would rename it the Ghetto Rose Resort Now! If you enjoy a nice resort, pleasant clientele, security for your personal items and your vehicle, then DO NOT GO HERE!The front lobby, yes looks like as always, but we stayed in the very last building. I noticed right aways the dying shrubbery and plants as compared to the first building. It says smoke free resort, but that doesn't stop the hallways smelling like POT at times in the evening. Our shower, literally, had dirty grout that the both of us noticed immediately.The both of us noticed immediately, that this was definitely not the same type of guests as usual staying here.We had a late check out, that they offered and we accepted. However, that didn't stop the cleaning crew and a handy man from trying to enter our room early in the morning on check out day while we were still in it. We even at one point called the front desk to make sure we did have a late check out, which we did.Now lets get to the straw that broke the camel's back. I expect with a timeshare security! A resort, security! Empathy, even if you have to fake it! Taking our bags to our vehicles, my own Vehicle was vandalized! As was five other cars staying at their resort. Which they found out about it, but decided to wait until we walked out to our vehicles. Do they have camera's? Their answer no! Supposedly they have security patrolling, although, in all the times I've stayed I've never seen security "Patrolling". Their make shift security person, has me write a statement on this simple form titled by another company with no address, phone number, and the resort information no where on the form. The Manager (Maybe that's who it was), DEAN, comes out and is empathetic for two seconds until he realizes we want the damage fixed that day or money / check issued. Then he passive aggressively explained that their cash clientele got refunds, but because we are time share OWNERS we get basically a food/drink voucher and some points back. We tried to explain that my Genesis is vandalized and I have to drive across a state and want compensation. He then goes to offer a list of local places that I can fix at my own expense (Which they were all closed). When my Fiancée went to the desk, the young lady literally smirked at her as she was expressing her frustration. I guess the front desk people think this is funny. Outside talking with this passive aggressive, DEAN, he tells I just need for you to "Acknowledge" that I gave you options. I explained what you need to do is go get me your business card. At one point, he curtly pointed at the sign on the wall that basically says the customer is liable for parking there, etc. etc. They have no cameras supposedly, but they knew a car with young people speed through the parking lot taking time to vandalize their clientele's cars.Thanks Ghetto Desert Rose Resort for a memorable time. My suggestion, if your are vacationing in Las Vegas, don't trust these people, the employees, or the security....

reviews.title: Best choice price/quality
reviews.text: Top place to stay 5 minutes from the strip! IdealLucas provided an upgrade which gave us 2 rooms and 2 bathrooms instead of room with 1 bedroom and sofa bedVery friendly guy at the check-in deskBeautiful spacious living room with dining area, lounge and kitchen

reviews.title: A nice oasis from the ocean of fees.
reviews.text: Great for families, and those who don't want to breathe smoke-filled air of your typical strip hotel/casino, or tired of the strip hotel's high fees (parking, resort). If you want your gambling fix, there's the Oyo within walking distance (and they have way better odds/payouts than any strip casino anyways). While they don't have the fanciest or largest pool, there's still a pool to beat the heat, if you are going in the summer - there was even a DJ the weekend we stayed. There's also plenty of other activities on-site that no casino will have without paying like a pool table, board games, and snow cone hour. As an all-suite property, they have a full kitchen, with full-sized refrigerator, dishwasher, toaster, microwave, blender, coffee maker, and even Henckels International knives (none of which you will find at strip casino hotel room unless you stay a high-roller hotel that is also all-suite). They don't put gimmicks in the room like those sensor-based snack trays (the ones where you if you sneeze-it-will-go-off-and-charge-$15-for-bag-of-nuts). Instead, you are treated with real Lavazza coffee, Scrub Daddy/Mommy sponges, Finish dishwashing pods, and Scott-brand paper towels - all things, again, you won't find at even at the all-suite rooms in a strip casino/hotel. At night, they limit the in and out road access for better security. There's also a laundry room (at this writing it was $2.50 per session/per machine washer/dryer) for longer stays. I wasn't able to try the bar or business center. They do have a concierge desk for planning your Vegas trip, especially if this is your first time there. (Fiona in the front desk was super helpful, too.)

reviews.title: A safe and comfortable resort, suitable for a longer stay.
reviews.text: + The location near the Strip is a plus, the free private parking, the kitchen equipment, the laundry services, the fact that although we checked out at 12, we could use the pool until 5 p.m. when we left for the airport and the daily activities which are diversified are a big plus as well. There is a BBQ area near the pool, that guest can use to make their own bbq, and they can eat on the terace.+ pool is open 'till 11 pm.+ Kitchen equipped with everything you could need (refrigerator, stove, oven, microwave oven, blender, coffee machine, dishwasher, plates, pots, glasses, cutlery).- The rooms are a bit noisy, as you can hear the guest walking in their rooms.

reviews.title: Wonderful stay in Vegas
reviews.text: This place - just brilliant.Anything you could possibly need handed to you on a plate, a veritable plethora of things to do and see in the city right on your doorstep, and some of the most conscientious, welcoming and helpful staff you could possibly hope for.I stayed two nights here in mid-July with a friend, we were passing through Vegas. We were given a spacious, comfortable room with every amenity we needed. Well air conditioned too, for which we were grateful in the 120 degree heat.I couldn’t recommend this place any more, and would most certainly stay again if we were to ever come back to Vegas. Next time I might give the pool a try!

reviews.title: Fantastic resort!
reviews.text: We stayed at the Desert Rose Resort in June. 2024.  The staff were very friendly and welcoming, including the manager, Derek who was very hands on, helping out in the bar when it was busy!  This was our first trip to Las Vegas and while the resort is not bang in the middle of all the action,  it was just a short walk to The MGM Grand at the southern end of The Strip.  You could walk but we mostly used an Uber, which are cheap and plentiful.  Desert Rose is a small resort and pool area was lovely, with plenty of shade and sunbeds.  Loved the free melon slushies the bar staff gave out in the afternoons as it was so hot! We stayed in a 3rd floor 2 bed/2 bath apartment which was well equipped and spotless.  We used the laundry room on the ground floor of our block which was only $2.50 each for a wash and dry (bring your own detergent.)  The resort offers a snack menu with burgers/wraps on it.  We had a chicken wrap which comes with fries which was enough for the both of us at lunchtime! All in all we had a great time staying at The Desert Rose and glad we picked it as opposed to one of the mega hotel/casinos on the Strip as any time we were in one they were really busy and I can only imagine the bar/pool areas would be miles away from your room, put it like this, I wouldn’t fancy forgetting my sun lotion!

reviews.title: Great Week
reviews.text: We stayed at the Dessert Rose during the hottest week of the summer. Temperature was 41-44 all week. Air conditioning stopped working on the second night. Staff was quick to get us a fan for the night. Raymond, the wonderful maintenance engineer, was there first thing in the morning to repair it( Everybody loves Raymond!). We enjoyed the pool every morning! It was very clean and had lots of places to sit in the shade.  It was a wonderful week!

reviews.title: A++++ experience!
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay here. We booked two side-by-side rooms for a week. The female who checked us in was incredibly welcoming, nice, and helpful. Our rooms were clean and modern. The kitchen was well-stocked. When we needed something, which wasn't often, we called the front desk or housekeeping, and the items were brought up shortly after. The pool was busy but not terribly so in the evening when we mostly went. Parking was not an issue. We were able to get a parking spot near our units every evening. We made some great memories and highly recommend this place!

reviews.title: Great, quiet place to stay.
reviews.text: Arrived on Sunday, and our room was not quite ready. They offered us a complimentary drink at the bar, until it was ready, which was about 10 minutes later. We had a 1 bedroom suite, with a full kitchen, and I have to say, everything was spotlessly clean. They answered my request for a quiet room, on the top floor. It was very quiet, and we had a balcony, not that we sat outside, as it was so hot! the pool was welcome, even though there were a lot of people in it, but we cooled off, and then went to get the Monorail from MGM Grand, only about a 10 minute walk from Desert Rose. The only bad experience we had was on the Tuesday night 11th June, when we had been out to Antelope Canyon, so we were very tired as it was a long day. We went down to the bar to order some food, it was about 8.30 pm. There was 1 girl making some drinks for 2 people, so I waited until she finished making the drinks, and 4 other people came after me. Well she finished making the drinks for the 2 people, I was standing there with a food menu in my hand, and she completely, ignored me, walked past me and asked the 4 people who had just turned up, what they wanted. I spoke up and said that I had been waiting to order food and that I was next. She took our order and said she will get on to it, after she makes the drinks for the 4 people. We went and sat down in the lobby, and noticed another 2 couples had turned up at the bar, and she was making drinks for them too. By this time, 1/2 an hour had passed, since she took our meal order, and she hadnt even started it. I went up and said "How long will our food be ?'' She said that she will start it in a minute. Well, we went and sat back down, only for her to finally bring our meals out, 1 hour after we ordered. She was extremely rude, and actually spoilt our night, after such a magical day, at Antelope Canyon. Everyone else was very nice, and friendly. I would stay at Desert Rose Resort again, its great if you wish to keep away from the craziness of the strip.

reviews.title: Desert rose is worth it!
reviews.text: After a lot of searching, we decided on Desert Rose and we were right! Super well located hotel, just a few steps from the beginning of the strip, we walked to the Blue Man show at Luxor and it was super peaceful. Hotel staff were friendly and went out of their way to help when our English was not understood. Great, clean and complete rooms, some items in the kitchen looked like they had never been used. Nice pool with plenty of space for chairs. Access card for side entrances and also for room doors, security point.Several places to eat nearby and also a gas station nearby. Overall, I didn't have any problems and would definitely go back.On the first attempt, I was unable to pay via credit, and after contacting them via the booking platform, everything went well and I received a confirmation from them. There were several Brazilians at the hotel when I was there. A tip for the city is that we got tickets for all the shows that we bought directly at the event.There are cheaper places, but for me the value for money was excellent, and I was even able to save a few bucks by using the kitchen for breakfast and dinner.

reviews.title: Quiet, clean, convenient, close to the LV Strip
reviews.text: If you aren’t into a huge busy high rise casino hotel I’d highly recommend Desert Rose Resort. We went for our anniversary to visit some surrounding state/nat’l parks before going to a concert at The Sphere. If you want ‘Vegas’ it’s just a short 10 min walk down the street.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: Great place, good value!  If I had the chance I'd have given this 4.5 stars. Friendly staff, well apportioned, quiet and a couple blocks off the strip, nice pool area, great workout area and spacious condos.    For management the only thing I suggest is some disinfectant wipes for the exercise area.  Equipment in great shape. Thank you!

reviews.title: DRR
reviews.text: The staff and the resort are amazing. The rooms are super nice, and the location of the resort is walking distance to the action on the LV strip.

reviews.title: Worth every Buck you spend !
reviews.text: The Hotel has a lot to offer:- A nice pool with Jacuzzi - Nice and spacious rooms with Balcony and Kitchen- Mostly you might be lucky to get a parking space very close to your room - Designated Smoking Area (its a gazebo with a place sit)- 10 minute walk from Vegas Strip- 5 Minute drive to Fabulous Vegas sign Suggestion for improvement: Security guys could be a little more courteous. My child was dragging 3 suitcases while i was checking-in and he asked one of the security guys if he could help and reply from the guy was very blunt, “Why should i help, It’s not my Job”.

reviews.title: Perfect stay!
reviews.text: I absolutely LOVE this place. This is the first time we have stayed here and it exceeded our expectations hugely! The rooms are large with a well equipped kitchen area and a nice lounge area. The beds are very comfortable. All of the staff were exceptionally helpful, friendly, courteous and professional from the front desk staff to the bar staff. The pool area is great with plenty of loungers. The food was reasonably priced and tasty. The grounds are well kept and it is nice and quiet at night and within walking distance of the strip. All in all a wonderful stay and this will be our first choice for future trips! Thank you Desert Rose Resort.

reviews.title: Clean and Quiet..
reviews.text: We were in Las Vegas for our friends destination Wedding. More specifically, an Elvis Wedding at the "Viva Las Vegas" Wedding Chapel, Elvis officiated. Our wedding party arrived at the Desert Rose Resort on Tuesday and stayed through the weekend, some stayed until Tuesday, as we did. I can say that the Resort was well maintained, clean and quiet. Our room was away from the pool and parking lot, so there was no noise. None of our group of 10 rooms had any issues with their rooms. The Resort has a small but efficient bar. The bartender McKayla, was always friendly and was quick to learn our names and usual drink preferences. The pool area has several lounge chairs, beds, tables, umbrellas and a nice BBQ area for all to use. The Resort is a short block walking distance from OYO and MGM. After spending all day and or night on the Strip or on Fremont, it was nice to relax and unwind away from the lights, noise and traffic. The Resort staff was friendly and available. Taxi's and Uber's were always nearby. Whole Foods was 2 miles away and delivered to the Resort. The Resort Manager, Derrick was always a pleasure to talk with. It seemed that he was always busy helping out the staff, whether serving a drink at the bar or making a killer double cheeseburger... Oh, his secret is that he toasts the buns.  All in all, I can say that we had a wonderful time at the Resort.Sadly, I don't have any pictures of the Resort.

reviews.title: Nice property in GOOD location
reviews.text: Nice property in good location for the strip.  Good size for a couple but a stretch for four (two being teenage girls).  Older property that seems well maintained.  Exit doors do NOT have closers so doors slam shut all hours of the night and day as people came and went.  We had end unit 2105 so heard it all.  Could also hear people upstairs and at times sounded like a herd of Elephants.  Nice staff.  Most places where we have stayed had books in the rooms telling us about the area and what to do when departing the unit.  Desert Rose did not have this.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem off the Strip
reviews.text: This is a hidden gem right off the strip by a 5-minute walk.  It’s nice to visit the strip but when you need a little quiet time a place like this is perfect.  The rooms are spacious with all the amenities you need including a full kitchen (fridge, microwave, stove, blender, etc.).  The pool and hot tub area include daily activities, corn hole, ping pong, and grills.  Adjacent is a bar and seating area also including a pool table.  Nearby there is a convenience store, liquor store and restaurants.  You won’t be disappointed if you are looking for a great place adjacent to the strip.

reviews.title: Springbreak with the family
reviews.text: Our two bedroom suite was clean, and spacious, with a nice patio area overlooking the pool area. Excellent location, with easy walking access to the Excalibur, MGM and other hotels.The staff was incredibly helpful and welcoming. Happy hour by the pool daily! Will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Vegas Baby!
reviews.text: Well maintained.  Friendly staff.  Good location with free parking. Quick walk to the strip and casinos.  Nice pool and hot tub area.  Would definitely stay again.  Bar has food but fairly limited menu.  Any questions or issues were addressed quickly.

reviews.title: They don’t have everything they say!
reviews.text: Under construction, no indoor room laundry, parking lots closed, no chefs for breakfast meals. The trip was not the greatest, we had to make a lot of adjustments and improvise in dropping off the family near the room and park parking in the back lot while our room was in building 1.

reviews.title: Great location and quite atmosphere
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay in at Desert Rose in Las Vegas.  This condo was close enough to the strip to play yet far enough away to relax.  The rooms are clean, the staff is efficient and responsive.  We would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: College Basketball Extravagansa!!
reviews.text: Desert Rose Resort was perfect for our basketball tournament vacation!  Easy drive to The Orleans for WCC and an even easier walk to T-Mobile Arena for Pac12.  This is a great location.  Room was very nice, had everything we needed, stayed for 2 weeks and will definitely stay again!  Plenty of room, comfortable bed, fully stocked kitchen.  Only short coming was no washer/dryer in unit but did have a common laundry on site if needed.  Nice pool area and had fun and engaging daily offerings, loved the snow cones every day!!  Enjoyed this resort very much and will return.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: We enjoyed this location. The pool area was exceptional, the rooms were updated and the staff were friendly.It is off of the strip, yet accessible by a short walk. The quiet location was appreciated. .

reviews.title: L. Gregg
reviews.text: Ideal location to the strip, attractions, airport and other things to do.  The property was very clean.  Bar of property that served food.  Excercise center, recreation with pool table.  Also had computer center.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.

reviews.title: QUIET PLACE TO STAY
reviews.text: My spouse & I went to Vegas for a few days.  Since we are not gambler, we opted for a place that doesn't have a casino or slot machines.  We also wanted something more spacious than just a regular hotel room.  Desert Rose Resort is slightly off the strip, so it's much quieter.  Yet it's only about 10 minutes walk to the strip.  It fits perfectly with our daily exercise.  The resort consists of 4 buildings.  Based on the review I read, some rooms could be quite noisy.  We called the resort before departure and specifically asked for a quiet room.  We were given a room on 2nd floor in building 4, which was basically facing the back.  Although it lacked any view, it's definitely quiet. The room was a one bedroom suite with a living, dinning area & a full kitchen.  The kitchen was well equipped and clean.  The bed was pretty firm and pillows were firm and comfortable.The reasons I gave it a 4 stars was there was no bug screen on window or patio door.  I'd like to open the window or the patio door for fresh air, but worry about any bugs or flies coming in.   Also, there were times of the day that both the cold and hot water taps have hot water only.  I had to let the cold water tap run for at least 5 minutes for the water to turn warm.

reviews.title: Never got a good night's sleep. Rooms too bright and noisy.
reviews.text: Arrived around 5PM on our check-in day, and the process was very easy. After check-in the representative sent us to another desk across the lobby for a “free gift”.  Beware, that the other desk is a sales rep trying to get you to sit in on a time share presentation. They don’t actually tell you this. They just say, go over to another property at a specific time and we will give you a $100 gift card and a two-night stay at another property. The lady kept going on and on and we just wanted to go to our room.   I kept saying we were not interested, and she didn't want to take no for an answer.    When I made the reservation I asked for a quiet, top-level room. We were given a 2nd floor room.  Upon entering the room, everything looked very nice with updated carpet and living room furniture. However, the furniture was as hard as a rock.  The bathrooms were a bit small. When we went to use the shower, the shower bottom was very slippery and there was zero water pressure. The kitchen had everything we needed to cook a meal. There were several closets and lots of space to put your clothes. The pool looked nice and inviting.  We could hear people upstairs moving about and it sounded like they were moving their luggage around at odd times during the night.There were curtains in the bedroom, but because of bright security lights outside, they did not prevent the light coming through.  It seemed like 6 a.m. when it was really midnight.  At 7:00 a.m. we were jolted awake by a loud banging and beeping noise from outside. It was the trash trucks at the dumpsters. This happened 2 of the mornings we were there. So much for my request for a quiet room!  I don’t know why they didn’t honor my request as the resort did not look busy.  If you want to get a good night’s sleep, I would not recommend this property.

reviews.title: Nice Little Resort
reviews.text: Great Little hidden treasure. Staff is great, & the location is just off the strip. The resort is just behind the OYO casino. The rooms are small but clean. Access to the airport, strip & the freeway is great. We didnt have any problems during our stay. The kitchen is fully stocked for cooking & the dishes/ pots & pans were of good quality. There's security patrolling the parking lot for the guess protection. I will defiantly  come back.

reviews.title: Top Floor Only
reviews.text: Condo itself is nice. 2-bedrooms, 2-bathrooms, full kitchen and living room. It was clean, fully stocked, and had everything we needed. The location was okay….. easy walk to MGM and very easy to find. The reason for the  3 stars is because of the noise. We stayed in a downstairs corner unit. The outside noise was annoying, BUT I could’ve overlooked it. The problem was the noise from above. The ceiling creaked with every footstep and it sounded like they were going to step through and come down into the bedroom. We could hear the toilet flush from above. We could hear the showers. Everything they did upstairs was noisy downstairs. It was so loud one night that I went to sleep on the pull-out sofa bed. Big mistake! It was SO firm that it felt like I was lying on the floor. After about an hour of lying there, a spring broke.  Needless to say, I did not get much sleep that night. Would I stay there again? Yes. Under one condition: I will only stay on the top floor so that there isn’t noise from above.

reviews.title: The Hotel was really nice
reviews.text: The place was very clean and organized. I liked how everything was set and the front desk was very polite. I just did not like how small the gym was but overall everything was wonderful. The location was also really good!

reviews.title: A very calming and welcoming resort just steps from the South end of the Strip, perfect for Allegiant Stadium and the casinos.
reviews.text: A very calming and welcoming resort just steps from the South end of the Strip, perfect for Allegiant Stadium and the casinos.

reviews.title: Great Location and Friendly Staff
reviews.text: We stayed at a spacious one bedroom unit and it had everything we needed. We liked that we could easily walk to the Las Vegas strip from the resort. The staff was very accommodating with all of our requests. Unfortunately we didn't get to try out the pool or hot tub as it was unusually cold and raining when we were there in early February. We would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Great location to MGM
reviews.text: Excellent location - only a 10 min walk to MGM grand.  Room was clean except for the balls of hair that were on the carpet in the bedroom.  The Cleaning people need to sweep better.  Pillows were fluffy and bed was comfy.  Bathroom/shower area was a little tight.  Other than that, we would prob stay here again.

reviews.title: Would stay again!
reviews.text: Good location, within walking distance of the strip.Good service.Everything was clean, in good shape, with good bedding and a very comfortable king mattress.We thoroughly enjoyed our stay here and would stay again!

reviews.title: Check in nightmare...
reviews.text: We waited a long time to check in. Queue for about half an hour. Maybe it's normal in Vegas, but it works better in Europe. The room is fine, the pool is pleasant, only some guests behaved inappropriately (drinking in the pool, etc.). The location is OK. Very near to Strip and also near the airport.

reviews.title: Smelly, noisy rooms
reviews.text: The room smelled like marijuana when we checked in. We were moved to another room which was better but the elevator also smelled like marijuana. We were unable to sleep due to all the noise outside when people were just arriving and or leaving. Will not book at this location in the future.

reviews.title: Few days in Vegas
reviews.text: Even though we had a room next to the road and lobby, it was very quiet. The kitchen has enough cookware to make most basic dishes. Full size fridge. The living room was comfortable. It was a very short walk to the monorail.

reviews.title: Excellent place to stay!
reviews.text: I would definitely recommend this Condo/ hotel. It was clean, comfortable and spacious. We liked having 2 bathrooms and 2 bedrooms. I would stay here again.The pool was heated and the hot tub was great. It is only 2 blocks off the strip, so was convenient to come and go to.

reviews.title: Excellent visit - stay at the Desert Rose for the holidays!! Sarah and Tiara at the front desk did a great job!! Rooms
reviews.text: Excellent visit - stay at the Desert Rose for the holidays!! Sarah and Tiara at the front desk did a great job!! Rooms

reviews.title: Excellent
reviews.text: Upon getting there we got greeted at the door and registering was fast the clerk was very sweet and all smiles the whole time, she showed us where our would be, later we called we needed batteries for our remote and extra blanket and there were there in kess then five minutes,, great service

reviews.title: My Happy  Place
reviews.text: We took a 70 days vacation  tour of America  and spent our last 20 nights  at the Desert  Rose. For our first 10 nights we stayed  in  4201 a 2 bed. My Husband  and  l had invited  my Sister and Adult Son to stay with us. 4201 despite  been  outdated was clean with a amazing  view of our Hire Car in the car park and the Strip Hotels= Mandlay Bay, Luxor, Exculbur, New York  New York, MGM, Tropicana, Oyo.  The Bathroom  was a Handicapped  one but one  could not complain  as we had a early check-in  and  amazing  views.  We drove to Los Angeles  for  2 nights and spent  1 night  at a Freemont  Street  Hotel. As a family we used the Gym and shower, pool and spa and sunloungers and bar. We used the laundry  several  times.  Rather annoying  that out of 3 washing  machines only 1 working.  As a Family we had a fabulous  stay. All our maintenance issues  where swiftly  dealt withAfter 10 nights and the Sister and Son had returned  to the UK  we moved  to 4205 a 1 bed  and  once again early  check-in.  We had another  fabulous  stay. The only 2 spoilers  was that the weather was  not hot hot and the balcony  had a overhanging plant  covering  half  the balcony  thus blocking the limited  sunlight.  On our last night the Husband  and  l  used the  BBQ  and  fire pit and it was rather  romantic. I will admit  that  I  a very difficult  person  with high expections  expecially when paying  large sums of money.  Hence  l would like to apologise  to all the Reception  Staff  who dealt with me. I would like to  thank them all for their excellent  Customer  Service  and l am in awe of their professionalism and  politeness. Also thank you to Jayden the Assistant  Reception  Manager  for taking away the check out stress. Also a shout out to all the Staff who make  the Desert  Rose  Resort  a fantastic  place to stay.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: We had an excellent time and stay in this resort. Loved it because it was walking distance to the strip so we can explore and enjoy our stay. It was a perfect location and distance to go visit family and friends.

reviews.title: I Would stay here again
reviews.text: A lovely place to stay away from the noise of the strip. Our room had a fully equipped kitchen, it was clean and comfortable. We didn’t have any issue with noise but it was not peak period The monorail was an easy walk. The airport was easy to get to as well. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: It is way better staying in a resort like this than to stay in a hotel.  Everyone was friendly.  Being so close to the Strip was a bonus.  We walked to everything. The king bed was very comfortable.  I wish it had a murphy bed versus a pull-out couch, but it was decent enough.

reviews.title: Walls are thin
reviews.text: The location of our hotel was decent. The pool was nice. Our balcony was nice. We had a real problem with the amount of noise here though. We were located by the stairs and the door. We could hear the door slam all hours of the night. The stairs would rattle our bed even while we slept and sometimes woke us up. I could hear any time the person above us was using the bathroom or bathtub. It was quite bothersome. Other than that, room was nice.

reviews.title: Very nice and clean hotel in a perfect location, with very good value for money!
reviews.text: A very nice and clean hotel, highly recommended! - Absolutely perfect location! Only 10 minutes walk to the Strip. This means that the hotel is in a nice, quiet location and at the same time you can get to the Strip very quickly. - You can hardly hear the nearby airport at all, so it is not disturbing at all - The hotel itself is very clean and beautifully designed. This starts with the large, inviting lobby (with fireplace area, pool table and bar) and continues through the pool area with loungers to the individual rooms. - The employees are very friendly and accommodating - The rooms are very large and equipped with everything you need (full kitchen, huge refrigerator, large sink, etc.). Everything is furnished to a high standard and very clean, so you immediately feel at home. - Laundry facilities are available - The free parking spaces are located all around the hotel. This means that the way to the car is always very short. - Uncomplicated check-in and check-out - No hidden additional costs/surcharges (billing 1:1 according to Booking.com) Clearly the hotel with the best price-performance ratio for Las Vegas. All in all, I would definitely recommend staying in Las Vegas and staying at the Desert Rose!

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: We stayed here for my 40th bday celebrations. The check-in process was easy, and we were given our room before check-in time. Our room was on the 2nd floor.The room was clean, and there was plenty of space, we had a balcony that overlooked the middle of the apartments, which was disappointing. Below us was an area which was possibly where the bins were, but it was very noisy at all times of the day. Because of where we were situated, our room was extremely noisy. The cleaning trolley went up and down the corridors, and we could hear guests in other rooms. There was a workman drilling at 8am in the morning also.The location is good, opposite the mgm and the monorail. I probably wouldn't stay here again as I was expecting better after reading all the good reviews.

reviews.title: Great hotel
reviews.text: Great hotel. We had the one bedroom apartment and it easily fitted 4 adults in there. Very clean, easy to find and a short ten minute walk to the strip. Very quiet from the room we stayed in and the check in staff were friendly

reviews.title: Nice break from the Strip hustle and bustle
reviews.text: Rooms comfortable and clean. Off the strip for a nice break from the crowds, yet close enough to enjoy all Vegas has to offer.  Free parking a plus. Enjoyed the pool and hot tub as well.  Definitely our go to for future trips.

reviews.title: Alright
reviews.text: Visiting this establishment for the second time, very well located a few minutes from the Las Veags strip, well-equipped room, equipped kitchen with oven, microwave and dishwasher, free parking, swimming pool, balcony, air conditioning

reviews.title: Great apartments in a good location just of the strip
reviews.text: Just got back from the desert rose resort.  The hotel is set back from the strip but within easy walking distance.  The pool area is kept clean and when we stayed had lots of beds available.  The pool area also has a nice relaxed seating area with fire pits to sit in the evening after a long day exploring Vegas.   You can buy pizza's and a variety of other food from the bar if you just want to stay in.  The staff are a credit and always there to help.  We had a family room which had full kitchen facilities if you want to cook for yourself.  The pool area had BBQ facilities if you fancy a BBQ.  I would definitely stay here again but if you want 24/7 gambling stay in the big hotels but if you want some time away from the hussle and bustle of the strip definitely stay here.

reviews.title: very much worth it
reviews.text: Spectacular 1 bedroom with enough room to swing a cat. 2 TVs. Everything spanking clean; everything worked. Kitchen better than at home. Full sized refrigerator, conventional oven, microwave, coffee maker, utensils.  Great sofa in living room.  I had a 2nd floor room with balcony facing West, with an upward NW view of the top of The Tropicana.Uncovered FREE no hassle parking had no shade = my car very hot, very convenient to quickly come and go.  The pool was a bit of a buzz kill compared to adultish, swanky strip resorts. When I was there, there were 4 children about age 5 - 7 all wearing life vests and treading water in the smallish pool.I used Wyndham points for a totally free two nights (no, I didn't have to pay a resort fee or parking.) Stayed Friday and Saturday night 7/7, checking out Sunday 7/9/23. Very busy time of year, obviously. Paid cash for candy bars available at front desk. Pool table in the main lobby. My particular building was connected  (indoors and A/C) to the main lobby building via stairs.Building set up is about 8 identical buildings built in a rectangular fashion, with OUTDOOR hallways forming an outdoor rectangle. Just 1 elevator per building, but it was OK. 3 story buildings.

reviews.title: A hidden Jem among the Giants
reviews.text: The Desert Rose turned out to be a wonderful property. Every employee I meet here was kind and helpful. They showed interest in how your stay was going and if there was anything they could do to make it better.  Really this is the first time I traveled somewhere that every person I encountered was terrific. This is an older property but the rooms are updated and, there are only 3 floors to worry about. The strip is just down the street. I stayed 5 weeks at his property and loved every minute. I had to move down the street to another on and wish I could come back. Thank you for all your hard work and what you do at the Desert Rose.

reviews.title: Nice to stay
reviews.text: This hotel is delightful, it has an apartment complete with coffee maker, refrigerator, stove, ovens, dishwasher.Very comfortable living room, kitchen, bathroom!Bedroom with a huge bed and a very comfortable sofa bed in the living room!It's just not on the trip, but it's close!We had to walk a little to get to Vegas Boulevard

reviews.title: Mediocre place to stay
reviews.text: Stay here due to great reviews.  I am not sure where to start.  We was given a room on the first floor next to elevator so we could hear people coming in and out if gate and laundry room.  Our room was not clean.  There was food crumbs in living room , tub dirty with hair in shower.  We rented a two bedroom.  It was very small.  This is a three star resort.  The pool is very small. Resort does not offer much.  The furniture is similar to a best western.  This is not a high end resort.  If you are looking for an average place to stay with no frills.  This is the place for you.  It is very close to the strip near Mandalay Bay.  The bed was very comfortable despite the room being very small.  The bath tub in master bed room is similar to a giant dog bed.  If you are from another countries this place would meet standards due to the fact that they are used to small spaces. No room to store thing on sick.  For two people in this room is tight. I would not return to this place but it is a decent quick stay.  There is a very small kitchen which helps to make a meal to save on funs.  The space to eat is also small.  Will need to use common outside space

reviews.title: Hidden Gem  -   Very Close To The Strip. 🌟🤩😍
reviews.text: We travelled from NZ & we arrived not knowing what to expect, but WoW. Very clean & kept up together, gated & secure.Rooms are very well equipped with everything you need, home from home. Fabulous pool with array of outdoor furniture, fire pits, games area, BBQ's hot tub.
