Very impressed that both pool & hot tub had chair lifts to enable ease of accessibility for people with disabilities to get in and out of, very impressed. Poolside bar, ice machines, self laundry area Elevators to all floor levels, ample parking. Located just off the strip, 10mins walk. MGM just across the road the monorail, great for getting around the strip.  Very clean & staff are amazing, friendly, helpful & very professional. Would definitely stay here again. Thankyou Desert Rose Resort for making our stay here very comfortable & tranquil, great place to relax away a little from the madding crowds 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

reviews.title: Nice resort near the south end of the strip
reviews.text: Mid Sept visit. Resort is clean and well maintained. Short walk to south end of the Vegas strip, approximately 30 mins walk to main part of strip (Bellagio/Ceasar’s) at fairly quick pace. Approx 10 mins walk to monorail at MGM station. Some homeless in the area. One bdrm suite clean with comfy king bed. Galley kitchen. Small bathroom with double sinks, grout in shower was soiled. Clean pool area with plenty of shade umbrellas. Beautiful BBQ area with nice equipment. Fitness room is clean but small with limited equipment, however adequate for a decent workout, need sanitizer to wipe down equipment. Single elevator in the building is painfully slow, we only used stairs from 3rd level and had to carry our luggage down for checkout. Overall a good experience for a physically fit couple.

reviews.title: Costa Rican family on vacation in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent hotel to rest with the family, the room was super nice, very clean, and it is perfect for visiting Las Vegas if you are looking for a hotel without the noise and crowds of people. They have a worker named Ibanis and she is simply special, she welcomed us and said goodbye with great affection, super helpful and attentive. My family and I would return to this place. The only thing they should improve is the attention at the reception since none of the people we talked to speak Spanish, being such a touristy place, it should be an essential requirement.

reviews.title: Top Hotel
reviews.text: We were delighted. The hotel is on a street parallel to the Strip, so it's a bit quieter, which we really liked. But we could walk to the MGM in 5 minutes. The apartment has everything, the kitchen is perfectly equipped, there's a balcony, really everything you need. If you want to grill, you can even get cutlery at reception. You can even get detergent for washing at reception. Gym, pool table, whirlpool, etc., everything is available. Staff are super friendly. Good internet. Next to reception there is a mini shop for snacks. There is a bar for drinks and also small things to eat. The complex is very, very clean overall. One small downside is the poor soundproofing. When a suitcase is rolled on the floor above us, you think there's a small earthquake. The gates to the pool bang so loudly that you can't take a nap there.

reviews.title: Ideal for several days in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Very good stay in this well located hotel with free parking.For 4 people, very clean and spacious accommodation with a bedroom, a living room equipped with a sofa bed, a dining area and a kitchen. Ideal for staying several days in Las Vegas.Pleasant swimming pool and area around the swimming pool.

reviews.title: Top class !!
reviews.text: Wow. It’s not often that I see a place that really, truly impresses as this one did.  Whoever manages this hotel deserves and award.Located off the strip (short walk away) behind the Oyo, quite a good location, ample parking – even with some shade thanks to well placed trees. The rooms are in a characterless concrete complex, many windows and balconies face into the inner courtyard – but that’s a good thing, because nearby roads are noisy.The room itself was not very large, but was well planned, well decorated and in good condition. 4-chair dining table, hanging closet with a room safe, lounge with a good sofa and armchair, TV with enough channels (but no access to HDMI input which is a minus) and a small but very well equipped kitchen. Kitchen had a dishwasher, oven & range, microwave (with an extractor above the range), large fridge, filter coffee machine, blender, and a full range of cutlery, crockery, pots, pans and kitchen tools. All good quality (Zwilling knives…). The attention to detail was impressive. Under the sink there was a small box with dishwashing liquid, a sponge, and dishwasher tablets. Perfectly arranged. Other hotels take note !The bedroom was not very large but decently sized. Good bed, TV, chest of drawers. Bathroom was a touch smallish. Wifi worked fine, lighting was good (all pleasant yellow lights).Staff were helpful and friendly, even going out of their way to be so.  There is also a small swimming pool which is quite busy, and an onsite bar which does food. There are a few convenience stores nearby.

reviews.title: Quaint and Convenient
reviews.text: Love the Desert Rose, it’s pretty much on the strip but not exactly on it. It’s a crosswalk away from the MGM and right next to OYO hotel. It’s not Caesar’s Palace, the Wynn, or any of those prestigious places, but it’s perfect for families that prefer the nice and quiet, instead of the hustle and bustle that comes from staying at a resort on the strip.

reviews.title: Apartment south of the strip 7´ walk from MGM
reviews.text: Desert Rose Resort is a complex with apartments ideal for families or friendsThe apartment is very well equipped (kitchen, dishwasher) with the minimum to last a few daysNo breakfast (you have to go to the supermarket) and no convenience store in the resortSwimming pool with very good musicAccess on foot to MGM in 7’Free parking

reviews.title: LOCATION. CLEAN. STAFF. FAMILY HOTEL
reviews.text: We arrived at the hotel with the expectation that it would be a good hotel, but it is much more than we expected.This hotel is suitable for families, large rooms, all the rooms have everything a family needs. In the kitchen we had everything, and we got to cook every day and besides buying food, we didn't need anything. ( We had to ride with Uber to the supermarket, but it's a short 5-7-minute drive).Everything was clean, the Internet went great (up to 4 devices).The hotel pool was great! There was even a possibility to use the grill there, and we also had a barbecue. ( Just have to go to the hotel reception and ask for the tools for the use of the grill). Thestaff was great and pleasent. We arrived at the hotel at 8 a.m. and even though it's not check-in time, they had a room available and we  were able to check-in. The hotel is very central. Not in the center of the Strip, but a 10-minute walk, we were already at the beginning of the strip, at the MGM Hotel.We are very happy to have stayed at this hotel and would definitely recommend it to anyone looking for a hotel in Vegas.

reviews.title: Great address
reviews.text: Incredibly located parallel to the strip, accessible on foot in just a few minutes.The apartments are huge and very well equipped. It's very clean. A lovely swimming pool on site with the possibility of having poolside barbecues.Inexpensive laundry

reviews.title: Awesome location, fabulous resort right near the Strip!
reviews.text: Adorable resort for families with wonderful amenities, only a block off the Strip. Rooms were clean and modern, and amenities were on point. Service was excellent! I would highly recommend this resort for families, couples, and even solo travelers. It was close enough to walk to everything on the Strip but without the crazy parking and resort fees of Strip hotels. It had a bar, restaurant with good food, a lovely pool, nice clean gym, and activities!

reviews.title: Very Good resort
reviews.text: Stayed in a 1 bedroom with full kitchen, enjoyed staying there, staffs were helpful, nice & professional, rooms & resorts was clean, enough parking space on site, we will stay there again. Check-in and checking-out was easy.

reviews.title: We enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: Stayed here for five day's in block 3 on thr ground floor. Close to pool area.  AC was very noisy well stocked kicten (shame there was no kettle). Bed was very comfortable. Staff were all extremely friendly. This is a time share complex and we did not take up the offer of a morning talk and gift for going. All in all we enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Do not recommend
reviews.text: We barely got any AC in the bedroom. The 1st maintenance man that came said yes, sorry we know about this and that's the way it is. All the air pushes into the living room - just leave you door open. What? A 1 bedroom is billed as accommodating 4 people! What if we had people sleeping on the pull-out couch? They're supposed to freeze so we can be moderately (not fully) comfortable? I asked if we could just shut the living room vent and he said no, it doesn't work that way. He brought us a fan but due to outlet location, it really could only reach me OR my husband, not both. So one of sweated all night while the other was cold. Plus husband found the bed very uncomfortable - I thought it was OK.Next day another maintenance tech came and said well I can shut the vent for you, that will help. Are you kidding me? That's what I suggested the night before. So that helped a little the 2nd night but very wasteful since we had to crank down the ac in living room to still let it waft into bedroom.I will say both of these gentlemen were very nice.The furniture must be new - couch and chair were extremely hard and uncomfortable.  Also, toilet paper was very thin and rough - not what you expect at a resort. Overall, our stay was very, very disappointing - nothing like our last visit about 7ish years ago. I would never recommend friends or family stay here unless you don't care if you're comfortable or get a good night sleep.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: Will definitely go back and stay there again great place to Stay ,location is great, Staff are very friendly and accommodating. The room that we stayed was very clean and well arranged and everything you need is there.

reviews.title: Great Location for Family Fun
reviews.text: Desert Rose/Wyndham is a great location with free family friendly activities near by. Unit 3321: We were two adults and two children in a one bedroom/full small kitchen. Units were clean, nicely decorated, in good condition, lots of storage space, a safe, and fully stocked kitchen with everything we needed to prepare meals. Sofa bed was comfortable for the kids. King bed was comfy. It was nice to have a balcony (extension of the unit) where the kids sat and enjoy their breakfast or tablets. Outdoors: The pool was very cool but didn't bother the kids. My husband and I enjoyed the Las Vegas skyline when we walked around the resort. The grounds are nice and clean, well manicured but there is no side walks around the buildings. There is no playground or basketball/tennis courts. Desert Rose/Wyndham was still a great choice and location to join other family members nearby. There was one sponsored activity we participated: Disco Night with music and snow cones for the kids. I can't say enough about how courteous and hospitable all the staff/representatives were throughout the resort during our entire stay. Having security around the resort was nice to see since the resort have no security gates. The kids enjoyed the pool, sandbag toss, and practiced playing pool. There's a ping pong table too. There was a small store but the prices were outrages; I did buy ice cream for us to enjoy. There was a nice bar where they served fast foods. Units: I did not have much of a choice of buildings/units to choose from for our one-bedroom but building 3, 3rd floor courtyard/path to the pool was a good choice. Timeshare: We are not owners and did not participate in the timeshare presentation/gifts offered. We had an excellent experience with the front desk, and a great time overall. I recommend Desert Rose/Wyndham and will not hesitate to stay again. Thank you Desert Rose

reviews.title: Modern and clean
reviews.text: Loved the pool area, patio and pool bar. Great music. Very clean and well maintained. Location very close to the strip. Walking distance. Would definitely return and hopefully get a room that overlooks the garden or pool area. Balcony of no use if overlooking the back parking.

reviews.title: 2nd honeymoon
reviews.text: Great location. Just off the strip. Close enough to walk to the strip, but far enough away to be able hide from the insanity of the strip when you need peace. I would recommend the Desert Rose Resort to all.

reviews.title: Secret Tip!
reviews.text: Fourth time in the DRR and now I finally have to write a review. What to say - always a great experience. Everytime we had a suite with so much equipment, two TVs, a kitchen with almost everything you need to prepare a meal, a lot of dishes and cutlery, big fridge, big microwave, big stove, coffee machine with coffee etc. even a big dishwasher with the needed detergent - feels like home! Everything all in all very clean.Big bathroom with tub and shower. A big niche for the morning toilet, even with a halogen lamp.Bedding absolutely clean and big cozy beds.Ten minutes walk to the strip, no bad or naughty customers like we had several times at Motel 6, very quiet atmosphere.Staff very friendly and accomodating, lets us check in 4 hours before we had our reservation time that day!Next time we make a vacation in Vegas we will book at DRR again!

reviews.title: Great as always
reviews.text: Awesome as always, the only problem was the bed was sinking in the middle, also some housekeeper came into our room at 7:30 pm after we checked in wife suffers from anxiety disorder, and scared her because I was in the shower...We spoke to the manager Dillion and we were told she wasn't even supposed to be in that building at that time...Dillion verified who came into the room but my wife was scared the rest of the vacation due to she thought someone would come into the room

reviews.title: Cozy location just off the Strip
reviews.text: The 1-bedroom condo was really large. Desk staff was very friendly & helpful. They got us in the room early. I recommend a 3rd floor unit with no street window. We heard sirens & loud cars all night. The A/C unit also squealed the whole time it was on. Kitchen was well stocked. Listing said free breakfast but that was not the case. Location is convenient to Strip but off it which was nice to not deal with that traffic. Wish the parking was gated but we never had any issues. Pool was great. Loved that they had a water bottle filling station so we didn’t have to but a bunch of water. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Anniversary
reviews.text: Great location. Comfortable bed. Clean. Hot jacuzzi. I have stayed at the Wyndham Grand and the rooms had washer and dryer. I like taking clean clothes back home, however the stay was good. The only reason I did not give 5 stars was the air conditioning not getting cool. Cons: Air conditioning was not cold enough in the bedroom.

reviews.title: Great hotel for a long stay
reviews.text: I highly recommend this hotel. The two-bedroom apartment we stayed in was very spacious and comfortably furnished. It had everything we needed including an iron and ironing board, blender, coffee maker and 3 TVs.The staff was very friendly and accommodating. Everything was very clean and well maintained, including the pool.The area is very peaceful, quiet and safe. An excellent choice for a long stay.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Don’t be fooled by the guy at the front desk telling you the presentation for Wyndham is only 1.5 hrs. It was 3 hours of full on hard selling!! We complained, were promised a bottle of champagne…nada arrived.  Hotel is in an armpit of a location. We got a dark room in the middle of nowhere.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: I loved the hotel I want to thank all of the lovely staff that where there I  liked the complementary drinks when we got there it was wonderful I would definitely go back I liked that the room was clean but if I gave a bit of advice it will be put the stuff with sponge for dishes in plane sight

reviews.title: Still great... last time was 12 years ago
reviews.text: Great value hotel... kind of apartment, really spacious with full equiped kitchen, separate bedroom, good sleeping sofa, friendly staff and easy to reach Las Vegas strip. Heated pool is great. You can walk or take über. Quiet place for Las vegas,... action and relax.Been here 12 years ago... still great.

reviews.title: Excellent location, clean , great for families
reviews.text: Loved the location, cleanliness and ameneties. It is just off the strip 0.3 ish mile walk across to mgm grand where you can hop on the monorail and 0.5 mile walk the other way to mandalay bay. Off strip location made it quieter which we loved. We usually look for spacious units with a kitchenette if possible and this place provides that. Rooms were clean as was the premises Nice little pool with families, so good behaviour all around. Peak months i would imagine this area might be crowded . They have drinks by the pool available if desired. Gym available, albiet small. Reasonable / good security as entry into the building is with card and living areas are all fenced off. Parking directly in front of building tooBonus for me .... no smell of cigarette smoke around Overall highly recommended for families.

reviews.title: Decent hotel at best
reviews.text: The hotel was okay overall. It was clean and staff was nice and friendly and close to the strip. Other than that it was terrible. Rooms were not soundproof as we could hear the upstairs neighbors throughout the nights and the AC was loud as well. Our room was by an exit door by the pool which slammed every time someone came in or out which was extremely annoying at night. We didn’t even spend that much time in the room so it sucks to have this much to complain about. Oh and I would recommend walking to a casino as it is close but a scary walk at night

reviews.title: Nice place located near the strip
reviews.text: Nice place located near the strip.  It's about a 10 minute walk to the Tropicana, MGM, or Excalibur.  But this may not be the most interesting place along the strip.  The rooms are small apartments with living room, bedroom, and kitchen.  The bathrooms are rather cramped with the shower/toilet in its own small room.  Room was clean.

reviews.title: Nice, 1 BR/1 bath apartment
reviews.text: We were in building 4, top floor which is the 3rd floor, facing east towards the airport.  Check-in was very easy, had a late check-in at about 12:30 AM.  The front staff all were very friendly and helpful.  The room is basically a 1 bedroom apartment with a separate bedroom, living room, dining table, and full kitchen with a full fridge, range, microwave, dishwasher, plates, silverware, glasses, pots/pans, etc.  Very clean, newly remodeled building/apartment.  Water pressure in the shower wasn't very good, but most hotels are awful these days thanks to the government mandated water flow restrictors in shower heads.  We used Uber to go to grocery store Vons down the street and back, using the kitchen to prepare breakfast and other meals.  Location is right behind the Tropicana - a short walk to Tropicana, OYO, MGM Grand, NY NY, and Luxor.  Tropicana has an Enterprise Rental Car station there, which we used to rent a car to drive to the Hoover Dam and Grand Canyon West. Highly recommend both.  The walk to casinos like The Bellagio or Caesars is a much farther walk and a bit exhausting.  It's just a short walk though to Denny's, liquor store, and convenience stores. I could definitely hear the planes taking off, but they did have a sound machine I used to drown out the noise a bit.  I really thought the plane noise would bother me more than it did.  The rest of the place was pretty quiet as far as guest noise or other noise, located on a quiet, low traffic street.  It wasn't warm enough to use the pool, but it looked nice.  It was a regular sized pool area, not a huge pool area like many of the big casinos have.  Desert Rose was a peaceful getaway from the huge, busy, crowded casinos.  If that's what you want, then I highly recommend it!

reviews.title: Great sized room - just off the strip !
reviews.text: Ideal location for not being on the stripEasy access within five minutes walk to MGM or Tropicana.  The room itself was very spacious one bedroomed apartment with a kitchenette which we didn’t really use sitting area with lovely sofa and big TV. The bedroom had a large queen size bed very comfy and blackout curtains.  The bathroom had a vanity area before leading into a bath with a shower over and toilet, it was very surprising how small the bathroom area was considering the size of the overall room perfectly adequate, plenty of drawers and wardrobe space .The room is clean although slightly dated not an issue in anyway.We chose not to pay $89 per day for room cleaning, but also not paying resort fees as you do at many of the other hotels. This made staying at the desert rose a very affordable and practical hotel. We had seen negative reviews about timeshare operating in the complex. Although we were approached once we politely said no, and they left us alone.Thank you for a wonderful stay we will returnWe would certainly return back, and I have recommended it to others since returning .

reviews.title: Close to the strip
reviews.text: Clean, comfortable room with all the required amenities. Not fancy, but met all the needed requirements. Less than a ten-minute walk from the MGM Grand and the Tropicana. And the monorail is a real step saver if you want to reach the north end casinos and hotels.

reviews.title: Bad start, ok finish
reviews.text: [This is an edit/update to a previous review]People seem to love this resort. The location is great. The pool looks nice. However my daughter and I were put into a corner ground floor handicap room. The windows and balcony face a wall. The kitchen is a corner with power outlets so badly placed it's an effort to plug in the coffee maker. It's truly one of the most miserable rooms I've ever stayed in. So much for a week in what looks like a pretty resort. Apparently they're fully booked so can't move us all week. Right. I honestly don't believe that.  I suspect it's because we are an RCI exchange. We're not gamblers, we're here to hang out at the resort, explore the area a little, and this is not a great experience at all. Maybe check before you book here that you're not dumped into an ugly basement room. Staff are helpful and pleasant, but that's not balancing the rest out.EDIT: The final straw was finding a  cockroach in the corner of the room with other trash -- obviously no one had cleaned there in a long time. After this an alternative room was miraculously found for us. It was March in Vegas. There is literally no way that the resort was full. It was empty. We saw a handful of people over the whole week, so we were clearly lied to for whatever reason. The new room was much, much better. These rooms are not the fanciest. The dishwasher was grossly dirty and didn't work. BUT it was nicer than the handicap room and in the end we had an overall good experience. However, if you need a handicap accessible room, don't go here. That room was AWFUL!

reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text: Very pleased with the location and the kitchen amenities. Full size oven/range and full size fridge/freezer. Plenty of cookware with very nice fry pans. Although there were glass casseroles of different sizes, no cookie sheet or broiler pan (we made do with heavy duty foil). No housekeeping during our ten day stay, and the housekeepers don't speak English so you should google "garbage bags" in Spanish. Would love to stay again for our next visit.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay here at a great value
reviews.text: We spent 5 nights here and enjoyed being away from the strip but happy to be close by. The staff were very helpful and so friendly. The condo had all that we needed to cook some meals and we were happy that they had barbecues to use. We enjoyed the pool, hot tub and the pool table.  Thank you for making our stay here so enjoyable!

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Lovely place, the rooms are great, and the location is good. Staff friendly, and the bar and snacks are ideal to chill around the pool. easy reach of the strip. Quieter than hotels on the strip so ideal for older couples or with kids.

reviews.title: No Gold Crown
reviews.text: The resort should not be a Gold Crown.  Three trips to the front desk and new room to check in.  Toilet malfunctioned for three days,. shower and sink never drained.  The staff saved our vacation.  Frankie, Dillion and Sarah provided excellent professional responses to our plight.  The immediate and sympathetic responses were in sharp contrast to the condition of the resort.

reviews.title: Desert Rose
reviews.text: Very clean resort and the staff are very accommodating. The checkin went very smooth. It is a timeshare so expect a request to attend a presentation. Very easy to access by car, Avoid the OYO Casino, has the vibe of a biker bar.

reviews.title: Outstanding resort
reviews.text: The staff were exceptionally friendly and courteous. The resort and rooms were as clean as we have ever encountered. Only a block off the strip, so location was perfect. We could easily walk to MGM GRAND, TROPICANA  and OYO.  we will return to this resort.

reviews.title: Wonderful experience!
reviews.text: The resort is in an excellent location just off the strip. Transportation was easily accessible when walking was unreasonable. Not many restaurants nearby, but we planned for that. The staff was wonderful! From check in to check out, they were friendly and considerate. We had an unexpected injury and a lost cell phone during our stay. The staff was consistently helpful and went above and beyond what we expected. I can't say enough about the staff at this resort!

reviews.title: Probably the worst Hotel stay of my life
reviews.text: This was a rental via AirBNB. It is a facility that is actually a time share. I do not own a share, I merely rented the room.Unfortunately, my experience with the room (1101) was realistically the worst experience of my hotel experiences. The walls are paper thin and I could hear EVERYtHING above and to each side. Every time a toilet flushed or someone took a shower the sound of the running water drowned out the tv. When the AC/Heat turned on (not often enough) it sounded like a hurricane. But worst of all, was that every time someone (not sure which unit) washed their dishes or ran the dishwasher (not sure which) my kitchen sink filled up with all the ugly disgusting dirty water. In addition it smelled horrible. This afternoon, after the third time, I sought out the maintenance fellow. He said that he had never seen that before and tried to pawn it off on me that I didn't run the disposer. I had no need to since I didn't cook or prepare anything that would necessitate thatI am sorry to say that I doubt seriously that I will ever use AirBNB again and certainly not this facility. Grade: D-

reviews.title: It pays to be off the strip!
reviews.text: If you’re a frequent visitor to Vegas and not worried about staying in one of the high end hotels then you’ll get far more space and value for your buck here! Kitchen, lounge with a sofa bed, separate bedroom, lots of space. Rooms are dated and could do with a revamp but the place is kept spotlessly clean. Staff are very friendly and helpful. The grounds and pool are very well looked after. Just a few minutes walk from the strip and best of all no resort fees!!

reviews.title: Not bad
reviews.text: Room was clean & properly stocked.  Everyone was very nice.  Only problem if we were to go back is road noise from vehicles on Main Street. If we went back.  We woul ask for inside room or room in another building not facing East Reno Ave

reviews.title: Beautiful resort
reviews.text: We loved staying here!  It was very pretty and the staff were fantastic! Mina was very helpful and sweet! The location is an easy drive to everything! The room was a nice size with kitchen dining area and livingroom.  The bed is king size with easy access to the bath.  The walk to the lobby is partially indoor and partially outdoor and very well-protected.  We would definitely stay here again. Lovely property!

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: My friends and I had a lovely stay at Desert Rose Resort.  We had two 1-bedroom units across from each other.  It is located just off the strip.   It was a short taxi rides to everywhere we wanted to go. The staff is pleasant and very helpful.  I would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Nice quiet resort not too far from the strip
reviews.text: Nice heated pool with hot tub.Nice little gym!One block behind the Tropicana.Easy access to the strip.Free parking on site.Nice fire pit area!Unit was very cleaned.Only downside is for a 2 bedrooms unit: no laundry room inside unit. There is a coin laundry room on the main floor.

reviews.title: ROSE TUB CLEANING SERVICES
reviews.text: Very friendly, Rooms very neat and ambiance. Very comfortable and pleasant, Customer service was great. Value for Money Had a brilliant stay. Cannot fault hotel. It was clean, in a good location, served a great breakfast and the staff were extremely helpful. Would definitely recommend and would certainly stay here again

reviews.title: Good Location, Decent Rooms, Make Sure Door is Locked!!
reviews.text: We stayed 3 nights in a 1 bedroom apartment but I don't think I would stay here again, if I'm honest. If staying, ask for an apartment on the 2nd or 3rd floor if possible.Pros: More affordable than most hotels on the strip and no strip/tourist tax. Full kitchen and facilities. TV and sofa area comfortable. Bed comfortable and a good size. Friendly staff. Pool ok size, but we did not use it. 10min walk to MGM or Luxor. It was clean. Cons: someone tried to get into our room via the patio door at 2am!! Please make sure your door is 100% locked if you're staying on the ground floor. The rooms lead off to the carpark so a lot of the patios are not within the resorts locked gates, so can be accessed by anyone. It was pretty frightening, but luckily the door was locked and they couldn't get in. The rooms are a little dated and could do with a refresh, but nothing fundamentally 'wrong' with them. Bathroom is quite small, however. Others have said it is noisy, but we didn't experience that.

reviews.title: Rooms and Resort are Nice! But Noisy Road and Airport.
reviews.text: Very well managed Resort!But can be noisy due to Road and Airport.Front Desk staff are excellent.This is a good resort if you are seeking peace and quiet.There is no Timeshare promotion.There is no Concierge to help you with Trips or Tickets.

reviews.title: Close to the stript
reviews.text: We stayed 2 nights. Lovely apartment with everything in it you need. Has a small balcony. We felt very comfortable. Reception staff could be more helpful, and kiosk by the reception is way to overpriced. Very close to the stript, approx 10 min walk. Has a free parking.

reviews.title: Very functional and Just Off the Strip
reviews.text: This is a very good property for those looking to avoid paying "on the strip" pricing, but still being close to the strip (Near MGM and Excalibur). It is not a beautiful property and does not have with certain amenities (no restaurant, tiny bar in the lobby) but does have a pool. Good security. The staff is very friendly and efficient. Units are simple but comfortable and spacious (bed was very comfy!).  I would definitely return here.

reviews.title: Loved the family friendly resort!
reviews.text: After 1 week on the strip, we were super excited to come to a non-casino, off the strip, family friendly resort.Immediate first thoughts were that we loved it! The room was amazing! I mean, it can't compare to Asian hotels & hospitality, but it reminded us of the luxury in those hotels.Large king bed, plus another large king pullout sofa bed!Dishwasher, Insinkerator, all kitchen utensils, cooking hob and hood, pots, pans, glassware!The hotel even provides us with dishwasher liquid and powdersThe carpets were clean (didn't feel like shoes walked on it)Toilet was small but cozyThe toilet basin is outside of the toilet, making it convenient for concurrent toilet usageOur balcony faced the Quail air center, felt very suburban, but had traffic and lots of police sirens throughout. Didn't bother us too muchThe pool is semi heated, the hot tub is lovely.Free table tennis, free pool Table, 4 BBQ pitsPool is open until 11pmFree parking!They provide wristband room card access which are SUPER convenientDenny's diner is within 5 minutes walking distanceYou prolly want to drive for everything elseWe will DEFINITELY be back!No resort fees. In return they make housekeeping a paid-option $90/day. A little on the high side but ya we're not complaining

reviews.title: Amazing rare find for Vegas
reviews.text: A very rare find. Everything here is just perfect.Stayed here for 6 days and just checking out this morning. The rooms are spacious with a living room/kitchen separate bathroom and bedroom.Settee folds out to another bed also. 2 large screen tvs with HBO movies.The kitchen is fully stocked with all the utensils you would need, huge fridge microwave, coffee machine, blender pots, pans and cooler.Small balcony not much to see from it but it doesn’t matter the room is quiet and clean. Located 5 minute walk from the strip behind the Tropicana. Close to MGM and Excalibur.There is a few shops nearby and a Denny’s close too.The pool is average size but has ample beds and shade. The resort is access key everywhere so very safe and lifts to all 3 floors. Ps we’re on a road trip doing Route 66 and were able to do all our laundry here for a few dollars. Staff super friendly and even the detergent for the laundry was gratis.I really could not recommend this resort highly enough.Great location great staff and facilities. This is one of the only 5 star ratings I have ever given.Well done desert rose, special mention to Andy one of the maintenance staff. Really nice guy and a credit to the resort. We’ll be back..

reviews.title: What a pleasant stay
reviews.text: The resort is well located. the amenities are great the exercise room as all new equipment and very complete. The bar which is open all day for breakfast,lunch and dinner (8am to 10pm) is great . KUDOS

reviews.title: It’s a small room, ants in two separate rooms n women trying to “sell” you owners update extremely rude and pushy
reviews.text: It’s a small room, ants in two separate rooms n women trying to “sell” you owners update extremely rude and pushy

reviews.title: A Great Place to Stay close to the Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: My mother and I visited the Desert Rose Resort, on October 1, 2022, for the first time.  We had a great experience checking in, at the front desk with Ms. Savanna.  She was very courteous, pleasant, and professional. Also, Ms. Barbara was accommodating, responsive to our needs, and provided outstanding customer service and support at the front desk.  These two professional and represented your company and themselves very well and made it a point to greet my mother and I each day during our stay! We request you thank them personally, from both of us, for ensuring our 7-day stay, was enjoyable, memorable, and pleasant, because of their exceptional customer service and support.This resort was very clean, maintained, and located in an ideal with public transportation. It is located only two long blocks from the Las Vegas Strip.Mr. Renald was very pleasant, professional, and receptive in advising us the water fountains were not working in the pool and gym area. Also, he offered us complimentary water and informed us the water fountains near the front desk were operational.  Most amenities, at the resort cost extra, e.g., coffee, and housekeeping. We did not take advantage, of housekeeping; when we called for clean linen, it was delivered within 20 minutes. The front desk receptionist was instrumental in fulfilling this request.My mom and I utilized the gym, and hot tub daily at no additional cost.Overall, our stay at the Desert Rose Resort was noteworthy and extremely pleasant!

reviews.title: Great quiet stay with no drama.
reviews.text: Had a great stay here. Quick check in, helpful staff, comfortable bed and nice facilities. Was concerned that it was close to the airport, but you do not hear any plane noise here.We had a one bedroom handicapped equipped room. Quiet and very roomy for just the two of us.   Don’t know if the lack of hooks in the bathroom was because of the handicapped room, or they want you to keep everything on the floor. It also had a personal safe, which is very nice to have to store all those winnings from gambling (big joke). The full kitchen had plenty of supplies to get by, and even had a package of Lavazza coffee and a drip coffee maker. I am a coffee snob, so the pods or usual weak packets you get in most places does not cut it after the usual Vegas late night. The unit was clean, quiet and within walking distance to a couple of casinos and Denny’s.   It’s soooo nice to have close, free parking.   In Vegas this is as rare as finding a $5 table.    The only issue would be the A/C blasts in the living area, but the small vent in the bedroom makes it hotter.  So we turned down the temperature at night and had to turn in up in the morning to keep from freezing making the morning coffee. We booked via Airbnb, so your millage may vary.

reviews.title: Girls 60th vacay
reviews.text: Great location , great staff . Pool was clean and perfect temperature. Rooms a little dated but lots of updates have been done and looks like more to come . Would definitely recommend this place and will be returning

reviews.title: Great place to stay with a car
reviews.text: Our unit was LARGE, well furnished with a great kitch.  We really could not have hoped for more.  We didn't have a car so our walks everywhere were a little long (bring a car) but everything about the facility is absolutely excellent.

reviews.title: Excellent and amazing
reviews.text: We decided to stay away from gambling facilities and it was a great choice. Excellent parking, excellent service, Barbara who checked us in was excellent, other Staff through our stay was also very helpful. Located a few yards from the main strip, walk there and easy to drive there. Room - you don't need more. Bedroom, kitchen, lounge and meal. We could cook and eat. Room service excellent, just ask and you have it.

reviews.title: Smaller than most vegas timeshares
reviews.text: The place was very clean and secure. If you are looking for something close to the strip, Allegient stadium or anywhere  south strip, its hard to beat this location. Just me and the wife went, and if there had been another couple with us, I believe the suite would have been too small. Tiny bathroom. You have to step into the tub to get the bathroom door closed, As usual with Wyndham, the place was clean, the staff was friendly and helpful and the roving security force made us feel safe and secure.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: Stayed at Desert Rose Resort for 3 nights. We arrived after midnight for check in. Staff is very friendly. Our room(appartement) was very clean and spacious. The beds are good. Food(pizza) was not very good. You are better of eating outdoors. The DRR is located approximately 500m from MGM Grand and therefore a great base for exploring Vegas.An other reason we chose DRR because they don’t have resort fees or other hidden fees.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: We stayed for 3 nights in a 2 bedroomed apartment. The room was comfortable with a full kitchen so we were able to make ourselves breakfast in the morning. Free ample parking was a definite bonus.  It was one block back from the Strip which meant it was much quieter.The property is located about a 10 minute walk to MGM and the monorail. The property is very secure with locked gates to the guest room buildings, with security staff walking around during the evening/night.We would stay here again.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: Really enjoyed our four night stay here as a family of five the two bedroom apartment had ample space. Nice having a balcony in room too. Staff were really friendly. Location toMGM grand is ten minutes walk same distance to Luxor and Excalibur if you walk round the back. I do feel that something ought to be done about the smell of marijuana coming out of some of the rooms. Management need to control this more and not turn a blind eye.

reviews.title: TERRIBLE with a CAPITAL " T" !!
reviews.text: Almost EVERYTHING about this place was SUB STANDARD as far as what a timeshare property SHOULD be like !! From the TINY ROOM AND BATHROOM to not having a jacuzzi to being CHARGED for a FEW PACKETS OF MAYONAISE it was a DISASTER from START TO FINISH ! The only thing that separated THIS DUMP from a Holiday Inn is that there was a KITCHEN IN IT ! I'll NEVER stay there again FOR SURE !!

reviews.title: Great location, staff, and grounds
reviews.text: The plus points are that every single member of the staff was friendly and accommodating to the greatest extent possible; the grounds and pool area were pristine and attractive; free parking onsite was wonderfully convenient; the location is convenient and would be ideal in cooler weather where you could walk to more attractions; the fitness room was well-equipped; the appliances worked well and the water pressure was excellent. Our unit had not been cleaned well. The units have been updated since the website pictures but, unfortunately, poor design choices were made.  The units and furnishings are dark and not particularly comfortable; the wall art is dreadful. It seems that every unit is a trade-off, so you have to pick your poison:  bad view, very little natural light, proximity to next-door casino with very loud outdoor music, proximity to smelly dumpsters.  The website shows a lovely low-threshold shower.  We learned that now this is only available in accessible or handicapped rooms.  Otherwise there is a brand new tub that is a whopping 16-18" to step into. Wi-fi signal was not consistent. All that said, we might stay there again if 1) we could check in early in the day to get maximum choice of units; and 2) it was a different season so the temperatures would be conducive to spending more time outside the unit.

reviews.title: Comfortable, convenient, friendly
reviews.text: We really enjoyed staying here. The staff is very friendly, especially the bartender, Jeremy! The rooms are nice and had everything we could want. The location is very convenient for the south end of the Strip. We could walk to the Tropicana and Mandalay bay casinos

reviews.title: Nice condominium
reviews.text: Its a time share that offers hotel service. It does not charge resort fee however they charge for a daily housekeeping (around $89 per day optional). The condo has two instances, a bedroom and a living room. Each one has a TV. It also has a small kitchen and a dinning room. The AC is centrally controlled.The elevator has issues, sometime you need to wait, some times it does not work but it is a 3 levels builds.The pool and the jacuzzi worked fine.The location is good, 10 min walk and you are in the stripOur overall experience was very good.

reviews.title: Vegas vacay
reviews.text: This is one of our favourite resorts due to being off the strip so it is quiet with a nice pool and BBQ area. Staff is very friendly and helpful. Room is very nice and spacious, beds are comfortable we usually try to stay here when in Vegas.

reviews.title: Good accommodation in a good location
reviews.text: Positives - the two bedroom apartment we had was fantastic and very well stocked. We enjoyed having the space and being able to order in food one evening.Location is fine, we got ubers most places but the Tropicana and OYO are both quite close, and we walked to both of these and to Denny's one morning for breakfast.Staff were all lovely, and check in was smooth!Negatives - the lift absolutely stunk to the point that we were all dreading getting in it.The pool area was very crowded the days we were staying, but did seem nice.The outdoor areas didn't seem particularly well looked after. The bins were over flowing and it didn't seem particularly safe - although we just didn't go out in the evening!

reviews.title: Great place close to Strip
reviews.text: We stayed for two nights at the Desert Rose in Las Vegas in June 2022.  The hotel was very comfortable with our suite that included a full kitchen and a separate bedroom from the pull out couch our kids used.  The property is very secure with locked gates to the guest room buildings.  The kitchen was very well appointed with dishes, glasses and flatware, and some cooking pans for the stove.  The parking lot was very tight for large vehicles and the pool area was not smoke-free.  Those were the only two cons.  The location is only a short two block walk to the Southern end of the "Strip" at Tropicana.  Although it is butted up against the airport, the jet noise was not an issue.  This would be a great place for anyone to stay, especially if it is an extended stay.

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Great place with staff trying to help all the time when I had questions. It was a perfect vacation.The mattress needs to be change though.I just hop for the day when they will provide real coffee machines instead of old style coffee maker with filter.

reviews.title: The service is awesome at Desert Rose Resort!
reviews.text: This is our 2nd time staying at Desert Rose.  The location is wonderful, parking is free and the rooms were big enough for my travel party.  The wrist band room keys are geniius.  The only downfall is the slow elevator.

reviews.title: Desert 🌹
reviews.text: This resort is very helpful if you want to save gas since the strip is a 10 minute walk. And especially now that they charge parking in every casino. The poor is very clean and security is always walking around and parking is very convenient. The staff is very friendly. They have a patio for you to just chill out side and draw your clothes after you come out of the pool in the patio and you can try with the sun hitting it. What kitchen is very small. Restroom is located in the room which was hard to use at night when everybody was asleep since me and my older son stepped in the couch and my wife with my little one slept in the bed. Because when you do use it you wake them up whoever sleeps in the bed. The AC is very loud. The door's hard to close in the restroom since the restroom is very small.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: Desert Rose is a good Resort and within walking distance to MGM and the strip.  The only problem was it was not very clean in the room.  There was food left over from the last stay under one of the tables. The tub was not cleaned from the last stay and the floor seemed to no be vacuumed.

reviews.title: Good space and convenient
reviews.text: It’s actually nice not to stay in one of the big hotels as I hate walking through the thick cloud of smoke every time I want to go outside. There are 4 buildings with the parking around the outside so nice and convenient if you are in and out of your car. A good block and a half to the strip which is fine. Was nice to have a lounge room, full kitchen and second TV, lots of space to spread out. Check in was quick and easy. Some strange hairs on the floor behind the door, but otherwise the place was clean. Would happily stay again.

reviews.title: Shells Desort Rose Resort
reviews.text: Was a very nice place!  The rooms and pool area were very good.  Can easily walk over to the strip so didn't have to drive.  The staff were very friendly and helpful!  The manager was diligent is assisting us with whatever we needed.  We would stay there again.

reviews.title: Enjoyable stay!
reviews.text: We liked having a full kitchen and being able to cook some meals. I enjoy more space. Nice pool area. Location is very good. Short walk to the Strip. Great early check in with Grisselda. She was very personable, and welcoming.

reviews.title: Nice location but needs updating and better cleaning
reviews.text: We booked through airbnb and thankfully got a cheap rate because this place needs better cleaning and some updates.  The rooms are laid out great, but the cleaning is lacking.  The shower pan still showed black, the grout and caulk was caked in places.  The master had all these setting but the only real setting you could get to work came out so fast it pelted you.  The floors didn't even look like they were vacuumed good so we requested the floors be cleaned again.  The mattresses were old and had some spill or sweat stains and dirt specks on them.  Behind furniture and appliances was caked with dirt and dust.  They didn't even bother to vacuum under the edge of the couch.  One bathroom door looked like a dog chewed it up.  The baseboards and corners were dirty.  I looked at another unit to possibly move and with a quick look at beds seemed to be the same so I requested they re-clean the floors and check the mattresses for themselves. I don't think they did honestly.  If I were an owner and walked into this place I'd be seriously upset at the amount of money people pay for these things.  Seems they spend all the money keeping the lobby nice.

reviews.title: This is an older unit and does not deserve a “resort” description
reviews.text: Furnishings, bedding, bathrooms/tub caulking, etc are old and rundown.  The AC units are HORRIBLE!  We had 3 rooms and all were the same.  When the AC units kick on, you can’t hear the TV.  The air is either too much or not enough.  Regulators did not function.  Would NEVER have considered this a resort.  Rooms are a good size, just needs a total overhaul, it’s an old hotel !  Would not recommend, nor ever stay here again.

reviews.title: Spacious room, great service, located 15 min walk from the Strip
reviews.text: We were checked in in a fly, very professional. Got a arm band as room key. We were in room 3107 and next to the street. A bit of the heavy traffic is heard during the evening but at night it is quiet. The mattrasses are very soft and have nice sheets and blackets. The carpet was spotless, the shower had good waterpressure and a curved shower rod. Unfortunatelly no breakfast was included and the food bar wasn't open at convenient hours for us but we still had a perfect stay. We will return

reviews.title: Average. Money grabbing
reviews.text: Stayed 4 nights. Had to pay a 2nd time as the hotel booking agent wouldn’t move my booking due to covid and the USA not allowing tourists… still disputing with my credit card provider.Hotel is nice and spacious, facilities are ok, it’s off strip so saves you the rip-off strip tax and parking fees etc.We had no hot water for a whole day we were there, no apology from hotel. Also no housekeeping, they blame covid… but they’re happy to clean for $90!! Just another money maker for the hotel.Probably won’t be returning.

reviews.title: Spring Break to Zion National
reviews.text: Location - tolerable. Resort - comfortable during the day. Staff - helpful. Wouldn’t stay at this location again due to the proximity to Las Vegas strip. Resort allowed people to check in for short stays not part of the vacation club. Drunk smokers by the pool towards day end. Not appropriate for teenagers or families. Trash cleanup was upon request and left in hallways during the day. Back gate propped open occasionally and anyone could wander in. Not a place we would stay again.

reviews.title: Desert Rose resort
reviews.text: Units need some upgrading.  Hot water and water pressure in the showers were not good.  Ice melted in the freezer in our room.  Staff was lovely and very efficient.  Grounds were well maintained.  Gym could use some updating and cleaning and the water didn't work to fill your water bottles nor were there wipes to clean your equipment post use.

reviews.title: It's a smaller resort, yet has all you need. The location was wonderful for what we had planned.
reviews.text: We really enjoyed the resort, and the pool is heated. The only downside was the workout room was closed. They did offer a sister resort to utilize their facilities; just wish it was on-site. We are considering coming back in the future.

reviews.title: Good times!
reviews.text: Frankie the Bartender is Awesome.  He was very nice, funny, makes the best drinks! Cucumber Melon Margarita and other flavored ones were amazing.  The nightshift manager was also very attentive and friendly,Thank you. Irene, Ceres, Sonia

reviews.title: Great service
reviews.text: We had a wonderful time here. The check in was fast, the staff were friendly and professional. Cindy and Kiana, Jesse at the pool and all of the staff were fantastic. They had security walking the grounds. They could update the room but the pool area and hotel lobby are beautiful.

reviews.title: Nice Resort, convenient and close to everything!
reviews.text: Not much of a menu serving at the resort, very limited. The room was nice, not much of a view, but convenient to hotels. Check out was inconvenient because I had confirmed for late checkout, then the next day we were being rushed out. In the end they said late check out was ok, but by then we were all stressed and rushed.

reviews.title: Amazing Las Vegas timeshare
reviews.text: This timeshare is great.  Pictures on Rci are totally outdated.  Timeshare is spacious. Clean. Fire pits. Pool and jacuzzi.  Only downside fitness center was closed.  They do have small bar.  5-7 min walk to mgm or luxor

reviews.title: Visiting Las Vegas at the Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: The Desert Rose is close to the Las Vegas Strip which made it easy to go to shows. We also did hikes in the area and took a daytrip to Zion. The staff are friendly and helpful and quickly respond to requests. The rooms are nice, clean and comfortable. I appreciated the full kitchen. The pool and hot tub were very nice.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: Desert Rose was the perfect location for our family vacation. We were able to travel to some beautiful scenic areas (Red Rock Canyon, Valley of Fire State Park, Hoover Dam, etc.) and also dine at one of the Casinos and enjoy a show at another. As nature lovers, we were very happy with the location. Casino lovers would enjoy the location as well.

reviews.title: Excellent Resort just off the Strip
reviews.text: Stayed at the Desert Rose Resort for 3 days. Location is fantastic. Close to airport. Just 10 min walk to the strip. Room was huge and well equipped. Pool/ hot tub/ BBQ  area was really nice and very well used. It felt like a community with 2  or 3 gas fire pits with chairs around.Best part of the resort was the staff. Super helpful and professional.Special shout out to the Front Desk Manager - John who really went out of his way to accommodate me when I had a bit of a health issue. Thank you!!!I've already got my next stay booked.

reviews.title: Pleasant resort stay
reviews.text: Beautiful resort complex with spacious lobby, one decent-sized swimming pool and a whirlpool in the middle courtyard; fitness center was closed for remodeling.Visually, the resort complex is appealing; buildings are 3 stories tall.Friendly staff; We were assigned a one-bedroom suite, average size unit, comfortable bed, full-kitchen was small, but functional.  Appliances appeared to be fairly new; everything in the suite was in good-working order. No in-suite laundry; There is a pay-laundry facility in each of the resort’s 4 buildings.The resort amenities look clean with beautiful landscaping; freshly painted common areas.Our balcony faced a courtyard. Other balconies face the parking lot, others face the pool area.The resort is about 2 to 3 blocks from the south end of the Las Vegas strip; very convenient to the strip, yet far enough away from the strip to be fairly quiet. Overall, we enjoyed out stay.

reviews.title: Vegas with friends
reviews.text: Great location, could walk to strip, friendly staff. Rooms a bit small, but we weren’t in the rooms much. Had security walking parking lot and keyed entry. Dirty towels were behind door when we arrived, and towels a bit old and hard. Nice resort for a stay in Vegas on budget or timeshare. Pool area nice with fire pits, pool looked well maintained. They were doing renovations so view from balcony area not the best, but we did enjoy our stay.

reviews.title: Sad if expect quality
reviews.text: We were very disappointed in the quality of the housekeeping and upkeep of this property . We had to move rooms twice before we found a room that we were comfortable staying in. Management sounded very understanding but didn’t immediately take care of the problems in the room please look at the pictures of the first two rooms we were moved to. The towels are in the third room we remove to tattered and worn.I will never return to this location. We were visiting Las Vegas for a romantic Valentine’s Day weekend and you can imagine how my wife was feeling.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: nice place - staff extremely helpful - great location - great accommodations - very clean - gated  I would say that this location is amazing and would stay there again. the location made it very easy to go to and from the Las Vegas strip

reviews.title: A block and a half Las Vegas blocks to the strip
reviews.text: First the positive.   Resort lived up to Wyndham standards.  Staff was very friendly and helpful.  Nice pool and Hot tub.    Yes its only a block and a half from the strip.   Just remember those are Las Vegas blocks.  It is behind the OYO that has a Steak n Shake as well as Hooters.   Easy walk to the MGM where there are many good places to eat and is the south end of the monorail. The negatives.  The street and front of the resort is very dark.   Didn't feel good to walk home.   The halls have tile floors.   They are very noisy when people run suitcases or service carts down them. A shuttle to the center strip would  be nice.   We have stayed at a similar resort in Las Vegas and they have shuttles to the strip with 3 drop points and an evening bus downtown. The last negative is we wanted to ask some questions prior to arrival.   The phone was off the hook or something as we could never get through.    All in all I think this is a good place to stay

reviews.title: Wow!!  Shell Vacations Club @ Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: This facility is great!  VERY friendly staff and management team, very clean facility, convienent location, easy walking distance to the strip, gated and on-site security, close to the airport ($12 Lyft), and lots of parking, if needed.  Forgot to mention ...the weather is great in January.

reviews.title: Closest to Strip
reviews.text: First time being here at Desert Rose gave us a good experience.  Very close to the strip. Walking distance to MGM. ROOM Amenities is great. It comes with small kitchen with pots and pans, plates, cups, mugs, utensils cooking utensils, full sized fridge. It would be nice with ice maker but not a big deal. There's  an ice machine on the first floor close to elevator. The only thing missing that we really need inside room would be the washer and dryer,  which they have it on first floor using coins. It would be more convenient if the room has it. Room overall is clean. The restroom is pretty small. If you have a family of four, you have to get through the room in order to use the restroom.  The balcony is nice and have overlook of the pool. The pool is very nice and clean. Nice set up of fire places and Bbq grills. I would stay here again. Thank you for the great experience.

reviews.title: Great value for a LV getaway
reviews.text: I chose this property for its proximity to Allegiant Stadium & the price per night. No resort fees but great amenities included in the nightly charge. I was so happy that I chose this over a casino hotel. Walking distance to everything that I wanted to see, close to the Deuce stop, and a quick ride to the airport. Clean, safe, and comfortable. Perfect for this solo traveler. Great staff! Welcomed me with champagne & held my luggage securely after checkout.  I will definitely stay here again. Thank you for a wonderful experience.

reviews.title: Epic weekend ever
reviews.text: I have stayed here multiple times, and every time we return they are always a good time. The location of the resort to the strip is perfect, the amenities are perfect, the value for our stay was fantastic, and we look forward to returning here again.

reviews.title: Super recommend!!
reviews.text: Absolutely amazing!! 1) the rooms are clean, the pillows are amazing (my favorite part lol), very homey, cozy and quiet.2) the pool: clean, big and with lots of room around for entertainment (bbq place etc)3) the staff is super helpful and awesome! Travis, Terra, Cindy ate the best!!Highly recommend this place !

reviews.title: 2021 getaway
reviews.text: Rooms are average. Shower was hard to regulate. A/c unit in our room was loud. Elevator needed maintenance took forever to operate properly. Would definitely pick another timeshare hotel to stay next time.

reviews.title: Not clean
reviews.text: This place was dirty ass hell! crumbs in the bed and long hair in the shower and sink from the previous guest. They didn't even try to clean and I stayed during covid-19. Just horrible! When I complained to management, they offered to re-clean but at the point I checked out because I was soo disgusted

reviews.title: Mini vacation
reviews.text: Nice location good for a quick private tripAway.  Not too far fromEverything. Quiet location. We enjoyed the pool Sunday afternoon with limited kids around and mostly adults. The room was clean and comfortable

reviews.title: Great staff!
reviews.text: Came early, was upgraded, clean, convenient!A negative was a smoking area right outside our door, if that was even allowed. Only bothered us coming and going though.At the the check-in, we were treated very well and accommodated with an upgrade for arriving hours before normal heck-in hour...awesome!

reviews.title: Great Experience
reviews.text: My stay was 7 days. The initial room I was given was near the elevator and so was noisy so I asked to be moved to a quieter area since I was with my minor daughter. Overall the rooms were clean, bed comfy and the customer service from all the associates was very good. The location was perfect as I didn't want to be smack dab on the strip but close enough to all the action if I wanted to walk. You must have comfortable shoes walking the strip. I had to stop and purchase crocs for me and daughter as I left resort earlier in sandals. You can easily walk 5 to 10 miles in a day. Getting back to the resort... On the 5th day the water was out till 6pm but they did offer us to use a sister property to shower...  Overall I would book again as the property was clean,  no rowdy guests and the service was great and it was a great location.

reviews.title: Not clean
reviews.text: room was dirty as hell and with COVID-19...I was pissed. I did have the cleaning fee waived because I took pictures. There was a big chunk of hair on the floor in the bathroom as if no one sweeps. The shower drained slowed and the bed had crumbs and particles under the sheets.

reviews.title: Not a safe place
reviews.text: Desert Rose Resort is not a resort at all. It is an apartment-like building they are selling as a timeshare. When I booked it through Expedia it had raving reviews? Be aware the walls are paper-thin, and you can hear every door slam or conversation in the hallways. The first night the strip helicopter giving tourist rides kept me wide awake. So did the drunks in the courtyard that could fight and carry on until 3 a.m. without interference from the resort staff.The worst part of the 3-day experience for us was the pool. I booked this stay for the pool. Our trip was a hiking trip, and I wanted my daughter to have a pool to swim in at day end. When my 13-year-old daughter and I tried to use the pool and had to leave due to feeling unsafe. Adult patrons were doing many things that were inappropriate. Most things I would like to tell you about, are not appropriate to write about.  For example, three large grown men were violently wrestling in the pool with one another. One body slammed another into the poolside and knocked the cement block loose. The manager and crew came out and spoke nicely to the patrons. The manager offered the ruffians the hot tub to sit in… while roping off the now cracked concrete area.  Later, I had to whisk my child to the room, because a couple at the end of the pool were having ---- on the pool ladder.  Desert Rose Resort- if you want to be a resort, manage your patrons. You have created a very unsafe place to visit.

reviews.title: Holiday in Desert Rose
reviews.text: Good atmosphere, enjoyable food, friendly staff, with a spacial note to Mohamed Abo El Wafa from the soda bar. The beach was clean, as the water was, the pools were well taken care of. Some of the rooms may require a little refurbishing.

reviews.title: Quiet place near strip and airport
reviews.text: Walk to MGM and Tropicana & Luxor.  But quiet and a place to decompress.  We used it to go to area parks rather than the casinos.  Very well equipped time share.  Very comfortable with updated furniture.  Great bed.  Would stay here again.

reviews.title: Best stay ever!
reviews.text: Dear desert rose resort management, Mina is the best worker ever! She really took care of us and made sure that our stay was accommodating. I appreciate the extra towels and the fact that she went above and beyond the call of duty. Thank you so much Mina for taking care of us we really appreciate all your help this is the cleanest resort and it’s so close to the strip. 10 out of 10 would recommend

reviews.title: Desert Rose in Las Vegas
reviews.text: Good location, smiling helpful employees, clean unit.  We had a plumbing problem and they fixed it within 1 hour.  Our unit, 2115, had a partial view of the pool and a partial view of another building's wall.  Otherwise, a nice unit and a pleasant stay.

reviews.title: 5 stars all the way
reviews.text: Everything was easy and efficient.We had a little trouble with our reservation while check-in, and it was solved in our favor in less than 5 minutes. It was an amazing touch to make the check-in curbside from the car!All interactions were contactless. Completely COVID-19 safe. Zero noise at day nor nightime, guarateeing a perfect night sleep. Certainly a perfect choice and with reasonable fares. Thanks for this magnificent stay.

reviews.title: Nice off strip resort
reviews.text: There was 6 of us and we fit comfortably in a 2 bedroom/pull out sofa bed.  We had a couple teens with us and a couple newly 21 year olds so we decided to stay off strip for our sons Senior Year Spring Break this past March. The weather was perfect and we were able to enjoy the pool whenever we wanted, and in the evening the staff lit the firepits (I believe there were 4 of them). We were able to sit by the pits. have a couple drinks (we brought our own but you could have purchased some from the pool side bar.) It was awesome that the pool was open until 11pm. We had talked with lots of people who had been staying on strip and most were not able to get into their pool area because the hotels they were staying at were already at capacity and many sat on waiting lists. Most of the people we talked to never even got into their resorts pool area at all for their stay. We ordered some breakfast groceries and snacks, had them delivered, and the staff politely gave us a call to let us know that our stuff was there. We DO NOT recommend walking at night to or from the strip. We watched 2 people shoot up drugs between OYO hotel & Tropicana. We uber'd anywhere we wanted to go after day 1, which worked for us. The staff was great, my daughter and her friend had food and drinks by the pool one day and they said everything was great. The only think that I   was surprised about was that breakfast was not included. I had called the resort about a week prior to our visit asking questions and the girl told us that breakfast was included and that their was an evening snack of enchilada's as well. When we got there, that was not true so I dont know if the number I had directed me to a 3rd party or something, but we were surprised about  that when we got there. That is when I decided to order some groceries from a local store.

reviews.title: A nice retreat off the main strip
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort during Spring Break and were pleased with the place.  The room was more spacious than a hotel and was well furnished and clean.  The area was easy to get in and out of, and you are enough away from the strip to make it seem peaceful.  The only downside to this property is that it is near the airport and a helicopter rental place, so you will hear that all night.  It isn't overwhelming though, and my family enjoyed staying here.

reviews.title: Relax
reviews.text: Clean, quiet, and close to the strip. Nice place with a pool and hottube to retire after to the day of shopping, hiking. Heated pool,warm firepits. Bar at the pool with decent drinks. We decided to grill our dinner, so much fun!

reviews.title: Nice property
reviews.text: This was our first timeshare trip, and though the weather was not the best for late January in Vegas, we had a great time.  Desert Rose Resort proved to be nice, clean accommodations.  Though we couldn't enjoy all of the amenities due to the general weather conditions (and Covid restrictions, to some degree), we still had a great time.  Though the 2 bedroom/2 bath unit was a bit smaller than we expected, is was perfect for our stay.  We spent a fair amount of time inside as we both had to work a couple of days remotely.  Very comfortable and we are glad we chose this resort!

reviews.title: Great bargain
reviews.text: We stayed here for 2 nights. The rooms are spacious and have a full kitchen. Right now with restaurant closures and increased risk of infection, dining in is a great option. It is convenient to the strip and the airport. The staff was courteous and efficient. For just over $200 for two nights, it was a real bargain. I have seen some reviews that said the property was a bit tired and dated. I did not find this to be the case at all.

reviews.title: Holidays Vegas Style
reviews.text: Peaceful,quiet, safe! The staff was very friendly and courteous and saw to our every need.  The location is within walking distance of the "strip" and convenient to other amenities! We would not hesitate to vacation at the Desert Rose Resort again.

reviews.title: Great staff and location
reviews.text: Kind, knowledgable staff. Fantastic location. Next to OYO casino but can't hear the noise at the resort. Firepits and grills  near the pool. Front desk has a button to push that notifies the closest cab.

reviews.title: Not bad, but not expected from a Wyndham property
reviews.text: Stayed here on a trip to spend time with our kids and grandson.  We've stayed at a number of Wyndham properties and have come to expect good quality and convenience.  We were a bit surprised here.The good is that the property is not too far off the strip, if that is important to you (not for us, as we spent our time with family).  The buildings and grounds are clean, and the property is secure.  The rooms are nice, and they are clean.The not so good.  We felt like we were staying in a hotel, as everytime someone closed a door in the building, the whole room would shake.  It was easy to hear neighbors to the side and above in their respective rooms.  Washer/dryers were pay for use, where most Wyndham resort properties have washers/dryers in the room, or available in the building at no cost.  There was no ice maker in the refrigerators.  Sound from the hallways came through the walls and door very clearly.  And, it felt like this was also a residence/apartment complex, as much as it was a "resort".

reviews.title: Nice location & Staff
reviews.text: This is a 5 minute walk to strip casinos and a great value for the money. We had a 2 bedroom suite and it worked perfect for two couples. The money saved by cooking a few of our own meals allowed us to "invest" more into the local casinos. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Room is NOT Clean even though they said it was
reviews.text: I was told by the person checking me in that my room was clean and sanitized but upon my arrival and checking my room I found the place not clean at all. I am wondering if they even changed the sheets and linens in my bed since I developed a rash and my daughter did too. Not what I pictured this place to be this unclean.

reviews.title: Okay, not great
reviews.text: We booked this resort due to the 4.5 star rating and were surprised as this resort is definitely not 4.5 stars. It is close to the strip and all the staff were very friendly and helpful and the common areas are nice, however the rooms themselves are VERY ordinary, 3 star at best. Cheap furniture and decor and there was always the spell of pot in the air outside. If you are looking for a party place close to the strip then this is probably a good option, if you are looking for something upscale and well appointed, this is definitely not for you.

reviews.title: Needing some work
reviews.text: This is a old place that is trying to keep up. Kitchens are nice, but found drawer held together with glue. They want a daily cleaning charge added on due to "hiring outside service". Mold around bathtub caulking, bathtub drain backing up in use, just to mention a few problems. But unit was clean and beds where comfortable.

reviews.title: Relaxation
reviews.text: Our visit was very good.  We didn't use a lot of the amenities, but we used the kitchen to save money on breakfast.  The kitchen had all the things we needed.  The resort wasn't too far from a walmart where we got the supplies we needed.

reviews.title: Very nice, quiet and comfortable
reviews.text: We needed more room and The Desert Rose delivered. Our check in was fast and smooth, the staff was very helpful our whole stay, called the desk for a cab several times and we never waited over 10 minute. The room was clean, the kitchen had everything you would need. Room included extra trash bags, dish soap, dishwasher soap,blender, broom with pan and a push sweeper. You have the choice of housekeeping, daily or not at all, fresh bedding is only a call away.The beds were extremely comfortable, bathroom had plenty of towels, the TV’s were all HD. It’s only @ a block or so from the strip, it’s very quiet. The pool is nice, there’s a bar if you need a drink. It’s very close to the airport, @ $11 cab ride. If you want super fancy stay on the Strip, if you want roomy and affordable this is the place! Has onsite security.Steve

reviews.title: Confused by high ratings
reviews.text: Let me start by saying the staff was AMAZING.  But besides that the neighborhood and parking lot was sketchy.  The resort was outdated and run down.  The hallways outside were run down and dirty.  Our room was dirty, with black hairs in the bed.  Also we only had 1 roll of toilet paper an had to call for more.  The floors were not that clean upon arrival, thankfully a broom was in the room.  The refrigerator handle was broken and the toilet paper roll was broken.  Also why was the bath tub so high, you have to really make an effort to step over.  The grounds were well taken care of, just wish the rest of the hotel was taken care of a little more.

reviews.title: The BEST!!!!!
reviews.text: this resort was the best! close to the strip! great pool with grills! quite! but still close to the busy strip. the staff were wonderful and gave me a bottle of champagne for my birthday at check in.i had a pool view but could still see some of the strip. the balconies are spacious and the room had everything we needed from the kitchen to a over sized tub . great for everyone!!  me and my boyfriend stayed 5 nights it was like a home away from home. would definitely recommend and will be back!!!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem💎
reviews.text: The Resort exceeded my expectations, starting w/ the Exceptional Customer Service over the phone, being greeted at the front desk by Travis. My room was outstanding all around, exactly as stated on the site, definitely will be returning👍🏽⭐️

reviews.title: Worst Experience!
reviews.text: This was my first time staying here and my last. Everything looked so nice in the pictures and the reviews where great. But my experience was terrible...so bad I didn't even stay for my whole trip. My husband and I checked in on Saturday and checked out on Saturday. Yes the room has great amenities but when were ready to go to bed we opened the sheets and found bed bugs. I about died!!! To top it off when my husband called the front desk, they sent the maintenance person. He showed up with 30 mins later with bug spray and said he could spray if we wanted him to. And that they would try and find us another room. My husband told him that we rather check out and he said "oh well". There was no sence of urgency or shock. I had to argue to get a refund and I still got charged the 1st night. We had to drive back home to LA at midnight. There was no rooms available at other hotels. Plus we where grossed out. Thankfully we had not unpacked or touched the bed. But just the thought of it creeps me out. The suitcase have been sitting in my garage since we got back because I am terrified to think we brought any back. This was a terrible experience. I will never stay here again!!

reviews.title: Good hotel, Close to strip, overall average
reviews.text: Hotel was well presented, clean, a good hotel to stay in if you are self catering and are going to be out of the hotel frequently. I traveled to Las Vegas and stayed at Desert Rose Resort with my Grandparents and Parents. This was mine and my Parents first time in America and my Grandparents 17th time and had stayed in the same hotel too. The pool is small and nothing special. The hot tub was set a little too warm. Although the rooms were clean, decorated well and we got a good rest each night. Bathrooms and showers were clean. Overall a good hotel to stay in. Visited in July 2017.

reviews.title: Nice units, Close to the strip!
reviews.text: First time I had stayed here and was very happy with how close it was to the strip. OYO is right next door and we ate breakfast at the Steak n Shake which was good all days. The Tropicana was also very close. There is a tall brick wall around the property but you could cut down the driveway of OYO to get to the Tropicana. Liquor store around the corner from here. Units were clean and quiet. Front entrance is remodeled and bar was cute with being open to the inside or outside to the pool which was cool. The pool area was nice and they had a hot tub with corn hole games and grills. Overall would definitely stay her again.

reviews.title: Affordable resort in downtown Vegas
