reviews.text: We came to Vegas for the PAC 12 Women's basketball tournament held at Mandalay Bay.  We were located 5 minutes from there at this resort.  It was roomy, clean, well-stocked, had friendly staff. We hope to come back in the future.

reviews.title: treated really well got free bottle of champagne on arrival close to restaurants casinos
reviews.text: really nice gem steps from the strip very quiet, heated pool, rooms re all suite and very nice and fully equipped, tea towels,  washing up soap, spare trash bags loads of towels, balcony with furniture.checked in early and got a room straight away, casinos just down the road, steak n shake, oyo, mgm grand all 3 minute walk. easy to get to everywhere from there. loved it.

reviews.title: Comfortable resort/hotel
reviews.text: The hotel/resort is located off the strip within easy walking distance to the strip restaurants and hotels such as the MGM.The room was very comfortable  and spacious (living room,dining area,separate bedroom,kitchen and bathroom). The rooms has 2 TVs and wifi internet (not secure). The staff are very friendly and helpful. All amenities are there for your use the bar, swimming pool, the business office and workout room. There is no restaurant, gambling area or breakfast area in the hotel. You cannot take a shuttle to and from the airport you have to take a taxi ($20). Overall great place to stay. Would stay there again.

reviews.title: Disappointing trip.
reviews.text: Very disappointing vacation.   Refer to previous comments as to why.  RCI has a lot to learn about customer service. We didn't feel that our request for problem resolution was unreasonable.  Sadly the vacation time we had been looking forward to turned out to be a really big disappointment.

reviews.title: Great getaway
reviews.text: Property and amenities well maintained.  Staff friendly and unassuming.  Pool area/hot tub well maintained; best hot tub I have ever seen.  Lots of leisure areas to hang out; grilling and lounging areas well maintained.  The room suited our purpose, full kitchen if you wanted to cook on vacation!  My only downside was the size of the shower/toilet; very cramped space.  Property felt very safe.

reviews.title: Girl Trip
reviews.text: The front desk person who checked us in was friendly and joked with us. A young man/concierge offered to book shows, gave us a few tips on nearby restaurants and which casino hotels offered free parking. He briefly offered a presentation, but accepted our response without pressure, which was greatly appreciated.Our 2 bedroom/2 bath unit was very roomy, up-to-date, clean, and best of all smoke-free!! My girlfriends both commented that their beds were super comfortable - I slept on the pullout couch and it wasn't bad. The walk-in shower had great water pressure and the kitchen was stocked with everything we needed to make coffee, oatmeal and toast, and even had a bottle opener and nice wine glasses 😊 One friend had a 4pm departure flight and was allowed late checkout to hang out by the pool. The hotel is one block off the strip, across from The Luxor & Excalibur so a bit further from center strip than ideal, but the price and accommodations were unbeatable. Very pleased!!

reviews.title: We loved it will be back again.
reviews.text: When we checked in we did get a Timeshare pitch but it was not as bad as many other places, the parking was great to where our room was, I was very impressed with our one bedroom suite the kitchen had everything you need to make meals even though we ate out most of the time, I had intentions of cooking the king bed was the only thing I had a little problem with it was too hard it's great for people who like firm beds, so I didn't sleep well  and the pillows are rather fluffy but all clean, house keeping did not come to our room but that was fine we didn't really need anything, the bathroom is huge nice big tub everything was clean didn't get to use the balcony it was kinda cold and didn't get to use the pool or jaquzzi either, my husband used the gym it was nice. if we come back to Vegas next year I would like to stay again but I wouldn't buy it as a timeshare. This place was great and quiet. Jay was great to us.

reviews.title: Great place to vacation
reviews.text: We loved the place, the facilities very well maintained, excellent location, close to the street, the very nice and clean common areas, the attention of the collaborators is always to provide the service that is required for me is excellent, the costs were adapted to our budget, I would like to see the option of the same site but with more rooms

reviews.title: Excellent family resort in Vegas
reviews.text: Fantastic oasis in Vegas. Close to everything, very convenient.....but far from the crowds and noise. Excellent for families! I was here on a solo getaway and was very pleased. I’ve been to Vegas many times and never knew about this resort. Within walking distance to the strip, no resort fees and plenty of parking! Nice pool, lounge and reception area. I was never pressured to attend a time share presentation. I will be back!

reviews.title: Disappointing Stay
reviews.text: The hotel is old and outdated.  It's needs some paint and updates.  As a Wyndham owner, I am very disappointed.  The hallways are dark and need some fresh paint. The street noise was unbearable. at night. The staff was very friendly and helpful.  I do not recommend this hotel.

reviews.title: Nice, clean, super location
reviews.text: Dropped in for a couple days and nights of Strip activities. Very clean, quiet and complete 1 bedroom condo, full kitchen  at very competitive price. Didn't do the pool or social activities.. Be advised that at the time of check in they will try and hook you into a condo ownership presentation with $$$ or some future lodging and best to just say "NO". Otherwise a very fine place to stay.

reviews.title: Great place to stay
reviews.text: One block off the strip and me t to the old hooters,  it us a great place to stay.  Staff very friendly, quite and the rooms were great.  To be able to cook was good. Short walk to New York New York. The only thing we missed was a kettle. The microwave was huge and had everything you need.

reviews.title: Nice hotel deal
reviews.text: I stayed at the hotel for 3 nights, price was really good, with no resort fees and free parking. The location was right off the strip near MGM, and I walked there and to the strip with no problem . The hotel was very clean and nicely set up with a kitchen. Las Vegas food was expensive, so a couple of breakfast and lunch I did in the room, with a Walmart near the hotel.  The hotel tried to sell me a time share by offering me a free dinner show, but I didn’t buy, and I enjoyed a nice hotel

reviews.title: awesome place.
reviews.text: it was a great place to stay. wonderfull staff. they had security patrolling the perimeter. and it was real close to the strip.  everything you need is onsite or close by. i will definately be back to stay there.

reviews.title: DON FELT LIKE PART OF A FAMILY ALL NEED MEET
reviews.text: Was very satisfied with all the attention given, felt the cleaning staff did good with needed requsts,Staff at desk helped with questions, The  tickets for show was alittle less than what iI thought, over all I would stay again,  Thanks  Don

reviews.title: Great place close enough to the strip
reviews.text: I booked this place for me, my husband and kids and it was perfect. My room had a kitchen, a separate bedroom, and a sofa sleeper. The pool area was nice with a heated pool and hot tub, nice grill area, lots of patio seating. The patio fires were pretty but not very hot but totally a chill kick it spot. They have games to check out, pool, corn hole, a gym and parking. I will say though that the parking close by where we stayed filled up and we had to park on the other side of the complex. I did notice security walking around so that was nice. A weird thing was someone who worked there came into our room when our son was there to see if his screwdriver was in there. I reported it because it was weird, even if it was in there you should go get a new one or wait until we were there (not go in after knocking) or completely checked out. We would stay again if we were promised this wouldn't happen again.

reviews.title: Excellent resort just block of the Strip
reviews.text: Resort grounds, unit itself and especially staff deserves  highest grade. Unit is spacious well appointed. Staff is friendly, responsive and knowable. Resort is short walk from the Strip. We did hikes during a day and shows at night and this was perfect location. There is good chance we will book same resort for next trip to Vegas.Only negative are old and very thin bath towels in unit.

reviews.title: Close to strip
reviews.text: No complaints: clean, enough room and enough parking.  Everything we needed for a weeks stay.  Close to strip and also to I-15 to quickly go away from the strip for other activities. Ican't think of anything else we may have wanted.

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: Great location ...but that's it..very disappointed in this resort. Probably worse Gold Crown resort we have stayed in in 20 years.Baths were dirty, phone did not work, door stuck, toilet overflowed, very small units. For a Wyndham Resort...it was not to their standards. Free WIFI did not work, had to pay for better wifi if we wanted. Had to ask for extra towels, Sheets did not fit sofa bed. Will not stay here again

reviews.title: Visiting family
reviews.text: hotel in a very good location two blocks from the strip walking distance to everything my only disappointment the restroom only had one breath smell inside of the main bedroom overall the hotel was great.

reviews.title: Hate to give this Vegas secret away, but...
reviews.text: Wife and I didn't want to stay in a casino.. found this GEM of a resort 1.5 blocks from strip. Centrally located between the strip, airport, and UNLV. Super clean. Super friendly staff. At a FRACTION of high casino hotel prices. Would stay again!

reviews.title: Family accommodation in Las Vegas
reviews.text: A really good resort for family as there is limited availability for families with more the. 2 sleeping options. Facilities were great and could not complain. Location right next to Hooters and MGM Grand so good access to the Strip. Unfortunately, they placed us in a room near an exit outside our bedroom where the security door slammed and it felt like a bomb went of when ever someone used it. So after 3 nights I had had enough and complained. They moved us straight away without any issue so that was good.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem.
reviews.text: Located just off the strip with an easy walk to MGM and the strip, is The Desert Rose Resort.We have stayed here twice before but has been fully refurbished and is just terrific. The rooms are all renewed with new furniture, Kitchen and appliances, carpet etc. Best deal when looking for accommodation without the inclusion of a smoky casino, yet walking distance to the strip. We will be back!

reviews.title: Very suprised. Perfect for us.
reviews.text: This resort although off the beaten tract is perfect for people who have plan their literary that doesn't include the Strip. It's clean, comfortable and kitchen has every bowl, appliance and utensil you could ever need to prepare a great meal. Staff very helpful.  I would stay there again if I came back to Las Vegas

reviews.title: Not bad place!
reviews.text: Location about 2 blocks from Tropicana casino. Check in people very nice! Not much of a dining area 9 chairs at a bar. Had 3 one bedrooms booked with family, units had nice layout, furnishings, clean!But 2 king beds were sink holes no good. Also could hear louder noises and people upstairs or down.They had a security guard walking property.Overall would give place B+

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay in Vegas!
reviews.text: The resort was wonderful.  The staff was very helpful and friendly.  Never too busy to call a taxi for us or offer assistance.  The unit we were in was clean and lots of amenities.  We never needed to call for extra towels, pillows or other necessary things.  The grounds were lovely, lots of green grass, palm trees and flowers.  The pool was fun!  The little snack bar in the lobby offered breakfast and hardy snacks which were delicious.  The AC unit in our room was a bit loud and the bathroom was a bit small but nothing we couldn't deal with.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: We just discovered this Las Vegas resort hidden right behind OYO (formerly Hooters).  Location was perfect...within walking distance of strip.  Great not to have to drive on strip or pay the parking fees! The staff was very friendly and made us feel welcome.  No high pressure to attend a timeshare presentation either.  Room was spacious (we had 2 BR/2 BA), had everything we needed  and we could see the strip from our balcony.  We would definitely stay there again!

reviews.title: Nice place to stay. Very helpful workers, convenient to walk to places of intetest
reviews.text: This was a very convenient place to stay to visit Vegas. We were very comfortable in our room. It had a full kitchen with table for dining. They put us (SENIOR CITIZENS)ON THE FIRST FLOOR. The pool looked inviting even though we didnt  have time to swim

reviews.title: close to the strip but still off the strip
reviews.text: Nice little resort. Very close to the strip but still far enough away from the craziness.  Only issue we had was that we had ants in the master bathroom sink. Pool was very nice and clean.  Hot tub was also very nice.

reviews.title: Great Tour.
reviews.text: You really need a lot of water before visiting places like it cause its really Hot.Its also fun. You can have a great time with your family and friends. More ancient places to visit and more place to snap and have fun.

reviews.title: Vegas condo with extras!
reviews.text: Nice resort, close to a few casinos. Nice outdoor and pool area. Very helpful and friendly staff. Didn't try the bar or food, it did not appear open during our entire stay. Security was in parking lot every night.

reviews.title: Quiet and Simple
reviews.text: We travelled to the Desert Rose Resort at the end of October for 10 days. We arrived late and Check-In was great. The young ladies at the front desk were very pleasant to deal with. The resort as a whole was great. The location was perfect. Quiet and simple.  It was located a short 5 min walk to the MGM Grand.  We used the pool one day. It was heated but we never went in.  They have a pool side bar that offers food and drink as well as Starbucks coffee. The timeshare person was excellent and didn't bother us at all.ROOM:  Our room was cozy. It had everything we needed.  We cooked our meals everyday to save money. The rooms were newly renovated with full kitchen, ensuite bathroom. LAUNDRY: The laundry facility in building 1 was quite the experience. 4 out of 6 machines were broken and they never fixed them the entire time we were there, even after we let them know. They are old and caked with soap. Twice we had to go to the front desk to acquire more quarters as the machines kept eating them.  Also one machine broke down while our laundry was mid cycle. It was quite the mess starting a new load sopping wet. It took us 5 hours to do 2 loads and wasted our entire evening.  We wanted to get some fresh clothes and go out for dinner and that never happened. CONS: Housekeeping. Where do I start.  After we arrived late, we wanted to go to bed right away. We pulled back the sheets to find a large lip stick stain on the sheets and hair all over. We called down and someone dropped off new sheets. We were concerned that the bedding wasn't cleaned at all and still we are unsure. GROSS. We also found that the shampoo they provided was open and half used. Since we were there for 10 days we had 2 scheduled cleanings, Wednesday and Saturday.  On the Wednesday we came back to our room to find our door was latched open and no one was around. We reported it to the front desk just to make sure it didn't happen again. The housekeeping only replaced the towels. The did not provide us with more coffee, dishwasher detergent, recycling bags.  We had another cleaning on Saturday and again they only gave us 2 clean towels and made the bed.  We again had to call down to the front desk and request Soap, Recycling bags, Face clothes, Bath Mat, Coffee and Dishwasher soap. We called the front desk for supplies 5 separate times and went down 4 different times to restock.  We started to feel like a nuisance for someone else's neglect.  We think maybe the housekeeper got in trouble for not locking our door and they retaliated by not providing us with any amenities. Either way they did neglect our room. Cleanliness is top priority and the Desert Rose dropped the ball hard. If you plan to stay at this resort, please check your sheets and expect minimal cleanliness.  I also sent a review to their head office as per their request and never got a response.  Typical hotel hospitality.I don’t know if I would return as there are a couple budget resort close by that take cleanliness seriously. BE AWARE.

reviews.title: family stay
reviews.text: great time, clean, great pool area ,we had a blast ,only problem was with elevator ,which had to be fixed daily ,otherwise great value ,helpful people ,we will  be back to this resort for sure .just off strip ,gated ,plenty of parking ,security , we had no issues ,check in was quick ,room ready opon our arrival

reviews.title: Great place to stay with no resort fee
reviews.text: We really enjoyed our stay here. The rooms were very nice with comfy beds and a lot of pillows. We enjoyed the heated pool and hot tub. (Just rinse after you get out, heavy chlorine.) the location was great for us as our favorite place to gamble is OYO(The old Hooters) It wasn’t that far of a walk to the center of the strip, about a mile to Planet Hollywood. The best part was the little bar/restaurant. Jason took great care of us and we got to enjoy an hour of free Mimosas and Bloody Mary’s on Sunday. It was a very enjoyable stay and we will be back!

reviews.title: Serviceable, nothing lavish
reviews.text: Traded my timeshare for this trip. Resort is okay; certainly not a Marriott Grand Chateau! 3-story buildings, decent pool, BBQ's are in a public area not easily accessible to your unit (to get food/supplies). Restaurant is actually the bar in the lobby. Room was clean, but common areas lacked; not one vacuum the entire week we were there. We asked for shaving cream and was told it would be brought to the room. Never arrived. Our first night we were woken up by security and other people saying we were in their room. Records showed we were not. Don't they have computer records for this? One morning we were woken at 7:30am by workmen on the roof. Seriously?  The location is great, very close to Oyo, MGM and Tropicana. (Tram station at MGM close by). The staff however needs some DEEP REMEDIAL TRAINING.  We had a 2 BR, very spacious. Master BR had a shower, 2nd bath had a tub (no jacuzzi tub). Washer/Dryer is NOT in unit but downstairs in a common area. There is one elevator per building (there are 3). Honestly did not hear jet traffic from the nearby airport; just a few helicopters during one day. Aside from the staff interruptions relatively quiet.

reviews.title: Great location with friendly staff
reviews.text: The location is close to the airport and very close to the strip.  The staff were were helpful and friendly and were always willing to help with any questions in relation to anything we wanted to know about Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Roomy, clean and close to the Strip
reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at the Desert Rose Resort and enjoyed the roomy, self catering suite. The kitchen is well equipped and helped to reduce costs from eating out. It was very easy walking to the strip, however our room on the 3rd floor was right above the security gate to the hotel. These gates are large heavy and metal. Unfortunately, people just let the gate slam, night and day. As a result it was very broken sleep for us during our stay. We would definitely stay here again but would request a room away from the security gates.

reviews.title: Such a lovely place
reviews.text: Very clean, spacious and comfy accommodation… Well equipped kitchen. You can enjoy peace and quiet, and it is only walking distance to the strip if you require more of the Vegas atmosphere. I will use again… and would recommend to anybody as perfect family location in Vegas…

reviews.title: The finest hotel I’ve stayed in anywhere in the world
reviews.text: From the guy who tends to the flowers & car park to the top boss man & everybody in between this is special place to stay, over 12 years of staying here it’s just got better & better I’ve brought many friends & family here luckily many of them was not only there first trip to Las Vegas but to the USA . The recent collapse to Thomas cook meant that I had to contact desert rose personally to see if they could honour my original booking for the same dates, not email a phone call to the guest service manager his reply came via email the following morning, confirming our booking, clean,safe,friendly,easy to deal with, the management all take time to speak to everybody as they pass through the hotels grounds

reviews.title: Resort Rose Resort, Las Vegas
reviews.text: Overall really enjoyed this resort especially for the helpful & courteous staff & the location of the resort to the Las Vegas Blvd & the Airport.!!  Highly recommend this resort!!  Also convenient location in relation to bus lines.

reviews.title: Clean , Friendly , Good size.
reviews.text: It is really the best resort.One disadvantage is that you hurt your feet while moving the coffee table to use the sofa bed.The coffee table has a double layer. It is easy to hurt your foot because the bottom is on the floor.I actually hurt my instep.It might be my mistake, but I can't judge the fatigue from long hours of driving and from tired after attending the seminar.I have never seen a table bottom on the floor like that.Be careful about it.

reviews.title: Good Location
reviews.text: Small resort, very close to the Strip but a quiet location. Check in was quick, low key time share sales person. Condo was nice, but small inside, kitchen, dining, lounge area.The view from our windows was awful, a balcony with a view of a high wall.The pool area was quite small, but we usually managed to get a bed or some chairs, but who goes to Vegas to sit round a pool all day! The Strip was walkable, but very hot.

reviews.title: Great resort!!
reviews.text: Very clean and quiet location.  Very close to the Strip but not right on it so did not have strip traffic noise.  Pool was perfect.  Service was available right away when we needed it.  Had a great stay at this resort.

reviews.title: Absolutely Fabulous Resort and value for money
reviews.text: Stayed 12 nights here and tonight is our last night. Booked the apartment so my Husband and I could rest after 6 days sightseeing in San Francisco and 3 days at the Freemont Experience for a family reunion. So  I booked the Desert Rose so that we could relax and enjoy the facilities. Had an issue with check in as first Receptionist gave us a apartment with no sunlight for sunbathing on the terrace. She then gave us an apartment facing a main road with a great view of the planes at the airport coming and going with sound effects. This would have meant I would have been seen sunbathing in my swimming costume on the terrace and at my age would have caused a serious traffic accident. I had a melt down at Reception and Athena the second Receptionist  was fantastic and after a wait gave me the perfect apartment. On the terrace I could see the Luxur and  Mandalay Bay  Hotels and the other side I could see the pool. Once settled in our apartment (after a phone call from the Welcome Desk and been shocked by a rude comment and the phone put down on me) and a good night sleep I have no more complaints. The resort is lovely and clean and well maintained. The pool and spa areas are lovely and do get busy and sunloungers limited The BBQ is great and a member of staff will light them for you as they work by gas.  Yes the lift was not working on two occasions and getting the apartment cleaned and bedding changed was something we missed as spent most of our time in the apartment but got clean towels and toiletries and coffee for the machine(any additional cleaning is an additional payment)Missed the Sunday complimentary drinks at the bar as well as first Thursday wine hour. Did make it on our second Thursday and very impressed with how it was done by Management. Big thanks to Travis for making me feel welcome.(All the best to the young man behind the Bar joining the Navy)Did not have issues with time share selling, despite one of them ringing us on our first night as per above and the next day saw Belinda who was lovely and gave me a lot of useful information about Las Vegas and was not at all pushy with time share( remember there is no  such thing as a free meal)The apartment had a separate bedroom and a lovely sitting room and well stocked kitchen and the best terrace for relaxing and sunbathing .From the resort if you go to the main road the Strip is less than 10 minutes walk and you can get the bus to the North and South Outlet Malls  and Fremont Experience area  for $8 for a 24 hour pass.From the resort if you walk to the main road you can get the bus to Walmart and Vons(at Vons get a free loyalty card to get discount. Took me 45mins to walk there and an hour to walk back)We have had a lovely stay here and regard this resort as the best we have ever stayed in our 40 years of  taking holidays as a couple.  No resort fees also makes it value for money ( The husband used the laundry 3 times and ice machine daily)I can't thank Athena enough for giving us my dream apartment and hence a truely lovely holiday.

reviews.title: Amazing again!
reviews.text: There is such great value here. It is a beautiful Oasis just off the strip. Perfect for a group to have more space, no resort fees, no extra person fee, and a full kitchen with coffee to save a lot of money. The pool is very relaxed, and you can go to other hotels if you want a pool party experience. I have stayed at many different places on the strip and I would pick the desert rose over any big hotel.

reviews.title: Still has it ....
reviews.text: This hotel is still a pleasant experience.  The staff was totally helpful even when I was stuck at the airport and I had some groceries delivered to the hotel they hotel staff held my groceries.  One night our elevator went out in the building,  the security guards helped my aunt up the stairs and charged and stored her rental scooter.  A little courtesy goes a long way. Really enjoyed my stay.

reviews.title: Home away from Home
reviews.text: it was the perfect size for our stay. Best way to stay on budget by utilizing the kitchen and making home cooked meals to enjoy more time doing other things rather than spending money on food! literally 10 min to strip and uber was very reasonable!

reviews.title: Nice little resort
reviews.text: Lovely resort; off the beaten path while still downtown Vegas.  Nice neighborhood; felt safe.  Very nice.  We were able to walk around the neighborhood and easy walk to breakfast places.  Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Fantastic as usual
reviews.text: After a worrying time because we had booked a Thomas Cook holiday but was flying with BA. They had paid the airline but not the resort so I paid again for our 3 weeks and hopefully be able too claim back from Atol. We arrived on the 30th September to a very warm welcome, we requested apartment 3319 as we loved it the last time. It’s like coming home nothing is too much bother for this excellent hotel. Pool is very inviting,  clean. Could do with a few more sun beds. We are here until the 21st October yippee!!!!!!

reviews.title: Such a deal!
reviews.text: Booked base on ratings and comments. Couldn't be more happier with our choice. What a setup, full kitchen, living room, balcony and separate bedroom. Street away from Luxor and the insanity of the boulevard, perfect location.

reviews.title: Great place to stay . Close to stripe but not noisy.
reviews.text: 2 bedroom rooms Roomie with 2 full baths. Full kitchen . Has elevator in each grouping of rooms. only room I would not recommend is the corner room next to outside airconditioner unit. Pool nice and open til 11Pm. during high times go down early to get your lounge chairs and umbrellas.

reviews.title: It’s behind Hooters Casino/Hotel
reviews.text: The reason I choose this hotel was because it was close to the strip. I took my wife for a fun exciting weekend in Vegas . The resort was big , it was clean great customer service and we just need a place to sleep.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: Close to the airport and strip. easy check in. We have been here a couple times. this time we got a 1 bedroom but it is way smaller than what we expected and there is no laundry in the room. Staff if very friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: Shell Vacations Las Vegas
reviews.text: Property is only a few blocks from the STRIP.  Yet walking back each night is tiring, recommend buying Monorail ticket and catching the Monorail behind the MGM Grand, which is a short walk to property.

reviews.title: Nice place but pushed to take time share.
reviews.text: The room was huge and everything you need in the kitchen.  The location was good and close to the strip.  The WiFi was awful and had to go to the front desk about it.  Came and went.  My only real complaint is the push to join the time share.  After you check in you are directed to get your parking pass and have to listen to how you can get cheap tickets for shows if you go to the 90 minute presentation.  We were very clear that we were not interested.  Finally got away to our room.  However, on our last day they called our room and again tried to talk us into the time share.  Again, I had to say no for a good 5 minutes.  Really left a bad taste for the place in general.  So, if you don't mind being pushed, the place itself is nice.

reviews.title: 2nd stay
reviews.text: This was our second visit first being about 4 years ago. Apartments have been updated & still have everything you need. We really liked the new addition of the bar in reception this place is great to hang out, the food & drinks are really good & the staff there a fantastic!!!

reviews.title: family vaacion
reviews.text: what a wonderful place. everything you could need or ask for ,, just like home but BETTER, we had an ADA room and it was perfect for Mom who was paralyzed in her wheelchair. enough room to get around and everything we needed. Even the pool was ADA.

reviews.title: Luxury hotel chains meet AirBnB!
reviews.text: This is the perfect compromise between a luxury hotel and an Airbnb. While Luxury hotel chains usually don't have a budget room with a kitchen and a patio (or even a separate living room with its own TV), AirBnBs don't usually have the same reliability or the sense of security that a hotel chain does. This is the perfect compromise between the two (and it doesn't feel like a compromise at all!). You have a great well stocked kitchen with every utensil or equipment  you could ever need. Everything else is awesome as well. And, it's located a 4-5 minutes walk from the strip (MGM grand). Unbeatable. Also, the deal from the conceirge  where you get a high discount on shows like Cirque Du Soleil + Buffet for 25 bucks was also awesome. Just be warned that you have to attend a timeshare presentation (a sales pitch to get you to buy a timeshare like vacation home from Wyndham) in order to get the tickets. But as long as you can say 'No' enough times to buy/invest in anything, you will get the ticket for your time (it takes around 2 hours).Another tip is to always try to get the top floor, without which you will have some trouble sleeping depending on how inconsiderate your upper neighbour is (ours kept stomping with high-heels late into the night and left their kind to run rampant right above the bedroom and living room), which was a damper.

reviews.title: A great place to stay in Vegas
reviews.text: Great option for Las Vegas. Good size rooms and can sleep 4 comfortably with the sofa bed. Kitchen and dining table and a separate bedroom. Very friendly staff. Nice Pool area to relax around. Not far to walk to the Strip and many casino options nearby. Very close to the airport. A bit of an escape from the hype of strip.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: Fantastic stay .So glad I booked this resort . This was my 4th time in Las Vegas and was getting sick of having to pay the extortionate resort fees the bigger hotels on the strip charge.Last year I paid $294 extra on my departure.This resort does not charge resort fees.My check in was perfect .quick and simple (10minutes) .last year I was in a line for almost an hour at one of the strip hotels waiting to check in.The reception staff are very friendly and helpful. The house staff also do a fantastic job and keep the rooms very clean.The little apartments are ideal . Nice sitting room with settee and large TV . Large double bed and plenty of closet space . Good sized bathroom .The kitchen is perfect with cooker , large fridge and freezer . Smoothy maker , toaster,coffee percolator.It's only a 5 minute walk to the strip.So glad I found this little gem and will 100% be using it for any future trips to Las Vegas.There is also a desk straight across from the reception if you are looking to book any trips etc . Staff very friendly and don't do a hard sell on you.The owners of this resort are lucky to have such a great staff .from reception through to house staff.

reviews.title: Good location, bad housekeeping
reviews.text: The location is great, right behind Hooters, quick two minute walk. Housekeeping is bad, they hire people that can not speak English, you have to call an interpreter to tell her what you need, it would be ok if I was in another country, but I shouldn't expect this here.

reviews.title: Excellent, friendly resort.
reviews.text: Initial niggles-reservation name mix up and room cleanliness were resolved, and the quiet room requested was just that with ample room and amenities for us four adults.As soon as the resort desk turned the welcome into a timeshare sales pitch, I stopped them in their tracks, and from then on they could not have been more helpful and friendly over our 2 week stay, as were the rest of the employees at Desert Rose. Lovely pool area and bar with limited menu but excellent food and ambiance.Used Uber for Vons and Walmart supermarket shopping,3 day bus pass for the Outlets, Freemont Street and TGI Fridays, plus the free trams and legs are us for covering the distances between Mandalay Bay and the Venetion areas of the strip. Although very hot it is only a short walk to the shade of MGM one way and The Exalibur the other way. Coco's bakery and restaurant is only a short walk away and an excellent choice for cheaper food and drink, as is Hooter's and Steak and Shake.Unlikely to go back to Las Vegas ( Seen it,done it ) but if so would not hesitate to stay here again.

reviews.title: A very comfortable stay
reviews.text: Our suite was really well specified with two bedrooms, two bathrooms a full kitchenette, lounge and balcony. This made for a really comfortable place to relax after returning from sightseeing trips. We were lucky enough to be on the top floor overlooking the pool  which I would recommend as some of the other rooms looked out onto the car parks and courtyards. The pool and hot tub was usually quite busy but conveniently located between the four blocks. The resort is located a little way back off the top of the strip so it's helpful to have a car if you venture out in the heat of the day. There's a large Vons supermarket a short drive away which we used to keep our supplies stocked. The front desk didn't push the timeshare as soon as they discovered we were from the UK :). Overall we were very happy with our stay and would recommend the Desert Rose for a relaxed way to spend time in Las Vegas - just remember to request a pool view!

reviews.title: Good experience but...
reviews.text: All over it was a goog experience but I gave three stars cause there is only one pool at the resort it wasn't enough for four building especially on the weekend and there was no wifi almost all the time.The wifi was so bad.it tells you the signal is good but no internet access.

reviews.title: great resort
reviews.text: This is a very nice resort. A short walk to great eating places yet off the strip so very quiet . We had a strip view from our balcony of the MGM, Luxor and Manadalay bay. Renovations have made the pool area a very inviting space. We will come back to this resort again.

reviews.title: OVER RATED
reviews.text: In my opinion, it is rated as a Gold Crown Resort because it is owned by the same company that owns RCI. Its proximity to The Strip and complementary Mimosas are it's only perks. It has a nice, but small pool. I had to ask for the green water in the hot tub be changed, which they did quickly.

reviews.title: Fantastic hotel
reviews.text: Have just got back from a fantastic holiday in Las Vegas, the desert Rose Resort is a great hotel to stay in, the one bedroom apartment we stayed in had everything we needed the staff were all pleasant and helpful we even received a call in the room to check if it had been cleaned.I went with my dad and two teenage daughters we all felt safe there as you have to use your room key to get into the different blocks and pool, also the gates around the apartment buildings can only be opened if you have a car so only people staying there can get in and out.There is a small shop that sells snacks and drinks, you can buy milk from the bar and as for food shopping we used Walgreens and cvs which you can get to on the Las Vegas Monorail, the neatest station to the hotel is at the mgm Grand and that’s only a 10 to 15 minute walk.The next time I come to Las Vegas I will definitely be staying here again.

reviews.title: Great place.  Needs better customer service.
reviews.text: The facilities and price are great. We had an early flight and went in to ask if we could get an early check-in. The lady at the desk promised to call us when our room was ready.  We killed nearly the whole day and finally were so exhausted we went back in (1 hour before check-in time) a different lady told us "oh yeah, your room is ready." she made it sound like the room had been ready for a while.  Why no call as promised? Then one morning there was drilling outside of our room to the point the dishes were rattling in the cabinets. I called the desk & asked how long this would be going on. I was told it was guys trimming trees. I told her this was not tree trimming. She said she would come down and check it out. She calls back to tell us it was the tree trimmers. When we were leaving we could see a guy that seemed to be cutting a sprinkler out of a ceiling in an exterior hallway outside of our room. When we returned to the room there was plaster on the stovetop, so it was not tree trimmers. This is a nice facility about a block away from the strip. It was challenging to walk to the strip at times because it was so hot so we Ubered a lot. The room had a coffee pot and provided coffee. There were plenty of plates and cups. No icemaker but ice machines in the hallways. I would recommend this place but if you get in early call back to check because they won't honor what they tell you.

reviews.title: Retirement Getaway
reviews.text: This is a quaint and quiet place to stay in the shadow of the Hooters tower just off the main drag in Las Vegas. Our unit had a full kitchen, nice bed, bathroom and porch. The pool was clean and relaxing. The ice machine was not convenient but you can make make your own in the room. We had a great time.

reviews.title: Great place!
reviews.text: This is our second trip to Las Vegas and the second time staying with the desert rose. Its a great little hotel, everything you need for self catering, small pool area, lovely friendly staff, I arranged for a package to be delivered to the hotel before my arrival and this was waiting for me in the rook on arrival.... ... I will however say that on arrival after check in you go over to see the activities people to help with tickets, activities and bla bla bla.... At this point they will ask you to have a 'free' complementary breakfast in exchange for theatre tickets or a 150$ gift card... This is at the sister Hotel a few blocks away.... Don't get drawn in.... This is a time share 'presentation' the people are pushy and want to know the ins and outs of your financial situation to sell you shares! The complementary breakfast is awful its one slice of bacon one sausage and a small spoon of scrambled eggs! (we was expecting a full English) anyhoo we was stuck hear for 4 hours and completely wasted our time so just giving the heads up so you don't waste half a day when time on holiday is so precious. Apart from this I'd highly recommend the desert rose and would definitely stay hear again if we was to visit Vegas again 😊

reviews.title: Another great trip!
reviews.text: Thank you desert rose resort for our 4th fabulous trip! Booked through Thomas cook stayed in 1 bedroom apartment for 2 weekd. The apartments are a real home from home with everything you need for a self catering break. The resort improves year on year with feedback. The swimming pool and communal areas are lovely. The only issue we had was the dryers in our block we're out of order all our stay. Already looking for next year x

reviews.title: Excellent 4 night stay!
reviews.text: Stayed here  with my wife and daughter in July 2019, really enjoyed our stay, place was clean with a fully equipped kitchen with all amenities,WiFi was not that great but your walking distance to the strip which made it great to get around.I would definitely go back.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resorts
reviews.text: Arrived 6/5 about 9:00 - despite asking for an early check-in did not get in room until 2:00.  Although resort is close to strip - don’t expect a view - most of the rooms only face each other - only 3 floors so even if you are facing strip - most likely could not see much.  Our view from balcony was pleasant with palm trees, flowers and you could even see the pool one way America the Luxor the other if you stood up.  Resort was gated so felt safe once inside- had a woman try to get money from us right next door when walking back from casino and threw rocks at us when we ignored her - just be aware of your surroundings.  Rooms were comfortable and clean - although advertised as a Wyndham - not quite up to Wyndham standard (like at Grand Desert); however it was very nice and I would stay here again.  Liked how close it was to the strip - they did have laundry facilities but you had to pay and they were downstairs on the first floor.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort, conveniently located.
reviews.text: Nice place to stay and close to the strip. Everything was great and met expectations. Beds were very comfortable and excellent sleeping privacy. Only improvement I would recommend is better internet accessibility in the rooms.

reviews.title: Excellent stay close to the Las Vegas Strip
reviews.text: I stayed with family in two one bedroom suites in April-May 2019The rooms were large, well decorated and spotlessly clean with a large separate bedroom and a fully equipped kitchen areaThe resort is laid out across 4 buildings around a central swimming pool and BBQ area and decorated in a Spanish southwestern style with rooms opening onto an external corridor.The resort felt safe both during the day and at night with security staff present, but the security staff were very helpful and friendly and not intimidating as in some LV hotels.Breakfast is served in the small lobby bar, offering a good selection of American breakfast items such as sausage/bacon bagel and a breakfast burrito plus Starbucks coffee, all at a very good price.The Las Vegas strip is a 5-10 minute walk just past hooters and the Tropicana but the Desert Rose Resort has a much more relaxed and quieter atmosphere.There is lots of complimentary parking available which is another advantage as many of the main strip resort hotels, such as Luxor, have now started to charge for parking.Highly recommended for a Las Vegas stay away from the crowds and noise and without the high resort fees charged at the casino resorts.

reviews.title: Best place to stay
reviews.text: This is the nicest Resort...10 min. Of the Strip, just behind Hooters, 15 min. By bus to the Airport, friendly staff, very clean Apartment...just amazing fecelitis, Pool, BBQ, free Computer use, free WiFi, Gym...

reviews.title: perfect place for families
reviews.text: we are a family of 6. this place was perfect for us. clean, comfortable, great kitchen. also enjoyed the pool with its bbq area. had all the advantages of being close to the strip without the disadvantages of noise, cigarette smoke  and casino. staff was friendly and helpful! highly recommend!

reviews.title: Close to everything on "The Strip"
reviews.text: We were there for four days and it was very convenient to everything that we wanted to do. Really not a restaurant but the bar in the reception area did serve a very tasty breakfast. Our last morning there, the hot water went out in our building and we called about 8 AM and the staff really didn't apologize for it at all. Not cool!

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: We had an excellent stay here. It's located a little off the south end of the Las Vegas Strip (just 10 minutes walk) - good to have a calm and quiet place to come back to. Our apartment was fully furnished including everything in the kitchen and it was spacious, clean and well maintained. The beds in both rooms were huge and all of us had very good sleep. Their WiFi was fast and the range was quite good all across the resort area. Their service was very good - smiling, to-the-point and very helpful. They do the usual "timeshare thing" after checkin (it's a timeshare resort after all) but the lady there did not bother us much after learning that we were just visiting the US. Overall, very good value for money.

reviews.title: Beware of racist lady that you need to collect 'parking tags' from
reviews.text: *Everything* about the resort was good except the 'picking of parking tags' after checkin. This part was so horrible though, that it ruined our moods for an entire afternoon and we are considering whether to take legal action.The lady at the timeshare booth that was disguised as "pick up parking tags" (on the May 20th noon) was extremely racist, rude and belittling towards us. She kept asking us things like our 'status' in this county, our visas and that she had gifts only for 'citizens'. I kept telling her that we've had a long flight and have a baby and a 3 year old who just want to go to the room and sleep, but this lady kept shouting and belittling us. Never in my 15 years in the US have I encountered such behavior. Eventually she just shouted to draw the attention of everyone on that floor and make us feel really bad.Wyndham, we will be getting legal opinion to see if any of this can be considered racial discrimination.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel, great location
reviews.text: Loved the Desert Rose! Really comfy bed, great kitchen, balcony, lovely pool area with hot tub and 10 min walk to the strip. Brilliant location on a budget as it's quiet and a good break away from the crazy strip!

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: Really loved this hotel. 15min walk to Strip. No party party bang bang 24-7. So if you want to be near Strip but you want casinos etc to your hotel, this is your pick. HUGE rooms! Also very clean and staff was nice. But then lets talk about wifi. It sucks, period. Its 2019 and I had quicker internet 2005 than this hotel. Without wifi 5/5, with wifi 3/5.

reviews.title: A little tired, but a good off strip place to stay.
reviews.text: Suite was clean but a bit musty smelling. Bed was comfortable and bathroom clean. Kitchen well equipped. A short walk to a few of the casinos such as Excalibur and Hooters. Would recommend if looking for off strip accommodation. We avoided the free shows, where we would have to sit through a timeshare presentation and were happy with our choice.Apart from the air conditioning sounding like a jet aircraft taking off, the room was relatively quiet.

reviews.title: over all great place to stay.
reviews.text: we would stay there again if we went back to Las Vegas again. They have a wonderful staff and all very friendly.  Anything we needed they had it, it was wonderful. The pool area and hot tub was very relaxing. Thanks again Desert Rose Resort.

reviews.title: Birthday Celebration
reviews.text: Spent a full week, found the staff to be extreme helpful & accommodating.  We arrived early & Grissella at the front desk arranged to keep our luggage & informed us by phone once a room was available.  Our eldest son was arriving the next day & upon his arrival the gal at the front desk escorted him directly to our suite.  The suite was very clean & well equipped with, wine glasses, mugs, plates, glasses.  We did cook a few meals & the suite had measuring cups, pots & pans, every thing you need to prepare a meal.  I will say the AC is quite loud when it came on so during the night we put it on manual to provide white noise.  The bed was very comfortable with tons of drawers & storage.  We didn't use the pool, but it did appear to be a nice area, with many of the guest in attendance.  With close access to the strip, it was a great location & we enjoyed our time there immensely.

reviews.title: Celebrating 40th Birthday
reviews.text: We arrived at the Desert Rose resort late at night following our long flight from the UK.  We received a warm welcome from Kiana at the front desk.  She was lovely and gave us great advice about the resort and gave us 4 keys for our two bedroom apartment so we had one each.  We were also given Vegas maps and information sheets which were really helpful.  I would just like to say at no point during check in or during our stay did anyone try to get us to go to a time share talk (I was worried this would happen from reading previous reviews on here) There was no mention of it at all which we were so pleased about.  All the hotel staff were friendly and helpful.  Our apartment had a view towards the New York & MGM hotels.  The location was just perfect for us a nice and quiet area with just a 5 minute walk to the strip.  Our apartment had two bedrooms one of which had an en-suite bathroom the other had the bathroom just across the corridor.  A large open plan lounge and kitchen area and balcony.  The kitchen was fully equipped with everything you need including complimentary coffee, microwave popcorn, sugar etc.  Plus tea towels, washing up liquid, dishwasher powder etc.  Cupboards fully equipped with pots, pans, plates, glasses, mugs etc.  Large fridge, cooker and microwave.  Powerful Hairdryers in both bathrooms, iron and ironing board.  Towels for both the room and pool.  A large safe to store valuables. Everything was immaculately clean in the apartment.  They don’t service your room each day like a hotel but this is clearly stated when you book so this was fine with us.  You can ask for anything you run out off and they are happy to restock for you.  We had an issue with a toilet blocking, Johnathan from maintenance came and fixed it for us an excellent service. The price we paid for a week was £835 via booking.com for the apartment with 4 of us staying, excellent vale for money with no additional resort fees at the end to pay.  The pool and jacuzzi area was lovely with fencing all round to make safe for children on the complex and all kept very clean and tidy.  I would highly recommend a stay at the Desert Rose Resort a perfect base to explore Vegas from.  We will definitely go back and stay there again.

reviews.title: Super convenient
reviews.text: The Rose is a great resort, recently remodeled so very clean, neat, new like. Covient by being walking distance to a few casinos. Clean, comfortable, and discreet.The staff was great help. All you need for a Vegas getaway.

reviews.title: Mrs.
reviews.text: We booked a room that sleeps 4.  The room smelled musty. The resort provided 4 towels for the pool but no exchange for clean ones.  There was a 25.00 charge for each towel if not in room at check out.  The air conditioner was so loud you could hardly sleep.  You could hear the air conditioner from the room above.  We had our granddaughter & the pool area was so crowded with adults drinking in the pool.  Lack of chairs in pool area.  I would not recommend this resort if you have children.  Lack of amenities. I think this was an apartment complex converted to condos.

reviews.title: Laid back Vegas experience!
reviews.text: My group stayed here on our last visit two years ago and are looking forward to our visit next week. I had to call to change the name on our reservation to a group member who is arriving earlier and staff was very courteous and helped me make the change quite easily. We rented a 2 bedroom suite for the week of EDC so that our group of 5 people could room together. We got the suite for less than $200 a night, which is significantly less then we would have paid for 2 hotel rooms. The hotel is amazing. Staff is super friendly. They do not provide room service, unless requested, since the building is predominantly timeshares; however, we requested one cleaning service and a few towel/soap refills and were serviced immediately. The rooms are gorgeous, clean, and spacious. We had two bathrooms and a full-sized kitchen, which saved us so much money on eating out. The resort is located maybe 2 streets down from the strip; we had to walk to each day to catch a shuttle at the Luxor and it took less than 10 minutes walking at a casual pace. The pool was a nice size and was kept clean, plus there is a BBQ area with gas grills for guests. We literally could not have asked for more and will continue to make this our "go-to" Vegas spot!

reviews.title: Economic and good option for a Vegas stay
reviews.text: Instead of stay at a tower, a homier option. Near to casinos and the Strip, good rooms with fully equiped kitchens. Services offered by the hotel are enough,  with all the expected. Pool is not big but quite enough to refresh in a hot summer day.

reviews.title: Long weekend..
reviews.text: Perfect stay!  Highly recommend for those looking to stay on the quieter side of the strip.  Rooms were clean & spacious & they have Starbucks coffee!!  Shot out to Nolan our bartender for his excellent service & warm hospitality!!!

reviews.title: Nice, clean place to stay.
reviews.text: The Desert Rose Resort was nice and clean. We couldn't use any of the facilities they offer because it was so cold, and it rained a lot, with an all time high of 50 on one of the 4 days we were there. While the weather was very disappointing, I would definitely stay at the Desert Rose Resort again.

reviews.title: Perfect location
reviews.text: The resort is about 5 minutes from the airport and just a couple  blocks from the strip.  The staff was very friendly and accommodating.  The unit was clean and spacious.  We chose this resort because it’s only 3 stories high with s nice patio area off the living room where smoking was allowed.

reviews.title: no room
reviews.text: we arrived and the resort staff told us there was no rooms open. we even called and confirmed the morning of our check in date. they sent us to another resort.  when I called RCI their coments to me was that has nothing to do with RCI....even though RCI is the one who made the reservation for us, basically could care less

reviews.title: Girls Getaway
reviews.text: Right off the strip behind the Tropicana.  Easy walking distance to the strip. Met with 'first timers' to Vegas, so I chose a place not right on the strip.  We all loved it.  Walking distance to everything.  Closest market is Von and great prices there.  We did not have a car, so it was an Uber ride way (2 miles).  There is a tram you can catch at the MGM Grand for $5  one way to go to the Northern part of the strip.  We ate in since we had a full kitchen and saved our money for the Aerosmith concert, Zak Bagan's Museum and Real Bodies Museum.  Did little gambling, but no wins.  Great place! Great resort and great staff!

reviews.title: Love This Place
reviews.text: We enjoyed our week in early April at Desert Rose. We were fortunate to get a first floor unit close to the lobby, so making our Uber connections was convenient. Every request we made of the staff was answered politely and promptly. We thought our one bedroom unit was designed well and for the most part attractive. Two needed improvements stood out:  newer, nicer bed linens (especially comforter) and a different configuration for the heating/cooling system. Every time the a.c. came on, it was too loud and powerful to watch tv on the couch. When the Wyndham timeshare crew showed the Grand Desert as their crown jewel, I didn't see it outshine the Desert Rose that much. I've stayed in both now, and our condo and the lovely pool at the Desert Rose would cause me to choose it again.

reviews.title: Wyndam owned, be aware
reviews.text: This property does NOT have any shuttle service!  Yes, only 10  minutes from MGM, but still a long way to the other end of the strip. ABout $10>00 Lyft each way to the grocery store.  Part of check in is saying 'no thankyou' over and over again to the Wyndam staff trying to get you to go to a time share presentation.  It was past 1:00 in the morining, our time and she would not stop, and then was rude.  The lay out of the bathroom is terrible.There are only 2 dozen lounge chairs for 4 buildings with 3 storries each!  Pool is very small and oddly and in my opinion, dangerously shaped.  Will not return!

reviews.title: STAIRS ARE NOT MY FRIEND!!!
reviews.text: This was a nice place to stay,  away from the hotels in vegas and all was very good except for the 2problems with the  internet and the elevator.1.  WIFI INTERNET  was very poor and we paid for the best service and it would not stay connectedand dropped many time every day..2.  THE ELEVATOR from the 3rd floor had a major problem on our 2 day there and 2 days later later they had a repairman working on it but it never got fixed the whole week that we were there up thru our Friday check out.   We could not get the elevator to come up to the 3rd floor and we hadto use the stairs to get down to the ground floor and the exits.  If someone was coming up to the 3rdfloor when we needed to go down,  we could catch the elevator then,  but that only happened twice all week .    Not a lot of fun when your  80 with bad knees.    The problem was in the switch in the 3rd floor call button but no one all week could get it fixed.On our check out day (Friday),  It was not a lot of fun carring our luggage down the 3 flights of stairs at 6 am.   Every thing else was very good but the Elevator left us with very bad feeling about the resort and their  care for their guests.     (A Wyndham resort)     Mr  Dee

reviews.title: Very Impressive Resort
reviews.text: Just spent a week at Desert Rose Resort and everything about our stay was a very pleasant experience. We had a two bedroom 2 bath suite with Kitchen and livingroom. It was clean, spacious and well equipped. Kitchen was well done, well equipped with anything you might need. Coffee and coffee machine was provided at no extra charge which for us was a bonus. Beds were very comfortable, bathrooms also well supplied with kleenex, toilet paper and soaps. Bathrooms are a tad small but efficient. Livingroom was comfy. Location of resort  was perfect for us, we rented a car for a few days trips and Ubered the rest of the time. Uber was only minutes away each time. Resort is reasonably close to grocery stores and a Walmart on Tropicana Ave that had a great grocery section. The pool area was well done with BBQs and additional seating. The staff at the resort were friendly, efficient and accommodating.This resort helped make our stay in Las Vegas amazing. Will most certainly be returning.

reviews.title: Very Disappointing
reviews.text: Very Disappointing! I researched reviews of this property before booking this location, and they looked positive.  In my opinion, this resort is at best a 2.5 out of 5.The first negative experience was during check-in and getting our parking pass.  After you check in, you are directed to the concierge desk to obtain your parking pass, where you have to endure an extremely hard sell to attend a timeshare presentation.  I told the guy from the beginning that I wasn’t interested.  I just said NO. Over and over again!  He finally had to relent.Then, we got to our building (room 3201), and upon entering, the hallway was very dark (we arrived during day light hours).  It felt creepy walking into the building!  The carpeting in the hallway and room are filthy and very dated. In addition, there was trash in front of our door, and it stayed there for well all day long!  It looked like a dirty diaper.Upon entering the unit, we were greeted by some sort of flies in all of the rooms.  The 2BR/2BA is small in comparison to other timeshares.  The bedrooms and baths are tiny.The décor in the unit is extremely outdated. The pull-out sofa and chair really need to be replaced.  They are very used and ragged. The olive and gray colors certainly don’t make it a very cheerful place.  The carpet was dirty and spotted.  Had to wear shoes while in the inside.Our view was of the parking lot.The small kitchen is adequate, but the cabinets and appliances are extremely dated.The cabinets in the kitchen and bathrooms are probably original and are in dire need of replacement. The worst part was that the kitchen counters and table were dirty!  I put my laptop on the table and felt a very large sticky area, and I could see old stuck on food on the kitchen counter.  UGH!The building was not well insulated, so the unit was very noisy.  We heard sirens all day and night.  And a very noisy bird.Don’t believe the ‘one block to the strip’.  It is a long couple of blocks to get to the strip.  Not a bad walk for most, but for someone with walking disabilities, it’s a bit far.On the positive side, the beds and pillows were very comfortable!I cannot recommend this property if you are used to nicer timeshares.

reviews.title: Steady stream of low flying helicopters overhead every evening
reviews.text: This is our second time in this hotel and even though we love the layout of their suites and the fact that the accommodation was very clean and well equipped, the noise from the steady stream of low flying helicopters heading to the airport in the evening is something we don't ever want to put up with again.

reviews.title: Nice stay with RCI @ Desert Rose Resort !!!
reviews.text: It was a nice stay at Las Vegas Desert Rose Resort. I didn't pay a single penny and stayed 7 night , Wow !!! This hotel was beside of the Tropicana hotel and casino's and good to walk on the Strip to start from Tropicana, Excalibur, Luxor , NY NY, MGM on the 5 minutes walking distance. Hotel staff was very good. Just only the two thing I didn't like in the hotel that is Shower with low speed water and the cleaning. Other than that every thing was perfect!!!

reviews.title: Las Vegas stay
reviews.text: Close to everything. Beds and pillows were comfortable. I liked that it’s only a 3 story buildings. We had a nice little balcony with a table and 2 chairs. The only downside for me is that they don’t have a washer and dryer in unit.

reviews.title: Excellent Choice
reviews.text: When considering this property, don’t be misled by the picture.  Wyndham has updated this resort.  The buildings are now shades of grey.  The decor has been modernized.  The pool are has a house tub, grill and pic ic area.  Amenities are very nice.  Close to the strip and without the resort charges.  Would stay here again

reviews.title: notes
reviews.text: nice place to stay. would like to be more towards the middle of the strip or a shuttle to the mid strip would be good as well. close to the airport, I could hear the planes at night. to much pressure to try to get a parking pass. they want to do a timeshare presentation

reviews.title: Comfortable, well maintained, friendly staff,
reviews.text: The reception staff is efficient and responsive, the resort is well laid out and conveniently located near the end of the Strip (next to the airport). The BBQs and firepits are handy and make for a pleasant stay. The only negative would be the wifi which tends to work only in certain areas and fades in and out.

reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text: Absolutely beautiful.  Within walking distance of the strip. Great amenities. Offered free won and cheese one day and another day free bbloody Mary's. Always calling to see if things are up to par. Only thing is cleaning isnt every day.

reviews.title: Just perfect for a nice family reunion trip
reviews.text: The Desert Rose provided a nice 1 bedroom apartment for the use of me and my two 20 something year old adult children.  It was perfect for us.  We enjoyed a hot tub that was suitably warm, a nice kitchen, two nice flat panel TVs and quality bedding.  The location was great.  We were not bothered by airport noise despite the proximity of the airport.  It was right next to the Hooters Hotel, which is next to the Tropicana which is on the Strip.  The MGM Grand monorail  stop was nearby allowing a quick commute to the Convention Center.

reviews.title: Rest & Relaxation. A Home Away From Home
reviews.text: Checkin was prompt. We were greeted by an attentive friendly caring staff. That catered to our every need. We stayed in the two bedroom suite. One room included a king size bed and bathroom. The other had a queen bed and a bathroom located across the hall with a small soaker tub. We had a full size living room. A dining room and full size kitchen. An oven and dishwasher included. The room was nicely decorated. The beds were comfortable. Our room views included many hotels on the strip and included the roller coaster. And on the other side. We had mountain views. The pool was a warm 75 degrees. It was perfect in Feb. With a cool breeze and a warm pool mixture. And the hot tub was phenomenal. The walking distance to the strip is minimal. And we had parking just outside our front door to the room. Save yourself resort fees by staying here. It would have cost us $70. a day. In fees alone. And that adds up quickly. We will stay here again! You can also save if you choose to cook in. And not dine out. It was a perfect home away from home.

reviews.title: Review continued
reviews.text: I do however need to thank a number of staff personally and hope the management acknowledge just how good these guys are as they went above and beyond in making our stay so wonderful.Firstly, Teri in guest relations, she was so helpful in answering all my questions before we even got there and  making us feel welcome when we arrived and helping us throughout our stay...hope the little goodies we left you found their way to you and thanks so much again for everything Teri....The food here is excellent.....The Palm is lovely for a buffet meal with endless varieties of food and lovely desserts....The adults only is a nice touch if you aren't bringing the children...   The A la Carte restaurants are fantastic, We enjoyed all of them..The Italian..Fatoosh & Seafood but our personal favourite was the Mexican......This was not just for the excellent food but for the staff who made us feel part of a big family each time we went... I feel this is down to the manager Eslam who his such a lovely welcoming man. From the first time we met him he made us feel like we were special and made time to talk with us and enjoy a laugh or two...this is passed down to his staff who take his lead and also befriend you and make you feel so welcome...Thank you so much Eslam...you truly are an asset to the hotel and we would make the effort to return to this hotel just to experience your hospitality in your restaurant alone.

reviews.title: Fine for off strip
reviews.text: There for a soccer tournament, not gambling or a normal Vegas vacation. Rooms had kitchens and living rooms, made it nice to make a meal or two.  Pool and hot tub were out of order, not sure if it was from a BabyRuth or not, but it never opened while we were there.  I get that fluorescent lights save money, but when they are all so blue, it makes it feel really institutional in the room.  The fire control box in the closet kept ticking and making odd noises.  Staff interaction was minimal, but happy hours were nice. So if you don’t want to stay on the strip but want to be walking distance, it’s fine.

reviews.title: Great for price, But NOT REALLY Great.
reviews.text: Ok this place is in a shady area.  There are apartments across the street that are abandoned and boarded up. Quite creepy actually. I wish the Facility was fully gated.  However they did block the entrance/exit close to the abandoned apartments at night with a plastic road barrier.  That did make me feel a little better.Upon arrival I entered my room and was very pleased.  It was neat and clean.  The bathroom is extremely tiny.  (The shower and toilet combo)  If your sharing with non family you may want to try another place as it’s difficult to change in there!   I usually dismiss when people complain about getting service when needed. BUT IT HAPPENED!  I called front desk about getting a luggage cart and a comforter for the sofa bed.  They said they would send someone right away.  Approx. an hour later I called again because no one had arrived.   The girl at the front desk said it was too late to get a comforter because housekeeping went home.  But she could send a blanket and a luggage cart.  I said ok.   30 minutes later someone came with a luggage cart but no blanket.  I believed HER that no one was able to get to it.  I thought the girls would be fine.  But they weren’t.  They were cold all night.  We were out all day so I had my husband call very late the next evening.  I told him “don’t let them tell you they can’t...We need it”.  Well what do you know.  The front desk said sure and there was a comforter up in 15 minutes.  No excuses that housekeeping went home.  NOT COOL.  One big plus, it’s walking distance to the strip. But the hotel/timeshare is just mediocre.  I did get asked to attend a presentation immediately after checking in.  But I was prepared and said I didn’t want to see any shows (they offer free shows or a free stay at another place.  But it’s not free, you pay $150/$200 up front then get the money back after attending the presentation.  No one wants to give 4+ hours of their vacation for a $40,000 time share sale!!!  Yes, that was the “lower deal price” they offered us afterwards.) I told her I had attended a timeshare presentation here in Las Vegas before and 2 hours is completely false.  (It is, and we did).   She finally let me go.  She took about 5-7 minutes but was then helpful and gave us a map.

reviews.title: Great Hotel close to the strip in a quite side street
reviews.text: We booked this hotel due to the good comments and recommmendations on this side and we have not been disappointed. Its not on the stip but in walking distance and the rooms that we saw are spacious and feel like a suite. Full kitchen equitment ist available and it made us feel like home just after arriving. If you look for a place better like a hotel room this is the right place.

reviews.title: Great family resort
reviews.text: We were incredibly happy with this resort, and our family of five agreed we would come back in a heart beat.We are not owners, but found a great deal on Expedia for a two bedroom unit.  The only drawback for us was the fact we were located at literally the back of the property, facing our onto the parking lot, and the construction in the motel across the street.Otherwise, we were thrilled with this property and it was located in an ideal spot to access the strip, but feel like you can get away from all the action.The beds were very comfortable, and the overall vibe of the resort worked perfectly for us.We’ll be back!

reviews.title: Property is Excellent. Skip the timeshare presentation!
reviews.text: This property far exceeded our expectations for the cost. The room layout is lovely.  Full kitchen, dining area, living area with master bedroom and bath, and a small balcony.  This property was renovated relatively recently and it shows.  The staff were super-friendly and helpful.  The bar/grill, while not excessive or fancy, was good and again the staff excellent.  And the best part...NO resort fees!  NO casino smoke (with the awful cover-up smell)!  This resort is now on our short list of places to stay when we come to Las Vegas. For the property - they get 5/5.Note - they don't service the room daily, but if you need more towels or shampoo, it's easy to ask and you will have them quickly.Now the downside. This property is part of the Wyndham Destinations organization of hotels.  As such - you have the option of attending a timeshare presentation (90 min) in exchange for show tickets or an Amex gift card.  We've attended these before, and we weren't going to do it.  BUT....the lure of a free show changed our mind.  BIG MISTAKE.90 minutes turned into 3.5 hours, and we were left to get ourselves back to the Desert Rose.   Once we made it back, the staff here were lovely, friendly, and quite apologetic.  Stay at the resort, just avoid the timeshare presentation (unless you want to waste half of a day AND get not-so-great-seats to a show).

reviews.title: Weekend to watch basketball with family
reviews.text: This was a great hotel.  It was so close to Hooters and was quiet. We wanted a place where we could play at Hooters but could sleep in a quiet room.  This was the perfect choice. The rooms are large and clean. The staff was always helpful and friendly. Just love this place!

reviews.title: Great family property
reviews.text: Nearest casino is Hooters which is nothing special. Pool was decent and overall the hotel was "not bad" although very expensive. You can get much more for your money staying at a resort! You will want a rental car otherwise you will be walking or catching a ride.

reviews.title: Home at Vegas
reviews.text: Love, love, love, we are owners here and always enjoy staying here every year. Rooms have been revamped. Never had an uncomfortable bed. Enjoy the full kitchen, we had a problem with the a/c the maintenance man was with us within 20 minutes. Close enough to the strip with a 5 minute walk.  Would recommend.

reviews.title: Great Stay
reviews.text: The family and I stayed here for sping break. There is a lot of room to move around. The rooms were clean and very comfortable.  Having a full kitchen was very convenient. The staff at the Resort were very nice from check in to check out. If you need a place to stay in Vegas with your family this Resort is great place to stay.

reviews.title: USBC National Trip
reviews.text: The DRS was very close to several casinos... MGM, Tropicana, Hooters, Luxor, Excalibur, and New Uork New York.  The property was very clean and the pool was fabulous during our stay. We took advantage of our kitchen and cooked breakfast two mornings and some friends used the grill near the pool to cook steaks & chops.My only complaint was that early in the morning I did hear the people in the room above us walking around and flushing the toilet while we were still trying to sleep.Overall, a very nice place at a very reasonable rate.

reviews.title: Don’t Do It!
reviews.text: So much for relaxing vacation. Drilling, hammering, sawing, & banging start at 7:30-8am every morning. The HVAC system sounds like a jet engine when running. If it's not enough to wake up every time the HVAC unit comes on and then get awaken every morning by Construction work. No idea I was coming for a vacation filled with renovations. I came to Vegas expecting to not get the normal 8 hours of sleep, after all its Vegas. But, I at least expect to be able to sleep when I am in my room. Absolutely terrible experience, wouldn't come back here again.You deserve better, don’t do it!

reviews.title: Really great place - just be ready for the check-in sales pitch!
reviews.text: We visited Vegas, 3 friends sharing the room for the week. Two days we had a rental car, the other days we were on foot. It was ideally located for us. For walking days we were in really easy walking distance of The Strip and most of the major attractions. For the days we had a car there was plenty of parking.The room isn’t one of mega glamour but clean, homely and had everything we needed. We didn’t want to spend a fortune on a plush hotel on The Strip, but we thought this was above standard for what we paid, we didn’t go with too many expectations as we had a great price but we were really pleased with it.My only negative is the sales pitch when you arrive. This isn’t at the check-in desk, once checked in you are told to go to another desk for a welcome pack. At this point, a very perisitant sales person will try and convince you to go to another one of their hotels for a 2 hour sales intro of their other businesses. In exchange they’ll give you show tickets or passes to experiences in Vegas. We weren’t interested in taking that time out of our break and found the sales pitch pretty aggressive and had messages left our room phone encouraging us to take it up. Basically, unless you particularly want to do this, just say no and ignore the sales guys. The pro’s of the hotel outweigh this negative. I was just disappointed at this element and my review would have been 5 stars without that.All in all, a definite recommendation.

reviews.title: What a peaceful stay!!
reviews.text: This was our second trip to Vegas. The last time we stayed at the Rio and did not have a good experience, so decided to give this property a try. We were greeted immediately upon arrival, and front desk staff was wonderful in explaining everything. They did advise us there is only housekeeping once per week, but if we needed anything (clean supplies) they would assist. The lobby wasn't very decorative or ornate, but was very clean and had a small store beside the front desk. This hotel had a pool/hot tub, BBQ area, adequate parking, laundry facilities and a short walk to the strip (maybe 10 minutes).Our room was spacious, full kitchen, dining area, living room (pull out couch) and separate bedroom. We had a great sleep each night, and temperature was easy to adjust, although the fan was pretty loud in the living area. There was no ambient noise, and we could not hear other guests at all. The shower was hot and had adjustable spray. TV was great, no problems with WIFI either. The kitchen was essentially fully stocked. We took a trip to a local smiths grocery, made our own breakfast/lunch each day and treated ourselves for dinner here and there.
