The kitchen and room were clean, and even had a few complementary snacks, coffee and cleaning supplies, if needed.All in all, a wonderful stay, we absolutely will return to this property and thank you to them for giving us a good memory to leave Vegas with this time!

reviews.title: Needs a renovation
reviews.text: I am very disappointed in this property.   The quality is far below the Shell/Wyndham brand.Pros: spacious rooms with kitchen.  Comfortable beds with nice TV and variety of channels. A small safe in the room.  Outdoor pool and jacuzzi. Friendly front deskCons: Noise!!!   Close to the airport but that would be okay if you didn’t hear every footstep and flush of your neighbor.  Since this is Vegas that means all hours of the day and night. There is no noise insulation.   Elevators small and dirty.  Rooms clean but  very worn.  Bathrooms small and dark. Location- be prepared to walk, taxi or Uber to everything.  Would not want to walk area at night.Would not come back.

reviews.title: 5 stars from us!!! Desert Rose a real Treasure!
reviews.text: We enjoyed the resort a great deal. We chose this resort based on the location to the strip and Excalibur, where the remaining of our family was staying.Our hotel room was clean and spacious. We had reserved a 1 bedroom unit that slept 3 people comfortably. The couch in the living room folds out to a very comfortable bed. our guest slept there.My husband and I took the bedroom and there is a privacy door. Only one bathroom and unfortunatly it's located in the bedroom. So our guest had to walk into our room to use the toilet and shower. Limited privacy. In the future if we come back with guest we will request a 2 bedroom unit!WE SLEPT GREAT!  OUR BEDS WERE SUPER COMFY! This was a very quiet time of year. We heard no noise what so ever.The location of the resort to the strip is the matter of blocks! We walked to the strip and back many times. And when we walked to much and tired ourselves out, we took a Lyft. And by the way LYFT is an affordable way to travel.  My nephew had a 21st birthday celebration!  That was the reason we had decided to come play in Vegas.  The front desk staff, bar staff., Security team, housekeeping team and Maintenance and management are amazing! The staff are trained well to adhere to the rules of saftey of the guest.   I got locked out of my room I asked th housekeeper to let me in my room. She said she would contact security to let me in and minuets later a security officer arrived and made sure I was the person who rented that unit before I was let in. Some people might get annoyed by that. I was thankful that I was quized regarding my identiy. Saftey!One time during the stay, the toilet over flowed, yeah I know that sucked but it happens sometimes. Maintenance was there within minuets and he had housekeeping cleanup the excess water and mop the floor. No compliants from anyone!I would personally like to thank everyone at the Front Desk;  Kiana, Troielle, Ilena, Charie, Athena, Michael Holland, Yvonne and Grace for all the advice and assistance each of you gave to us and our guest while we were at the Resort.The bartenders Moses and Jason, we appreciated the Mimosas and Bloody Marys, they were delicious. The Front Desk Manager Mr. Travis Fryman is extraordinary & compassionate. He is kind, considerate and he made our stay most inviting. A bottle of champange was awaiting for us upon our arrival, in celebration of course for my nephews 21st birthday!Honestly, we would be delighted to come back.  Personally, for myself I like the resort because its small and quaint. It feels like home. I didn't feel lost, like I do at large resorts. Everything is within a short walking distance. Laundry on the first level. short walk to pool, hot tub and grilling amenities. Onsite pool table too!Desert Rose is a treasure in LAS VEGAS~Our travel dates 3/01 to 3/05

reviews.title: Pretty good - clean and neat.
reviews.text: Just understand that you're going to get hit with a pitch when you check in. Otherwise it really was pretty nice. Comfortable furnishings, clean room and bathrooms. We had a 2 bed/2 bath. Didn't use the kitchen at all, but everything seemed really clean. Probably a pretty recent remodel. Quiet enough, near the strip. Walking distance to MGM, NYNY, etc. Also close to the airport. Pricing was high, but it was NASCAR weekend, so the value was still there.

reviews.title: Noisy
reviews.text: This was our 4th stay here and our worst, we stayed for 3 nights to rest up before our long journey back to the UK. Our first night we hardly got any sleep as one of the outside doors connected to the wall of our room was broken and kept banging we complained in the morning and after much discussion we moved to another room. Had a good nights sleep but our last night we were kept awake again due to our upstairs neighbors banging around and then arguing loudly with each other, and again in the morning. We will not stop here again

reviews.title: Handy Timeshare near the Strip
reviews.text: We have stayed here several times. The beds are very comfortable, the living space is fine, Everything in the small kitchen space you might need, although electric outlets are oddly placed. Our family enjoyed the hot tub. There is a bar and grill in the main lobby. We didn’t try it so can’t comment.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I really appreciate my stay at the Desert Rose Resort from February 22 to 26, 2019. The hotel is really a pearl in the middle of the busy Las Vegas entertainment area. The pool and the hot tub area is perfect to relax and the hotel staff is always trying to help and make your stay even better.I would only suggest to keep the cleaning standards a little bit higher in the room hallways and inside the rooms. We found some hair and dirtiness once we arrived. Also, the internet wi-fi does not work if you are in the pool and barbecue area.

reviews.title: Room not clean
reviews.text: Location is very good, first impressions not very good, pot smoke VERY strong when we stepped into room and there after the smoke smell was stronger then any casino. Corners in a small bathroom were dirty and had hair in them. Room was just not clean. Wifi was poor

reviews.title: Price and location are good
reviews.text: For what we paid I felt ok. It’s the only hotel that I could accommodate a family of 6 without issue or breaking the bank. Easy walk to MGM Grand and from their the monorail or the strip. Also convenient to the Tropicana or even the Excalibur for more food options. Also Hooters is right there if that’s your thing.Hotel is clean but many guests are loud or slam the gates accidentally. When you check in they immediately pressure you into timeshare sales by telling you to go the concierge for a parking pass. Just tell them no firmly.Parking is easy, no issue there.Small bar available for drinks or coffee.Pool must be heated along with the hot tub as it was being used despite it being freezing out.

reviews.title: Amazing place - will never stay in a strip hotel again!!
reviews.text: Stayed here with 3 friends for my 40th, cannot recommend it enough. Staff were super friendly, Kiana especially made pur stay really special, spotlessly clean, everything you could ask for or need in a home away from home. Safe, secure, comfortable and literally 3 minutes walk from the strip if you cut through MGM casino - PERFECT!!Cannot wait to come back 💗💗💗💗💗

reviews.title: Great value
reviews.text: Loved the service and the price. Close enough to the strip to really enjoy it. Staff was friendly and ready to accommodate. Room was nice and large, clean too. They don't do regular housekeeping, but was quick to accommodate when we needed anything.

reviews.title: Poor Service / Horrible Experience
reviews.text: Generally, I give high ratings if a resort provides quality and exceptional service. And I do judge fairly as noted from my previous ratings.  However, unfortunately, although I tried to find the good in this resort, it was such a horrible experience that I cannot give this resort a rating higher than two (2)!I selected this resort as an exchange to my timeshare.  It was a last minute booking and they were the only resort available for the timeframe that I needed to spend in Vegas.When we arrived, the front desk told me after checking in to go to the Concierge for a welcome gift and map.  I thought they were going to give me a map with directions to my room, but the lady who assisted us started trying to solicit us to schedule a timeshare presentation.  I told her that we are exhausted from our BART and then Airplane travel time and just wanted to get to our room first to relax and only came to the Concierge desk cause the front desk told us to stop there first for a map of the area, but she kept pushing us to sign-up to watch a presentation and then telling us we can have gifts for just going to the presentation.  I told her that I’m tired and just want to get to my room, then she insisted that I call her when I’m rested so that she can get credit for talking to me and she’ll give me gifts to use while I’m in Vegas.  It was a bad first impression being solicited upon arrival, especially with carry-on and luggages, and we were tired from the travel and just wanted to relax in our room first.Then we were told that mid-week, we would have someone clean our room on New Year’s Eve.  We were gone the whole day into the night and retuned the following day on New Year’s Day, but our room wasn’t touched at all.  No one replenished our towels or provided additional paper towel or toilet paper.  I ended up having to use the pool towels provided in the room since we needed fresh towels.I called the front desk to have someone replenish our towels and at least provide us with additional supplies, but they said I can’t be in the room when they clean.  I said they were supposed to clean yesterday and we were gone all day, but I’ll step out if I need to.  They said they would send someone.  After waiting 30minutes, no one showed, so I called for assistance again.  Front desk said all the housekeepers were busy.  I asked for an ETA so that I’m not waiting around for a housekeeper to replenish my items especially since it should have been done yesterday.  Long story short, I waited over an hour for housekeeping to show and the housekeeper couldn’t speak English.  She took the pool towels that I used and I told her aren’t you going to replace that with 2 other pool towels because there is a sign that says I would be responsible for any missing towels at $25.00 each?  She couldn’t understand a word I was saying, so I had to call the front desk again to tell them that the housekeeper took two pool towels and didn’t replace it because she didn’t understand English.  They said they would document that.  I asked if someone who speaks English can come to my room, so I can talk to them about what I need.  Unfortunately, I was told that all their housekeepers who were working that day only spoke Spanish.  The housekeeper was pleasant, but it was difficult trying to express what I wanted to when she couldn’t speak English at all.  Not only was the wait for housekeeping long and frustrating, but to have a language barrier on top of that and to think that I would be charged with an additional $50 for 2 towels that I was forced to use because they did not clean my room on time and there was no other clean towels to use at the moment and not having it replaced so that I am not charged for the 2 towels the housekeeper took.  Also, I went to the convenience store to buy a soda and tried to pay with cash since it was $2.50.  They said I needed to use a debit card.  I said, “What a reverse, most people accept cash?” So I had to go back to my room to get my debit card to pay for only a $2.50 purchase. It just went downhill from then.  One bad experience to another.  I will not select this resort to stay at again.  No wonder they probably have vacancies.  It’s because the service was horrible.  The only reason I’m giving it a 2 instead of 1 is because the rooms were initially clean aside from the poor service and the employees were pleasant aside from individuals who made the overall experience terrible.

reviews.title: Great place.
reviews.text: Our first visit to Las Vegas and was very optimistic with staying at the desert rose due to others reviews. This place is great for location just round the corner from hooters, new York New York and MGM grand our view from our apartment was of the luxor and was lovely. Also Ample parking. I will however give everyone a heads up to not get drawn in by the 'free breakfast' for 150💲 gift card this is a time share thing and is a complete waste of time the lady offered this to us after our 10hour flight and tbh we just wanted to drop out bags off and start exploring so we said yes and was obviously caught with the gift card! We wasted 5hours at a sister hotel and the breakfast was pants! Don't get wrapped up in it.The hotel itself was good for what we needed a few dodgy characters changing around the locked gates at night with a strong smell of marijuana staff were all very polite and friendly just what we needed 😊

reviews.title: Great for families
reviews.text: We had a 2 bedroom apartment on the 3rd floor facing the Tropicana and Delano Resort. Looking over the rear car park.Main bedroom had a tv, walk-in closet, mirror , en-suite with shower and toilet ( plenty of room) and then a vanity which was between the bedroom and shower .  Hairdryer also.Either a super king or California king bed which was very comfortable . 2nd bedroom had a queen bed, tv, walk in wardrobe.Another bathroom with hairdryer, bath and shower.Large closet also with a safe .Kitchen- full oven, full size fridge/freezer, sink , coffee maker and plates,bowls, cups, glasses etc.Living area had a tv, balcony and chair and a sofa.Fantastic property for families.Property approx 5 min walk to the strip.( property is also a timeshare , but we had no hard sell) The rooms look as if they have been updated a few years ago.The outside looks more recently painted a gray colour . Lots of little court yards between buildings.They have a pool, however closed when we were there .Lobby looked more recently furnished and looked open and spacious . Very welcoming.Would happily stay again

reviews.title: A nice less expensive alternative to the big strip hotels.
reviews.text: This is a lovely Wyndham hotel just a block off the LV strip.  It is located right behind Hooters hotel.  It was a 5 min walk to the MGM.  It is a large spread out hotel, 3 floors, all rooms have balconies and a full kitchen, living room and large bedroom.  Room 1313 overlooks an internal courtyard so very quiet though no view.  I don't think any of the rooms have much of a view.  Large bedroom with king size bed and modern bathroom.  I didn't use the kitchen but it looked well stocked.  There is a pullout couch in the living room so plenty of room for a family of 4.  The only downside is the food offerings. There is a very small bar in the lobby that offers breakfast and lunch but the offerings are very limited and it took nearly 45 mins for breakfast to arrive.  There are only a few seats at the bar so we ate sitting on the lobby couches.  The next morning we walked over to the MGM and had a fabulous breakfast at their main Cafe.  And it surprisingly wasn't expensive.The Desert Rose has an outdoor pool but it was chilly during our stay and the pool is under renovation so we didn't use it. We could have walked over to their Grand Desert Rose location to use the pool if we wanted to.The front desk staff, housekeeping staff and security that I met were all friendly, helpful and professional.

reviews.title: A nice hotel off the strip but........
reviews.text: We stayed at the Desert Rose for New Years Eve for 3 nights. The unit was wonderful-spotless and everything that you could possibly need. We were a 8-10 minute walk to the strip-loved the Hotel BUT did not like the time share pushing. We had been traveling for over 9 hours and just wanted to go to our room. We were sent to the other side of the lobby and persuaded to visit a time-share. DON'TGO!!! We wasted a whole afternoon in a office when we should of been enjoying Vegas..

reviews.title: Family Vacation
reviews.text: This hotel was extremely close to the strip considering it wasn't on Las Vegas boulevard. This hotel had 2 queens, a very comfortable double pullout couch and a king bed in a 2 bedroom suite with a good equipped kitchen. The lobby was modern and the staff was nice. I wouldn't recommend going to the timeshare presentation to get free stuff because it was expensive to start, too long, and there are too many staff persuading you. I still recommend staying at the Desert Rose but don't go to the timeshare presentation at the other hotel.

reviews.title: We are so pleased that we chose this hotel
reviews.text: We really like this hotel, they called themselves a "resort".  To me, it is a 3 storey high apartment like hotel.  It is a self contain suite.  Ours is a 1 bedroom apartment with a full kitchen, dinner table, living room with a sofa bed, 2 wall TVs, one in the living room and in the bedroom, full ensuite.  Just south of the green MGM, I took the bus (ie. SDX & Deuce, WAX to & from the airport) in the first few days, very convenient.  Room is super clean, very quiet, no complain at all.  Did not get push to listen to their Resort presentation. We booked it through Expedia a few months before the trip, it is only $110 Canadian/night + tax, many other hotel on the Strip in Vegas has a daily “resort fee”, be very careful when booking, it could be $50+ per night on top of the daily rate. Has 2 USB plugs on each side of the night table

reviews.title: Great non-casino stay for families
reviews.text: Had 2 kids and wanted to find a place near the strip but not in a casino. This place fit the bill perfectly. Looks a little dated but service and amenities were great and the room was spacious and very clean. A great stay!

reviews.title: Dec visit
reviews.text: Over all a good and neat place. Some staff were friendly other not. They were busy with renovations during our stay. Pool and Jacuzzi were closed. We were without water for a day with no compensation or free water when asked if they would supply water I was told that we could buy some of we wanted. Loud banging and fire alarm three times were a bit much.

reviews.title: Excellent value
reviews.text: We like staying off the strip out of the hustle and bustle.  Nice property, well taken care of and recently updated. Pool and fitness room are neat and clean. Just a five minute walk to the strip at the MGM end and Uber rides are under $10.  Enjoy, we sure

reviews.title: Quite a disappointment
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Desert Rose several times (the time before this only being in September 2018) so was looking forward to spending time there over Thanksgiving when my mom and stepfather used their timeshare, however, the stay, starting with their arrival, was just not up to par in any way!Our room was a two bedroom suite with a kitchen, living room, dining room, two bedrooms and two bathrooms. The room was very nice size and quite comfortable for 5 of us. The bed in the second bedroom claims to be a queen but in all honesty, it looked and felt like a double. The pillows were all extremely soft and not comfortable! I had to use like 4 in order to get into a comfortable position.  The only lighting in the room are two table side lamps which don’t give off much light. It seems that there should be an overhead light, possibly with a ceiling fan, in each room to lighten them up! My mom and stepfather checked in on Sunday, November 18th and right away had an issue with the heater and air conditioner not working correctly. Someone came to check it for them and told them it was okay but it really never actually worked right for our entire stay.The first morning they were there, my mom went to use the hair dryer in the master bedroom bathroom and it was broken. She called to request a new one and did not get it right away so she went to get the one in the other bathroom but there was none. She had to call back to tell the front desk that she really need a working dryer AND that shewas going to need the 2nd dryer aswe were going to be there and would need them both. She said it seemed like no one thought a broken hair dryer was a big deal and no one seemed to be in any hurry to help her! We arrived on Wednesday and when I helped my 9 year old nephew with the shower on Thursday morning, in the guest bathroom, the shower was broken and we were unable to use it. All 5 of us had to use the shower in the master bathroom while we waited for maintenance to fix the other one. It turns out the valve was broken and was an easy fix but having worked at a couple of different hotels, I know that housekeeping should be checking EVERYTHING at I make sure it is all in order in between guests! Also, in the guest bathroom, there was HAIR on the wall and the back side of the door that was none of ours! It was so gross and again, having been a manager at a hotel and having to spot check rooms, I am well aware that these things should be checked and cleaned between check ins!! Housekeeping obviously was NOT doing their job and because it was so gross, I wiped it all down myself!!One of the nights the guest bathroom toilet overflowed all over the bathroom floor and when we called for maintenance, someone actually came up pretty quickly! Once he got the toilet plunged, HE actually told us to call the front desk and they would be able to send someone up to mop the bathroom floor for us. My mom called downstairs and was told that there was no one in Housekeeping and we would have to clean it all up ourselves! It wasn’t even offered that someone would bring up a mop or anything to help so we had to use the pool towels and dish soap to make sure the floor was clean and dry! A few other things to note are that (1) the door in the master bedroom closes on its own so it is annoying when you are trying to do anything  (2) the cover over the fan in the master bathroom was not attached and was half falling off. We were afraid that it was going to fall at anytime (3) The drawers in the chest of drawers located in the living room kept sliding open (4) the carpet in the elevator was pretty nasty! Every time we got in it someone commented on it. It just need to be removed and maybe just a mat should take its place?On the plus side:  (1) Parking is free and there seemed to be plenty off it (2) proximity to the South end of the strip is nice (3) we utilized the metro bus on one of the days and it was super easy to get from one of the strip to the other (4) the property is non gaming and non smoking  (5) they do have a LITTLE bar so you can get a drink if you are so inclined.Again, having stayed at the Desert Rose many times, I look forward to each stay there but this stay was just not good!! As with some of the other Shell properties we have stayed at since becoming Wyndham, the service does not seem to be the same nor does the quality of the property! It is disheartening because one always assumes that Wyndham properties should all be pretty nice!

reviews.title: Hidden Gem. So close, but away from the noise.
reviews.text: Changed our booking to Desert Rose Resort after reading bad reviews of our original booking.Desert Rose Resort is next to Hooters Casino Hotel away from the noise of the Las Vegas Strip but an easy 7 minute walk gets you amongst the glitz and glamour. Starting at the MGM Grand and New York, New York.Our accommodation had a full kitchen, dining/lounge and separate bedroom with ensuited bathroom.Friendly, helpful staff on check in. Only blot was one employee (David) who never smiled when I held the door open for him or when he brusquesly delivered supplies to our room later.Definitely a place to stay when we come back to Las Vegas.

reviews.title: The personal service of a small hotel
reviews.text: We arrived Christmas Eve. The concierge wasn't working that night but we were supposed to check in with them on another day to get our "welcome package". We never checked in with them since we didn't have a car. They were relentless about calling our room but we did not answer. One time while we were waiting for Uber, one of the salespeople came over to strike up a conversation but we got away as the driver arrived. We were in the lobby area many times during our stay waiting for an ride or a food delivery so we got to hear the sales pitch being perpetrated on many new arrivals. It is true that if you accept their "free" tickets to something they request you contribute some payment. None of the giveaway enticements sounded worth having. I'm not upset about the selling since we avoided it. We asked for a quiet room and were put in Building 3, top floor, view of courtyard. It was very quiet except sometimes our next-door neighbors had noisy parties. It never got loud enough or lasted long enough for us to call the front desk. When we first arrived, my husband went in the restroom and found that the toilet was not flushing. We called and maintenance came right away . . .  on Christmas Eve! The problem was fixed within minutes. The apartment was extremely clean right down to corners and baseboards. There was dish soap, dishwasher detergent, recycling bags, paper towels, etc. If you need to wash clothes, there is a laundry room near the elevator and the front desk will give you detergent and Bounce dryer sheets just by asking. There were plenty of towels in the bathroom area including some in a cabinet under the sink. There's also pool towels at the bottom of the night stand. To sum up, any supplies you might need are there. They also had a pantry in the lobby to buy snacks and during the day there was a "Grille" that made hot food that was pretty good and priced normally. Our one-bedroom unit had lots of drawers, counter tops and electric outlets. There were two closets with plenty of hangers. In terms of location, this was very near the strip. If you hesitate to stay here because you may have limited mobility, I think it would be okay. A person used to walking could get over to the MGM in under ten minutes. I am not great at long walks because of my back so we did use Uber for trips to hotels on the Strip. It was never expensive and we were spending only $6-7 per trip for UberX. There was only one thing I didn't like about the room we had. The toilet is in a small space between a wall and the bathtub. We both repeatedly hit our hand on the tub. You won't be able to close the door if you are already sitting down so that is a decision to make before doing your business. It made me think of an airplane restroom if the sink part in the plane restroom was a tub. Also, the tub wall needs a handlebar for safety. The kitchen was awesome and had plenty of appliances. You'll be able to make toast and blend up smoothies. I've read in some reviews that there is disappointment about the lack of a kettle. All the large appliances are spotless and the refrigerator smelled like nothing - not old food, nor cleaning solution. Just clean. One thing I suggest if you are staying a few days, there will be leftovers. Put food storage bags on your shopping list.I'm trying not to leave anything out. While we were there, I saw an ATM machine in an alcove off the lobby but I didn't have a reason to use it. There was also a pool table in big room off the lobby. I also saw a business center with computers but never went in there. We will definitely stay here when we return to Las Vegas and will recommend to people who might ask us.

reviews.title: Nicely renovated , now owned and managed by Wyndham
reviews.text: Enjoyed a beautifully renovated 1 bedroom suite on the top floor in building 4. Had access to the Wyndham club down the road for pools and sauna, as the Desert Rose is in final pool renovations. If you are a timeshare owner of SVC, do attend the ownership update with Beth ( presenter) as you'll get some excellent tips. Merry Christmas and worth a dtay again.

reviews.title: Quiet and close to strip
reviews.text: We booked a timeshare week in Dec and had a spacious 2 bedroom suite. Comfy beds, small but well equipped kitchen, clean. Stayed in building 3 facing parking lot -be advised it is very noisy with traffic, sirens and garbage collection in the early morning. I would ask for a room facing the inside. Security was always present in the night and locked gates.This hotel is very quiet-no casino or restaurants. The pool and hot tub are being remodeled which we were not told about when we booked. Very disappointing as we would have used it for sure or booked somewhere else!Check in went smoothly and the front desk staff member was fantastic! Very willing and knowledgeable to give us advice for day trips etc.We had read reviews giving us a heads up about the timeshare gimmick rattled off by the concierge. In order to get our parking pass we had to listen to her. I must admit we got sucked in! Even when we said we weren’t interested in buying timeshare she asked why? She made it sound so easy- no pressure just go and look at the new property, get a free breakfast and you’ll get $500 worth of tickets to a show. Don’t fall for it! First she asked for $10 for each of the 4 tickets (WOW show) so we had to give $40 upfront- obviously so you don’t back out! They shuttled is over to the new resort which was gorgeous! A salesperson met us and showed us some rooms and pool etc. Then led us to a horrible breakfast like you would get at a hotel free continental. Then we had to sit for an hour with the one lady and listen to her talk about their properties.  Even though we told her from the start we had no intention of buying another timeshare she still had to put in her time with us in order for  her to for fill her required responsibilities. Very awkward!  All of the timeshare managers that were walking around and staring at us couldn’t believe that we weren’t wanting to buy. They even asked what are we doing there????  We did get our free vouchers to the show  but the seats that are reserved for timeshare recipients are in the $50 ticket section. I even looked on Groupon and those tickets were going for $30. So definitely there was no such thing as $500 worth of tickets. Those are only for the best seats in the house which they don’t give you.... unless maybe we bought the timeshare!?? As far as the location of this resort it is very close to south end the strip.  You can easily walk to Excalibar Mandalay Bay MGM New York New York  T.  Mobile arena. From any of those places you can hop on a bus to see the rest of the strip.  We rented a car so went and got groceries several times which I would definitely recommend. We went to Walmart. There is a little convenient store  in the Arco gas station just across from the Luxor which has cheap beer etc There is a laundry room in every building. It cost $1.25 for a dry and $1.75 for a wash so bring your quarters. They also had a wine and cheese social in the lobby a couple of times at 4 o’clock during that week which was really nice. They do have a little coffee bar that serves some sandwiches at certain times in the day and also a bit of breakfast I think. Also drinks later in the day. All in all a quiet little getaway close enough to the strip with very friendly staff and clean surroundings. Will be nice when pool is up and running...

reviews.title: Cheap and cheerful
reviews.text: Great rooms really clean complex, next door to Hooters and across the road from the MGM grand which leads you straight on to the strip. Very quiet we did not get hassled with the time share pack, we just explained we were not interested and they just left us alone to enjoy our hols. Resort has no extra fees like you have to pay on the strip plus you get free parking which is a bonus in Las Vegas, I would stay at this resort again if ever in Vegas.

reviews.title: Very good value for the money  with courteous, attentative staff
reviews.text: Travelers have to decide what is the most important to them. Desert Rose is a good choice for those people  who want to cook some of their meals  and don't mind walking somewhat since it is 1.5 blocks from the side of MGM. We stayed in a 2 bedroom. The rooms are spacious  and clean as was the outdoor pool and spa. There is a daily bus to drive guests to a grocery store so a car isn't essential.The lobby has a lounge and small bar area with foods to go.This isn't the place for those seeking an onsite casino and room service or  flash but it is an excellent value for everyone else.

reviews.title: LOVELY  FRIENDLY PLACE
reviews.text: Lovely  quiet  safe  clean  friendly  place.   easy  to  get to  near  the  airport.   reception  great  and  holiday  attraction s  given  a free leaflet to  all  things  free.   DEBORAH  very  good and  neil   .   room   great   could  make  breakfast .  i  loved  it  and  will  come back . cpmccaughan@aol.com

reviews.title: An Excellent Stay Just off the Strip
reviews.text: This is an attractive and very clean and well maintained property. We enjoyed our stay and found the staff to be very friendly and helpful. Location was just off the Strip and convenient to everything. Recommend.

reviews.title: Lots to like despite disappointments
reviews.text: We selected this hotel to stay off-strip with our seven year old for a couple of reasons: we don't care for casinos; we don't like to walk 12 miles from our car to get to our room; we don't like smoke; we don't like parking fees; and we don't like resort fees. This resort scored on all these points. We were in a 2 bedroom/2 bath suite. The beds were comfortable. The suite was clean. The full-size kitchen was ideal. It was incredibly easy to get from our car to the room after mornings of hiking. Now the not-so-good. There were USB ports next to all the beds, but only the ones in the small bedroom worked. We were on the side closest to Hooters, and we could hear the bass until 3am. When people moved in upstairs after the first night, they seemed to like to do light furniture moving at midnight, so we heard furniture scraping across the floor. I get it, but there's not too much to be done about that. But there are two huge drawbacks. First, none of the HD TVs really worked. They were nice TVs, but they were zoomed in too far. Worse, the reception was terrible. We planned to watch the Thanksgiving football games in our living room, but the reception was indecipherable. The only room with good enough reception to actually see the plays (albeit, there was still a tremendous amount of "snow") was in the guest bedroom, so we all huddled in there. Additionally, there was no cold water in the guest shower. It was only hot water, scalding hot water that would have burned people who just jumped in. So the benefit of having two showers to clean up after hiking was gone. We decided just to deal with these inconveniences. I mentioned them at check-out and they apologized. They want people to buy into their time share system (you'll get asked to attend a presentation). If I bought into a time share, I would expect the TVs and bathrooms to be impeccable. I would think they would make sure every time that things people use daily (like TVs and showers) were in perfect order, and these were not. These were huge disappointments. We anticipate returning to Vegas in the not too distant future, and as much as we liked the set up and the layout, we will have to think about whether the risk of more inconveniences is worth it.

reviews.title: Loved it....was Perfect for me.
reviews.text: Never being in Vegas and by myself.....really looked into a good place to stay.  Well, I definitely found it!!  A quiet place with a kitchen, living room and bedroom.  Nice home away from home.  Most of staff was great and their concierges were amazing....especially Nichole and Belinda!!  Loved you girls and thank you for all your help!!  :)  Would definitely return!!  I had problems with a couple things in my room....and they were fixed in no time.  It was within walking distance to just about all of the strip, if you don't mind walking!!  They have happy hour on Fridays with wonderful (free) strawberry daquiri's and a lovely pool and hot tub.  Rooms were clean and comfy. I know where I'll be staying if I ever get a chance to go back.  Thanks you all for making me feel like I wasn't alone for a week!!

reviews.title: Lovely, relaxing stay a short walk from the strip!
reviews.text: I stayed here for a week in September with my family for a family member’s wedding. From the moment we arrived, we were impressed by how clean the reception area was. Staff at check in were fantastic and this didn’t take too long at all. The suite was spacious and adequate for what we all needed during our stay. Our room did smell quite stale and as though there had been previous guests smoking, but we did inform reception and they sent someone to check this. It did go away once you had been in the room but was noticeable upon entering. There was a fully equipped kitchen, however there is no kettle - only a coffee machine. There were plenty of utensils, spacious fridge and lots of cupboards for storage. The only bad thing to this is that the cupboards are extremely high - I did struggle to reach at times, however this didn’t affect my stay. As this was my first time in Vegas and we were there for a wedding, we spent little time using the kitchen facilities within the room, but there was more than enough there if you wanted to cook etc. The bedroom was large, with a comfortable bed and a tv in this separate bedroom. The double sofa bed was also very comfortable and there were plenty of pillows provided. It would be handy to have a spare duvet in the room as there was only a sheet and a blanket (which was quite itchy) for the sofa bed. We did ask at reception for a duvet, however we were given three mattress protectors. Again, this didn’t really affect our stay but it would make sleeping arrangements even more comfortable if there was another duvet. There were plenty of towels left for the pool and for the bathroom. The rooms are supposed to be cleaned once per week - I don’t think they are cleaned thoroughly, more of a quick tidy round i.e. bins emptied and towels replaced, soap replaced etc. We were not given any spare toilet rolls, however we asked at reception and the lady kindly gave us two without any fuss. The pool area was more than adequate, enough sun loungers and seats for the amount of guests that were there. It was relaxing to sit out in the Vegas sun after a heavy few days on the strip. The food at the hotel’s bar was excellent and very reasonably priced. I would definitely recommend the BLT sandwich and the pizzas. The staff at this hotel are extremely attentive! They have excellent customer service, are very professional and friendly, and know how to make their guests feel welcome. I was unwell on one particular day and a member of the team offered me a bottle of water and tissues (free of charge), making sure I was ok - this is often very rare in other hotels. I also informed reception that a member of my family was getting married and they left a card and chocolates as a small gesture, which was a lovely touch. The hotel’s tuck/gift shop that was located by reception was reasonably priced and was always well stocked. Reception staff were always on hand to call for taxis and made our stay very enjoyable. There is an ATM machine located near the bar, which came in useful. There are also two drinks dispensers by the pool tables - cold water and fresh lemonade, which is free to help yourself too. If I ever return to Vegas, I will most definitely return to this hotel! It is only a 10/15 minute walk to the hustle and bustle of the strip, and is in an excellent location to be far enough away from the main attractions allowing you to get some rest if you need it. The hotel is also ideally situated next to Hooters, which is one of the cheaper casinos for drinks etc. There is a lovely little cafe/restaurant about a 5 minute walk from across the hotel called Coco’s Bakery - we ate there most days for breakfast, which was cheap and very tasty.

reviews.title: Good location just off the strip
reviews.text: Very good location just off the strip. Friend has a timeshare so we were able to stay here for a great price. Clean and comfortable room. Not connected to a casino so it's quiet. Small kitchen which had all the basic necessities including full sized fridge and dishwasher. Free parking and free Wi-Fi are nice bonuses. I'd definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Two days with no working toilet?
reviews.text: Yes this place is highly rated, and we've stayed here twice before too...and were impressed, so went back for a third time.  But something in the management and maintenance has changed there. We two days in a room where the toilet would not flush even a single sheet of toilet paper and the hotel kept stalling on fixing it. We declined the room change on Day 1 since it didn't occur to us that they wouldn't fix it, but then their "engineering" department never did come back? So... our opinion has changed.  Oh yeah...and they still charged us full price at check out time.  This is definitely not the same place it used to be …(and beware of the time-share hype they will now put on you at check in time. They are building some new hotel and they are laying on the "free dinner" or "free show tickets" if you agree to come to one of our presentations.  For a minute I thought we were in Mexico.    We'll be looking elsewhere next time we're down that way

reviews.title: Good location, nice place
reviews.text: It has a good location near Hooters Casino and Tropicana Casino. The staff is excellent. We had a 1-bedroom suite on the first floor, which was nice and clean, but the air conditioner was loud when it ran.  The bathroom is small, but the sink area outside the bathroom is roomy. Must go through the bedroom to get to the bathroom. Sofa bed was comfortable.

reviews.title: Great resort!
reviews.text: This resort was very nice, extremely clean, and only a short walk from the strip.  The staff went above and beyond to make our check in, our stay, and our check out pleasant.  They made sure all of our needs were met and even held onto our bags for several hours the last day of our stay so that we didn't have to drag them around with us. Excellent resort that I will definitely visit again.

reviews.title: Excellent property but beware!
reviews.text: We loved this property.  It was renovated, great beds, nice stocked kitchen.  They helped with every question we had and had a taxi at the front door in minutes.  It's within minutes from the Strip but was quiet at night.  No complaints.That being said, after we checked in we were told to go to the Concierge to receive our welcome package which included a Vegas map and parking permit.  We got the package, didn't need a parking permit, but then got a pitch for a timeshare presentation for the next morning.  We could get a $125 prepaid card or $40 for 3 tickets to a show just for attending the 120 minute presentation which included breakfast. It didn't bother us too much because we wanted breakfast and a deal  on a show.  We learned that the Desert Rose is part of the Wyndham resorts.  When they are not booked with timeshare owners they rent the rooms as a hotel.  We got a tour of a larger resort which was very nice and had nice amenities.  Everyone was nice, but we weren't interested.  Of course, you could just say no at the beginning, but getting 3 tickets for $40 to a major Cirque Du Soliel show was worth it for us - and the show as great!!

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: Lovely hotel everything you need ,staff very friendly & helpful can't do enough for you .love the barbeque area free to use every day/night ,we loved this being a family of 10 .pool great loads comfy beds ,hot tub great .rooms very modern massive beds ,fridge freezer huge ,oven/microwave huge honestly couldn't ask for more .Great location right near hooters & mgm short walk 2 strip ,uber taxis great if needed .local shops very expensive but if you get taxi or walk reasonable prices 1hr walk away or 10min taxi ride huge difference in price .

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: I have been to this place many times.I was there for 5 days in Oct and was pleased to see renovated rooms. The front desk  staff were very nice.Thats the good part.So there is a little trick they play on you at check in. After you get your room keys you are directed to go to the concierge desk to get your parking permit.I went there and the girl started talking to me about their new sister property and offers of gifts as a reward for checking it out and all this.I said I was very tired and just wanted to park my car and go to bed.Then she wanted us to buy Vegas tours and so on.I had to say can I please get my parking pass and go.Terrible and inconsiderate.Night 5 I get a call in the room from a lady asking me if I liked my stay and I said yes and she proceeded to go on with the time share sales pitch again.I said I was not interested.I said I got the same thing at the concierge desk.I hung up the phone.So this bothered me.I called back to the lobby and I asked for the name of this person.The same person answered.I got her name.20 min went by and I got another call from this person lecturing me and saying that if I stay at a hotel like this I am to expect this.She said that she was doung her job and I should have told the front desk to put my room on the no call list???? Be aware of this at check in. All they end up doing is pissing off their guests.

reviews.title: Great place right off the strip!
reviews.text: Me and my wife went to celebrate our anniversary in Vegas and chose this place...we were very pleased! First let me say the staff was very friendly and helpful. It’s literally right off the strip you could walk! Our room was very nice and had everything you would need plus more...

reviews.title: Friendliest staff
reviews.text: This place makes you feel really welcome.  It is a lot of bang for your buck. The staff will help youwith anything and everything you want or need. The suites were very clean and the pool area is like a party.  Close to everything.  A great place to stay    :)

reviews.title: Not on the strip...but close!
reviews.text: We spent 2 nights at the Desert Rose. It was a pretty nice place. It is nice because it is away from the strip, yet close enough to walk there is you want. (its a 10-15 min walk). There were 3 of us in the suite. The bed was good, although the sofa bed was just OK. The room was clean and had a full kitchen. It is really nice having the kitchen, esp the frig! We were able to fill it with lots of water and drinks for the hot walks to and from the strip!!  Our room was clean. We didn't ave any problems with the timeshare people. We were ready for them because of reviews and we told them we weren't interested and they were fine.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Lovely hotel
reviews.text: Rooms very spaces and large , pool area clean ,staff  very friendly, great location,the only downside was not cleaned ie floors, bathroom, kitchen, although bedding and towels changed twice in 12days.no tax on rooms and a quieter hotel this was nearly perfect

reviews.title: Perfect for a family
reviews.text: We’re done staying on the strip. Now that we have a toddler, this place was everything we needed. Fully equiped kitchen, large condo, friendly staff, well maintained. Carpet could do with a cleaning though. They did not push the timeshare sales pitch on us, probably because we’re European. Pool is small but we were the only ones it. Excellent WiFi!

reviews.title: Love the Desert Rose!
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Desert Rose a few times but it had been several years so I was very happy with the stay last month! The property is clean, quiet and non gaming, which means no cigarette smoke anywhere inside!! This is very nice to those of us with allergies and who are sensitive to smoke!! Our check in was easy, and we even arrived early, around 12:30 pm, and were giving a room! In order to get the parking pass, you have to stop at the Concierge or Guest Services desk (can’t remember what it is actually called) but once there they hard press you to sign up for a timeshare tour. They offer all kinds of things to entice you but really, why would I want to spend a few hours out of my time in Las Vegas to a time share presentation?? Even after we said no, they kept trying. I get that this is their job but after we said NO they continued to try and I feel that this should not be done!! Since I was there last, the lobby had been remodeled and there is now a little bar there! We did not spend any time there but it looked fun and the lobby is bright and open! They also offer wine and cheese, I think, during the week but we were there on Saturday so did not get to check it out.Our room was a one bedroom suite with a kitchen, living room, dining room and bedroom with bathroom. It was a very nice size and quite comfortable!! The bed was amazing but the pillows were all extremely soft and not comfortable! I had to use like 5 to get comfortable! The only thing I would to complain about is the configuration of the bathroom area: there is a nice large vanity, with plenty of counter space but when you go into the the bathroom itself, it is very small. The toilet and shower/tub seemed to be squeezed into a small area and it’s quite claustrophobic! I am wondering if there is a way that the wall in there way to extend the wall put into the vanity a little someday?Parking is free and there seemed to be plenty off it. The hotel is off the strip but across from the MGM about a block so if you want to walk there to get the monorail to the other end of the strip, it would be pretty easy!There is not a restaurant at the hotel but The Hooters Hotel is next door and it has some good restaurants in it and there are some restaurants within walking distance!We are looking forward to returning to the Desert Rose again soon!!

reviews.title: Great base for your holiday!
reviews.text: We stayed here for our two week honeymoon, it was a fantastic base for our holiday, just off the strip so it was nice and quiet.  It had absolutely everything we wanted and needed, we had a one bedroom suite on the second floor in block 4.  I was slightly worried after reading some peoples reviews but had no reason to be.  The bed was really comfortable from someone who has a bad back, the apartment was really spacious, air con was excellent, it was so very hot when we were there.  We had our room cleaned 3 times during our stay and its fair to say that some cleaners were much better than others, but the apartment was lovely and clean when we arrived definately no issues.  The staff were friendly and very helpful, we had breakfast by the pool a few times which was lovely, the shop in reception is handy, just wished they sold milk.   Didn't see where the washing machines were.  Pool towels are provided.Thanks to other reviewers we were prepared for the hard push for the timeshare, they are really pushy but friendly enough.   Quickest way to the strip would be through Hooters car park, cross road to MGM back door and station for monorail is there or come out of back door of block 4 where car park is, turn left then right walk though Tropicana car park, through back door and walk through to front and the bus stop is there for the Deuce bus. We loved staying at Desert Rose and would recommend it as a great base for anyone visiting Vegas!

reviews.title: Quiet, Clean, Close to the Action
reviews.text: We stayed here as it was recommended by Arizona River Runners and is the pick-up location for their rafting trips.  We were hesitant as we usually stay at the Mandalay Bay, but we were pleasantly surprised!  The room was spacious and clean. We liked the separate bedroom and living room, and we enjoyed the full kitchen.  We grabbed Uber to locations around Vegas and never had to wait more than 3 minutes.  Will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Lovely quiet hotel just off the strip
reviews.text: We were worried when booking this hotel as we thought it would be too far away etc. It is actually just off the strip and right next to hooters which is where we ended up eating most of the time! It is a nice break from the hustle and bustle of the strip and i would definitely stay here again. We had a nice apartment room with a fully equipped kitchen that had a lovely little welcome pack with coffee etc. We had four people staying in the room and it was fine for us.

reviews.title: Close enough to the strip!
reviews.text: The location is perfect. A 5 min walk to the tropicana the with all of the amenities and a big ,clean, and modern suite. At night the view is incredible, ask for a view of the luxor! Food at the clubhouse is great and inexpensive. I really loved feeling close to all the action of vegas but set off to the side of it all that we could get some peace and quiet.

reviews.title: Great Rates
reviews.text: The resort would've been worthy of 5 stars had they not called me 2 days in a row trying to solicit me with timeshares and if it didn't take 5 minutes to adjust the water temp in the shower.The room was nice and comfy and they supplied everything that you'll need in the kitchen to cook. Wifi worked really well, but the pool was extremely small. Overall I had a wonderful 3 night stay there and it's close to the strip, but water pressure is horrible and needs to be fixed.

reviews.title: Good If You Can Survive Check In
reviews.text: We went for a quick trip to Vegas to see some shows.  You can walk to the the Strip from the hotel either via Hooters to the north, or the road to the south.  We saw shows at The Park MGM, and Mandalay Bay and both were easy walks. The room was clean and very spacious. We didn't really use the little kitchen, but it is functional.  There is no breakfast or coffee included with your stay.  The room has a coffee pot but only one packet of coffee.   There is no housekeeping (unless you pay extra).  Most rooms have an outdoor patio, but it was too hot to use when we were there.  Although we did not use the pool, we did see a few others in it.    There is free parking, which is becoming tough to find in Vegas. We had a car  so the free parking and easy ability to get in and out were great.   The hotel exterior doors are always locked.  We had trouble with the locks one night, but after that all was well. The check in itself was fine.  No wait and friendly clerks.  However to get your free parking pass you were forced to visit the time share and attractions sales desk.  We had a long drive to get to Vegas, so a rude salesperson was the last thing I needed on a very hot day.  I was very polite in stating that I had no intention of buying tickets or a timeshare.  She would not give up and kept asking questions.  She didn't take a subtle hint, so I did have to get difficult with her.  Then she just became rude and nasty.  All I wanted was a parking pass.  It is unfortunate that this happen, as first impressions are important in the hotel industry.    I probably would have given my stay a higher rating, but check in was just a bad experience.

reviews.title: Pretty Average, Especially by Vegas Standards
reviews.text: This “resort” is more like a motel.  “Suites” are pretty large and comfortable but amenities are sparse.  Location is not bad -about a fifteen-minute walk to The Strip.  Concierge service is poor, which is a pretty big deal in Vegas.  Maybe not a bad place for a group of young people on a Bachelor/Bachelorette Party trip to Vegas but not really recommended for those looking for a really great Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Good location if you're using a car and touring around the area
reviews.text: The location is good if you're travelling with a car - we had a rental and would use it daily to go to restaurants a few miles away from the strip every evening.  Parking is on site and it is close to the airport yet still quiet.  Plenty of space and a full kitchen.  On arrival there is pressure to give you "free" stuff to attend time share sales presentation.  Suggest you just keep saying "no" and get on with your stay - takes a number of "no thank you" replies, but after that you'll get your packet and be on your way and they will leave you alone.  No room laundry daily, but enough towels and it was not an issue for us for our 3 night stay.  Price is good and easy to walk along the end of the strip where the resort is located near Hooters and MGM up to Bellagio and back - didn't use it but there is a tram if you want to go all the way to the other end of the strip - probably about 4 miles from one end to the other.  Bed is comfortable and quiet area at night - we were on the second floor, did not hear anything from the third floor above us so either nobody up there, the building is quiet or we had quiet people above us.

reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.text: As owners we were very disappointed in the cleanliness of the common areas. Our bathroom was slightly dirty with mold in the floor grout. The carpets in the hallways needs to be steam cleaned and the outdoor tiled areas needs to be pressure washed. On a positive note, the bed was very comfortable and the staff was very friendly upon check in. The time share presentation invitation is to be expected. We would not recommend using points at this location.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: Can't imagine a standard hotel room after saying in a condo here. Full modern kitchen, living room, bedroom, and bath. The a/c was cold, beds super comfortable, and grounds very clean. Close to strip but quiet. Pool area nicely outfitted including grills. Only minuses were housekeeping service only weekly and hot tub out of order. You'd think it would only take a phone call to get it repaired in Vegas.

reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.text: Feel so disheartened with the rate of deterioration at this resort. We are staying at this resort for an extended stay, obviously not what this resort wants, we have had no cleaning over the past 2.5 weeks. Asked for a change of sheets a week ago were just left in the room and had to make bed ourselves. Tried to get clean sheets from the front desk for this week last evening and it seemed to be too much trouble told to ring instead. Otherwise the resort is not too bad nice pool area and near to strip.We have been coming to this resort for several years and have always liked it, such a shame that we are no longer welcome here so will have to consider looking for another resort next year as am bringing family with us and cannot in all conscience bring them to somewhere so unhygienic

reviews.title: Booking request for specific room was ignored; issuing of parking permit was combined with aggressive advertising.
reviews.text: Booking request for specific room was ignored; issuing of parking permit was combined with aggressive advertising.

reviews.title: We like it here
reviews.text: 5 minutes from the strip which makes it quieter at night. Good size with kitchen, bedroom and living room. Pool area is good. No resort fee so prices are reasonable. Pretty much all over the strip you will be subjected to people trying to get you to go to one presentation or another and all manner of other sales opportunities, this hotel is no exception so be on your guard and assume everyone is trying to make money. Don’t let that put you off this hotel just politely refuse if you aren’t interested and enjoy the value for money this hotel offers.

reviews.title: Inconveniences
reviews.text: First clothes closet is tinier than tiny. I've had more clothes space on a standard cruise ship room and that says a lot. Second, the "heated" pool is cold cold but I'm told you get used to it. Okay. Third the hot tub is out of order with part ordered and no estimated timeframe for repair. This is Vegas. There are probably more hot tub parts than rental cars. Thirdly, the kitchen is well stocked with dishes utensils etc. Except there is no storage available for food. Forced to shove items here and there. Also forced to pay to enjoy pool time at another hotel in order to enjoy my pool days. So inconvenient. I will not return. Many more condos near the strip. You want me to attend a timeshare presentation too? Why would I?

reviews.title: Air conditioning and refrigerator
reviews.text: Ok so we stood here for a week the room was nice had everything  we needed pool was clean.. you can grill by the pool which is a huge money saver when staying in.. staff was friendly they had a bar in lobby also they sold sandwiches soda and candy ...now only down was the refrigerator  wouldnt close had to actually  put a chair for it to hold completely  and  the air  condition wouldnt get colder  than 79° in the room despite  lowering  it to 60 not good at 106 weather so room often got muggy...bathroom  was small vanity was big outside bathroom..overall had a good time

reviews.title: Value for money
reviews.text: No Wow factor like a lot of Vegas hotels but clean and comfortable. Rooms are spacious (bedroom plus living / dining / kitchen area) and well kitted out. Excellent self catering facilities. Lovely pool area. Great option for budget travellers and just off the best end of the strip so a bit more peaceful. Ask for a pool view room.

reviews.title: a great place to stay but beware of the timeshare presentation
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed here at the end of July for a week, the room was great with a good sized kitchen that contained a fridge/ freezer the size of a small wardrobe , the room was spotlessly clean with a good sized sitting area. There was absolutely no noise during the evening, which means you get the best nights sleep you have ever had in a hotel. The beds are extremely comfortable with a good sized tv in the bedroom (and in the sitting area as well) the hotel is approx 5 mins walk from the mgm grand (the start of the strip) about 3 mins walk to hooters which is a great place to get breakfast. WARNING do not go to the timeshare presentation , they promise you all sorts of incentives to attend this presentation it really isn't worth the pressure selling that you will be subjected too, my wife and I left before the end of this ordeal &had to get a taxi back to our hotel. Overall a nice quiet place to stay with no resort fees.

reviews.title: The best vacation
reviews.text: The hotel is very good from cleaning and servicing  and also the food And they have a very good animation team with good show ideas and activities on the beach and pool thanks desert Rose resort.........

reviews.title: Watch out for the time share scam!
reviews.text: Stay was okay, but....The lady at the check in desk was lying about the fact that we were ‘lucky enough’ to be VIP’s and that we only need to sit through a presentation in order to get free tickets for shows or dinners. What she didn’t tell was the fact that we enlisted ourselves to attend a highly manipulative sales activity in order to choke us into a very, very bad investment. This was a deliberate deceivement, which ruined our experience completely.The timeshare sales is something which should be legally forbidden, it’s all about making people’s holiday becoming a financial nightmare experience.We were surprised that a well known and renomated company like Wyndham is actively offering these timesharing ‘scam-products’ and therefore we will not book a property managed by this company ever again.

reviews.title: Perfect location and nice rooms
reviews.text: We stayed three nights at Desert rose and were were all very happy with our stay. The apartments were clean and beds comfortable. It was so great to have a full kitchen with all amenities. Location were top notch, an easy 5-10min walk to the strip and close to MGM and Luxor/Mandalay Bay.

reviews.title: Great home away from home
reviews.text: This is a great place to hang your hat if you are not looking for a hotel with a casino. This is a resort that is a little older but is do able It has a full kitchen if you get a 1 bedroom suite. It has a pool and hot tub. It has a decent size exercise room, ping pong tables and pool table. Its easily accessable to the strip and the highway to go to other parts of Nevada. There is a supermarket (Vons) about 15 min away. A liquor store is around the corner by Motel 6. When you do arrive, they try and hook you up with a timeshare thru Wyndham Vacations. We were sceptical but actually it was a great deal. The timeshare was affordable and we believe worth it. The facility they show is so different than where you stay. Its updated with a movie cinema and game area. There are many pools and childrens places to play. Also, if older ones come with you and are not able to get into the pool easily, the have a lift. This is ONLY at the newer facility they offer for the timeshare. The stay at the Desert Resort Inn was excellent. We will definitley come back again.

reviews.title: Lovely stay - nice atmosphere
reviews.text: We rented a two bedroom apartment, which was really lovely and very well equipped. Pool area was a great place to hang out and the beers from the bar were great. We wanted to be off strip, but this is only 10 minutes walk (safe) to MGM and New York New York. Only negatives were flakey WiFi and an initial "offer" of a free breakfast and other freebies in return for sitting through a two hour (timeshare) talk. We declined and they were absolutely fine with that. All in all, a great place to stay.

reviews.title: Beware of night security
reviews.text: I watched thru peep hole as security knocked on my door to see if anyone was in. And hid..when I confronted him..he denied. I reported it and was treated like I was the liar.I was told that no other reports had been made and that the security check in showed guard on other side of resort...I was refused when I asked to see this record... I caught him just outside my building so he was not on other side...and I saw exactly who it was at my door...why would security, who is paid to look out for thieves, be checking if anyone opens their doors....he may not have been working alone....make sure all things are locked up...and if you do go there...please report any anonymous knocking at your door...they claim I am first to report...but I may be only one to have caught him.... mgmnt supported guard and I suspect nothing will come of it...it should have called police to have proper investigation... I will never recommend this place and will continue to warn others of my experience....a bright fluorescent vest and his silly bun/pony tail are pretty identifying marks..

reviews.title: Lots of Room
reviews.text: We stayed in a 2 bedroom apartment and it was great. Make it cheaper by getting all your own supplies as full kitchen and 2 bathrooms. Pool area good with bbq's to use. Laundry room which is handy. Close to MGM with monrail that goes right down The Strip. Use Uber and go to Freemont Street, the original Las Vegas Strip, great experience.  Get to Welcome to Las Vegas sign very very early in morn as long lines just to snag a photo. Would recommend people to stay here as really reasonable price for Las Vegas and convenient location if you don't want to be in a casino.

reviews.title: Decent place to stay
reviews.text: Off the strip, reasonably priced, short walk from the strip, comfortable bed, spacious, clean suite with kitchen. Easy check in service. Free parking is a huge plus. Breakfast: nothing exceptional. Save yourself the disappointment, go grocery shopping and make your own. Didn't eat any other meals there, luckily lots of choices nearby. Would stay again.

reviews.title: Overall ok could be great.
reviews.text: Overall the stay was ok. We had a problem at check in as we had already paid through our travel agent they said we hadn’t. They looked it to it and realised we had. However, when they took the $100 security deposit they also look the cost of our entire stay meaning we paid twice. Luckily, we realised when we were there and went to reception and had to esuluate it to the manager to look in to. It look 3 days to go back on our card. As we only took one credit card to the US this had took us to the top of our credit limit. Which wasn’t great in Vegas and ended up impacting the rest of our stay. As they had fully refunded us they wanted to take another $100 secruity deposit otherwise they said they would lock us out of our room. However after speaking to the manager and having to explain again we didn’t have to pay it. The rest of the stay was good however our room wasn’t in a great place.

reviews.title: Great accommodation
reviews.text: Stayed here for a week with my wife. The 1 bedroom apartment was absolutely fantastic. Lovely space, full kitchen, dining area, living room with tv, bedroom with huge bed and second tv and bathroom. Positives - fully stocked kitchen with every utensil/ container/ plate jug/ smoothie maker etc you could need. - great size apartment with all you need - fab location 5 minutes walk from the strip as you can walk straight through hooters car park and you are there - great size pool with nice chairs/ loungers/ day beds around it -staff on check in friendly Negatives- really strong weird smell in lobby (but we only went there for check in/ out so didn't matter to us) -very very rude sales lady you have to tackle to get the parking permit (being talked at for 25mins about something we were clear we didn't want was very unwelcome after a 24hr travel day) - quite rude staff on check out when they were training a new member of staff they were quite rude to both that new person and to me when trying to re-charge me for a fully paid for holiday but this did get sorted but I had to demand a printed confirmation that it was sorted in case a problem happened later with the credit card. Conclusion - the apartments and pool are worth it, would still highly recommend just avoid the lobby!

reviews.title: nice
reviews.text: like a 1 bdrm apt.  close to the strip. great price , nice little bar and quick foods. very attentive staff and friendly. easy parking with plenty of spaces. we stayed the weekend with no problems . nice pool out back for guests and kids.

reviews.title: Quiet clean and convenient
reviews.text: We stopped here for three nights before our road trip. It's convenient for the airport and only a short walk to the strip. The staff were courteous and helpful. The room was spacious for two of us and very clean. It had a full kitchen with oven microwave,dishwasher, large fridge freezer. The bed was comfy and we could hear no noise from outside. The pool area was a little small for the number of rooms. The bar area and the food was a little over priced but purchasing from the Walgreens opposite park MGM overcame this. Overall this is a great hotel to start or finish a trip in usa

reviews.title: off strip short walk to strip
reviews.text: we enjoyed our stay here kitchen was a plus, big bed,good shower as well as good A/Cyou will need it was very hot out side the pool was a welcome site after a hot day on the strip Only complaint I had was the fact the cleaners never cleaned/made up our room at any point during our stay but as we kept the room in a suitable condition, this didn't bother us too much if you wanted anything like coffee or clean towels got the coffee but no towels you had to ask the front desk also asked for a early morning call one morning its a good job we got up ourselfs because never received the call

reviews.title: 8 mins walk from the strip
reviews.text: great place to stay, if don't want to stay on the strip, and don't want a casino...NO RESORT FEES. 4 blocks of 3 storey with pool in middle. Don't hear noise from strip or planes, even though next airport, see and hear helicopters, but that isn't a problem. Lounge, kitchen with fridge, oven, microwave all extra large, coffee maker, blender, toaster, dish washer, iron/board, hairdryer. Massive comfortable bed, small bathroom, with shower over bath, but has large added area with sink, mirrors, and cupboards. Staff very helpful, if need to phone US phone number, they will let you use there phone. Free WiFi, but that can be abit on and off, when leave hotel, when you come back it doesn't work, and have to wait for it to ask you to log back in.

reviews.title: Great Choice
reviews.text: We have always stayed on the strip but decided to try this property for our group of five.  Stayed in a 2 bedroom and was very happy with the size and amenities.  Property is nice with a good pool area. Would defiantly return

reviews.title: Great hotel just off the strp
reviews.text: Had the best stay here, The hotel was amazing and comfy and the staff was excellent. It was our daughters 21st birthday and the guy at the front desk sent her up a card and gift, There was 4 of us and the rooms were huge.

reviews.title: Great resort
reviews.text: Stayed in this hotel in July 2018 for one week.Really loved the hotel, great spacious room with excellent air conditioning (which was VERY essential considering the heat outside!).Comfortable sofa bed with a wide variety of TV channels and a very nice swimming pool. Excellent kitchen and cooking essentials in room.Only bought food at the bar once during my stay but the food was very nice and reasonably priced.Only complaint I had was the fact the cleaners never cleaned/made up our room at any point during our stay but as we kept the room in a suitable condition, this didn't bother us too much. Excellent location which is just off the strip which isn't too busy and nice and quiet with a nice view of the city.Excellent hotel and would love to return in the future.

reviews.title: Wonderfull apartment
reviews.text: Very Nice and huge appartment with two bedrooms and two bathrooms plus livingroom/kitchen. Kitchen was very Well equipped with a huge fridge and everything you would need for cooking even salt and pepper. Our room was out to The Big parking lot behind The Tropicana hotel - The kids did not mind because that meant that they had strip View. They felt very privelledged! Pool was Nice and Big and there were available sunbeds all The times We used The pool. Security was visible at Night and The Resort felt very safe. Took approx. 10 min to reach The strip. Highly recommomended If you appreciate a Nice and quiet place to stay in The middle of Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Great room but BYO food
reviews.text: The room was great and of Wyndham quality. Food is hard to come by so bring your own to cook in the kitchen in your suite. They are inadequately staffed at the tiny bar that tries to serve food and there is nothing close by to walk to in 100 degree heat. it was staffed with one person at breakfast who was trying to make coffee in the front and run to the kitchen to cook in the back. Crazy!To make matters worse there was no free coffee in the lobby only they're $4 Starbucks that required the cook to make it. The coffee in the room was fine but just had the tiny packets of creamer. They're going cheap in the wrong places.It was however a great value with a two bedroom two bath apartment with fully equipped kitchen for less than one room on the strip. It's a short walk to the Luxor but don't plan to do it in the summertime. It was over a hundred degrees even as late as 11 p. M.The room was terrific and the hotel grounds well kept. Someone reviewed and said it was dirty. Mine was spotless the beds were comfortable the linens good quality.The elevator face the West sun and had no ventilation so was probably a hundred and fifty degrees and very slow. If you stay in the summer plan to take the stairs, which also are not air condition but at least not suffocating. Can you tell I hate Vegas in the summer?

reviews.title: The best vacation l have
reviews.text: First this vacation the only vacation can I take in hole year taking this vacation in desert rose resort make it the best.1_ the staff are very polite in every part in the resort for example : حماده خلف،احمد عيد،اسلام معوض،عزت على،عبدالله حسن  in the palm restaurant and محمود ابراهيم،عبدالمنعم احمد،ابراهيم سعد،سمير محمد،ابراهيم محمد in bella vesta  bar also mr walid in hotel mangement 2_ the animation team are very funny specially pokka also they very polite3_ first resort that treat Egyptians like foreigners even better4_ the food is greatFinally the hole place is fabulous .Remark,The mini desco for kids need more work.Thank you for the wonderful vacation

reviews.title: Dirty
reviews.text: This was our second visit to the resort. I do'nt recall any issues with our stay last year. However, there were some negatives this time. Could it be just luck or because we booked our stay eight months in advance on a special deal that they gave us a dirty unit, room 1216? Upon entering the room at 3am, I noticed dirty kitchen floor, dirty kitchen table, grease on bedroom night stand, soup scum and mineral deposits on both bathroom and kitchen faucets. What a disappointing impression! Staff offered to give us another room, but I opted to stay if they would send house keeping the next day to address the problem. We were dead tired after a long travel. The day 2 disappointment was THEY DID NOT CLEANED THE UNIT AS THEY HAD SAID. When I called down the second time to speak to the manager, I was not as calm as the night of checked in...........They cleaned the unit the next day.Too bad I could not ask them to clean the carpet. Our feet were BLACK from walking on the carpet. Not sure my husband's white socks will come clean.Finally the mattress was very saggy. Not ideal for someone like me with back problem.Despite the above negatives, my grandkids had a great time.One last note was the AC, it sounded like a plane engine. We could not hear ourselves talk when it was running. That was extremely annoying.

reviews.title: Vication
reviews.text: Desert rose is faboulous ,the resort,animation,amazing food,people ....all perfect, the a la carte restaurants are the best, everyone is trying to do the best for our accomodation, is a very big resort.In one word....EXCELLENT

reviews.title: Desert rose resort LAS VEGAS
reviews.text: amazing place - great location - no resort fees - free parking -  room was amazing but some rooms face a wall 2 mins from hooters great food And 10mins from strip taxi $20 dollers from airport - pool great with 4 barbecues - 24 hour security any questions let us no

reviews.title: Wow - fantastic resort
reviews.text: We visited Desert Rose resort for 2 weeks from the last week of June. We found it to be a very good resort, with a good choice of; pools (with or withiut slides), beach, bars and the food in the variou restaurants was also good. We had a fantastic 2 weeks here, the staff were friendly and always happy to help and would go out of their way to accommodate any requests. The only downside was the bathroom in our room, which could have done with a bit of TLC but even this was a cosmetic issue which could be overlooked when the powerful shower nearly knocked you off your feet..  Will definitely go back.

reviews.title: Great Family Stay
reviews.text: We stayed here and liked the resort. We stayed for 2 nights with 2 rooms. Plenty of space, pull out sofa, private bedroom, balcony, and a full kitchen. Our rooms were clean and staff was nice. No resort fees here! It is an easy walk to the strip from the resort.
