Concierge did talk about time share to us but we weren't available due to our short stay. We would stay here again.

reviews.title: Elvis week
reviews.text: Stayed at the Desert Rose, had a lovely room all the equipment you need for self catering. The pool was clean as was the Jacuzzi. Well situated close to the main street and amenities. Would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Brilliant 3rd visit
reviews.text: We've just returned from another great holiday in las vegas! The desert rose resort is a short walk away from the strip very quiet and extremely comfortable. The accommodation is modern with every amenity you would require from a fully equipped apartment. The staff are very helpful and polite and endeavour to sort out any problems. There is a small shop on site but for more choice there is a supermarket 5 minutes walk. There is a bar on site but unfortunately not run very well as the poor people serving are the cooks too and you can wait an awful long time for a drink, the food is nice. The major problem that we always encounter is lack of housekeeping. I don't mind keeping on top wiping round sweeping up but what I do have a problem with is sheets and towels not being changed after a week and having to ask repeatedly for this service.Would definitely recommend for families couples

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: 3rd visit here still a fabulous resort. Only bad point is the house keeping .every year its the same problem get told its twice a week only time they come is when you complain to reception that you want clean sheets and towels after a week. The reception still blame the cleaners as they are outside contractor. Same excuse every year.needs sorting wyndham.

reviews.title: Nice family hotel
reviews.text: Family of 5: kids 11, 9 and 7. The hotel is clean and comfortable for a family especially with the two bedrooms. The hotel is a little off the beaten path but you can be at MGM within about 5 walking minutes. The hotel has a nice size pool and always a pool table and table tennis which the kids enjoyed. Now this hotel does try to sell you on investing in Wyndham properties when you first check in so be prepared. If you are not interested in listening then just say NO and do not get excited about the free opportunities they give you. If you take the tour then it is about 3 hours and ends badly if you do not purchase with them. But you still get the free giveaways. So just decide if it is worth it to you. Over all nice hotel for a family!

reviews.title: Great place just off the strip
reviews.text: This resort is just a block off the strip although there is no gambling it is a great place to stay. It is close enough to everything so you won't mind not having the casino on site. There is coffee and even popcorn in the room. Rooms were clean and front desk people were helpful. No resort fee and reasonable price especially for Vegas.

reviews.title: Customer Service
reviews.text: Our room was not in the best of locations.  2 bd rm was not at all as expected.  Room 4103 was located right at the door (open and close all day), an electrical problem which locked the door and we had to constantly open for people banging on the door and a view of the parking lot. I requested a change on my first day and was told there was none available at this time (the resort was half full) my request was not addressed.  Housekeeping terrible.  Was scheduled for Wednesday, server entered without knocking and caught the wife in the shower.  All she could say is any garbage.  She was told to do the front and kitchen and she just left without doing anything. My wife called the front desk and someone showed up later (with an attitude), changed towels, emptied garbage, made beds, no sweeping, mopping.

reviews.title: Nice location
reviews.text: My husband & I are staying at the Desert Rose 7/8/18-7/12. It’s a couple blocks off the strip so it’s an easy walk but also makes it quieter. The units are nice & all have patios. But be careful of the wood bed frame in the bedroom. It’s knee high & a killer. Also, the cabinets in the kitchen are too high. I’m 5’ 7” I am having a tough time reaching the dishes on middle shelf. I would have to stand on a chair to reach the dishes on the top shelf. Also, there’s no washer & dryer.

reviews.title: Close to 5 stars rating
reviews.text: Located near the strip the desert rose is a great place to start your Vegas trip.Great kitchen with all you need to make breakfast, lunch and dinner if you like.  Seperate bedroom and sleeping couch gave mum and dad, and probably the kids as well, some needed breathing space.  Nice and clean, easy free parking, great wifi and good pool-area.

reviews.title: Below Average Resort
reviews.text: The Desert Rose is conveniently located, within a mile of the Mandalay Bay, Luxor, Excalibur, Tropicana, Hooters, the MGM, the New York New York, and the Aria.  In fact, the resort is only one block from Hooters.  It is an average resort, with a small swimming pool and few amenities.  The resort mostly banks on the hotel-casinos to provide entertainment options to guests.  The resort doesn't measure-up to Wyndham's standards.

reviews.title: 100 USD for deposit still on my credit card without any reason. Never come back again.
reviews.text: I wrote 3 emails to info@extraholidays.com (from Wyndham web page) and reservationsdrr@shellvacationsllc.com (found it on Tripadvisor), because I realize that the USD 100 corresponding to de deposit of our stay at Desert Rose Las Vegas ONE month ago still on my credit card balance. The amount will be definetely charged soon so I NEED TO SOLVE THIS URGENTLY. Reservation Nº 145725765472 ORREGO (Hotels.com).Never come back to this Hotel. You have no direct e-mail address, that is inconceivable for a hotel that is considered to be of good quality.

reviews.title: Another great stay
reviews.text: We love this place for the following reasons.  Location. Close to the strip and the airportThe kitchen.Big room.Personal feel to the hotel.Easy to get round the hotel.Staff. Exceptionally helpful and friendlyThe fact that you can sit on your balcony and enjoy a glass of something whilst (just ask for the right room) taking in the skyline of the strip. Hope to get back sometime.

reviews.title: Five great nights in Vegas 👍
reviews.text: We stayed in the Desert Rose Resort for five nights. Before we booked this hotel, we carefully checked all our options. Considered also a big casino-hotel on the Strip but eventually ended up with this hotel because of the great reviews and good price. And glad we did! The location was great. Not too far from the Strip but anyway away from all the loudest noise so got a good nights sleep. Our room was a two bedroom condo with a full kitchen and that was great! We made our own breakfast every morning, also lunch and dinner a few times. Room was also very nicely furnished and good looking! The only little minus was that the pool area was a bit small for a hotel this size. If you weren’t at the pool early, then you didn’t get chairs. But all and all a great stay!

reviews.title: Excellent stay
reviews.text: Had a fantastic week in Las Vegas, and this was the place that helped make it. The hotel was clean, easy to navigate, the pool was excellent with a good number of sunbeds. The overall hotel had a modern enough feel to it, with good facilities. The staff were friendly and helpful at all times. The location was very good, with the south end of the strip with a 10 to 15 minute walk. Alternatively the Monorail stop at the MGM was close by. I'd definitely recommend a stay here.

reviews.title: Very good location, safe and comfortable place in Vegas:)
reviews.text: We are very much impressed with our stay at Desert Rose Resort. Fantastic location, quiet, relaxing, safe. Not far from the Strip (15 min walk). Welcoming and professional staff. Nothing was a trouble. Swift check in and out.Room very clean, well equipped and good size like for 4 people. Pool kept very clean. Free parking. Whole place felt very safe. 💯% recommend:)

reviews.title: reservations.com sucks!!!!
reviews.text: the hotel is fine, the reservations.com service they use is useless.  they cannot help if you booked via hotel directly and vice versa.  After directly calling the hotel they were fast and helpful. I dont know why they cant help.

reviews.title: Hassan rasly
reviews.text: Absolutely fabulous hotel staff cannot do enough for you especially hassan  rasly everyday he was smiling always happy to see me and my family he always helpful always looked after us everyday will miss him definitely be back just to see his smiling face he works really hard and in 40 degrees😱

reviews.title: Bad choices on the resorts end
reviews.text: Decided to stay here because we had a few years ago and it was away from the strip but close enough. Check in on a Thursday night. Friday morning we were told the pool was closed until they finished trimming the palm trees. Now to me you should do things like this should be done early or in the middle of the week. Not on a Friday when everyone usually is checking in for the weekend. So now on Saturday the pool was closed from about 11 in the morning until about 9 at night because the pool pump was’nt working. Well maybe from all the junk from the palm trees. So basically hardly had use of the pool all weekend. Only consolation was using their sister resorts pool about 2 miles away. I just wish I could of use the pool more.

reviews.title: Fantastic Family Fun
reviews.text: Friendly and helpful staff ensured all six of us were well taken care of!! The room was comfortable for everyone and having a kitchen saved us money and time! The pool is great for swimming or just relaxing and LOVED the bar and BBQ grills!

reviews.title: Wedding
reviews.text: The workers here are so nice. The kitchens had all the basics needed, measuring spoons,toaster, blender baking pans etc..The corner of the beds are a hazard ,we all have marks on our legs from them.It is located close to so many things both walking and driving distance. Very easy to catch a uber to and from the resort. I would stay here again and it lands up cheaper than other hotels with no hidden fees.

reviews.title: Excellent apartments
reviews.text: The apartment were equipped to a high standard and in good condition. The staff were very helpful and fixed any issues promptly. The apartments are one block from the strip, close to the MGM grand. They were good value for  Vegas hotel prices. The only downfall a pushy  woman was trying to sell me time share on arrival, l was  not interested after driving 5 hours.   I would stay there again,  and avoiding the pushy time share woman!

reviews.title: Very Good Location
reviews.text: On arrival reception were very helpful, as we arrived early we were still permitted to check in and I asked for a quiet room and was given the choice of 2 rooms.  We picked room 3211, there was a large kitchen/diner/lounge and then a separate bedroom and this was all very clean and well stocked.  I did have to ask reception where the hairdryer was, it’s hidden in the cupboard under the wash basin with spare towels.  There was one slight problem and that was with the bed, it was a large wooden bedframe with the mattress within it and walking past the end of it I misjudged the size and banged both my shins twice on 4 separate occasions which did cause significant bruising and grazes.  This could be classed as my own fault (I think it is because the frame is much larger than the mattress) but when I spoke to another guest I was advised that everyone does it and she had wrapped the bed footer around the bottom of the frame.There is a bar/grille and we used this a couple of times for drinks until we found the liquor store down the road (on the right) which is obviously cheaper and as we had a fridge and an ice bucket we took our own drinks around the pool.  The menu is more for snacks rather than big meals and as is common for the whole of Las Vegas vegetarians are going to suffer.  We had breakfast on the last morning and when I told them I did not eat meat they suggested a cheese and egg bagel, this was quite nice.  If you ask at reception they have menus for local takeaways that deliver to the hotel and again reception was very helpful and placed the orders for us.  Do ensure you check the food order before the delivery person disappears as our order was incomplete.It is a short walk to the four corners where you arrive on the strip and when the strip has sent you insane there is a nice pool area in the hotel.  I won’t say it is quiet because there is a constant stream of helicopters passing overhead and there are a lot of vehicle sirens but I did manage to read my book.  We never had a problem getting sun loungers but the hotel does need more parasols as not all sunloungers have them.Having seen the strip hotels and pools I was so thankful that we had booked the Desert Rose because the strip hotels are very lively and we needed the respite of calmness away from the madness of the strip.I would definitely recommend the Desert Rose and had it not been for my injury’s from the bed I would have scored them top marks.

reviews.title: Cant wait to return
reviews.text: We visited last Vegas for my husband's birthday, we chose the desert rose simply because it was a stone's throw away from the hussle and bustle of the strip and all of the main hotels and attractions and it didn't charge a ridiculous check in fee.  All of the rooms are a suite. beautify decorated with everything you need, including a full modern kitchen, coffee machine, smoothly maker, oven and microwave not that we used it much but it was nice to have.  There's a dining room  with a very comfortable living space too.  Flat screen TVs in living area and bedroom with an amazing dressing area and spacious bathrooms.  The beds are humongous and so comfortable too. The pool area is very relaxing, there is a red hot jacuzzi and there is always plenty of sunbeds on offer. There is  a seated BBQ area with fire pits for guests to use and a spacious modern gym. I was very impressed with how clean the grounds were with beautiful pathways lined with flowers and grassy areas All in all its a beautiful place.Now for the staff The staff were so friendly and helpful especially Neil who was on the information desk. One thing they do is try to get you to go for a tour of another Windham hotel where they try and talk you in to buying a timeshare with them but it's your choice you can refuse.  We went and it took a couple of hours and we got show tickets for circue de solai for 10 dollars each instead of 80. I wouldn't recommend going because it is a very hard sell they use divide and conquer tactics and they will not take no for an answer . We got out unscathed but it was difficult. There isn't a restaurant on site but there is an amazing diner close by called Coco's where we ate at everyday for breakfast.  Only thing is the pictures which are advertised on trip advisor for this hotel is before they renovated the place. It is much more modern now so don't let the pictures put you off. I couldn't recommend this place high enough Thank you for a wonderful stay

reviews.title: Holiday/wedding
reviews.text: The hotel itself is a wonderful place to stay whilst in Las Vegas. Perfectly situated just a short walk from the strip a perfect base to relax from the hustle and excitement of the strip. The rooms are very spacious and include kitchen, dining/living room, bedroom with a very comfortable bed and also a bathroom which may be a little awkward if your not stopping as a couple as it’s only accessible through the bedroom. The only downfall from our stay here was when we arrived which was the terrible service from the reception (Cheri). We found her very unhelpful as she couldn’t find our booking and didn’t seem to care. It took about an hour to resolve but was still not fully resolved as one couple in the large party of us was left without a room and said they would have to wait. The rest of the party proceeded to our rooms to unpack. We let the other couple leave their cases in our room and freshen up whilst they wait for a room to be ready after a few hours we returned to the reception to be greeted again by the unhelpful and rude Cheri to see if a room was ready. She had a look on the system and said a room was still not available which made us annoyed as the booking was made a year in advance and also was a very special occasion as we was traveling for our wedding. We asked to speak to a manager. The manager came and was quite helpful but we were Very annoyed when he looked on the system and said there was plenty of rooms ready which I think is a terrible service and a waste of a day for us. Especially when we have all had a very long and tiring journey from the uk. Whilst staying at the desert rose I would like to say what a pleasure it was to be greeted and spoke to by David what a asset he is to the resort and very helpfull he was during our stay.

reviews.title: Fantastic value for money
reviews.text: Highly recomend this resort as there is no hidden costs.. massive spacious bedrooms with alot of storage and big living areas with all new appliances. Lovely pool area and in a great location within walking distance to the MGM and New York hotels etc.. i would for sure stay here again..

reviews.title: Great place to stay, away from the bustle, still central
reviews.text: The resort is about 5 minutes walk from the MGM Grand's entrance and just around the corner from Hooters. The nearest Deuce stoppage on the Strip is about a 10 minutes walk away. The 2 bedroom apartment was quite good and well furnished. Housekeeping though is not provided, which is a dampener. But overall a great and economical place to stay, if you want to be away from the bustle of the Strip, yet close to it.

reviews.title: Very good sea
reviews.text: Family big hotel, good clean, restoran very good and big, animation interesting, big room, good sea, every day something new, too many flowers, the best show in Hurghada, everything the best! Desert Rose top!

reviews.title: desert rose bit of a mix up
reviews.text: just spent a nice relaxing week here. desert rose is lovely. however the ineptitude of the reception staff was a laugh. first of all we were booked in for two days instead of a week. went out, came back in and our keycard wouldnt work. turns out we had been booked in for only 2 days. the receptionist had to re-book us back in. she asked our address, couldnt spell the word John when we gave her it.asked her to confirm our taxi booking to go to airport and then she told them the wrong time to collect us after i had given her the correct time. taxi firm then said they had never heard of us despite picking us up at the airport to take us to desert rose.bar closed early 9pm. other than this it was a good place to stay. plenty of sunbeds pool nice and relaxing. a wee bit out of the way,a good 10 minute walk to the strip

reviews.title: Another great trip
reviews.text: Desert Rose has changed hands since we were there last, the reception has been improved and a bar has been put in. There is now no complimentary breakfast. The pool area is very clean with lots of seating but a little short on sun beds. The apartments are excellent didn't want for anything in the well equipped  kitchen, watch out for the bed frame both me and my husband ended up with bruised shins! It's round about 10 minutes walk to the MGM and Luxor. 5 minutes to Hooters. We got a Uber out to Wholefoods on the first day (about $7) and stocked up with drink and snacks so we didn't have to carry them back.

reviews.title: Great choice
reviews.text: Desert Rose was fabulous... from check in through the time we left.  The unit was meticulous and well laid out. Very comfortable bed.  Excellent air conditioning.  The appliances, pots and pans, dishes, etc. were all of very high quality. All of the employees were helpful and had a great attitude. The location was close enough to The Strip to be convenient yet being a bit away from The Strip made for a much more enjoyable and relaxing trip.   A real bargain for the price.  We will definitely stay here again and recommend Desert Rose to everyone.

reviews.title: Great stay!!
reviews.text: Desert Rose was amazing to stay at! It's a little bit off the strip but we enjoyed getting away from the hustle and bustle of the Vegas strip and could relax properly at the pool and in our apartment. MGM monorail is only a 10 minute walk away which will take you to loads of places along the strip and Excalibur/New York New York is roughly 10 minutes too which is where the strip begins. The photos of this accomodation really doesn't do it justice as the pool/reception/apartment were lovely and kept spotless! Loved the chilled vibe at the pool with BBQs and firepits if you wanted a night away from the strip. All of the staff were very helpful - could always answer any question and helped us with a few phone calls on our trip. Taxis were always pretty quick when called - costing anywhere from 10-25$ to the strip (depending on where you were going or how the traffic was) and only $30 to the Stratosphere. We really enjoyed our stay! Thanks Desert Rose!!

reviews.title: Perfect for large groups
reviews.text: We had a group of four friends rent a two-bedroom, two-bathroom suite and it was the perfect size! Each bedroom and living room has its own tv. Lamps in the bedroom had USB and outlet plugins for phones which was awesome. There is a pull out couch which is quite large, would probably fit two children. There is a kitchen but you cannot really cook, which is fine if you have a lot of leftovers or raw foods like fruit, yogurt, and cereal.The front desk also offers really cheap food like instant noodles $1.50-$2.50, mac and cheese, and Chef Boyardee. There is also a small pool that is shared between the four complexes. The area has great bus access (119), WAX (airport and Fremont access), and the regular Strip routes near the Luxor. There is a Hooters hotel with a fantastic Steak n Shake on the same block. And the hotel is located near an AM/PM gas station for snacks and drinks.Also, if you're a Pokemon Go player, the area is a nest and has a Pokestop haha. It's also walking distance to the 3 gyms just one block away.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Quick to check in. Staff were friendly and helpful. Room was clean and well stocked. 5 minute walk from the strip. There is a little shop, that could do with some of the basics like bread and milk.  Tried to persuade us to go and check out the timeshare but we said no and they didn't try it again.  There's a bar, pool and they serve food. I haven't tried the food though.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Great stay with clear air and safety
reviews.text: We stayed here at the end of 2017, and it was a great stay. The reception and concierge service was welcoming and great. We arrived early than check-in time, however, when we asked about early check-in if it would be possible, they willingly checked the vacancy and gave us two rooms. The room was super-clean and large, and have a great kitchen equipped everything for cooking. Also, it was a fantastic thing that we enjoyed super clean air (the air of the most of hotels in Las Vegas seems not good because of casinos). Even the interior of the room was far better than photos of hotel reservation sites due to the recent renovation. Location was good, and hotel site seemed really safe because of double checking door, and guards who patrol in day and night. We will definitely stay again if we would visit Las Vegas. *Important tip: If you are a light sleeper, request third-floor. I had horrible first night because I could not sleep due to a drunken elephant of upper room until 3 AM.

reviews.title: Great Location
reviews.text: One block from the Strip and good accommodation makes the Desert Rose ideal for a base for the Vegas Experience! Within easy walking distance of Luxor, MGM, New York New York etc. Rooms more than comfortable with a good size kitchen.

reviews.title: Lovely but
reviews.text: I loved this hotel my kids enjoyed  very much I don't like the lake and how they close this circle from the sea i want to set and see the sea I loved the seafood restaurant i loved the night partyLoved the snakes bar  but the food in the main restaurant wasn't perfect it was ok Room is very old but i like it but it's not clean you have to ask them to clean the room many timeKids club was horrible and very old Pools good but they let people swim with clothes 90% waiter or couches etc not polite  they look to the ladies bodies and talking and laughing to each others unpolitely

reviews.title: Great private place but pushy staff
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights. The place was lovely, lots of privacy, enclosed pool and bbq area. The room was comfy, clean and spacious. Troille checked us in, she was brilliant, could not Do enough to go out of her way to help with anything needed. We booked this hotel as there were no resort fees, and free parking, although off the strip, it suited perfect. The strip was literally a 5 minute walk. The only thing we didn't like was the lady at the concierge. She really tried to push "gifts" down our throats and tried to pressurise us into accepting. When we said we would think about it as we were tired from 24 hours of travelling, her attitude completely changed as though we were just an inconvenience. She then later chased us, calling us in our room a few times to try get us to sign up for free gifts. Apart from that, it was a great little place and we would defenitely return

reviews.title: Comfy, Relaxing - and No Resort Fees!
reviews.text: My husband and I chose the Desert Rose Resort as part of a package holiday from the UK for our honeymoon. We picked it over strip properties mainly because of the lack of resort fees though as the holiday approached we started to fret that we should have gone with a strip hotel - turns out we needn't have worried. While there was a bit of walking involved to get up to the strip itself, it wasn't anything major - plus this way there was no navigating a chaotic casino floor to leave the hotel as seems to be the case elsewhere! The hotel itself was clean, very comfortable and staffed with very friendly personnel. We stayed there for 11 nights, during which time we had only 3 minor annoyances: 1. there's a bit of helicopter noise at times as choppers head over to the strip, but we got used to this relatively quickly. 2. The timeshare spiel when you check in (which was extra painful when you're super-polite Brits who have also been awake for 30-odd hours at that point) - to his credit, the gentleman didn't push the matter further when we declined, but it's something to be aware of going in. And 3. While we didn't mind that housekeeping only come twice a week, it did cause a kerfuffle when we realised they'd forgot to give us a spare loo roll! Fortunately front desk were quick to resolve this when we mentioned it on the way out the building.The hotel also has free parking - something of a rarity this close to the strip it seems; so given that we'd hired a car for the duration, this was hugely appreciated. One more thing - we didn't use the pool, but noticed it was open from about 8am until 11pm - given that Vegas pools otherwise seemed to close in the late afternoon, this seems an especially big plus if you happen to be pool people.I could go on and on about how great we found our time there. If we were to go again for only a few nights then we might consider staying on the strip, just to save on travelling time; but for a longer, more relaxed Vegas holiday, I recommend the Desert Rose Resort unreservedly.

reviews.title: Mixed Feelings about this ‘Resort’
reviews.text: I travelled to Las Vegas for 5 nights with my mum and my 2 teenage daughters. My daughters and I were supposed to stay at the Tahiti Village Resort and my mum was going to stay at Dessert Rose with a friend, but my mum’s friend decided not to come and due to my Mum accidentally booking a non-refundable room (which we didn’t realise at the time) we all ended up moving into the Dessert Rose. So my review might be slightly coloured by the fact that instead of a lazy river and Denny’s on site and a free shuttle bus to the strip and the Shopping mall, we ended up in a ‘motel’ (no way is it what I would classify as a resort) away from the strip with no complimentary transport. We did contact Expedia and the motel to see if we could negotiate to cancel, but the motel would not. As the non-refundable nights were literally in the middle of the 5 nights - it would have meant moving motels 3 times if we choose to stay elsewhere on the other nights and there was no way I was doing that with 11 am check outs and 3 pm check ins it leaves a massive gap and is inconvenient.What made this worse was that we watched the prices of some of the fabulous hotels on the strip come right down on price and the Dessert Rose was REALLY expensive. More expensive than New York, New York, Excalibur on standby! And more expensive than our original choice.  So people check your bookings when using Expedia and Booking.Com and don’t book non-refundable unless you’re absolutely sure.The pros for Desert Rose. The staff were helpful and we did have two rooms and a small kitchen. However we did have to ask to move from the first room as it smelled dreadful. It was also dark and dingy as most of the rooms overlook other rooms. It’s also TimeShare. The second room was better with slight view of pool. There is also a nice balcony.The cons. It was very expensive for an ordinary motel with quite a walk to the strip. With room prices the same as some of the bigger hotels on the strip. It’s motel style so the rooms are all outside and so not air conditioned in the corridors. The pool is tiny. The walk to the strip is what ruined it for me. There is no public transport near the motel and no complimentary bus so it’s a hot slog every time you go somewhere. One choice of restaurant. Nearest supermarket is on the strip!Would I stay there again or recommend it - no way. Unless they lower their prices and get some transportation happening - stay away. Book something more user friendly 😀

reviews.title: Once again, a terrific stay!
reviews.text: We were in Las Vegas for a wedding, and opted for the two-bedroom suite at the Desert Rose Resort.  My other family members were scattered around the property in single and double bedroom suites.  We were all in agreement that this is a fantastic place for family gatherings - the large rooms, the pool, the huge refrigerator, microwave, stove, dishwasher, and all the pots, pans, plates and silverware one would need for a great stay.  Its proximity to the strip is a huge bonus, as it's an easy five-minute walk to all the nearby casinos.  Although the Desert Rose discontinued its free breakfast program, breakfast can be purchased for under $10 in the lobby area.  We found all the staff to be really friendly and accommodating.  My friends and family are now considering the Desert Rose for all their future stays in Las Vegas instead of the casino hotels.  It's a great place.

reviews.title: Great Las Vegas Getaway
reviews.text: Stayed for a week in May 2018This is an off strip apartment complex but it's only a 10 min walk to the main strip and all its big attractions.On arrival the staff are very welcoming and friendly. The appartment was fantastic. We had a 1 bedroom apartment that had a bed settee in the living room. It had the best Aircon we have ever had. The kitchen was very high spec boasting all mod cons, even a dishwasher. Coffee for the machine was complementary as was the safe and WiFi.Large flat screen WiFi in the living room and bedroom.Good powerful shower in the well equipped bathroom.The resort is cheaper than all the local hotels and on top of that there are no resort fees... Making this houndreds of dollars cheaper.Good pool area with a barbecue area set to 1 side.Had a problem with the safe but the staff resolved it within minutes.The closest transport link in the monorail at the MGM giving access to the whole strip.There is no cosino but it's on tap just a short walk away, the closest being the Tropicana or Hooters. And just a little further to MGM, Excalibur and New York New York Hotels. You can also pick up the free tram from Excalibur to the luxor and Mandalay bay.We have stayed at Last Vegas before at on strip hotels but recommend this resort as a great family friendly place to stay and a much cheaper alternative.

reviews.title: Would stay again
reviews.text: Stayed here for 4 nights recently. It was my first visit to Vegas but my friend had already been a few times. We thought the location was great. Across the street from the MGM (but really anything "across the street" in Vegas is like 1km away) and basically next to the airport. I was worried that the planes might be quite loud but we couldn't ever hear them. Close walk to the T Mobile Arena, Shake Shack, the Excalibur etc. Parking was never a problem and the rooms are spacious and clean. They did try to sell us on shows and things when we first checked in but I had done my research and we were prepared to say thanks but no thanks. Also, if you tell them you are there to hike (which we were) that shuts down their angles quite a bit :) Kitchens were great for making dinner and breakfast. Never felt unsafe in the area. Close drive to the Whole Foods for groceries. As others say, the pool is busy but that's to be expected when it is almost 40 degrees Celsius out. Security had to throw a guy out because he was intentionally splashing other guests. There is a small fitness centre. Would recommend this place to friends.

reviews.title: Great stay but could improve!!!!!
reviews.text: A nice welcome from Grizelda, reception staff, check in early and efficient.  Rooms and general areas upgraded from last visit two years ago.  Quiet room overlooking a small courtyard.  Plenty of room in suites, very comfortable accommodation.The only downside to this property is the timeshare sales, concierge.  We were in the room 10 minutes busy unpacking and settling in, they rang the room mithering about a free breakfast, timeshare and would you like to collect your welcome pack, just a rouse to get you to the time share desk.  The welcome pack should be given on check in at reception, not at the mither desk.  We deliberately avoided eye contact and contact with them as far as we could when coming and going through the front door, a tall mouthy guy frequently shouted across the lobby to the reception staff, which we found inappropriate.  We have visited here many times before so knew what was coming.After giving then a firm no thank you on day one, they called again 4 days in with the same spiel, told them again, no thank you, they did not bother us again.  They are the only downside to the hotel stay, so if you do not want to be mithered, ignore them as they can be pushy.  Please read other reviews of people who attended the free breakfast.Pool area comfortable but small, gets very busy by 8.30am so you do have to get down there to get sunbeds and parasols.  There are electronic safes in the room, housekeeping twice a week but a bit hit and miss regarding leaving replacement toiletries and toilet rolls, but you only had to ring down to reception or give them a list on your way out and things would be replenished.Overall a very pleasant stay in a good location, MGM grand in front of you, Hooters and Tropicana to the left and Cocos diner to the left, we felt safe, as security walking around all the time both in Desert Rose grounds and Hooters grounds, and I would have given this holiday 5 stars only for the timeshare mithering.

reviews.title: Not customer friendly
reviews.text: Upon checking in, everything went well. Staff appeared well trained.Once in our room we received a solicitation call to attended a Time Share introduction.  We were promised free breakfast and show tickets if we attended, we agreed. The staff at the Concierge desk appeared to be the herding staff for potential buyers. There was this obnoxious motor mouth, male staff member that made me want to run for the hills. We were advised we were to pay for the taxi to the hotel where the time share introduction was being held, and that we would be reimbursed once we presented our receipt at hotel. Once we arrived hotel, it became obvious  the degree of the lure. The breakfast (If you could call it that) was  two very small  microwaved pan cakes, no butter to be had and sausages, I declined the breakfast.  The sales persons were determined to make a sale and held us hostage for hours. When we declined the option to purchase at the end, the smiles turned into frowns. We were left with no instructions regarding transportation back to our hotel. There was return shuttle, but we were not told of it. Once back at the hotel, the staff at the concierge no longer greeted us with smiles, somehow they seemed to know we did not buy.  Even Mr. motor mouth was quiet.The pool, at Desert Rose, was somewhat small and always crowded. Elevators are very small, bathroom very small (You can only back in and out) so if you are tall or big you will have a problem. In addition, you will not be able to hook your laptop up to the TV for better viewing (They made it so you cannot).  I have stayed at other hotels that do not practice this. I am not sure why this hotel has so many positive reviews. I was fooled by them, but will not stay there again.

reviews.title: Fantastic !!!
reviews.text: Booked the apartment as I am not s fan of the big hotels . It was perfect . Large bedroom , separate living space . Balcony overlooking the pool . Free WiFi and the air con worked a treat . Staff really  friendly and even gave us a bottle of bubbly and a card on our wedding day . Location fab .a short walk to mgm grand and flamingo . Will stay again !

reviews.title: Great value for couples stay
reviews.text: Got a good price compared to nearby hotels.  Two couples shared two bedroom room.  Pool was nice.   Short walk (3 blocks) to Strip.  About 1.5 blocks to a liqueur store and a great diner call Cocos.  Ate there twice.  Rooms were very nice.Got deal through Wyndham Vacations.  Had to talk to representative for a few minutes while they tried to entice us to come sit through a timeshare meeting next morning.  Didn't do it and it was not a hard sell.

reviews.title: Mixed review about these apartments!
reviews.text: Stayed here for 6 nights. First impression was great, reception looks fantastic and so are the staff. Once given our room key we was advised to get a parking permit from another desk. Staff on this desk did all they could on selling us a timeshare (meeting). They would not take no for an answer and the manager even stepped in and put her sales bit in!.....Our apartment was lovely so made up for it. UNTIL we went to bed. We were in block 1 on the second floor. All night long we could here people coming and going and the pulling of cases. After 9 days on Route 66 staying in basic Motels we was expecting to sleep! Our room was not cleaned once in the time we were there, even though we was advised at check in, it would be cleaned on Thursday. No clean towels or anything. For what we paid at least provide clean towels! POOL- The pool opens at 8am and you have to queue to get a sunbed! By 8.10 they are all gone. There are roughly 30 sunbed to a whole complex! By 9.30am there isn't even a chair to sit on because people have no choice but to sit on chairs all day! Found it strange how no member of management even walks around to check for litter or anything else! I'm far from someone who complains but when you pay a lot of money you do expect a decent nights sleep. POSITION OF HOTEL- Away from the craziness of the strip. Safe enough to walk at night. Returned after midnight on 2 occasions and no reception staff of security on the door!Would I stay again- Yes 100% but would request a room not near the lift or main reception building. Also think the sales pitch shouldn't be so strong.

reviews.title: My Favorite Resort in Vegas!
reviews.text: I just returned yesterday from a 4 day business trip in Las Vegas. I always stay at the Desert Rose Resort, it is my favorite! Although not the cheapest place in Vegas, it has NO RESORT FEE, it is a Non-smoking and Non-Gambling property...and it is SAFE!  Because of a recent 10 Million Dollar renovation the entire property is beautiful! The rooms are 1 bedroom apartments, fully equipped with everything you would expect from a Shell Resorts property. The beds and pillows are amazing! Towels and sheets, very nice. Furnishings are stylish and lovely! As a woman traveling alone, I can’t put a price on safety, and feeling taken care of...I love The Desert Rose.The staff is friendly and go the extra mile! Michael checked me in on my airline and printed my boarding pass for me! Although no complimentary breakfast, you can order breakfast or lunch at the hotel bar for under $10! Delicious! (Did I mention free Margarita’s by the pool on Wednesday’s?)The pool area is gorgeous, even BBQ’s if you want to fix yourself a steak! I highly recommend this property for business, couples get away,  or for a family vacation. Just behind Hooters, really close to the Strip...but quiet, and guest keep their clothes on in the pool and hot tub! 👍🏻

reviews.title: Great place to stay with the family
reviews.text: We did a family vacation in Vegas over New Years.  Desert Rose was a great place for us having 4 kids.  The pool is great, it was great having a kitchen and being just off the strip things are a bit quieter (but not so far that you can't walk to everything), the location is fantastic.

reviews.title: Little Oasis in the heart of the Vegas madness!
reviews.text: We often as humans, respond and react to negativity, as opposed to positivity. Having read many a number of reviews on here, it has always struck me, that I will seek out the negative reviews first and allow this to cloud my judgement.In this instance I cannot find any negativity to add to this review. From the ease of finding the resort, when arriving in Las Vegas, to the friendly and efficient check out when we left.The whole experience was a joyful one. The huge rooms, so clean and well kitted out, to ensure a pleasant an comfortable stay.The neat and relaxing pool area, with great seating facilities, and a bbq area to boot.The Strip that is a walk away, in the southern part of the Las Vegas Boulevard, near resorts like MGM, Hooters, Luxor, New York New York and Excalibur to name a few.The resort is spotless and the staff are helpful and friendly. Plus you are not charged the additional resort fee, which made a difference.In all, it was a fantastic stay, and would more than recommend this resort to anyone wanting to visit Las Vegas. Thank you to the Desert Rose team for a great stay, in one of the maddest, wackiest and coolest citys' I have been fortunate to visit.Viva Las Vegas!!!!

reviews.title: Not Bad At All...
reviews.text: Not a bad resort to be fair, decent value for money and we would go back without hesitation. A short walk from the Strip around the corner from Hooters and across the road from MGM it's well placed.Staff are all respectful and good at their job although there was a slight hitch with the dreaded time share lady until we brushed her aside.Room are clean, tidy and well maintainedDownside is the internet is pants..

reviews.title: Good base for Vegas
reviews.text: Rooms were ok and a decent size, pool area was good and had some big beds that all 4 of us managed to lounge around on, not over expensive either so doesn't break the bank, not too far of a distance to New York New York hotel end of the strip

reviews.title: Resort is great for families, hate the sales pressure!
reviews.text: Booked through my daughter but when we went to get our parking passes we were pressured into an owners meeting and when they found out we were wyndham owners we had to be bussed to the Grand for a "free" breakfast.  Yeah right, 3 hours later I finally made it back to the Desert Rose (Sent my husband and grand daughter back earlier while I finalized our paperwork which nobody seemed to have) and we had been subjected to a very pushy salesman who basically told us that we had been ripped off and we were getting nothing for our original purchase which I assume he was going to tell us how we should buy more useless shares from him at a place we were not impressed with, except my husband told him that we were going to get a lawyer and unload our shares any way we could because we couldn't even enjoy a couple of days of our holiday at a resort without wasting time getting pressured by salesmen to buy more shares.  Left a bad feeling for all of us and kind of ruined our enjoyment of any wyhndam properties.  The resort itself was okay.  It was very quiet for being so close to the strip and offered a few conveniences that we enjoyed like a safe in our room, the heated pool, exercise area and outdoor grills.  We had an interior room that had a balcony but not a spectacular view but at least it didn't smell.  For the price it is a great family resort close to the strip and main highways.  If you don't mind the sales pressure then you will love it there.

reviews.title: Nice inexpensive place
reviews.text: We really liked staying here.  The condo was clean and stocked with (almost) everything you'll need. Bed was comfortable, pool area clean and all furniture comfortable.  We also like that they are environmentally conscience by cleaning the room every 3-4 days.  However, three notes from our stay though - the last my least important:1. Bathroom layout - they stuffed the toilet and shower into a 5x5 room so when you 'sit' one shoulder touches a wall while the other rubs the shower curtain - bad design IMHO2. Condo not fully cared for by staff - we had no coffee filters upon check in and supplies (TP, towels, coffee) not properly restocked when the room was cleaned.3. We checked in about midnight ... The two obvious hookers relaxed in the lobby before walking out when their "ride" arrived.

reviews.title: Clean, comfortable, and convenient
reviews.text: We stayed in a two bed room unit and were very pleased with how clean and comfortable it was.   The property is very convenient to the strip (near Luxor) and highways 15 and 215/515 yet pretty quiet with the exception of some buzzing helicopters. The pool area can get a little crowded and all the lounge chairs might be claimed during the sunny hours but if you are open to not getting a lounge chair or going in the evening it was fine.  Having a grill and fire pits was a great plus.  Unfortunately the pool was unavailable the first couple days so the kids were hugely disappointed. We did not experience any pitch but we also didn’t try to get any discounts thru the hotel and we did get a parking pass with no pressure.   I would have given 5 stars if but for one thing - the noise from neighboring units.  We couldn’t believe we were being woken up by the sound of the toilet flushing in the unit above.  Once that would wake us we would hear the walking around, more toilet flushing, water running, etc. my son on the pullout couch would be woken by the chairs in the kitchen. These sounds were heard over the ac fan.  It wasn’t that the upstairs resident was being obnoxious but we could clearly hear when they got home at night and readied for bed.  My only other comment was the security presence.... we couldn’t decide if it was comforting or disconcerting.  If you aren’t into staying at a high rise casino or want more of an apartment, the Desert Rose is a great choice.  I will look at Wyndham properties on future trips based on our stay here - I may even order the sheets and try to convince my husband we need the mattress.

reviews.title: Housing for Arbonne’s GTC
reviews.text: Close to the MGM campus so join st a sort sweet walk. Great lobby to gather in and oil area. Our room has two bedrooms/bath, Kitchen, dining area, living room plus balcony. Great place for four of us to stay. Will return next year!!!

reviews.title: Slamming gate all night
reviews.text: The rooms were fantastic and I cannot complain about the spaciousness of the room we had, along with a well equipped kitchen and everything you could need there.The pool was also very nice and a great bar with a good selection of drinks and food served there, which was handy in the late afternoons after exploring. My issue is that our room was right next door to the entrance gate into the property, and every time someone came or left the gate would slam so loudly that the whole room would shake with a loud bang from outside, which woke us all up several times throughout the night. If I had a different room at the property, I would gladly stay here again if I have the chance.

reviews.title: Very nice place
reviews.text: First off, be prepared for the time share presentation pitch. You have to listen to every offer for free meals and shows to get you to the presentation in order to get your parking pass. Wasn’t anticipating this and usually a huge turnoff right away for me.That said, the property is very nice and located just off the southern strip. An easy walk to just about anywhere on the strip. The rooms are quite large and have everything you need for a long stay from kitchenette to living room area. They are clean and modernly appointed. The pool area is also very nice.If you are a light sleeper, you are fairly close to the airport and can hear planes taking off/arriving. Not terrible, but noticeable.Overall, a pretty nice place but the timeshare presentation push costs a point plus. But I have to say the room was larger and better equipped than other big name places I’ve stayed on the strip.

reviews.title: Very nice place - skip the "hospitality" Folks though
reviews.text: But you can't skip the hospitality folks...  You "have" to talk to them to get your parking pass for your car!  After checking in at the front desk, I had to go to the other side of the lobby to get my parking pass for the car to park in the lot.  Keep in mind, my stay was not a time-shore, nor some kind of guest stay that I "won", I paid to stay here via Expedia.  After an early flight, and running around to get the rental car and such, I just wanted to drop off the bags and go out for lunch - my family was hungry.  But I had to get my parking pass.  So across the lobby I go to talk to these people.  I stated I just needed my parking pass.  They started their "Pitch".  When they stopped for air, I informed them that I was not interested in anything except my parking pass.  Then again it went.  I asked again fro my parking pass.  It was surreal, like I was being punk'd, or on candid camera!  After almost 10 mins, I just walked away.  The dark-haired woman ws on drugs or something.  Her statements didn't even make sense.  When she looked at me, she looked right through me.  It went on and on. IT WAS BAZAAR. I finally just walked away.  When I came back i state to the front desk that they were to get mee my parking pass, that I was not going to be subjected to the hucksters again.Our 2br unit was nice.  It had been tastefully updated.  The beds were really comfortable.

reviews.title: Affordable with everything you need!
reviews.text: Booked late onto a stag party and friends were stopping at MGM (which booking solo would have cost a bomb). So I researched desert rose resort and was extremely happy. Large comfy bed with living area, balcony and kitchen. Definitely recommend if you wanna do Vegas on a bit of a budget.

reviews.title: Nice and Quiet
reviews.text: Stayed here for a few days and loved it!!  While being close enough to easily walk to the strip, it was so peaceful and quiet. Nice having a full condo with a small balcony.  We avoided the whole time share thing, sure wish they wouldn't ruin the strip experience with so much of this!  In one day walking the strip, I'm sure we were approached 20 or more times wanting to give us money, show tickets, etc for just 90 minutes of our time!!  Been there, done that!!  Not for us!!  Also the hassle of soliciting strippers or trying to put bracelets on your arm for money!!  I wanted to make a sign saying "NO THANK YOU" because we repeated those words over and over and over!!  But that's Vegas I guess!!  All the more reason we loved getting back to our great peaceful Desert Rose Resort at night!!  Highly recommend!!

reviews.title: Great for extended stays
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for 9 days in March 2018 and overall we had a very pleasant experience, so much so we are staying there again for an upcoming trip. PROS: close to strip, updated modern decor, clean rooms, fully equipped kitchen, comfortable beds, private balcony. Feels more like an apartment/condo than a hotel, which is ideal for extended stays.CONS: thin walls- this was my biggest complaint. Had a few sleepless nights due to noise heard above (ranging from loud footsteps to full-on conversations). Bathroom is kind of small as well, but I liked that the toilet/shower was in a separate room from the vanity area. TIPS: I requested a top floor for my next stay to hopefully avoid the distracting noise. Also, for extended stays, they have limited cleaning but we were very satisfied with the frequency and quality of cleaning during our stay.Overall, I would highly recommend this hotel for anyone looking for a convenient, clean, modern place to stay, especially for extended stays.

reviews.title: Great location, and great facilities
reviews.text: I stayed here on business (lucky me, I know!) and was  impressed. We were at a trade show at Mandalay bay and it was within walking distance.It is only just off the Vegas strip (behind hooters, you can see the luxor from the car park) the apartment was very spacious. There was a nice size living room with a dining table plus a wardrobe. And a balcony with chairs and a small table. The kitchen was very well equipped and had a large cooker, fridge freezer and microwave. There was an ice bucket and an ice machine on the bottom floor. The welcome pack came with coffee and filters for the coffee machine, popcorn, salt and pepper, sugar and a sachet of lemonade to make up. There  was washing up liquid also. The bedroom was a good size with a walk in wardrobe and a seperate bit with the sinks that led to the really deep bath, shower and toilet. The complex was really nice with blocks surrounding the pool area. The pool was a nice size and temperature but got really busy in the afternoons. There is also a hot tub which was lovely. The pool area had lots of lounges, beds, and table and chairs. It had about 6 bbqs and a couple of fire pits. And table tennis. You needed your key card to get in the pool area and in through the car park entrance. There was a restaurant. We didn't eat in it but had dinner round the pool one day and the food was nice. The staff were really friendly and helpful and there was always someone about cleaning, tidying, watering the plants etc. We paid 62 dollars a room per night. The taxi from the airport was about 30dollars. There is a service station with a shop a couple of minutes walk away with sweets, crisps, drinks etc. It had a small selection of food. Bread, jam etc. The strip is only about 5-10min walk and starts you around where the Luxor is. I think it was better being slightly away and not having  a casino as it was quieter. The big hotels are full of people and the queues for check in were massive!  Las Vegas itself was amazing. The strip is great especially  night but all the hotels were great to look around. My favourite was the Venetian and  New York was great as well. I'm a vegetarian and had no problem with finding food. There's fast food places to fancy restaurants everywhere you go. One of the best places I've ever visited and I didn't even have time to drink in any of the bars or go to any shows.

reviews.title: Good
reviews.text: Stayed at the desert rose for a week on arrival (after a 10hour flight) we had a lady talk us into a free complimentary breakfast (the next morning) at there sister hotel (5min drive away) transported by there buses,DO NOT get roped into this as its a time share thing and it takes 90mins to have someone waffle on about something I told the guy I wasnt intrested in and the free breakfast well they may as well not have bothered it was 2 sausages and 2 pancakes (hardly a full english like the lady at the desk said!) Aside from that the room was clean and well equipped only down side was no kettle for us english tea loversA few days in we had a problem with our sink and it not draining the problem was sorted quickly although the maintenance men took our only bin/trashcan from our room we spoke to 3 receptionist to get it back and still are yet to recieve it 2 days later and we leave tomorrowWe headed to the pool today it was clean and enjoyable also on the first night there was some very odd people hanging around the entrance gates (not main entrance) trying to gain access, we didn't know on booking that some rooms are occupied full time.It is a easy walk to the strip, or can take a short taxi rideHooters bar, restaurant and casino is next door and is well worth a visit and a burger! 👌  The staff where all very polite and friendly but if I came back to vegas I would find  different accommodation.

reviews.title: Pleasant stay walking distance from the strip
reviews.text: We stayed at Desert Rose Resort 2 nights in February 2018. We decided to go to Las Vegas knowing that we do not have too much to look for there but take a glimpse of what the fuss there is all about. Unprepared for this short visit we decided to book 2 nights in DRR, although it was a bit more expensive but also seemed a bit more promising than 2 other hotels in a nearby block about which we got some information. Our intuitive decision proved to be a success. DRR is inexpensive and satisfying place to stay in Las Vegas, whether one spends there a long vacation or a short visit. DRR is located a bit further than one block from the strip, easily a walking distance. It is close to main roads, conveniently accessible from I-15, and it is very close to Las Vegas International. Nevertheless, it is very quiet there, and in the room no noise was heard. The entire compound is surrounded by a heavy fence and locked gates. We have not researched the reason for this enclosure. Anyway, we have not felt unsafe either in the area or walking to the strip and back in the dark. Several elevators service the different wings of the buildings making it possible for someone who does not want to schlep suitcases to stay in any floor. We got a suite that included a kitchen that was open to a living room and a bedroom. The suite could sleep four and it was very spacious for 2. There is, however, one problem when 3 persons or more occupy the suite. The layout is such that the bathroom opens to the bedroom, and people in the living room have to pass through the bedroom on their way to the bathroom.The kitchen is well equipped with dishware, utensils and electrical appliances. Those in our suite were of the first quality. No breakfast is served. Actually we were surprised to find out that our room was not serviced at all after the first night. The note in the room was leading us to believe that rooms are serviced between 9am to 5pm and a special request should be made if one wants one’s room to be serviced out of these hours. It did not much matter to us because our stay was short, but a clarification is in order.If I ever go again to Las Vegas, I will save time looking for other hotels and will try to book this place again. Hence, I have no hesitation recommending it to others.

reviews.title: Nice location with friendly staff
reviews.text: We stayed here for 1 night due our timeshare was not available until the next day.  Our family was pleased with the location and the 1 bedroom suite with full kitchen.  The location is next to Hooters and just a short walk to MGM and the strip.  Free parking and no resort fees are a plus!  We were immediately greeted with a smile as we entered and was not bombarded with a sales pitch ( this is a timeshare.). The pool is a bit small but was fine for our one night stay,  The only downfall was the unit did not have laundry facilities.  That would be the only drawback if I stayed here for more than one day.

reviews.title: Great hotel very close to the strip
reviews.text: This was our second stay here and this hotel is still a really good value. It’s very clean, the staff has a very positive attitude and are helpful. Easy and free parking on the premises and the best thing is that there is no resort fee like most other hotels in Las Vegas. Maybe calling it a resort is a little exaggerated since there’s one pool, and it’s not very big. But this hotel meets our expectancies and we get a lot for our money so we will certainly stay here again.

reviews.title: Family vacation
reviews.text: Fantastic hotel, close to the strip yet not a gaming/casino hotel so nice and quiet and NO SMOKING !! We stayed a week and booked this hotel 100% because of the great reviews it received on Trip Advisor. We weren't disappointed . We booked a 1 bedroom suite, which had a sofabed that my 13 and 14 year old sons slept on. We had a 2nd floor room over looking the pool ( definitely  recommend this view as opposed to the parking lot/road view)  with a small balcony. The room was clean, fairly new condition, and had a FULL kitchen with over, stove, microwave, fridge, freezer and dishwasher..........as well as coffee maker, blender, toaster. The toilet/bath tub are separate from the sinks/vanity which is useful for a family of 4 getting ready in the morning.....though the bathroom is a little small. Huge king size bed was SO comfortable in the main bedroom, and had a TV too. We walked to the strip which took 4 mins, The Luxor, Excalibur and MGM Grand and Tropicana are just minutes away  .............so it was a great location and we felt safe walking back to the hotel after an evening at a show. Security was great, there is a safe in the room, and you need your keycard to enter the complex and pool areas. Parking is easy, lots of spaces available close to room for bringing up groceries etc, and is FREE . NO hidden resort fees, and we got WIFI for our 4 devices for free too that was good enough so that we could stream Netflix etc in our room.

reviews.title: Nice and clean...good location
reviews.text: Pool is too small for the amount of families that come here.The bar is also barely a bar...they do have plenty of people to sell timeshares though...which is annoying..,even though this was a great deal...I would pay more to not be bothered by sales people.Room and bed was great ...as was having a kitchen...but the salesperson ruined it for me.

reviews.title: Very nice condo hotel
reviews.text: Very nice condo hotel. Good location. Clean. Well appointed kitchen. Not your casino hotel so no surprise resort fee added per day. Full kitchen great for that economical cook it yourself stay. Close to strip and transport. Bathroom was a little small.

reviews.title: Awesome Hotel near the Strip
reviews.text: We stayed in a one bedroom suite with a pull out couchin living room. The room was clean, good size, very well equipped kitchen! Excellent for families. No casino so it was quiet. Very close to the strip for walking. Small pool but not busy, lots of loungers for sitting. Would recommend for sure! Excellent value for what we paid.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: The accommodation was comfortable and not too much noise. Enjoyed the fact that the apartment had everything in which we wanted, two bedrooms, two bathrooms, kitchenette, dining room and lounge room. It was spacious and enjoyed the balcony as we were on the top floor. At least the air conditioner was enjoyed after being outside during the hot day. The only down fall was the fact that it is time share (which I had been aware about at the start), as you are sent over to the concierge and offered free things then asked how much I had earn a year, once telling them that I do not get the amount they mentioned, they quickly did not mention anything else and I had then mentioned if they were time share which they replied yes and I also mentioned that I was not interested. Overall the staff on the reception desk were friendly and polite.  Close to the strip, one block back from the MGM Grand. Free parking and close to buses. Worthwhile stay.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Great location, just off the strip, about a 10 minute walk to MGM Grand or go the other way and about a 10 minute walk to Luxor.  It seemed to be a family type setting as there were a lot of kids, some children in softball uniforms, and families.  Room walls were kind of thin but did not hear a lot of noise from our unit except for the air conditioner, which was really loud, toilets flushing,  and workers pushing their carts in the morning.   Wi Fi did not work worth a darn.  This is a time share facility so they try to get you to go to their 90 minute presentation but not overly pushy.  Deborah, the Wyndham representative, was very helpful and not over aggressive in her job.  Desert Rose Resort staff very friendly and helpful. Check in is at 4 pm, but we got there at 10 am and they checked us in, which was a great help to us. It worked for us and we would probably stay there again.

reviews.title: Vacation
reviews.text: This is our third time staying here and we really like it. Prices are reasonable and rooms are very clean. The only complaint we have as usual is the internet. It’s a pain to connect to and then u have to keep connecting cuz it boots u out. Then sometimes you can’t even connect. But if there were no internet, we would still come back. Location is great. Right next to strip.

reviews.title: A luxurious apartment with lots of room to move.
reviews.text: Very comfortable apartment with plenty of room to move. The air conditioner was a welcome relief. We had a car so parking was a necessity. Perfect location for walking to the Strip. Would stay there again if we visit LV.

reviews.title: Las Vegas  2018
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort. It's the second time we've stayed here. First time being about 12 years ago. It was great then and it was great this time. It's condo style so you can cook or not. Everything you need was in the condo. If you didn't see what you needed all you had to do was call the desk. It has  a nice pool and hot tub. A small exercise room with equipment.  You can go sit by the firepits in the evening.  There are barbeques for your use. Nothing smells better than a big juicy steak on the bbq. I will stay here again. There were many upgrades done since the first time here. Love the resort and it's location a few blocks off the strip. It doesn't have a casino so it's a much quieter place. Awesome for families

reviews.title: Eh, could have been better but not bad
reviews.text: I just stayed here for a week in a two bedroom unit and I traded it through a timeshare service.  The PROS- good sized unit, full kitchen (as expected for timeshare), not too far from the strip as its only a block to MGM and you can pop into the monorail if desired, bar in lobby, and free parking.  The CONS- unit was not fully clean as there was crumbs on counter and the floors were not cleaned.  I swept a full dust pan full of crumbs, hair, and dirt as well as had to vacuum the floors (otherwise unit was good). They did offer another room, however when I went in there the floors were also dirty so the housekeepers must not sweep/vacuum.  In addition, the pool heater was broken, the spa was not clean as there was dirt or something gritty on the floor, and there is only one slow elevator per building.  I also recommend a unit away from the street as the traffic and sirens are loud all night long.  If you want a low key unit with a full kitchen that is not too far from the strip, then this is a good option.  I however will probably check out another place the next time I visit Vegas.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: We were in a 2 bedroom 2 bath room with a kitchen for six people.  It was very clean and comfortable. The hotel is located just 5 minutes from the strip. It was very convenient for walking on the strip.

reviews.title: Guest Beware
reviews.text: BEWARE that this is a time share and the concierge  there will offer you a bunch of "free" things including breakfast if you agree to go on their tour which you pay them 20.00 for. We ended up not going and they were relentless in calling our room, even calling the day after.

reviews.title: Great Resort and lovely staff
reviews.text: We stayed for 8 nights, great room with kitchen, fully equipped, large living area and big bedroom, bathroom, Toilette and Shower separate and a nice little balcony. Also a great pool area with a jacuzzi and a bbq area, a Laudry, easy to use, a Gym and a Lobby Bar.

reviews.title: Great place, great people
reviews.text: I've stayed at the Desert Rose a further 4 times since my first review in 2008. There have been a number of changes over these 10 years with a change of ownership and a refurbishment programme. Gone is the free breakfast and evening free beer and snacks, but the rooms have been substantially modernised, as well as the reception area with a small bar now added as well as free computer access room and small games area.The staff have changed, but the helpfulness and high standard of customer service hasn't. I contacted Daniel by phone prior to leaving the UK to request a quiet high floor room overlooking the car park and this is exactly what was provided. My wife though wasn't 100% happy with the room and Daniel and Heather were very patient in allowing us to look at a couple of alternatives. In the end though, we stuck with the room allocated!The room's refurbishment was evident and the bed was excellent and comfortable. As has been mentioned, this property does not have a casino and is slightly off the Strip, but within 5-10 minutes walking distance, with lots of parking spaces. No resort fees either, so great value for money.As I mentioned, no free breakfast these days, but Cocos Diner is a short walk away.Thanks again to all the staff and we look forward to visiting again soon.

reviews.title: OK place to stay
reviews.text: It was an OK place to stay with my husband and my 3 21 year college kids over spring break.  We had a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom room.  The room smelled a little like BO, was small and the furniture was very worn - we may have had an older room.  The kitchen was well equipped, however we did not cook.  We went to the grocery store and got some items for breakfast, chips and beer which was nice since eating on the strip gets expensive.  The location was close to the strip and we did see security strolling around the resort when we returned from the casinos at night.  Good for families, however I don't think I would bring small kids to Vegas.

reviews.title: Very nice quite
reviews.text: This was a great place to stay and be close to everything but also a quite place to stay where you don’t have to walk a mile or two through the casino to get to you room.   It’s nice to be at a place with no casino.   If you want one they are close by, the relaxed atmosphere of the place is welcome.  The rooms or suites are very nice, clean and comfortable.

reviews.title: Excellent for families.
reviews.text: I have stayed in Las Vegas several times at many casinos hotel but this time elected for something different.  This hotel has a lot going for it.  It is located between Hooter's Casino and Howard Johnson's just off Tropicana Blvd.  The street it's on is quiet.  Has great access to both Tropicana Blvd and South Las Vegas Blvd.  Excellent parking and security.  The room was a 2 bedroom condo, with a large lounge room and kitchen.  We utilised all these facilities during our visit.  I found this property to be very quiet.  We had a ground floor room with was ideal with a lot of luggage and easy room access.  I found it easy to walk everywhere and it's surrounds.  For families who wish to avoid the gaming hustle and bustle.......stay here!  Excellent value for money.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort Las Vegas
reviews.text: This was a LOVELY place to stay. Our room was massive with a lovely comfortable bed! The hotel was in a great location just off the famous strip, with free parking! The hotel staff were very friendly.  It’s just a GREAT place to stay!

reviews.title: Great location, NO resort fees.
reviews.text: We usually rent a car in Vegas and at the Desert Rose you can park near your apartment. We love having a full kitchen and dining area. The rooms were a little narrower than I expected and watch your shins on the corner of the bed! sharp and unexpected.

reviews.title: Desert Rose.
reviews.text: My wife and I have stayed here many time in the past. We will be the for a week and the ens of may. We really love the place. The only thing we miss is the free breakfast. Our rooms have always been clean. The bed and the furniture are quite comfortable. The pool area is also kept clean. The cleaning staff are very polite and helpful if you need something. It is always a pleasure staying here.

reviews.title: I would like to start with a few words of gratitude
reviews.text: I would like to start with a few words of gratitude to the whole staff for our excellent rest, for heartiest welcome, for the human relation, for smiles and good mood. This was our first visit of the hotel, but I hope not the last, I unambiguously have the desire to return here, and I understand the tourists very well who are regular guests here, the hotel deserves it)) Yes, I admit that our room was not super (we had a standard reservation). but we didn't even think to improve it for surcharge as we only spent the night and cleaned ourselves up there, and sea view is better from the beach or from the bar Bella Vista, but not from rooms)), but it is our personal opinion. In rooms you have cleaning services in Egyptian style: carrying the trash out, water supply, change of towels, and the bed was made ideally)), at least once I saw how the bedclothes were changed. Cuisine. We were pleased with the food, we always had a good choice, however I won't describe it in details. We were in all a la card restaurants, and every restaurant deserves attention, it is worth visiting unambiguously, Lebanese was the most pleasant (the atmosphere was highly unusual). As for having a snack, the bar Bella Vista deserves special attention (it is situated between a lagoon and the sea, the view was magnificent), as usual I don't have heavy breakfast, but having swum for a while, appetite wakes up, so sandwiches, the Vienna wafers, pancakes couldn't be better)), barkeepers are friendly and efficient. There are many bars on the territory, we didn't visit them all (next time we will make up for lost time) The sea. The open one was more pleasant, than the lagoon, water is colder in the lagoon and there aren't small fish there, as the water gets warm it is ideal for children. But in the high sea there are a reef and small fish as well, those people who are in Egypt for the first time will sure have something to look at. Entertainments and leisure. A good animation team entertains all kids and adults, generally speaking, the hotel has a standard set of entertainments, but animators work with enviable enthusiasm)), we "passed" pools, a water park, the sea is the best)), it is the sea which was the reason for coming here. Next to the hotel you can find two shopping malls: Senzo mall and a market Cleopatra, the prices are reasonable, but you will not get pleasure from "bargain till the end", the prices are fixed. The Cleopatra market is 5 minutes walk from the hotel, Senzo is a little bit further, you need 20 minutes to get there. At first we thought to buy a local SIM card, but we changed our minds since free Wi-Fi was enough for us. We went to Luxor, however one day dropped out of our hotel life, but we aren't sorry about it at all, the excursion was exciting, we got lots of impressions, the guide was excellent and the bus was comfortable. We ordered this excursion at a local agency, the supervisor's name is midoBikham, we met him during our previous trip to Egypt, he is a highly professional, you can contact him using Facebook and it was really cost efficient. Those people who doubt whether to choose this hotel or not, please, don't doubt, the hotel is worth living in (only if you do not have overestimated requirements).

reviews.title: What a gem
reviews.text: Great find. No parking fee. No resort fee. Clean and well appointed rooms. Free WiFi that actually works. Amazingly friendly staff.  Well taken care of property. Staff do an excellent job of maintenance. I look forward to returning.

reviews.title: Nice place off the strip
reviews.text: We were pleasantly surprised by the Westin time share property.  Location is right next to Hooters....not that that really matters, but it's a easy walk to the strip.  Close to Mandalay Bay, Topicana, DeLano, New York, New York.  Staff was very pleasant.  Rooms are apartment style, small kitchen, living area, eating area bedroom and bathroom.  Not close to any grocery stores so if you don't have a car it can be hard to get food items if you want to cook.  Did not use pool or hot tub but they both looked nice.  They have breakfast, for a price, but we didn't eat.  Bed very comfortable but watch the corners of the platform because they can take your shin out!!  We padded them with towels.  I would stay here again with out hesitation.

reviews.title: Comfortable and NICE
reviews.text: This was a nice mini condo like place to stay, without a club in it so you can sleep at night.  It was just off the strip and block from the airport.  Had everything we needed in kitchen, also iron and ironing board. They even have complimentary laundry detergent and fabric softener at front desk. The bed was the best part of the room in my opinion...big(King) and firm. I am now begging my husband for one.  More hangers would have been nice. Parking was plenty and free. Front desk staff was awesome!  Has a small shaded patio with 2 chairs and a small table. Had black out curtains.  Was quiet for the most part, we had a bottom floor room and so when people shut their doors in the middle of the night above us it was kinda loud.  Also, housekeeping staff in A.M. were very loud and knocking on doors all around us.  Their carts are very loud also, maybe they should consider different wheels on them???  I should also note that I slept a lot during the day to be fair.  Pool and lounge chairs were amazing.  Fence and locked gates around whole resort, so nice and secure.  Just seemed like good people staying here and working here.

reviews.title: Spacious accommodations if you don't need to be on the strip
reviews.text: The one bedroom suites will adequately fit 1-4 people. Oddly, some aspects of the suite seem newly renovated (countertops, kitchen flooring, bed) while others don't (cabinets, bathroom flooring). The whole complex is fairly quiet especially for Las Vegas standards, but talking and music could be slightly heard from a neigbhour's sweet across the hall with both doors closed. Planes and voices in the hallway by people returning late at night could also be heard once and awhile, but not enough to classify it as "noisy." There's lots of parking albeit a bit tight.
