The business center is private and quietbut within the lounge and pool table area so it can probably get noisy at times. Although it's technically located within walking distance from the Strip, it's far enough that you should have a car or take taxis if going there regularly.

reviews.title: Simply a No Brainer
reviews.text: I am writing this on my last day here at the resort. I have nothing but praise for the staff, the room, the grounds, and the location. Check-in was super fast, and after letting them know I was here for business, I didn't get any of the time share sell that other reviewers talked about. I asked for and was given a third floor room so I wouldn't hear any stomping around on the ceiling. The room was very quiet and I didn't hear any airport noise even though the resort is very near the airport. The room looks to be very recently renovated, with new furniture and carpet. My one bedroom unit has a full kitchen with blender, 12 cup coffee maker,(you will not find an in-room coffee maker in any casino resort) toaster, full size fridge stove and microwave, and all pots pans dishes utensils, just everything. Four place dining table, sleeper couch and side chair, dresser and nice tv in the living room, and the bedroom has a king size bed, two nightstands, a dresser with another tv, and a walk-in closet. Very nice bathroom with perimeter lit mirror, and a deep tub/shower that drains nicely so you aren't standing in dirty water. For a short stay, you won't have housekeeping service. I like this as I can come and go as I please without worrying about the room being done or not. There were plenty of towels for my 3 night stay. Excellent pool area with a small hot tub, daybeds, conversation pits with gas fires, four gas BBQs, and a ping pong table. Here's the deal. Parking at most casino resorts? 10-20 dollars a day on top of your room rate. Parking here? Zero dollars. Resort fees at the other places? 20-40 dollars a day on top of your room rate. Resort fee here? Zero dollars. I always rent a car, but you can walk to Hooter's next door, or the Tropicana on the strip in just a few minutes. This place just makes good sense. As long as a room is available for me here, I will never stay at a casino resort again. Thank you everyone at the Desert Rose!

reviews.title: Soooooo nice!
reviews.text: This suite is an apartment! Very modern and clean. Staff was so accommodating with early check in and late checkout. Grisselda was very professional and sweet upon our arrival. Resort offers heated pool, jacuzzi, workout room, and pool table for $0 resort fee. Walking distance to Hooters, Tropicana and MGM. Once there skyways take you to the strip!! I will stay here on my next trip!

reviews.title: Wonderful place
reviews.text: The Desert Rose is just that. It's close to the strip but quiet. The rooms are clean, large, nicely decorated and comfortable. We used the pool and hot tub and our balcony was perfect for drinking our morning coffee. We didn't cook while there but could have in the cute little kitchen. There is no resort fees and parking is free, unlike the big hotels on the strip. It was a reasonable Uber ride back to the Desert Rose and we felt very safe there. We loved it and will stay again if we go to Las Vegas again.

reviews.title: Poor cleaning services
reviews.text: We had stayed for 7 days and we were surprised to hear that they do not clean the room during this period.  Half way through our stay we asked for a cleaning and were told the cleaning is done every 3 to 4 days and we were scheduled for a cleaning on Friday afternoon.  Unfortunately, when we returned later that day our room was not cleaned.  When we called the front desk we were then informed that rooms are only cleaned after 9 days.  Of course, this is ridiculous but what choice did we have.  Furthermore, every second day or so we had to get more towels, coffee, etc.  On occasion they would refresh our hotel needs but that was not consistent.  We expected better like we had experienced during our last stay there.  We were also disappointed that they no longer served a continental breakfast.  Unless they change their cleaning policy, we will likely find other accommodations next time.

reviews.title: Fantastic oasis just off the strip
reviews.text: Spent 4 nights at the Desert Rose with my wife. Very helpful and polite staff, room was clean and had everything we needed. Key points: It was quiet, had not even a trace of cigarette smoke (unlike EVERYWHERE else that we went!). Huge bath tub and massive bed!Right next to the strip, but far enough away for loads of peace and quiet. Would definitely recommend (and most certainly would stay here again).

reviews.title: Great quiet place but almost on the strip
reviews.text: This place is amazing if u would like to be few steps from the strip but still hidden from all the noise, crowds and lights. Staff there is 100% friendly, polite, helpful and professional. Appartment was large, clen, fully furniahed, great balcony and felt very well maintanced and safe. Close to the highway, free parking, and 1 minute from Las Vegas strip.

reviews.title: Great bargain spot!
reviews.text: Over the years I've stayed just about everywhere is Las Vegas almost always for a lot more money than the $68 per night (with no resort fee!) that I paid at Desert Rose for a full one-bedroom suite with free wifi, Etc.  Place is just a block off the strip and adjacent of Hooters, Tropicana and MGM.  Main entrance is off Tropicana but there's a back road (Reno) that drops you on the strip with no traffic hassles.  Very clean and comfortable.  We didn't use the full kitchen but what a plus for a family.  We'll be back.

reviews.title: Perfect again !
reviews.text: This was our second time staying here and we already know that the next time we go back to Vegas we will be staying here.The resort is super clean and quiet, the rooms are very spacious with full kitchens(including a quiet dishwasher) and all the amenities you need for cooking, there was a free in room safe, and 2 TV's, one in the living room and 1 in the bedroom.The front desk staff was amazing any time we needed them, Paula had us checked in and informed very quickly, and we were off to our room, even though we arrived 5 hours before check-in time !I'll take the spacious Condo style room over a small hotel room any day.5 Stars again for this place, without hesitation !And also, if you are price shopping and find this place seems more expensive than others, NO RESORT FEE !

reviews.title: Weekend Visit
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Desert Rose several times now.  Their renovations are complete now and it is even nicer than before.  This is a smaller, quieter resort, that is easy to get to without having to travel down the strip on a busy weekend.  The rooms are updated - modern, nice and clean.  The outdoor area is great - nice pool, bbqs and fire pits.  The renovations included a nice bar, accessible from both the pool area and the lobby.This was much better than staying on the strip (which we did our last visit) - where you pay to park, pay ridiculous "resort fees" (which are for local phone calls and wifi - both of which are advertised as free, but aren't. These are free at Desert Rose). Will be back here again! In May!

reviews.title: Awesome hotel, great rooms for the whole family.
reviews.text: This hotel was a really pleasant surprise. We are travelling three kids and two adults.The room is really large, sleeping couch one of the best we have seen and the beds are really comfy.Location is really good, walking distance to the strip but just far enough to be peaceful and quiet. Friendly staff. Even has fully equipped kitchens. Parking just outside the rooms.The pool area is also nice. Would definitely go here again if travelling with the family.

reviews.title: Off the Strip
reviews.text: Having stayed on The Strip before and having a pet hate for Resort Fees (!) we gave the Desert Rose a shot as it was a short walk to both the T-Mobile Arena and Monte Carlo, we were attending shows and that was our primary reason for the trip.It is a Wyndham Timeshare resort that is open for general bookings so just bear in mind that staff are very keen for you to speak to their reps and get your welcome pack, frankly we did not have time.The common areas are clean and tidy, the room was both spacious and well kept with good facilities and a nice balcony.Staff were always polite and friendly, no issues at all.Location is great for 'off strip'. You are 10 minutes walk from the New York NewYork, Monte Carlo, MGM etc.  All cab rides to the north end of the strip are rapid as you are basically running up a road that is paralell.No issue recommended this accommodation

reviews.title: Good Value, Close to Strip but Quiet
reviews.text: If your looking for an off-strip but proximate location to stay in Vegas, this is a good choice. It’s behind the Tropicana and adjacent to the Hooters resort casino. We had a one bedroom unit with a fully equipped kitchen (no oven, just microwave and stovetop). The room was clean, quiet, and comfortable.

reviews.title: Quality stay, good location.
reviews.text: The property was very nice and the 2 bedroom condo was perfect for our party of 5. The roll out bed in the living room added extra sleeping. The room was very clean and modern. The master shower had a really nice 3 water feature that was very relaxing after a long day of walking the strip. The resort is next to Hooters Resort so you can gamble on the cheap. You can also catch the monorail at MGM which is across the street.

reviews.title: 50th birthday
reviews.text: Had a wonderful week here in December for our joint 50th birthdays . So good we are coming back again for valentines !! Suite was very clean , comfortable bed and full kitchen close to the strip but quieter !Even got a birthday card and chocolates and wine . Thank you !

reviews.title: Comfortable and clean
reviews.text: Spent 3 days in a 2 bedroom condo. 3rd floor with a small patio looking at lights of MGM and Luxor. Rooms were extremely clean, beds very comfortable. About 20 min walk from the front of the Tropicana. They don't change sheets or change towels for shorts stays, but lots of towels, and everything you need in a kitchen (fridge, microwave, blender, cups, glasses etc). Only minor complaint was trying to understand and use the multi head shower. For the price, an amazing, peaceful stay just off the strip.

reviews.title: Extremely nice and clean normal hotel in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: I love this place, I have stayed here a few times during the SEMA show in November. It's been renovated now and is done up well. We like this place because we don't want to deal with the big hotels and casinos. It is walking distance to the MGM and other hotels if you want to go and there is a nice restaurant just down the road if you need to get a normal priced meal. The only real issue is the location is on a side street that sometimes when traffic is bad can be annoying to get into but nothing that would stop me from staying there. I for sure will be returning when I have to come back.

reviews.title: So beautiful
reviews.text: This resort is perfect . Clean with new appliances . Super comfortable bed. Spacious & roomy . Great lightening in the bathroom . Fully stocked kitchen with just enough dishes. I'll definitely be coming back

reviews.title: Close enough to The Strip
reviews.text: While the hotel is not on The Strip, it is close enough to walk part of it or take the Monorail from MGM. You also have other options: car (not recommended), cab, public transport.The suite came with 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, dining room, living room, and a fully equipped kitchen (great if you plan on being in Las Vegas for more than a couple of days).The rooms were clean and spacious enough for two of us and should easily accommodate four people.The airport was visible from our suite--it's close, except it can get noisy so if you're a light sleeper, you might want to get a room on the backside.Hooters is right next door (hotel, restaurant, casino). MGM and Tropicana are within walking distance. Mandalay and Luxor are just within walking distance for the healthier folks.The hotel has a heated pool (didn't use--it was cold during our stay) and a hot tub.The facilities are clean; the staff is friendly. Warning--no restaurant and no daily housekeeping, although calling the front desk got us the extra supplies we needed and there are plenty of restaurants near by. When you check in, you get a folder which gives you options for food delivery.Definitely would stay there again.

reviews.title: My Family of 4 stayed here for 6 nights
reviews.text: We stayed here for 6 nights after spending two in a big, fancy and expensive hotel. I actually wish we'd just stayed here the whole time.It is a block off the strip but in a great location and we walked to the strip numerous times with our 6 and 8 yo girls. If we wanted to go to the other end of the strip we took the monorail from the MGM Grand. It was also easy to drive to the shops without having to bother about getting across the strip/freeway.The room was very clean and comfy and the  kitchen had everything we needed. Our balcony didn't have a good view but  we didn't use it except to dry towels.The pool, spa and bbq area were excellent and not visible from outside the resort unlike other placesOnly issues were that despite booking  for 2 adults and 2 kids the sofa bed was not made up (or made with weekly clean) and the staff made direct calls to our room to sell time share. I'd definitely recommend this place for families.

reviews.title: Desert Rose
reviews.text: Great place to be near the strip, but away from the madness. Full kitchens are great and all like new. Clean and nice. Get a 3rd floor suite farthest from elevator. No one above you slam doors and noisy people only on one side. Some airplane noise but not after midnight. Walk to MGM. I will return. Thank you Desert Rose.

reviews.title: Good location, good kitchenette, bad bed
reviews.text: Each year the desert rose declines a little more.  I've always enjoyed the location and quiet atmosphere. But over the years "extras" have been deleted.  At one time there was a breakfast. That is gone.  A social hour. That's gone. Room service (cleaning etc). That's gone. I could live with the missing extras but a bad bed (mattress) is hard to accept.  It didn't make a difference that I complained to customer service.If sleep isn't high on your importance list, this is a good place, otherwise be warned.

reviews.title: Hidden Gem
reviews.text: Full kitchen, nicely landscaped, very friendly and helpful staff and within walking distance (little more than 100yds) of the strip. The maids only do the room twice a week which I like. If you need anything else they’re more than happy to help. I had no problem sleeping as the place was quiet. There is a great heated pool and laundry facilities. Grocery stores are about a 10 to 15 minute drive away. I love it here. The only down side is that you really need a car. It really helps in keeping your kitchen fully stocked or anything else you might want to do. Finally, the Desert Rose Resort is a great value, this is the third time I’ve stayed here.

reviews.title: Clean, close to strip, good amenities
reviews.text: Close to the strip. An easy walk. Great to have a kitchen and separate bedrooms and lounge for a group travelling together. Pool was nice. Has a laundry too. Staff were helpful. Modern apartment with full size fridge and stove. Microwave and coffee machine. Good water pressure in shower.

reviews.title: Separate bedroom, kitchen and very quiet
reviews.text: Only 10 min walk to Excalibur where we had relatives staying, which was handy but I was glad we chose here instead. We had a separate bedroom so kids could go to bed and we could stay up and then move them to the sofa bed when we went to bed, very convenient. Full kitchen also very handy to make breakfast. Great pool, nice warm temperature, and very peaceful. I really enjoyed this low profile low key hotel to come back to after the craziness of the Strip, yet only a short walk to the Strip. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Friendly personnel
reviews.text: Desert Rose is located 2 blocks from the strip, on a road that's not too busy.  It is behind the Tropicana resort.  It is also close to the airport.  The rooms are spacious, with a pool, exercise room, bar, and many indoor and outdoor sitting areas.

reviews.title: Lovely break
reviews.text: I recently visited the Desert Rose resort for a break with my mum and dad and had a lovely time. The hotel is great with fab food and lovely staff. The animation team were amazing and made us feel very welcome. We didn’t stop laughing. Everyone is more than happy to help no matter what. Great break and we will hopefully return!!

reviews.title: Lovely holiday
reviews.text: It was really nice holiday day I enjoy with everyone here in the hotel and I like very much the see and the beach very nice view and I like the maxo restaurant and I love all the animation team they are very friendly and the service is good also and we will never forget that holiday and for Sure we will come back

reviews.title: Great experience for family trip
reviews.text: I stayed here with my children (ages 8-12) and parents (mid-70s) on a Thanksgiving family trip. The units are clean and updated, and the facility is quiet and conveniently located. The two bedroom layout worked great and it was so nice having a kitchen. My kids enjoyed the pool which was not fancy but clean and maintained.We did not get a hard sell on timeshares, just a brief offer for show tickets if we attended a tour (we did not).I noticed this property has high levels of security, there were always visible guards, they swarmed on me when I left my kids unattended at the pool for 2 minutes to use the restroom, and again when I brought a glass mug of coffee into the pool area. They were also hovering when my brother and his family visited us from another hotel. While I think some people could find this annoying, it made us feel safe and it was apparent that they had no tolerance for excessive noise, rowdy behavior, etc.

reviews.title: Wonderful Stay!
reviews.text: The website does not show the Reno work that was done on the propertyThe room me and my friends stayed in was very nice and well equipped with what we needed. We cooked breakfast everyday and sometimes cooked dinner too! So having a kitchen was great! The location is great! Walking distance from the strip. Plenty of parking and it was free. I like that because we didn't have to worry about the hustle and bustle of finding parking on the strip.Bathroom was small but because the sink was not in the actual bathroom was good because it allowed us girls to primp while someone was in the bathroom! Room was clean and the bed was comfortable. The sofa in the living room was comfortable as well. The staff were very helpful even when trying to print boarding passes and the printer wasn't working! I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort
reviews.text: Arrived 5 hours before check-in, Michael at the front desk was incredibly helpful and courteous.  He found a room that was ready to go and processed me in.  The room was fantastic.  The resort is off the strip, but you can see it from there.  I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Modest by Las Vegas standards
reviews.text: My wife and I stayed 5 days recently at the Desert Rose, located a couple blocks off the strip behind the Tropicana.  We walked to a few casinos and were able to get to the monorail within about 15 minutes (through the MGM).  Other plusses of the hotel included a comfortable bed, quiet room, responsive heater/air conditioner, and free parking.  On the negative side, if you are there several days, the walking distances can become tedious.  We elected to rent a car.  There is no breakfast available at the hotel.  There are no screens on the windows, so I hesitated opening them.  I continually bumped my leg on the sharp corners of the bed frame, as did my wife. There is no daily housekeeping so we needed to empty our trash ourselves and the mini bar of soap only lasted to our third day. Extra towels are in the cupboards below the sinks, but not soap.  We did not find a hair dryer.  The pool looked nice but the weather was rather cool. If you want bottled water it is necessary to buy it from the tiny store at $2 a bottle.  Having bottled water in the fridge would have been nice as the climate is really dry.  The front desk staff were helpful in getting a boarding pass printed out for our return flight.  We initially tried to use a computer in the business office, but the only computer  connected to a printer (the left one)  was being used.

reviews.title: Awesome!
reviews.text: We have stayed at the Desert Rose for many years because it is close to the strip has a nice pool area and Condo Style Rooms with full kitchens and is quiet. Very family oriented. To our suprise when we checked in this time we found that they had done a complete remodel of the entire facility starting with exterior of the buildings right down to absolutely everything in each room. Pool area they have added fire pits , new bar and restaurant in the lobby. Very beautiful job all around and Hotel Room pricing for feeling like you are at home. Highly recommend this place to anyone!  We will definitely be back.

reviews.title: Good value
reviews.text: Just 9 minutes walk to the strip... close to the airport (but no noise) and at one end of the strip (that makes it peaceful).. nice pool though not huge... service was good.. we stayed in 2 bed-room 2-bath with kitchen and utensils... available parking... 2 gates for easy entry (you need your room card to open.. so safe)...no complimentary meal.. (no daily trash-cleaning, which was ok for us as we could throw it in trash-bin in 1 minute!) they have a small bar at level 0... overall nice stay and not too expensive. 10-15 min drive to airport.

reviews.title: THE BEST HOLIDAY
reviews.text: The best holiday in ms life, the best resort ih hurgada. Thanks everyone for make my holiday very nice. Our room was excelent,clean and the Mr Arafat is so good man. He help us with everythink we need. The Shazly is so kind and friendly . The the Arafat and Shazly for everything. It was the best vacation in my life and i will back again i hope. Good luck everyone and make fun with this people. Engoy in resort.Andrea

I want to start commenting about this hotel with the Animation team because they are amazing, they know how to make us have fun and be happy even by staying in the hotel, even they do great outing to clubs here for very good price. I want to specially thank ( Beso, Basangoo, Moda, Tito, Jimmy, youssef and lastly Moka ) Generally talking about the hotal it was very good

Great place, great service, friendly animation team, i am absolutely coming here, its really comfortable, relaxing and enjoyable in every way, i absolutley recommed this place to everyone, and i hope everyone enjoy the place as i ve enjoyed :D :D

reviews.title: A nice Time Share Property, one block from the strip close to Hooters Hotel and Casino.
reviews.text: I had a nice two bedroom unit here. It was quite nice equipped with two washrooms, three flat screen TVs and a well equipped kitchen with all the required appliances and pots, dishes to make you feelAt home. Seven days this was our base of operation. Nice pool off the lobby that was oh so nice to relax in after a day out in and around Las Vegas. Part of the Windom Hotel Chain. Excellent. Great for families or adults alike.

reviews.title: A nice place....
reviews.text: Yes ok the end of the south part of the strip but it was so nice. The employees were very accommodating and kind. Peter and John helped my friends and I load our groceries in late in the morning (our flight were delayed). The renovated rooms are nicer than most apartments. The apartments comes equip with everything except food  but it does have popcorn coffee and little salt and pepper shakers. I enjoyed housekeeping coming once a week I'm a little germophoed so I've already sprayed and wiped everything down didn't want to have to do it all over again. I do recommend maybe once Renos are complete maybe a shuttle service maybe just to the mgm or planet Hollywood and the airport

reviews.title: Good value and location definitely recommend
reviews.text: Myself and 3 friends stayed at Desert Rose end of September for 1 week. The apartment was spacious and clean and full of all the amenities you would expect - including towels and sun lounger towels! TV’s in every room with loads of channels. The pool is small but never too busy and perfect to chill by during the day. Fast Wi-Fi and a well stocked bar and small shop. Local garage serves alcohol (take your own to the pool - save on bar prices). Walmart is a $8 Taxi ride and worth stocking up on supplies. We used uber to get around mostly but the strip is only about 2 blocks or a 10 min walk. Hooters next door do great wings! It’s worth noting we stayed during the horrific events that occurred in Vegas and the staff were very helpful and accommodating at such a time. No complaints whatsoever and would definitely come back and stay again. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Amazing
reviews.text: I've been coming here for 10 years. It's always a great place to vacation. The hotel is great and the employees are always friendly. A perfect hotel for families. It's close to the strip without being a casino hotel.

reviews.title: Fantastic hidden gem!
reviews.text: My family and I stayed here for 10 days and we are really glad we chose the Desert Rose. We’ve been to Las Vegas before so didn’t feel the need to be in the middle of the strip. There are huge benefits of this place, the main ones being there is no heavy resort fee tax imposed (like there are in the Strip resorts and hotels), there is ample space in the apartment, free parking, and there is a full kitchen with full sized fridge (some of the strip hotels do not come with fridges as standard and the high end ones charge if you remove anything from a minibar fridge). The apartments are just great. Loads of space, balcony, kitchen with everything you’ll need (cutlery, plates, cooking items etc.), nice dressing area and loads of storage. The staff were all very kind and friendly. I would try to get one of the 2nd or 3rd level rooms over looking the pool / central area rather than the car parks if you want a nicer view. The place is also very quiet and relaxing. We didn’t use the pool but it looked nice.You can grab a cheap breakfast by the bar in reception in the mornings which is nice. There is also a small store with basics, but you’ll probably need to go to Walgreens on the Strip to stock up properly. Or if you have a car head to Walmart or Target (both fairly close by).You can walk to Strip in around 10 mins (MGM, Tropicana, Excalibur or Luxor are closest .... well, Hooters is actually closer but that place is grim). We didn’t get stung by the heavy timeshare sell routine. Just tell reception that you are meeting friends in the next hour and you are in a bit of a rush checking in. They didn’t ask us at all to attend a meeting or presentation. Just be forceful yet polite. I will DEFINITELY stay here again. What a great find. Save money and time by staying here. Thanks to all the staff for making it a great holiday!

Amazing hotel , so friendly stuff , crazy animation team and relaxing holiday The all stuff bring me a nice feeling and smile all the time 😂😂And i will spend any holiday for me in this hotel with lovely stuff and crazy animation as Beso , yousef and Kato 💋💋💋💋💋💋💋❤️

reviews.title: Amazing Hotel
reviews.text: Super desert rose , it was very good and amazing, very good staff helpful kindful amazing , super animation team A lot of activities everyday especially youssef Kato beso moda black Jason asya and sevta

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: First visit to Las Vegas and stayed at this hotel for one week. Can't compliment this place highly enough. Spotlessly clean and newly refurbished room. Kitchen had everything you could possibly need, nice friendly helpful staff. No casino which we really liked. Great location if you don't want to be right in the heart of the buzz but not miles away from it. Would certainly stay here again if visiting Vegas

reviews.title: Room with a view.???
reviews.text: The apartment was clean and tidy had a kitchen ,fridge,microwave ,and a dishwasher.The view was looking at the back of the lift shaft last time i stayed here the view was looking at the car park. Small swimming pool and a hot tub. Small shop on site limited supplies . Ten minutes walk to mgm hotel.

reviews.title: Heartless in the wake of tragedy
reviews.text: I stayed at this "hotel" with my wife and daughter for the Route 91 Harvest festival. I don't need to repeat what happened there but I I can comment on this hotel. First, the one tiny elevator was completely inadequate. Now add a hundred people fleeing for their lives, *no one could find the stairs*. This place is almost directly across the street from the venue, many of the wounded (and worse) were hiding in this hotel. We had people in our room that had nowhere else to go. Many of the hotels in the area are giving refunds because of what happened and what was experienced on their property. I called to see if Desert Rose was also doing this. Nope. Business first we have a no refund policy and our "upper management" has decided this is how we'll deal with this situation. Totally your right, but now I get to exercise my right.  I will never stay at another Wyndham property. EVER. I will make it my mission in life to tell everyone I know how heartless this company is. You should be ashamed of yourselves. While the rest of Las Vegas is coming together to support the victims in any way possible, Wyndham just gives us the middle finger. It's not about the money, its the attitude. Oh and the wifi sucks too.

reviews.title: Nice hotel
reviews.text: A very nice hotel with a very very decent cost to luxery ratio. Not expensive and very close to the strip. A nice pool (which they close to soon if there is a hint of bad weather). The rooms are very good and being absle to coock and have a fridge helps to relax after a long flight.We really enjoyed our stay.

reviews.title: Nice holiday
reviews.text: It’s was a nice holiday and great hotel and nice service and good staff they real friendly and the restaurant is real nice food and the beach it’s real nice space for swim and the animation they super active we loved and I will come back again

reviews.title: We want to stay again! For longer!!
reviews.text: Used TripAdvisor in March of 2018 for spring vacation. Loved the results. So we did it again for September-oct for work and play. The kitchen was fantastic. We went to the grocery store and got frozen pizza for lunch. That way we save time and money for more fun stuff. You can bring your own food and drinks to the pool! Our room was on the outside of the tower but facing another tower, not the best view, but felt safer, and very quiet. Fans in bathrooms work and are good for white noise, as do AC fans. we didn't need much from the staff, however they were all smiles, said hello any time we passed any of them and asked if we needed anything. Even the people working on the renovations were very nice. Only have one complaint and it's just that somewhere on TripAdvisor it said something about breakfast, that was outdated... Oops. We LOVED THIS PLACE!!!We plan to come back sometime after the new year.

reviews.title: Good holiday
reviews.text: It's was a nice holiday and nice hotel and good service and nice staff they so friendly we liked so much and the restaurant it's good and nice food and the beach it's real beautiful and the animation they real super active we liked spical Bob and the hotel it's real nice .

reviews.title: Great Place To Relax Just Off The Strip
reviews.text: We stayed here for six nights in September and could not fault the hotel, the staff, the facilities and cleanliness of the hotelOnly a short walk to the strip (5 minutes) with ample FREE parking on site.Hotel has three floors all accessible by lift. Our one bedroom apartment consisted of separate bedroom with built in wardrobe & TV, the bed was king size and very comfortable, bathroom with bath tub and over head shower, living & dining area with TV and fully equipped kitchen, FREE safe and iron & Ironing board.A small welcome pack was in our room on arrival (washing up liquid, dish cloth, dishwasher tablets, coffee, tea, sugar filters for coffee machine)On site on the ground floor is a laundry room consisting of washing machines and dryer's also situated on the ground floor is an ice machine.The hotel has a good size clean private swimming pool with ample good quality sunbeds along with a good size hot tub (and the water is hot). The pool area does NOT have a life guard on duty.This hotel also has a BBQ area (4 large gas BBQ's) and large seating are for guessed to use.The hotel operates a key card to access ALL areas of the hotel which makes you feel very safe.This hotel does not have a casino however you are only a five minute walk to the strip.

reviews.title: Nice holiday
reviews.text: It’s nice hotel I liked so much everything great and the restaurant it’s good and food also good and nice staff and really friendly and the animation team they real nice and they make us happy and they super active and I will come back again

reviews.title: Good holiday
reviews.text: Very good animation and excellent clean and i like disco so much but beer isn't found and all time no beeer and there not coffe machine in all bar but swimming pool is very good clean and i like house keeping

reviews.title: Great Place to relax
reviews.text: Just far enough away from The Strip to relax in. Lots of parking available, easy check-in and comfortable accommodation. I had a two bedroom apartment on the ground floor with a balcony. Big living room, two bathrooms and a huge kitchenette. Recently painted and very clean. Beds were comfortable.Nice family alternative to the big skyscrapers and casinos.Would return. Pool is not big but is good enough to cool off in.Better off taking a short walk to the strip to get breakfast. All in all, very happy stay but not much money.

reviews.title: Enjoyed our stay
reviews.text: We spent a week at the Desert Rose.  Rented a two bedroom and a one bedroom.  Staff was very friendly and answered all our questions.  Accomadations were clean and met our needs (five of us).  There was some walking to the strip casinos (Desert Rose is right behind Hooters),  Since we flew to Vegas, we used Uber for most of our longer trips.  Desert Rose had a great swimming pool, laundry, and met all out needs for our stay.  For being in Vegas we thought the rooms were very clean and quiet.

reviews.title: A hidden gem 💎
reviews.text: I have recently returned from Las Vegas and these apartments are amazing. From checking in everything was fantastic. The staff are so helpful and friendly. They make you feel so welcome. The apartments are brilliant. Ours was situated in block 4. They are fully equipped with all the mod cons. The only slight hiccup we had was with the air conditioning but was promptly fixed by reception telephoning for a repair man. Don’t have any negativity at all for this wee hidden gem

reviews.title: Second Visit
reviews.text: We like this property, the pool, rooms and reception are great. From the property it is an easy 10 minute walk.I would have given a rating of 5 stars if not for the 3 bewares.Beware the time share sales people in reception.Beware the fact that housekeeping only service the room weekly.Beware some of the beds have very hard corners at shin height.

reviews.title: Property is great but the Accounting Department is terrible!
reviews.text: We arrived for our stay on a Monday afternoon. We decided to stop at the hotel and check in, even if we couldn't get our room right away. The front desk agent checked us in without issues. She requested to have a credit card on file for 'incidentals.' I don't remember what the amount was but it was a pretty standard amount. As we had prepaid through Southwest Vacations, all we agreed to have charged (our held) to our credit card was the incidentals deposit. She finished our check in and we happily left for the rest of the afternoon, coming back later to get our room keys.The hotel was beautiful. We made sure to request a renovated room as far from any construction as we could get. The accommodated us and we were more than happy with our 2 bedroom room. There was plenty of space for us and our two teenagers. We loved having a kitchenette for breakfasts and snacks. The pool, while kinda small for a Vegas property, but it was perfect the property. It was quiet and peaceful and an oasis away from the Strip. Based solely on our room and the beauty of the property, this would be a 5 star review. Unfortunately the accounting department messed that up.During our stay we discovered that they not only hit our credit card for the incidentals deposit, but placed a hold for the whole amount of our stay. Remember, we prepaid through Southwest. My husband went down right away to have it fixed. Unfortunately accounting was gone for the day but the desk agents assured us it would be fixed the next day. We went down the next morning, and my husband explained the issue again. The manager stated it was a accounting snafu and as soon as the payment posted from our travel agent (though it was through Southwest) they'd clear it from our credit card. We assumed that was what happened.We got home, checked our credit card and realized the hold was still placed on our account for the amount of the stay. This time we contacted our travel agent. The hotel gave her the run around for a few days but at some point she believed that they finally worked it out. Unfortunately a short time later, when we checked the account, it was still there! This time we contested the charge with our credit card company, fully prepared for a battle. Miraculously they finally removed the charge from our account. A charge (hold, whatever) that should never have been place on our account in the first place!!I really loved this property. It's just off the Strip, an oasis from the chaos. I loved the room and the pool. Unfortunately their incredibly poor handling of our accounting issue means I can't in good conscious recommend it. This problem could've ruined our vacation and highly resent that.

reviews.title: Nice holiday
reviews.text: Service is good,animation team its real active and always make us happy and the resturant is good and nice food and the hotel real amazing every things good and cleaning every time and reception its good and i will come back again

reviews.title: Great staff, quiet and close to the strip
reviews.text: My husband and I aren't big on the party scene, so this was the perfect resort for us in Vegas. It has a nice pool and hot tub, without the craziness of the pools on the strip. It was walking distance to a lot of the strip, though we did take an uber to our show to save time (and our feet). I loved how the room had a nice sized kitchen and a separate living room. After Vegas we went out to Bryce Canyon and Zion, but had a redeye back out of Vegas after. The resort let us come back on our last day to use the pool and shower in the fitness center, which was great. I doubt many other hotels in Vegas would allow that. We'd definitely stay here again!!

reviews.title: Third and last time
reviews.text: I have stayed at the Desert Rose twice previously, alas, despite previous happier visits, I feel this will be our third and final time.The main reason for this is the absolutely appalling way we were treated at check in; upon arrival we were asked to provide a credit card-now I'm not naive, I realise that it is common practice for most hotels these days to ask for a credit card to hold deposits when checking in, however when travelling overseas in order to avoid credit card fraud ( interestingly, an issue which seems particularly prevalent at the Desert Rose according to many of the other reviews on here) I tend to pay a cash deposit and didn't even take a card with me. However the receptionist flatly refused to check me in without one. I explained that we were repeat customers who have stayed here twice previously so I know that it has never been an issue, but NO, the message was clear: No card, no room.Now on my original booking form ( made with Thomas Cook) it states "it's RECOMMENDED that you carry at least one credit card on holiday to America. If you don't have a credit card a cash deposit may be needed instead." ( note the word RECOMMENDED as opposed to essential) I had this printed out and handed it to them, thinking they would HAVE to accept it, but still there was a complete flat refusal to budge, blaming the booking agent for this incorrect information.What were we supposed to do? We had no card so I couldn't give them the very thing they insisted on! We then were told to wait in the lounge whilst they tried to contact management. This was after a 10 hour flight ( plus a 2 hour delay) so this was not welcome.Eventually, Tia Hatcher, the assistant guest services manager came out to see us and reiterated the need for a credit card. I explained yet again that we didn't have one, we had it in writing that we didn't need one, and that we have stayed here previously without ever needing one, instead leaving a cash deposit. Her response was could we not ring somebody back home in the UK, and get them to provide a credit card for them to put on file? I explained that with the time difference it was almost midnight back home on Saturday evening/early hours of Sunday morning so this was not practicable. I offered instead to leave a substantial cash deposit. I offered to leave my iPhone as a deposit. I offered to leave my passport as a deposit. THEY WOULD NOT BUDGE. Eventually they relinquished and said we could stop for one night. I pointed out that we had fully paid for seven nights but they seemed hell bent on having a credit card on file. I really don't understand what this obsession was with having a card? The room was paid for in full, and my understanding was that they only want a credit card on file so in the event of any theft or damages they could charge it, but I was offering to leave a substantial cash deposit or even my passport, so what was the problem? If we'd been a large drunken stag or hen party, I would of understood it, but we were an average middle-aged couple- not exactly high risk. Anyway, we stayed the first night on the understanding we would go back in the morning and speak to them again. With the jetlag we slept in and I nipped out for coffee about 10 AM, but when I came back to the room guess what? Yep! My door key had been deactivated and I was effectively locked out. Seriously? I have never been treated so badly and I felt like a criminal.Another trip to reception and another conversation about their insistence to have a credit card on file. Eventually I contacted my son back home in the UK who texted me my credit card number (along with expiry date and security code on the back) but guess what? This wasn't good enough! It seemed they needed an actual imprint of my card, but in the absence of this being possible they insisted on a photograph. I'd had enough by this point. Utter mindless bureaucracy. Eventually I managed to provide them with a photograph of my card, which seemed to pacify them, but what an appalling and inflexible approach to problem solving.I cannot recommend this hotel and cannot envisage ever staying here again.

reviews.title: An oasis in the glitz and desert.
reviews.text: The Desert Rose is the perfect spot to stay in Las Vegas if you want a comfortable, quiet and homely stay in Las Vegas. It provides a great place to stay in a busy city. Gorgeous pool, spacious rooms, comfortable beds and friendly staff.

reviews.title: Beds heat and Jacuzzi
reviews.text: Having stayed here for 2 weeks I can't praise the resort enough it was out standing expect a couple of things! One the beds had a sharp wooden frame around so after 2 days my legs looked like they'd been through 12 rounds with Mike Tyson. Another thing was the Jacuzzi it's was bloody hot! And in 50 degree heat the last thing you want to get in is a boiling pan because that's what it was. Other than that nobody told me you'd sweat in Vegas was rather shocked.10/10 for the reception staff.House keepers only knocked once on the 2 weeks we was there though so that was a bit of a let down.Anyway as they say.... COME TO VEGAS THEY SAID.....

reviews.title: Nice holiday
reviews.text: Nice hotel and nice holiday in this hotel I want to visit this hotel next time because I love the place and animation in special bob and all people are kindly and rooms are very good and every thing in desert rose are nice

reviews.title: Vegas Sept 2017
reviews.text: Just returned from a 2 week stay Absolutely loved it  Appartment superb Never seen one as well equipped Great location short stroll to the hustle & bustle of The Strip . Spotlessly clean everywhere Staff Superb Friendly & Really Helpful Will Deffinately be returning Keep the good work up guys 10 out of 10 :-)

reviews.title: Brilliant hotel
reviews.text: I stayed in the desert rose for 2 weeks.  It was a brilliant hotel and the staff were absolutely fantastic and very helpful.  I would recommend the desert rose and I hope to return.  The apartments are lovely and have a welcome pack when we arrived.  The pool was great and jacuzzi was warm.   Near the strip to walk .

reviews.title: Fantastic
reviews.text: This was our fourth time staying at the Rose,but this time we were given an updated room...and all I can say is wow. The renovations they've done to the lobby were impressive enough,and the pool bar touch was great,but the room itself was quite simply fantastic - I'm a little bit hesitant to wax too lyrical about it as I don't want it to be sold out the next time we go to book it (as we undoubtably will) but,suffice to say,it was superb. The staff were great too (apart from not delivering a tea kettle we requested,but that's far from being a deal breaker!),and the invitation to attend their time-share presentation was dealt with quickly and simply by a polite "we're not interested at all,thank you",so thanks to all the staff at the Rose for a fantastic experience and we'll see you next time!

reviews.title: Thank you
reviews.text: Full five thank you the rose for a lovely stay, I've never seen Las Vegas as busy as this month with redirected trips from Florida, mr Olympia the ggg fight and so on, so was lovely to take a step back a block to our little paradise, we had a two bedroom apartment as usual the updates were very nice and a pleasant surprise when we got in after our ten hour flight, staff were lovely as always and nothing was a problem, thanks to team rose for a pleasant stay

reviews.title: I didn't want to leave!
reviews.text: If I ever come back to Vegas I will stay here again. Everything about it was great, nothing I can fault, and the price was cheap for Vegas. The info pack of a map, brochures and what's on, that you get on arrival was handy. On arrival they pressure you into a timeshare talk, we said no 4 times then walked away. No resort fee, no casino onsite, a laid back place to stay in comparison to other places.A few minutes walk to the strip and to nearby shops and restaurants, the room was huge, quiet, clean, non-smoking, comfortable and had brand new everything in the kitchen. Good aircon, two tvs, nice balcony up on the 3rd floor of building 4 overlooking the pool. The bed was one of the most comfortable beds I've ever slept in. Laundry was $1.50 and $1.25 for dryer. Reception give you free laundry powder if you ask. Good wifi. Amazing pool with music and lots of sunbeds. I really didn't want to leave!

reviews.title: Nice place to stay
reviews.text: We stayed at the Desert Rose for three days and were very happy with the service and the room.  Room was newly renovated, clean and spacious. We had a problem with our reservations and the front desk was very helpful in resolving it. They admitted it was their error and gave us a credit at the bar and grill which I thought was very nice. The only complaint I have is that there are not enough chairs at the pool area and very little shade.  The Strip was only a block away which was convenient. We would definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: 2nd stay fantastic stay.
reviews.text: This was our second stay at this resort. The accommodation was just as good as last time and the room was newly renovated. There is everything you could possibly need in  the rooms they are so well equipped.The reception staff are excellent and go out of their way to help. Guillermo was very efficient a credit to the hotel. We wouldn't hesitate to stay here again as we love it and thought it was excellent value for money.

reviews.title: Great Place
reviews.text: Is a lovely place to stay clean, comfortable and well situated. Its just behind MGM and next to Hooters a short walk to the strip. The rooms have everything you require for self catering. The pool area is good and the bar has a small menu the food was good and the bar staff attentive. You can pay to upgrade the internet service.

reviews.title: Wedding trip!!
reviews.text: Welll this place is very good I like it , we got the 2 bedroom suite and living room and with a kitchenette and dishes and more and balcony and they have laundry room on site and pool and BBQ grills and a bar in the lobby and a mini market and place is not hard too find and they have security for parking lot that u have too have a tag for it for ur car and security gates that u use ur key only and I love it and don't mind coming back soon! Only thing was the master bedroom bathroom was sooooo small I didn't like and wish it had a tub but it's just a shower but other then that it's great for family and friends and places was remodeled new I like it and the AC was great and cold , and the bed frame sticks out too far and we keep kicking it and that's all! Well be back soon

reviews.title: Fantastic accommodation, great location 😊
reviews.text: Just returned from a week here and loved every minute. As someone with a terrible fear of lifts this accommodation is amazing and let me relax without that worry. 2nd trip to vegas and hired a car this year also, again great for this stay as parked outside room and useful for grocery/beer shopping! The accommodation was much bigger than I expected with everything and more than we could need, the standard of furniture and bed was amazing. ( only problem we had was banging legs of corner of bed, we just put our cases at the ends to stop us walking into it and I believe there are plans to change this.  Loved the pool, no problem going alone and leaving hubby in room, always got beds which surprised me and the seating area with bbq's was a great idea although we didn't use them. Location is fab, 5 mins walk to Tropicana and 10 mins MGM, great central location.We will definitely return next year as this offers everything needed for a great stay in Vegas.  ☺☺

reviews.title: Thieves which are shielded by the administration of the hotel
reviews.text: I was staying in the Desert Rose Resort during WMworld 2017 (08/27/2017 - 09/01/2017). New Balance trainers was stolen from my room conceivably 08/30/2017. Doors and windows was closed. I suppose it happened during the cleaning... I travel a lot all over the World, but such incident never happened before. It's very sad experience.04/09/2017 I've contacted the hotel through booking partner and hotel gave a promise to get in touch with me in a day. There wasn't any contact.I recommend everyone to avoid this hotel because of thieves which are shielded by the administration of the hotel.

reviews.title: Wedding in Vegas
reviews.text: Great hotel for the family.  Just a 10 minute drive from the airport, parking is free. The resort has just been renovated and the apartment we stayed in (ask for a view of the pool) had everything for a self catered family break. Supermarkets are a 5-10 minute drive. The staff were all friendly and very helpful (Carla was kind enough to help my wife with her wedding dress). The pool was cleaned daily and great fun for the kids - towels supplied in the room. The Strip is just 5 minutes walk, through the MGM Grand, so you won't be bothered by the noise or crowds. Why stay anywhere else!

reviews.title: Nice clean stay away from the Strip
reviews.text: The resort is a small resort in walking distance to the strip and is far enough away to get away from the casinos for the day. The room was clean however we stayed for 2 weeks and the cleaner only came twice, but the resort and room on the whole was very clean. The resort states that it has a shop, this however is very small and does not really sell bits you need for a long stay here. We walked to Vonns one day which took around 30 minutes and ordered a taxi back to the room. Upon arrival we had the timeshare speech and the woman behind the desk was a little pushy but after an 11 hour flight and time difference we would not be agreeing to our free breakfast, she understood this finally and we did not get bothered again. The pool area was nice and the woman who worked behind the pool bar was amazing, really friendly and helpful, however on weekends you really need to hire someone to help her and perhaps less sales staff. Really nice lady however and really made the days at the pool extra relaxing for us. The pool did get a little grubby towards the end of the week and over the weekend, we noticed that the water was not as clear as it was at the start of the week, this was also usually when you would see more people around on the timeshare breakfast. The pool also had a big black mark around the sides which looked as though it needs a good scrub, don't get me wrong however this is a very clean resort and the pool area was very relaxing. Overall we will look to return here in the future as the staff where friendly, the bar food was cheap and good and the whole resort was clean and very relaxing.

reviews.title: Such a friendly and quiet place to stay.
reviews.text: We have visited Desert Rose 12 times now and have always been pleased, happy, looked after, and treated with respect. The staff go out of there way to help you and nothing is too much trouble. The room we had in block 4 had been refurbished and the one next door housing  my son and his family had too. They were both ideal in every way. The beds were comfortable and so lovely and clean. It was our son and his family's first time in Las Vegas,  and the rooms we had were wonderful. Our first time staying in The Desert Rose, supplied continental breakfast and did so for a few years. When it was taken over by new owners, that was changed, but missed.The kitchen contains a beautiful fridge freezer,  which would be appreciated to contain a small carton of milk in there, so that when you finally settle in you can have a coffee with the coffee machine  you do provide. I'm not too fond of black coffee lol. Plus a couple of bottles of water till you can get your supplies.Other than that, our holiday was great, so not a bad review if milk and water is our only negative.  Carry on giving people all that you do,  we'll see you again. Thank you. Shirley and Glenn xx

reviews.title: Space
reviews.text: There was a lot of space in the appartement. The kitchen was well equiped. It takes some minutes to walk to the strip. Breakfast facilities were limited in the hotel. They offered some deals in other hotels. The swimming pool is nice.

reviews.title: best holiday
reviews.text: desert rose hotel we love it , i have enjoyed with my family awesome days , my children like the Aqua Park its very amazing and interesting , we have enjoyed lovely time with The animation team . They are helpful funny and crazy team especially youssef zizo moda and jolia

reviews.title: Recommended hotel if you wan to stay off the strip
reviews.text: Stayed here August 2017 for two weeks. We arrived at 12 noon expecting to have to wait for our room however it was ready straight away. Unfortunately the room we were allocated was opposite rooms that were still being renovated so we asked to be moved, which we were without an issue. Reception staff were great, especially Kelsey. There is free Wifi for up to 4 devices, and Kelsey gave us another code because we had more than 4 which pleased the kids no end. Yes they do ask you to attend a 'welcome meeting' which does turn out to be timeshare however you just need to say you aren't interested and there's no hard sell to attend.The hotel itself is situated at the back of Hooters / MGM, this is good is you wish to be away from the hustle and bustle of the strip but it is a ten minute walk which isn't great when it's very hot (and for those of you who know Vegas there is quite a bit of walking involved so this extra 10 minutes does make a difference). The Monorail is located at the back of MGM so again a few minutes easy walk to get there however I wouldn't recommend using it. It costs $5 per person for one trip - it's cheaper and easier to go by taxi! An Uber from one end of the strip to the other costs approx $10.50 so cheaper especially if there is more than two of you, and takes you right to your location rather than having to walk to and from the Monorail. If you haven't used Uber before I would definitely recommend you downloading the App, All Along the strip and in the hotel reception they give out promo codes for $20 off, we downloaded it on to all 4 phones so got $80 worth of taxi trips. We also found Uber to be cheaper than the local taxis by roughly $5 per trip. Taxis to the airport with Uber were also around $11 whereas we paid $20 with a local taxi.Anyway back to the hotel. The rooms were very spacious with a full kitchen, HUGE oven and fridge, microwave, dishwasher, toaster etc. All utensils and appliances looked new. The reason i booked this hotel was because it had a kitchen and a separate living area. Having two children for two weeks I wanted the space rather than a cramped hotel room, and freedom to eat in if we wished to, which this hotel certainly provided. It is very expensive to eat out in Vegas unless you want to live on McDonalds so having the opportunity to have the odd lunch and breakfast in saved a fortune. There is a few supermarkets around (15 minute walk) or bigger ones 5 minute drive away if you want to take advantage of the free Ubers, and we stocked up once each week while we were there.There were a few downsides to the hotel. Firstly the Maid service was shocking. I think these are more or less sold as self serviced apartments. During the two weeks we were there the Maid visited 3 times and the only thing they did were change the towels and one one occasion put a couple of glasses that we had left in the sink in the dishwasher. The bed linen wasn't changed during the two weeks, neither were the pool towels, the floor wasn't hoovered / swept, and the bathroom wasn't cleaned at all. It didn't bother us as for the two weeks we were there we actually spent 6 days away from the hotel as visited California so we didn't sleep in the same bedsheets for the whole time, however the hotel didn't know this so I wouldn't have been happy if I had been in the room for two weeks. The pool area is pleasant if a little small. I am an early riser so was at the pool for 8am (open 8am until 11pm), however come 9am you will find difficulty finding a sunbed. They would benefit with a few extra beds however it is a small space. There is further seating areas however it was very rare you saw people sitting at the tables so maybe could take a few out and put some extra beds in? Friday / Saturday seems a quieter day for the pool as obviously people coming and going.Air conditioning is VERY noisy and woke us up on several occasions, it also didn't work very well in the bedroom, but not a major issue. Another downside is the bathroom which for some reason hasn't been refurbed like the rest of the room. Again not a major issue but cannot understand why you would update the rooms and not the bathroom as it looked old / drab compared to the rest of the apartment. Shower was old and bath filled with water from the shower if you are in there for longer than a couple of minutes, shame really as although perfectly fine it did let the apartment down overall (didn't help that it wasn't cleaned for the two weeks we were there either).Overall I would recommend the hotel if you don't mind the little extra walk as nice to get away from the constant casino atmosphere. Staff very pleasant, clean hotel, freedom and space of of an apartment rather than a hotel room. Better Maid service and an updated bathroom would have given it a better rating from me, but would stay again.

reviews.title: First Time Stay
reviews.text: Stayed for a week with my family , we had two x 1 Bedroom Apartments on the third floor Block 2. The rooms had been refurbished and had everything you could need and more.The Kitchen was fully equipped and the welcome package was very useful for our first mornings fresh coffee. Our rooms looked into MGM and New York , New York . (Top tip to access the strip , turn left out of the entrance , walk across hooters parking lot, cross Tropicana then enter MGM , walk through to the west wing exit and your on the strip)If you want a nice friendly hotel off the strip with a nice relaxed atmosphere you won't go far wrong with the Desert Rose

reviews.title: Awesome
reviews.text: Awesome Hotel , helpful staff and amazing ! Pools are great , super animation team are crazy they are helpful kindly and funny I like them shows tonight thanks animation for the amazing work thanks Youssef and Zizo

reviews.title: Good price/value, but beware of the scam!
reviews.text: This place is very clean, well equipped and situated close to The Strip. The nearby airport does not create any excess noise. However, they try to lure you in buying into the Wyndham points system with hard selling practices. At check-in they send you to another desk to get your parking voucher. This is where the scam happens: they offer you a free breakfast at another Wyndham hotel and promise lots of presents (e.g. very reduced rates on shows) if you participate. We fell into this trap. The breakfast was lousy, and the 2-hour presentation took 4 hours. If you sign up, you're stuck with it for life. We realized this, and didn't sign up, but wasted over 4 hours of our vacation on this. They also had no respect for our 3 kids waiting all the time with us. We were quite disgusted about the whole thing, and will think twice before going to a Wyndham place again.If you avoid this scam, this place is great, though.

reviews.title: Off the Main Strip
reviews.text: My parents booked to return here but this was our first time in Vegas.The hotel is about 15-20 minutes by taxi from the airport. It sits next to the Hooters Hotel and is about a 5 minute walk from the MGM. The checkin was quite easy and we were given a room in Block 4 on the 3rd floor with a view of the pool. The room has good air conditioning, a dining table, good kitchen area with a huge fridge/freezer, cooker and dishwasher. The sofa bed for our daughter was easy to set up and put away. The main bedroom had one of the most comfortable beds I have slept in and the pillows matched. The bathroom and vanity area was a bit on the small side but didn't present much of a problem. There were 2 TV's in the room and plenty of drawers for clothes. There is also a safe in the room. Access to all parts of the building are by keycard and there are also security guards on patrol at all times. There is a bar by the pool, but there is no problem if you want to buy your own drinks outside the hotel and drink them around the pool (no glass or bottles).Sunbeds are always available in good numbers. The pool is a reasonable size and there is also a separate Jacuzzi pool. There are BBQ's also available if you fancy cooking your own steaks etc. These are thoroughly cleaned by staff every day. For somewhere to base yourself to explore Las Vegas, but without the hustle of the casinos, this place is spot on. There was some kind of Basketball/cheerleading tournament going on in the area during our stay and quite a few competitors were staying at the hotel, but this didn't really impact our stay in any way. If staying in Vegas in the future I would definitely consider rebooking at the Desert Rose.

reviews.title: Great Stay! Love This Apartment!
reviews.text: My family of 5 adults stayed in a two-bedroom apartment. We loved the place! It was clean and very comfortable. The kitchenette was well-equipped so we enjoyed some "home-cooked" meals in the apartment.The resort is well located. As it is not along the Strip, it is very peaceful and quiet. However, it is convenient enough for one to get into the action of the Strip quickly. It is only a short walk to MGM Grand.From the bus-stop near MGM Grand (along Tropicana Ave), we took the WAX (Westcliff Airport Express) to Las Vegas North Premium Outlets. There is also a bus (201) to Walmart Supercenter which is further down Tropicana Ave. We will definitely stay here again if we visit Las Vegas again. For the price that we paid, I don't think there is a better place that can offer the same tranquility in a busy city without being too remotely located.

reviews.title: A trendy difference in accommodation
reviews.text: We stayed for four nights during a month long trip around the states.  It was wonderful to have a new, clean, comfortable apartment to stay in.  As we had limited luggage, the laundry was an added advantage.  It was very hot in Vegas and we enjoyed being able to relax in the games room, having a game of pool and a cold lemon water after braving the heat and walking the strip.  We only discovered there was breakfast available at the bar on our last morning.  The bar lady was really lovely and had we known we would have had our breakfast there every day instead of walking out into the heat!  I don't remember it being mentioned to me at check in and there was a very small sign but it would be much better to maybe have a chalk board with a menu that is clearly visible.If you are staying here with a car it would be the perfect choice.

reviews.title: An amazing 7 nights in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: Our apartment was clean, tidy and had everything we needed for 7 nights. The only downfall was when we checked in. Told to visit the opposite countered about whats onto do in vegas.  Got roped in to signing up for a breakfast and tickets for a show costing 50 dollars......we had been up for nearly 24hrs. When we read through the paper work it was for a time share. You had to sit through 120 mins presentation in order to get the show tickets, have a credit card and be a couple.  In fairness they did refund my money when i made a complained. The pool area small but there was always sunbeds, however it was so hot we tended to just sit in the pool. We walked to the strip and back every day...that way we could eat everything we wanted ! Staff are friendly and helpful, will order taxi's on request, provide clean towels or extra toilet rolls. Didn't use the bar as we tended to go up the strip to meet up with friends.

reviews.title: Great accomodations for a Family Getaway
reviews.text: My wife was adamant that we stay in a nice resort with no casino. So this was the spot. I used to come here many years ago when it was known as the Hawthorne Suites and it was awesome then and it was awesome this time around. The resort is conveniently located in the famous Vegas strip, behind the Tropicana Casino and next door to the Hooters Casino (literally). Parking is located surrounding the property and has easy access to the rooms as long as you have your key card. The property is very clean and well landscaped, with nice decorations. There are signs of work and improvements being made at the resort, which are always necessary as the years go, but there were no inconveniences because of the work. Lobby: The lobby is spacious and open, with many sofas to lounge around. At the rear of the large lobby is the bar and corner lounge area with a large screen TV playing sports. Bar: The bar is both inside and out of the lobby, towards the pool area. The only negative I experienced was the long wait for the bar service. Unfortunately there was only one person working it. Although alone every time I visited the Bar, the Bar lady provided excellent service and always with a smile. But she needs help, so Desert Rose Administration, help her out. Pool area: My wife and I had our 2 little ones with us (ages 4 and 2) and the pool was perfect for them. There were plenty of sunbathing chairs and umbrellas, along with lounging areas with more shades. The water on the pool was warm and the jacuzzi wasn't too hot to get in considering that the weather in Vegas was a scorching 105.Hotel Room: Our room was a 1-bedroom apartment-like room with a full kitchen (with everything needed from the kitchen). According to the Front Desk staff, our room was recently remodeled and it was evident. The mattresses on both the queen size bed and the sofa bed seemed new and firm. Our room was clean and roomy in both the bedroom and living room areas. The closets and drawers offered plenty of storage space. I had a first story room that was overlooking into the pool area so that was a plus. The bathroom was small, but we managed. We didn't eat there at all so I can't comment on that, but everything else was excellent. All in all, we really were impressed with the facilities and the entire experience at our stay there at The Desert Rose. We found our non-gaming spot.

reviews.title: Nice Stay
reviews.text: We were booked here for two weeks but left it empty for 8 days as we were on a road trip. Much better than expected we stayed in one of the refurbished one bedroom suites. A good size it had a decent size bedroom with a king bed, bathroom with bath and overhead shower and a really useful well fitted kitchen. The living area had a good size sofa bed and flat screen TV. There was refurbishment ongoing in the corridor next door during our stay but it didn't impact us save for some dust. The pool area is a good size and we always managed to get sun beds but if I had one criticism it would be that the area around the pool needs a good scrub down. Overall a good stay, would stay again 7/10

reviews.title: Love it! great place!
reviews.text: I really like this plac!  very close to the strip and you can save yourself 20 bucks  for parking and just walk to MGM studios because it's at the end of the block. we have stayed here more than once. We shopped on tripadvisor for a great deal and got itwe recommend that you get a first floor unit because the halls and the elevators are open air and very warm in Las Vegas and so the sooner you get to the room the better and ask for a handicap suite because they're much bigger! and they have a kitchen and separate bedrooms so you and your family can go to bed when you want. we love the pool with the  free cabanas and we love the bar and restaurant at the pool.we love the shows in Vegas and we love the famous people restaurants because the food is always better than good!

reviews.title: Nice family atmosphere
reviews.text: It was perfect for a family vacation with kids, with two bathrooms, there was enough room for everybody.  The kitchen was a little tight but we made it work.  The pool was nice and one night we cooked out using their barbecue. I would recommend it.  The only complaint was that the copier was not working in the office so we couldn't print out our boarding passes.

reviews.title: Average Time Share Property - Good Location
reviews.text: We stayed two nights at the Desert Rose.  We are Shell time vacation owners.We found the time share unit average at best.  One of the elevators was not working.So they stuck us in a room right by the road.  So with its good location by the Tropicana, of course, the road is noisy all night long.  The air conditioning unit reminded me of a jet engine taking off.  So multiple noise.  It was a first floor room.They also did not program the room keys right the first time; so we had to waste more time to go back to get the keys correct.And of course - the agent has no respect for Las Vegas time calling at 9:30 in the morning. They were pushing of course time share updates.  They called to say they had a present and I checked at the front desk - no gift. Obviously it was just a call to get us to give up Las Vegas time for high power sales.  For those who have not stayed at the better time share properties (where we usually stay), one might like it.  The toilet and shower area is dinky.  There is a sink area.  The king size bed might have been comfortable if it had not been for the noise factor. so those who are not given a street side room, probably will get a nice night's sleep.There is a living room area. Both the bedroom and living room have TVs. There is a small table area.  Internet connection is good.The kitchen is smaller size for condo units - but does have the usual refrigerator, microwave, stove, and so forth.   The dish ware was nice.There is a swimming pool area which is popular in the summer.It is nice to be able to park close to one's room - although it looks a bit tacky as one enters the hallway.Overall, this is a medicore Shell Resort.   The location for Las Vegas is good.If you stay here, just realize you are staying here due to location - as its just a very average time share.Note:  We are owners at Vino Bello - and realize that not all properties can be as nice at that one is.  But really - this resort needs some work.  (Note:  We had just stayed at a luxury time share Embarc in Palm Springs so it was obvious how average this place is)I rated it average due to its very good location which influenced me to not rate it lower.We did have good views of the Mandalay Bay and Luxor from the street side patio area.
