reviews.title: Week long stay
reviews.text: Just returned from staying in Vegas, excellent apartments just been renovated, clean and lovely pool, friendly staff and not far from strip five minute walk, lovely and quiet at night, kitchen with full cooking facilities, 1.5 miles from Vons supermarket

reviews.title: A little disappointed
reviews.text: Visited as a couple and expected a a peaceful calm property away from the hussle of the strip... (This is how it was sold to us). When we arrived this is pretty much what we got very calm peaceful place with a lovely pool... There was a fairly hard sell to get us to attend a time share meeting but after being quite firm we were left alone.... After a couple of days however the calm peaceful atmosphere changed.... There were a few youth sports teams that turned up and pretty much took over the pool 15-20 16 year old boys wrestling in the pool bumping into other guests shouting and swearing was not what I would call peaceful. There was little or no supervision from their coach or the other grownups looking after them it was a kind of free for all.... There was also running around the corridors at night constant banging. I would not stay here again.

reviews.title: Some issues
reviews.text: Stayed for 2 weeks with my wife and the first thing I would say is the accommodation is great, room, service, staff all fantastic. Maybel From housekeeping is a rockstar, my issues are with the hard sell of the time share they get you when you check in saying it's a welcome meeting and they will give you free show tickets, stay clear it's nothing but a sales pitch we where told an hour to an hour and a half tops after 3 hours I'd had enough and told them I was leaving, 3 hours of saying it's not for us is ridiculous. After a week of staying at the resort we had to change rooms as when we returned it had a strong smell of marijuana phoned front desk we where moved room immediately, next morning opened the door of our room same again reported it to security as it's supposed to be a non smoking hotel but after we reported it to security it stopped so that issue sorted quickly. on checking out the young girl on the front desk tried to charge us for our room after we had pre paid before we arrived but she was adamant that we had to pay again had to get a supervisor and she still wouldn't  believe her own colleague. So 5 minutes of her explaining to her that we had pre paid and showing her paperwork we took with us, she finally believed us. so like I say some issues but I would recommend this hotel just be aware of the time share thing they really push that so when you check in  say no no no

reviews.title: Could have been better
reviews.text: This could have been a better rating if it wasn't for a few problems we experiences during our stay. First off we arrived at the hotel at 2pm were informed check in was at 4pm and we could leave luggage with them, this is what we did and went to get some food, came back at 3.45 to be told room still wasn't ready and it would be ready at 4pm so bang on 4pm our room was ready. Got a nice refurbished room as we were staying for 2 weeks, room was lovely spacious with a huge comfy bed, so far so good. We were invited to a complementary breakfast at their sister hotel which were decided to go to. BE AWARE this was intact a timeshare meeting, we were told it was a welcome meeting and would last about an hour to an hour and a half, after 3 HOURS of constantly telling the guy we weren't interested and were leaving he got his boss, who asked if everyone was pleasant to us which they were apart from him himself, because we weren't buying a timeshare he didn't even make eye contact with us and was so rude it was unreal. Back to the hotel after being there 1 week we came home after being out for hours and our room was stinking of marijuana as we don't even smoke the smell was disgusting and giving us sore heads. I went to reception and they send maybel from housekeeping up to check it out. I understand they have legalised marijuana on 1st July this year but this is suppose to be a non smoking hotel. Maybel was brilliant so friendly and helpful and she got us a room move, was a bit of a pain packing and unpacking again but did so anyway. So next morning we were heading to the pool and when we opened our room door onto the corridor we were hit by the same horrible marijuana smell, my husband make security aware of this and that was the last we smelt it. The rooms are fully equipped with everything u need and the pool area is lovely. Upon check out we were informed by Karla who checked us in that our credit card would be charged the full amount of our stay. We prepaid our fully accommodation with our travel agent before we departed but trying to explain this just wasn't sinking in. She was adamant we hadn't paid and she would be charging our card. After being there about 10 mins with paperwork to prove we paid, someone else came over and said we HAD in fact paid in advance and we weren't to be charged just be careful of this we almost paid twice

reviews.title: Seven days in Las Vegas
reviews.text: My wife and I have just spent 7 days in Las Vegas staying at the Desert Rose Resort.We had one of the newly renovated one bedroom apartments which was very roomy and nicely decorated.The staff were very friendly on our arrival and made you feel very welcome.The resort is about a 10 to 15 minute walk from the main Las Vegas strip which made it an ideal place to stay, nice and quiet.The only draw back is there are no supermarkets close by to buy food if you don't have a vehicle and they need a booking desk in the resort so you can book shows at the casino's or excursions like the Grand Canyon.However I would certainly stay here again.

reviews.title: Room for a Family
reviews.text: What a great location and a suite with everything you need. We were easily able to walk into the city to visit casinos and shows, enjoy local cuisine and the spectacular lights of the Las Vegas strip. The suite had a huge separate bedroom, two part bathroom with separate vanity, although the toilet was located next to the bath. There were plenty of good quality towels. The kitchenette was well equipped with basics  to prepare your own breakfasts but no real cooking facilities other than a microwave. There was a coffee maker and good ground coffee. We had no room service. Free parking on site, well lit grounds and a beautiful pool and BBQ area.

reviews.title: Good resort
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days during July.  Because there were 4 of us we chose the 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom suite.  It is located near Hooters and is close to the Tropicana and not far from MGM.  Although our suite needed some TLC to include new furniture and carpet, it did provide us with all the amenities we really wanted -- full kitchen, kitchen table and enough room to have 4 adults be very comfortable.  AC was good and it certainly was necessary as the July heat was well into triple digits every day of our stay.  The staff were welcoming although computer issues slowed both check in and check out a little.  The elevator did not work in our building for the first 2 days but worked the last two days.  There were some ants in the second bathroom but not in the master bathroom.  Some trouble getting onto the wifi but eventually, with help, we were able to log on.  Overall our recommendation would be good for a place not in a casino hotel.

reviews.title: Home away from home
reviews.text: Best place to stay when I'm in Vegas, clean comfy and has all the ammenities as if I was home with a full kitchen, new bar added near pool area this year also. Pool area also has newer chairs and lounge beds, Walking distance to strip. Behind hooters and Tropicana

reviews.title: Great rooms
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed at this hotel Thursday and Friday before our grand canyon whitewater trip and the Friday when we got back.  The rooms were amazing.  I loved the way they were set up like apartments.  Plenty of room, comfortable beds, and amazing front desk service.  They even kept our extra luggage bag for us the week in between.  The location as at the end of the strip behind hooters, but it was easy to grab a taxi or Uber car to go where you wanted.  When I go back next time, I will definitely stay here.

reviews.title: Newly Renovated
reviews.text: This made my second time staying at the Desert Rose Resort.  The first time it was 2 years ago I was not that impressed it was clean but very dated.  It was in need of some serious updates.  I went back this year during the week of June 11 and to my surprised it was renovated  the rooms were very nice, the master bath had a 5 headed shower, all the furniture and appliances  were new.  The Staff gave A one customer service and was always willing to accommodate you in anyway they could.   A shout out to Edgar who took good care of us.  He went beyond the call of duty by checking in on us to ensure our needs were met.  Thank you Edgar. Desert Rose Resort is one block from MGM and across the street from Hooter's you can get reasonable delicious food from CoCo's  around the corner..  We had a great time in Las Vegas remember what goes on in Vegas stays in Vegas.

reviews.title: Relaxing and fun Vegas getaway!
reviews.text: We had an amazing weekend here. Everything was updated and new and beautiful! The pool area is pretty and it is very quiet and relaxing. We had an awesome time and would definitely stay there again. The kitchen had all the necessities needed to make actual meals. There is also a grocery store about 5 minutes away, which really helped. The staff was also friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: First time in remodeled Room at Desert Rose
reviews.text: Room was in Bldg.2, New furnishings are all in a gray color.  Everything very clean and refreshed .    Being an old school Desert Rose Guest these past 10 years, I do miss the warm coral colors the resort used to have and the couch design with the lounger on the side.  The paint on outside of some of the bldg.s is a charcoal color now. It looks so different to me.  But things need to be updated and given a new look to stay in the game I suppose- I still like the old colors(earth tones) We were there in May and the pool was really crowded so get there early if you need shade.   Also we miss the cheaper $25.00 late check out,  Its $70.00 now for 2 hours later.  Our plane was scheduled to go at 6:00 PM so we were just stuck at the airport.  All in all we still like the desert rose- Its a low key dependable place. Home away from Home. Peaceful and tame with heavy security.   More of a family style place. *Not really for Vegas Party Scene*. There were a few wild ones there for the billboard awards- they did tone it down when they realized what kind of place Desert Rose is. (more family or couples place) Saw allot of security checking things out this trip and on regular patrols on the grounds. Made me feel safe!  The key cards are still a little buggy.  We got locked out of our room once and the pool area once.  If you go to the pool -make sure to take your I.D. as you will need it to get a new key if it does not work. the new bar and grill is awesome Try the Desert Rose cocktail and the Burgers are yummy too!

reviews.title: Great refurbishment done
reviews.text: Having spent 2 weeks at this resort three years ago I knew what was to come.  However I was delighted with the job done both in lobby and our room.  The old rooms were good  they are beautiful now !  Friendly staff - I knew what to expect when  going for car park.pass and the lady accepted that I wasn't interested in timeshare.  My one and only complaint was that in 104 degrees in bright sunshine the hotel decided one day to lock down the sun shades leaving no shade at all. I asked at reception and was told it was because of winds forecast.  Other than a light breeze there was no winds all say.  I wish there had been !   Desert Rose should take action when required  not when only possible.  No breakfast now but didn't use it last time.  Didn't use wind/cocktail evening either.  Thoroughly recommend this resort if you don't want  casino as soon as you enter  Will be back !

reviews.title: Nice place, bad room service
reviews.text: Very tranquil and comfortable place with a very equipped room.  however, the room service is from bad to non-existant.  We stayed a full week and received (as the contract says) one only visit by a room maid, however the maid's report left at the room was full of lies of what she has done and after reporting it, no action was taken.

reviews.title: Very adequate, but I like Grand Desert better
reviews.text: This place is perfectly ok.  Its clean and quiet, and for the price ($150 per night for a 2 br apartment) was a really good deal.  Most of the negatives are small details, but my biggest complaint is the bedrooms and bathrooms are small and feel cramped.  The master bath in particular had no counter space to put things, and not enough towel racks.  Given that they dont provide daily housekeeping  (which is fine with me) towels need to be hung to dry and reuse, and there isnt space to do that.  Added to that, one curtain in the main bedroom is just a smidge too small, so it gaps a bit.  First morning I rolled into a beam of blinding sun.  Using a book to push curtain to cover the gap was a workable solution, but bigger coverings would be a better.  During the day, the natural light was great. The a/c didnt carry well into the master br either.  So it was freezing in the living room just to be cool in the bedroom.  We have run into that with similar places before, so we kept the bedroom door open and got an extra blanket for the sleeper sofa.  The pool area was also just very ok.  There were lots of comfortable chairs, and some shade as well as fire pits for evenings, but pool itself was a little small especially by Vegas standards.  And yes the time share push here is the hardest sell we have received after staying at many Wyndham properties.  But my husband checked in and he likes to be nice and let the guy talk, so maybe its just him.  To be fair, I am comparing all of this to the Grand Desert, a sister property a few blocks away (where they actually do the time share presentation) where we stayed previously.  The Grand was bigger in every way...high rise, 2 huge pools, more rec room amenities, bigger rooms.  On this trip, the Grand was more expensive as well, though that varies.So, I suppose it is all in what you want. If you prefer smaller, simpler, quieter, then the Rose will be fine.  If you want a little more, go for the Grand.  Both are solid, clean and safe and we love having kitchens with full fridge and even a stove so we can feed kids simple meals and not waste money on restaurant food they won't eat.  Both properties are also very walkable to strip (Rose might be a little closer) and plenty of free parking at both places is great!

reviews.title: Getting Better!
reviews.text: They are under new management and going through renovations.  I was in an old room.  It was clean and comfortable and very big.  I saw one of the updated rooms and they look awesome!  This placed needed the renovations, I think they're headed in a good direction.

reviews.title: Clean, tidy and well situated
reviews.text: This resort was our first experience of USA. It is well located only being 15 - 20 minutes from the airport and a short 5 - 6 minute walk to the strip. It was good value and all areas were clean, tidy and well maintained, and the staff were friendly and efficient.

reviews.title: Great Property.
reviews.text: Firstly the best points... the location of the place, excellent. The rooms are massive compared to other properties on the strip, the one bedrooms would easily sleep 4. Great cable tv, huge fridge, microwave and other mod cons, everything you need for a self catering (if you want) apartment to save money. The staff - they couldn't do enough for you if you needed help with anything.The bad points, the hard sell at checkin for the welcome pack that is really a cover for time share. Do what I did and tell them you've been to the property before and you know the score and your not interested - they will leave you alone. The so called business center that comprised of a computer with a printer... I was at the property for 2 weeks and the printer didn't work for the entire duration, the second week the computer packed in and nothing was fixed for 7 days and then I left with it still not being fixed. But the staff will help you if you need anything printing off or booking.Would I stay here again - YES!!! Why? one big reason - your are left alone.. no stupid phone calls to your room, no one pestering you at the pool, no housekeepers every morning.Superb place that I would recommend but don't tell everyone as I want to keep the place a secret....Cheers

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Really good stay and great place for the cheap price paid. Hotel offers a Large apartment with great facilities. Modern and clean. Would certainly stay again. Shame about the time share hard sales talk though, that every guest is forced into when checking in.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: Vegas was our last stop on our USA trip in April, we were pleasantly surprised by our room, the kitchen had everything we needed, the bed was comfortable and the lounge area was a great addition. Apparently our room was not renovated, but it was still nice, the pool area has also been updated. The staff were also very helpful on check in/out. However it is off the strip and takes about 10 minutes to walk to Excalibur.

reviews.title: Sound option for a Family visit (!!?) to Vegas
reviews.text: It's safe to say that Vegas with a young family isn't this towns target market.....This Hotel however,  provided everything we needed.It's close to the strip, simple and tidy with no Vegas glitz ... but that was a welcome change.Currently going through renovations.Watch your shins on the corners of the beds! Solid option... but not if you are looking for a Vegas experience.

reviews.title: Excellent Location
reviews.text: The apartment was immaculate had full kitchen with oven,microwave, fridge, freezer, dishwasher and coffee maker.The apartment also had dinning area new sofa which went into a very comfortable double bed very thick mattress on sofa bed. Flat screen tv in front room and bedroom.  Lovely bedroom with large make up area and good bathroom nice thick carpets in bedroom and front room also nice balcony with table and chairs so if you have anyone who smokes this great. Pool was nice thick chusion on beds. Staff were very nice and 6 mins walk to Excaliba Hotel. Free internet and it was very quick had no trouble at anytime of day or night.

reviews.title: Great just got even better!
reviews.text: I've reviewed this venue previously and hadn't planned to write another one, however the ongoing renovations to the rooms are so impressive, I felt it justified another look.As always, we requested a quiet room on the top floor, as far away as possible from neighbouring 'Hooters', which can be rather boisterous sometimes. As the top floor is currently being renovated we were offered a room on the middle floor.All the furniture, fittings and fixtures are brand new, and have a lovely contemporary look. In the kitchen, there's a new refrigerator, oven, microwave and (completely new addition) dishwasher. The lounge space has a brand new sofa and armchair, new carpet etc. and is very comfortable indeed. There's some really nice art.We always thought Desert Rose was a fantastic bargain, and with renovations complete, the apartments have become even more attractive.On a negative note, I'm sorry that Wyndham's feel it necessary to try and talk you in to attending a time-share presentation (held the following morning) two minutes after you arrive at the venue. After a full day's driving that was never going to work, and, I suspect, irritates a lot of guests.

reviews.text: Is the best of the best vacation i have ever been in a hotl like this is the best hotel i have ever seen nice and amazing views here i like it so much me and my friends love it so much and the stuff here is so good and amazing they  are so friendly and they give us the best servises ever and the animation team special thanks for them they are so good and active we loved them so much specially bebo and anoo and rooney they are best of tge best and the rooms is so clean and have a very nice view Thank you desert rose

reviews.title: Nice Hotel
reviews.text: I recently stayed here for a mini vacation, and the staff was pretty nice. We arrived earlier than the guest who's name the room was under, and they held our luggage at the front until we were able to check in, which was very convenient. It does seem more of a family oriented hotel, as the restaurant,bar and pool all close at 11. So if you're a night owl, be prepared to walk a little bit to the Hooters restaurant up the street.There is also a little diner named Cocos nearby, which is very good as well. My only gripe is that there were ongoing renovations, and in our room you could see paint splatters in some areas and there was a random ice machine out in the courtyard of Building 1. So I had to find an ice machine at one of the other buildings. Other than that, it is nice if you are wanting a quiet little getaway.

reviews.title: Weekend for Two
reviews.text: Room is Tastefully decorated, clean as a whistle, and easily accessible to the MGM, New York, New York, and other casinos on the Strip. There is a steak house right next door, and thr resort is closest to the Hooters Hotel and casino.

reviews.title: great place to stay
reviews.text: stayed here with family, lovely and clean with good facilities, a short walk to the strip (you come out opposite new york new york) ask for a refurbished room as the old rooms are dated and dark. only issue was you have to walk through the bedroom to to get to the bathroom. the food from behind the bar is good and reasonably priced. would stay again.

reviews.title: Exactly what we needed
reviews.text: First off, let me say how AMAZING the front desk staff and manager truly are. We get there and have no reservation in the system, our time share never sent it. They spent an hour or so trying to fix it and went out of their way to ensure we were taken care of. They let us chill in the lobby and even offered to give us pool keys while they get it sorted out so that our children would be able to play. Everyone could take some notes from these fine citizens on customer service!The rooms are being remodeled and we got one that hasnt been remodeled. I would not have been able to tell, though, if it were not for the picture in the lobby of what the final product would look like. I think the rooms are spectacular how they currently are so i can only imagine how awesome they will be when they are finished. The kitchen area has everything you need to live a normal life. Pots, pans, utensils, baking sheets, mixing bowls, plates, cups, etc.The only minor complaint i have is there is no sound barrier, meaning you can hear people in the hallways and below you. When you call the front desk for something, you get speedy service.Parking is on site and thats a plus. It is close to the strip so you can walk to the casinos. Pool is clean and has a little area to bbq or just chill away from the pool.We are 100% satisfied with our stay and cannot wait to come back.

reviews.title: Girls Week
reviews.text: I can't say enough good things about our stay!!  The staff was amazing and always willing to help with anything -- special thanks to Dillion and Skylar for over the top professionalism and providing quality service and information.This hotel is located a short walk from MGM, NYNY, Excalibur and other hotels on the south end of the street -- We spent our days at the pool and our nights on the town -- the pool has grills available for guests.When we checked in we ordered our groceries (including Alcoholic Beverages) from Von's and had them delivered the next morning -- This worked wonderful!!  Bring a small cooler to hold snacks and beverages for a day at the pool - because their pool was wonderful (and there are fire pits for evening relaxation)

reviews.title: My holiday
reviews.text: It was so amazing holiday and I enjoyed so much here with the people and they are so kind and helpful and the place is so good the pool and the beach the lagoon every where is so beautiful and the entertainment is so so so good we enjoyed the shows so much a new ideas every day a new show and the active animation team I want to thank all of them about them efforts they are always smily and happy and special thanks for Rooney the super hero and about the bars and the rooms so good and clean I advice any on to come here in the holiday and I know that I will come again with all my family the next time

reviews.title: Soccer Tournament
reviews.text: This is the perfect place to stay in Vegas. Walking distance to the strip...Hop skip and a jump from the Airport. The best part is they are condo's so they are self contained. Full kitchens.  So it is like a home away from home

reviews.title: Lovely property close to strip
reviews.text: We got a nice ground floor room ...It was huge and spacious apartment with all amenities ...we just loved the place ...Only disappointing thing was we could hear people who were upstairs and one night I had to call at reception as they were making a lot of noise at night time ...We stayed for 5 nights and it was awesome except that the upper floor people were bit disturbing ....Best part was location of this property was close to strip and we used lyft discount codes to call cab and go to strip daily ....Las vegas is awesome ...

reviews.title: Average but cheap
reviews.text: We stayed in a 2 bedroom, 2 bathroom suite. It was roomy and nice to have the amenities of a suite including full kitchen. The price we paid was excellent compared to anything else in the area and we were happy to be off the strip. The biggest downfall was cleanliness. Edges of tile in bathroom and kitchen were filthy and baseboards had not been cleaned in a long time. We were told our room was one of those renovated but the couch was very saggy and old and the furniture was beat up. For the price, I would probably return but cleanliness could go a long way at this property. They want to seek a timeshare but I wouldn't have an interest in buying with Wyndham based on this stay.

reviews.title: Girls Week!
reviews.text: So we started out with getting here at 10 am, knowing that our check in was at 4 pm. We have had the most incredible time just waiting for a room!  Yes we waited but what a great wait staff and personal they have!  We asked for a room with sunshine and got it!  We asked for a room that was renovated and we got it!  We came in on a Monday which was a benefit for us because we received such  a wonderful gift just for talking to staff!  I can't say enough about how they treated us with great respect!!

reviews.title: Mixed reviews.. Liked the location but was generally a bit disappointed.
reviews.text: Firstly, location was good. It was a 5-10 min walk from the strip, located behind the MGM and Hooters. The hotel lobby and pool areas are nice and staff were friendly.Now, the disappointing bits.... The hotel rooms are in the process of being renovated, and if we went again I would definitely request a newly refurbished room. The rooms that are yet to be done are really starting to show their age, and in my opinion not the nicest of environments. The hotel is split into blocks, and the builders were working on the one we were staying in. We constantly had to walk through poorly lit corridors and negotiate building materials (plaster, wet paint, old room fittings...) that we're being left in the corridors.... Was a complete mess to be honest!My other criticism is the way in which we were sold cheap show tickets in return for us attending one of their time share events to find out more about what they offer. We were told this would be 90minutes of our time just to give us more info on their time share options, also a free breakfast. In fact, this was 3 hours of our time that we could not get away from, and was a high pressure sales pitch! We could not get the show tickets until after we had sat through everything they had to say, including a tour of their sister hotel. The hotel staff clearly need to be explaining to people what this actually is and how long it really takes. We were so annoyed and nearly missed something we had booked for that afternoon.To summarise, nice hotel if you can get in a new room and location good... But if you agree to cheap show tickets then expect to loose a whole morning for it!

reviews.title: Great Stay!
reviews.text: We four stayed for two nights first time as it was reasonably priced despite few negative comments. But we found that the comments were wrong as the staff were very Friendly extended Great Service to make our stay very Comfortable  & the property is Well Located  to access the strip quickly by walk. It is also Very calm, quiet & neat place. We strongly recommend this place  for anyone who would like to have a memorable stay. Our room has a well furnished kitchen with coffee maker, blender, etc., a Living room, king bed room with attached bath and a queen bed room with common bath and all have TV. It also has a sofa bed & dinning table. Free wifi, parking & elevator are also  available to have fun.

reviews.title: Getting better, but still needs Improvement
reviews.text: I have been a Shell owner for two years and have stayed in this particular property about four times because of the proximity to trade show venues which I work. The property is beautiful and nicely appointed but it does have a few glaring strikes against it.  The units have been undergoing  renovation and the ones that are finished are very attractive.  What was not updated, however, was the one item that was my biggest complaint about the older units.   The air conditioning unit sounds like a jet engine whenever it kicks on and, if I am watching TV, I can't hear what is going on and, even worse, if I'm trying to sleep, it wakes me up even when using ear plugs.  I try turning down the thermostat so that the air conditioning would not kick on during the night, but the unit got quite warm and stuffy.  This problem is not unit specific;  all the units I have stayed in are the same.  The biggest complaint I have about the new units is one of safety.   The bathtubs do not have any type of non-skid  surface, nor any shower mats or grab rails.   Getting into the shower is like stepping on a glass surface.  I was actually afraid to take a shower  because my feet slipped and there was nothing to grab. The tub  has a slight slope to it towards the drain which just makes it worse.  I complained to the front desk and they said that they had had other complaints but they were told that the problem with nonskid surface is that they mildew easily.  I told them that having a guest fall and injure themselves would be even more of a problem for them.  I wanted my concern put it in writing so I sent an email to the assistant front desk manager as well as the maintenance manager.   This was the second day of my stay and, to date, still have not received a response.  I am also a Worldmark owner and will likely be using those units during my 4 to 6 Las Vegas per year trips in the future.  There are units are not as attractive as Shell, but they do have safe bathrooms, easy check in, in unit laundry, and fireplaces.  They also seem to be more responsive to concerns than is Shell. The one positive thing I can say about checking into this resort is that it is a more seamless process than previous stays.  They seem to have done away with the guest having to initial and sign (many times) a check-in document.  Previously, I felt like I was an unwelcome transient rather than a valued timeshare owner.

reviews.title: The renovations are big improvement
reviews.text: I've stayed at this resort a few times, it is small and conveniently located which is why i like it.  For quite some time it was a bit run down and we avoided it.  Now that the renovations are almost completed, I am glad we went back.

reviews.title: Great value just off the strip
reviews.text: Great value stay.Room clean with sofa bed and full kitchen.Wifi was a little hit and missOnly few mins walk from the stripPool was great and plenty of loungersPlenty of parkingNO RESORT OR PARKING FEES........!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: Kitchen and balcony in Vegas
reviews.text: We love having a full kitchen and balcony. The carpet was very nasty. A non-stick pan and ice maker would have been nice. The toilet is squeezed in extremely close to the tub making it difficult to close the door. We had a view of a very poor apartment complex across the street and Mandalay beyond that. They were in the middle of remodeling so the rooms might be better now.

reviews.title: A big win in vegas
reviews.text: I can't leave vegas , and not comment on our stay at one of the most beautiful and relaxing timeshares we have stayed at. the timeshare was totally renovated , and lacked nothing. the staff were professional, and friendly . the pool and hot tub were wonderful.The timeshare is down the block from Tropicana , and hooters casino's. 10 minute walk to MGM

reviews.title: Remodeled Lobby Area, Nice Rooms
reviews.text: My family has stayed at this resort twice before our most recent visit.  Since the last time we visited (about 2 years ago), they've done a nice remodel on the front check in area.  They actually put in a bar at the back of the lobby area which had a basketball playoff game on 2 nights ago.  The rooms are nice and spacious for the price you pay compared to a hotel on the strip.  There's no resort fee, which automatically saves you about $40/night.  There is an average sized pool, a workout room, self laundry, billiards table, and a tour info booth which is staffed during the day.  I believe the hotel is part of Shell Vacations, so a lot of the residents are timeshare owners.  I love booking this through hotels.com though without having to pay the annual timeshare dues!  I would highly recommend this resort for a family that needs more than 2 Queen beds.  We usually get the one with 2 bedrooms and the sofa bed in the living room area.  They all have kitchens and 2 bathrooms also.  For maid service, you do have to request it if you're staying multiple days.  They won't clean your room unless asked to.

reviews.title: Very Nice and Great Location
reviews.text: Very comfortable, nice pool and hot tub....easy walk to Strip and monorail. Easy to get to from the airport. Good for families...has a well equipped kitchen for breakfast and small meals. No restaurant.

reviews.title: Great Stay for the Whole Family
reviews.text: We spent 3 nights here, it was a great stay.  The room had recently been remodeled and it was very nice.  Loved the multi-head shower.  Slept everyone just fine.  Resort is a 2 block walk to the MGM.  It's an easy walk, but walking by Hooters resort after dark brought out some interesting individuals.The only complaint was this is a time share resort, and they want you to attend their presentation.  But, they were REALLY good about us not wanting to take advantage of any of their "free" stuff.  Just know they will make an attempt.Non-gaming, very clean, great staff, great time.  Will be back.

reviews.title: Reasonably price family accomodations
reviews.text: We stayed here because we wanted to stay in a reasonably priced suite where we could put a toddler to bed in a separate room while we stayed up someplace other than the bathroom.  This worked out really well.  Our suite had two bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room, an eating area, and a kitchen.  They are currently renovating the property and I believe we were in one of the newly renovated suites.  I think they've done a nice job.  The location is off strip, behind Hooters.  We didn't have any issues in the area or feel unsafe while walking to the strip.  We had no cleaning service during the duration of our three night stay, but that caused no issues.

reviews.title: Great place to stay just off the strip! But... check your credit card after your stay!
reviews.text: My husband and I stayed here for a week in March. We had a newly renovated room, and it was great! Modern, clean, spacious. It was great to have a kitchen - we ordered some groceries and had them delivered to the hotel, for snacks and breakfast. It was great to have a separate living room and bedroom. The bathroom itself is very small, but still functional. The location is perfect, just one block off the strip - so, it's nice and quiet (compared to the strip), but still within walking distance - the best of both words. For those complaining that there's no breakfast - you can order breakfast from the bar. We had breakfast twice and it was delicious and reasonably priced.There are two things that I would caution people about:1) This hotel is associated with a timeshare. When you arrive, they will tell you to pick up your "welcome packet" at a separate desk across from the front reception area. When you pick up your packet, the staff there will try and push you to attend a timeshare presentation. The lady that spoke to us was very confusing, saying things like "Do you want to go see a show while you're here? I can give you free tickets and food". My husband, not realizing it was a timeshare ploy, said "Sure!", which is when she explained that all we'd have to do is have a nice, free breakfast with them the next morning. I found this weird, and said no... but she pushed and pushed ("How can you not want free money?!" and then looking at her coworker and saying "These people don't want free money!!") until we said yes. We then had to give a $20 deposit to her. However, when we got back to the room we decided we didn't want to waste our morning at a timeshare presentation, knowing that we are not going to buy anything. He went back to cancel, and get back the deposit, and they made up allllll sorts of stories that they no longer had the $20, come back tomorrow, etc. He had to go back to the desk FOUR times before they could refund his $20.2) We booked this hotel through priceline and paid in full several months in advance. When we got home from Las Vegas, I noticed that the hotel had charged my credit card again for the full amount upon check-out. When my husband called to correct the mistake, the staff were really rude to him. We did, however, get refunded the amount a few days later.

reviews.title: Great facilities excellent staff
reviews.text: It was a bit dated but is being refurbished but bed kitchen lounge area great, pool loungers all areas good,  staff were excellent the only thing that could b better is that towels changed more often.  It's behind hooters that do great chicken wings opposite mgm and New York New York

reviews.title: canceled flight due to wind storm
reviews.text: The Desert Rose saved the day for us.   Making a connecting flight during the March 30th windstorm did not work out very well.  After many departure changes the flight was canceled, we were given a number to call to get a discounted hotel rate, but were told all the rooms were taken due to the storm.  We called the Desert Rose because we always stay there on our Las Vegas vacations.  We called at 9:30 pm and spoke with Karen and she was very helpful.  Great suite in room 2305.  Newly remodeled and very nice.  Thank you Desert Rose!

reviews.title: good visit for the price
reviews.text: I read lots of TA reviews before we booked it.  Some good, some bad.  Our room was very clean, but a bit dated.  Furniture was old and worn. Bed was good. Kitchen was good. Room 217 I think? No view, but for the price we loved it and would stay again.  Very quiet. Pool looked great, but we didn't have any time unfortunately to make use of it. They do not clean the rooms daily but we asked for more towels and they brought them promptly.  The staff is very friendly and helpful with any questions we had.

reviews.title: Lost its appeal
reviews.text: We stayed here for 4 days in February this year were a bit disappointed as we had stopped 3 times previously and had enjoyed the hotel. I understand since our last visit it has new owners who are updating it, its needs it the room we had was exactly the same décor as our last visit 6 years previous, they no longer provide a breakfast and there is no where local to get one. We were there for nights and had no housekeeping at all, we were also charged after we left $2 on our credit card, god knows for what but for being that petty we will not stay there again and for that case any other Wyndham properties

reviews.title: Get away trip
reviews.text: We have a 1 bedroom suite. Nice  remodeled room. I had great check experience. We used the heated pool and spa. Pool towels are in your room. Close to the strip. We will come back. The room is cleaned once a week unless you need something else.

reviews.title: Great room, Great location, low key
reviews.text: The room was very nice, room service was only scheduled to come by once during our 5 day stay.  I would've liked daily room service.  I'm sure we could've called for fresh towels, but we didn't bother to ask.  If you're looking for the "Vegas experience" this is not the place.  However, the rates are great for what you get.  The room is way better than being at one of the nearby hotels and you are easily within walking distance to the strip.  It's right there.  The pool area is nice and peaceful and they have 4 grills that you can cook on.  I was very happy staying here as opposed to the Tropicana where my conference was at.  I would just walk back and forth between the two.  I highly recommend this place, the check in experience was pleasant and the rooms are great.  It has more of an extended stay feel, which I like.  You can't go wrong staying here.

reviews.title: Clean and convenient
reviews.text: Just came back from a weeks stay in bulding one. The unit was recently refurbished. Quite clean. Kitchen well supplied, just add food, nice to make breakfast. Pool was quite nice and you can usually find a good lounger to use. Location is pretty good, 10 min walk to MGM Grand. Only problem is proximity to Airport helicopter operations area, and you're right on their approach path, can be quite noisy at times. Would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Very good stay
reviews.text: I booked this hotel on short notice, trying to escape from the horrible Excalibur hotel. This hotel turned out so much better, clean and non-smelly. The location is very close to the strip. I walked to the MGM hotel several times. From there you are on the strip or can take the monorail. The one bedroom unit I had had a fully stocked kitchen and bathroom with toiletries and lots of towels. The soundproofing wasn't the greatest, but did not bother me at all. Quiet place. I would definitely consider this hotel again.

reviews.title: Janis and Julie's adventures in Vegas
reviews.text: Excellent accommodation, excellent customer service, nice and quiet, minutes from the strip, absolutely no complaints.Neil was so helpful a d nice and funny.Only one downside was that we couldn't hook on to the wifi, but we were on holiday and not that bothered. Would we go and stay there again??? Yes, definitely. XxBy Julie, from Kendal, Cumbria

reviews.title: Absolutely Perfect!! Very Satisfied.
reviews.text: 5 minute safe walk to the strip. Friendly staff. Clean, comfortable, quite rooms. Easy check in + check out. No resort fee. Beautiful comfortable pool area that makes you feel like your in Mexico. You can drink your own drinks(no glass) or purchase from bar that's half inside half outside. Very close to airport but that's easy to forget because it's not noisy! There were 6 of us in a two bedroom - it had a pullout in the sectional. We were comfortable; and the kitchen had everything from a bottle opener to a blender. Would definitely stay here again and tell everyone else to aswell!

reviews.title: Great Place just out of the madness
reviews.text: Arrived on the TC Manchester flight which got us to the hotel for 2.15 ish.Room would not be ready till 4 so chilled out and had a few beers while room was readied at the bar in reception. Got collared by the offer of a free breakfast, Dinner and show to sit through a timeshare presentation at the partner Wyndham desert resort. All I can say is its a very hard sell and took 4 hours and not the advertised 1.5 hours. Really pushy salespeople.Room was ready and we found it to be pleasant with all mod cons for our short stay, apart from a Kettle but had a percolator.T not so popular in the states.Was a great location. Decent enough breakfast down the road at COCO's as well.Really enjoyed our stay at the desert rose.

reviews.title: Enjoyed the stay
reviews.text: The hotel room was clean, no resort fee. It's within walking distance to the strip. Our room had a kitchen and all the necessities (pots, plates, etc). Had a good view of the Luxor light. Price was reasonable, friendly staff. Would definitely stay again and highly recommended.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Having stayed here last year we come back in February of this year. We stayed this time in a 2 bedroom apartment and found it to a very high standard. We also found the rest of the resort to a high standard after all the renovation it has undergone and have decided to stay again in September.

reviews.title: Excellent service
reviews.text: We loved this resort.  The staff was great!  A shout out to Skylar for going the extra mile and thanks to the gentleman who gave the kids a treat.The location is convenient to the airport and Vegas strip, but is far enough away from noise and traffic to provide a relaxing atmosphere.   The pool and spa are well maintained with a small indoor outdoor bar,cafe area.Worth every penny!!

reviews.title: Better Than Ever
reviews.text: I wrote a review back in 2015 blasting the Desert Rose for the filthy rooms and lack of maintenance.  As I am a timeshare owner with the company that owns Desert Rose I gave it another shot and am quite impressed with the changes.  The lobby has had a massive update and it is no longer embarrassing to have guests join you for a drink at the newly added bar!  That's right, there is a bar in the lobby now. It is tastefully done and can be entered from the lobby or the pool.  The room updates are very nice.  They changed out the carpets, furniture, draperies, and counter tops.  The paint has been refreshed and although the appliances are the same the kitchen is fine.  The room was clean. The whole resort has a much happier feeling. It felt like the staff takes pride in working their now (in 2015 they were not the most happy people).  I will be back to enjoy this newly renovated resort.

reviews.title: Girl's weekend
reviews.text: I am an owner and took the 5 of us to a 2 bedroom condo.  We were able to get early check in(2 pm)  which let us get ready for a concert. The room we gave us was recently updated, smelt fresh and beds were comfortable.  There were hairballs in shower and chips strewn behind drapes that were missed by housekeeping.  Kitchen was well appointed  My worst point is that after refusing a presentation by sales staff, they called the room at 0750 in the morning!  In Vegas!

reviews.title: Ja'Nay and David
reviews.text: Stayed at Desert Rose with some friends to celebrate my 30th birthday in Vegas. We stayed in a 2 bedroom which was spacious enough for the 4 of us. I cannot even nitpick at the little things because of Ja'Nay and David. These two made my entire stay more than perfect. Once they heard I was celebrating a milestone they went above and beyond to ensure it was one I would never forget. Both Ja'Nay and David made sure each time I saw them that I was having a spectacular time and took genuine interest in my getaway. David even sent a bottle of wine to my room and sent us a round of drinks while sitting at the pool. The two of them made my Birthday getaway a memorable one. I will definitely recommend this property and be back myself. Thank you David and Ja'Nay!!!

reviews.title: superbowl weekend
reviews.text: very quiet and has all the basic necessities.  More of a timeshare apartment complex than a resort. But great location, less than a mile from the strip. HEATED POOL AND jacuzzi. Nice fitness center.  Nice get-away spot if you don't want to stay on the strip

reviews.title: Quiet & Clean
reviews.text: Quiet, clean, and comfortable.  Front desk staff were very accommodating, we had an older room and they found us a remodeled room, thank you Michelle for your understanding.  Pool was open and heated in February which you don't find at the big hotels at this time of year.  Love the addition of the fire pits!  They had different activities in the evening and alerted us via phone, we wish we had known about these sooner so we could adjust our day around them, they sounded fun.  We would definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Remodeled rooms are clean and modern
reviews.text: Second time staying at this property and was still satisfied, although my recent experience was worse than my first. I had stayed here a week with my family and the only hiccup was the housekeeping department never cleaned our room. They were scheduled to clean our studio on Wednesday but they never showed. We had to call in to get extra towels delivered to us and had to deal with a increasingly dirty bathroom. Other than that this property is in an excellent location and within a 5 minutes walking distance to MGM Grand and Tropicana. Nice facilities with a decent exercise/workout room and a clean pool area. Several seating areas are located through the courtyards as well.

reviews.title: Excellent Customer Service!
reviews.text: A group of us took a Vegas trip and loved everything about our stay at Desert Rose. Upon arrival David, the bellman, went above and beyond to make us feel welcome! Throughout the whole trip he was truly amazing and made us feel like family. Thanks David!

reviews.title: vacation
reviews.text: Very nice hotel to stay with family or friends. Spacious rooms with kitchen, living room. Quiet place. Within budget. Housekeeping was ok. Close to main locations to the city. Not a bad place to stay if you are a big group and is affordable.

reviews.title: Very pleasant stay, Very clean, well equipped, Great staff
reviews.text: Staff were able to allow us in for an early check in. Fantastic after a long trip. We were greeted personally every time we went in and out. When a party member became ill, they offered to contact medical support, gave us extra blankets and genuinely showed concern. The unit was very clean, well equipped and well supplied to meet our needs.

reviews.title: Good location
reviews.text: Good location to be near but not on the strip. A bit of heavy sell on timeshare on arrival but not a huge issue. Room was very well equipped and nice. Overall the price was good, location very good and services all OK. Nice small bar area and free wine a couple of evenings a week.

reviews.title: Near the MGM/Strip - free parking
reviews.text: We are time-share owners so we were excited about checking this place out.  Staff was friendly and even allowed for an early check-in.  They have a free wine-cheese reception every Tuesday and Thursday afternoon.  The pool is beautiful as is the hot tub and all the grounds surrounding it.  That was the positive part.  The negatives were the room location was right next to the gate and elevator and were extremely noisy -especially at night as our bedrooms were on that side.  Early mornings were loud noises of the construction going on  up on the next floor.  The resort was not very busy so you'd think that there would have been a better room located away from all this day/night noise.  Secondly the place wasn't very clean.  Floor corners all had dirt piles and my slippers were filthy from walking around the room,  The beds were, however, extremely comfortable.  Wifi was pretty good.  Warning:  Midweek cleanup is nothing more that towel replacement and a they remake your bed - No Cleaning whatsoever!

reviews.title: Some problems but overall good
reviews.text: Our 2nd time staying here. The 1st time they offered breakfast which was awesome! They no longer offer it but our 2 rooms were ready at arrival about 2ish. I was hoping for a newly remodeled room but didn't have any available. One of rooms had issues with the air conditioning. It took 3 maintenance guys and a whole day to resolve the issue. The 1st guy blamed us for it not working... really?? Finally the last maintenance guy was very nice and apologetic and took care of it. Overall I like the new paint, live entertainment, the location but they really need to bring back the breakfast!!

reviews.title: The Dream Escape room
reviews.text: My room was off to the side of the building, adjacent to the pool. So at night when I looked out my window, I got this beautiful blue glow of the pool and the hot tub. and the towering Tropicana Hotel/Casino, Luxor and Mandalaye Bay Casino. The weather was unexpectedly warm, and surprisingly people were in the pool. That glow of the blue lights kept trying to lure me in, but I stood strong, that and besides not having swim wear.  LOL  Security on the property 24/7 walking around !! Felt very safe. Especially for a single woman like myself coming in all hours of the night, can't get my time together with the time difference. Wine and Cheese nights in the lobby. "smile" Not located on the strip, "where it's to noisy"  and not to high up in the clouds " to get dizzy from heights",  it's just right

reviews.title: Decent
reviews.text: The price was great.  The staff was friendly.  Location is very good, close to the strip.  $5 Uber ride to major casinos.  The rooms are a little bit shabby.  Pool was nice.  Some of the furniture was old and worn.  If they did a slight update, it would be 5 stars imho.

reviews.title: Great place for longer stays
reviews.text: We booked a week at the Desert Rose Resort. Check-in was a breeze and once you got past the Wyndham folks trying to sign you up for a timeshare presentation, we were off to find a spacious 2 BR, 2 BR apartment. The beds were comfortable and the bathrooms big enough. The full kitchen was fully stocked for stovetop cooking and eating at the table size for four was nice. Dishwasher was in good shape and due the length of our stay, housekeeping came in once to tidy up. The location is a short walk to the strip, tucked away just behind the MGM Grand and Hooters. While we were there, many of the apartments were getting renovated. New appliances and rugs were visibly being installed and the old ones being removed. Glad to see as the rugs in our apartment could also use a replacement. With that said, we would definitely book there again if we had an extended stay.Dave and April

reviews.title: Nor what I'm accustom too
reviews.text: I rated this property a three but it could be rated a 2 or 4.  The location is good and I really liked the courtyard.  We used the grill area for a family dinner.  We also sat around the fire at night and used the hot tub and pool.  The staff was also pretty friendly and helpful.  The rooms are what keeps this property from becoming a 4.  They are in the process of renovating the rooms and hopefully this will help.  However, when we first checked in we got a new room and we asked for a different room by the end of the first night.  There was a bad order in the room that was unbearable.  They where helpful in reassigning us a new room but this room had not been renovated yet. We actually enjoyed the room and furniture better in the old room. The TV had a bad signal though and that was irritating.  So hopefully they become a 4 not a 2.

reviews.title: Great for the money
reviews.text: Stayed here for a conference at Mandalay Bay.  This hotel sits just off the strip.  Quiet area and safe.  Did not hear any airplanes or noise within hotel room although close to airport. 5 minute walk to Mandalay Bay or MGM in the other direction. Residence Inn like room with 2 separate rooms, kitchen, table and TV area.  Comfortable beds. Clean. Older but not rundown.  They were doing some outside pool area renovations at the time we were there.  Nice common area, all gated/enclosed. Nice staff and helpful. Free parking. Great Deal overall. Would most definitely stay there again.

reviews.title: Friendly propery
reviews.text: They are renovating, and our room was not yet renovated. Nice ammenities in the room, but not much on the property-no eateries, no breakfast, etc. Walk a block or two to the tropicana for food or take an UBER somewhere else. Great "happy hour" in the lobby on certain nights, which was a ton of fun with a lovely singer and free flowing (cheap)wine. Heated pool and great hot tub. Location was easily accessible to walking to the strip(MGM/NYNY end) or grab and UBER for $6 to just about anywhere on the strip. Overall, we had a lot of fun there in a nice room. *had an odd extra charge(over$100) to our card when we checked out that we are still disputing. Hopefully will be resolved asap*

reviews.title: Good Location, Lousy rooms
reviews.text: This place is undergoing renovations. so maybe the new rooms will be better, but when my daughter (18) and I checked in we obviously got a room in the older section of the bldg.  The room was very shabby, couch was threadbare is spots and stained, furniture was chipped and scratched, decor was outdated, bed was lumpy and uncomfortable.As if that wasn't enough, the heating/cooling system was so noisy that when I called the front desk to complain they said "you mean the sound in the background?" It was so loud they could even hear it over the phone!! They upgraded us from a one bedroom to a two bedroom, which was nice, but the new room was just as shabby as the first.  The only reason it didn't seem so noisy was that the vent was in the hallway instead of the living room, so the sound went down the hall instead of into the main room.The only saving grace was the staff. They went above and beyond to do whatever they could to make us comfortable, and they didn't have much to work with, so I commend them for their efforts.There seemed to be some people staying in newer rooms in another part of the resort, and I suspect this was because my room was a timeshare trade.  Perhaps "paying" guests got better rooms.Don't stay here.  It's not worth it.  There are too many other places in Vegas better than this, probably for less money

reviews.title: Awful place
reviews.text: Ok, I usually don't complain about accomodations because really how much time do you spend in your room right? Well upon arriving the lobby wasn't welcoming at all, as there was construction going on behind big tarps, during the day it was very noisy starting at 9am with construction. We were in the second building which apparently all the construction was happening, all the stairwells were blocked off so the only access to outside was the elevator which looked pretty sketchy and dirty. Once in the room we noticed it was really dated with a 70's vibe, meaning the furniture looked tired. The carpet was dirty and there were crumbs all over the floor. The bed was okay, went to make coffee in the morning and the cup was dirty. It's about a 5 or 10 minute walk from the strip just behind Hooters so we would end up taking the bus to the centre of the strip. This is the only building with out laundry so we had to go to another building. Will never stay there again.

reviews.title: Excellent and spacious accomodation just off the strip
reviews.text: While this resort is off the strip you are literally across the roads from the MGM Grand.The rooms are spacious and well appointed.A couple of points to note.The  resort is undergoing work at the moment so there is a little bit of noise. There are no breakfast facilities at the moment but being Vegas there are countless options within the nearby area.This is a great facility and excellent value for money. Do not be put off by it not being on the strip.

reviews.title: Good off-the-strip location
reviews.text: Very pleased with the one-bedroom apartment unit. Kitchen was fully-equipped and the place appeared to be quite clean. HOWEVER, the King bed in our room was atrociously uncomfortable. I understand they are renovating this property building by building so perhaps when the building housing our Unit 3311 is renovated, the bed will be replaced with something with support and substance. Despite it's proximity to the airport, we never heard planes while in our room. And please, please, please .. do yourself a favor and drive the half hour to Red Rock Canyon. Even if you don't hike, the 13 mile scenic drive will be WELL worth the effort.

reviews.title: Conveniently located with all you need
reviews.text: Hotel is conveniently located from Airport / Strip. Apartments/Rooms are clean and has got all you need... A well stocked kitchen will all utensils, Overall it contains all you need to stay for the time you are in the city.

reviews.title: Last minute getaway
reviews.text: This was our first visit to Vegas staying off the strip or Fremont street. We were offered a free weekend from a family member to stay at the Desert Rose Resort so we decided to go. It was a very nice updated one bedroom. It was awesome to have a kitchen and separate living area. The room and hotel were very nice and clean. We found the staff to be very nice! The only drawback from staying here is that it's behind the strip so it's a couple blocks to get to the strip. It's a quick walk and you can easily access the tram from the MGM across the street. Which would be fine for us except it rained our entire trip. Overall, if looking for an affordable room with a kitchen rather than being on the strip this would be an okay choice. My preference is to stay on the strip close to restaurants and shops.

reviews.title: Ok and nice
reviews.text: First, I want to let people know this resort doesn't have a casino, so if you're ok with that, keep reading. The resort is still under construction, I think it used to be apartments, but not sure. The remodeling didn't mess up my trip, but I can say that it'd be nice if they could fix the thin walls. Yes, you can hear the people walking above yore head unless you're lucky to be in the 3rd floor. But then the people below you can hear you. The lobby and staff are nice, no issues there. The other issue I had was the cleanliness of the room. I found a lot(!) of loose strands of hair all over the room I stayed in (other members of my family had another room). I felt like they don't vacuum or sweep the place. The location was fine, next to Hooters and walking distance to Coco's restaurant. Not difficult to get to MGM either (street access), the bridge from Tropicana to MGM was under construction. Not too far off the strip.

reviews.title: Clean and spacious-average
reviews.text: Being that we stayed in several condos vs hotels on this trip, I feel I had a few comparables. This is fine, but loud would be the biggest complaint. It's located just behind the strip, but unlike the Vegas hotels, not well insulated. Its on a busy road, one that has traffic all day and night. I actually thought my husband must have opened the window it was so loud in the bedroom, but he hadn't. Other than that, the place seems fairly well equipped with everything you need and it was clean.They try and sell you on a time share option with a discount for attending. After trying the Vegas Condo vs Hotel choices, we will probably just stick with hotels in the future. The bonus was we were travelling with friends, so staying in a 2 bedroom was a nice option.

reviews.title: Beautiful
reviews.text: I will of course stay here again if I cannot get into the Cosmopolitan as I am team Marriott. The privacy, the service, the LOCATION-- everything was perfect. Could not have asked for a better weekend!

reviews.title: Wedding day
reviews.text: We went to this apartments to stay for 2 weeks in October 2nd 2014  I was getting married it was just perfect if u like no hassle An free to do what u want then this place is the place to be for a long stay staff are very helpful nothing is to much the hole room livening room bathroom balcony every think is just perfect needs up dating but not to bad this is the place I would stay if I go back we was married 8/10/14 and what a amazing day 👌🏻

reviews.title: Spacious and clean
reviews.text: I was in a renovated room, it was done very well.The room include a complete kitchen with a blender, coffee maker, oven, refrigerator, microwave and everything was new. This is basically a 1 bedroom apartment.The hotel is ~1/4mile from the monorail.Pros: kitchen, comfortable bed, fast internet, two rooms suite, close to the airport without hearing the planes. Cons: no desk, they did not offer breakfast when I was there. Rooms near main walk ways can be noisy.Good hotel if you don't want to be right on the strip.

reviews.title: Good hotel, clean, full kitchen, has had recent renovations and no smoky casino!
reviews.text: Stayed twice now, will stay again.  Clean rooms, all suites with fridge and stove.  Not a luxury place but it is clean and has had renovations.  Best value in Vegas in my opinion.  Only negative was one very rude woman at the desk.  All other staff was very friendly.  The lobby has very comfortable couches to sit in while waiting for a flight.  Pool is small but nice.  Nice that the hotel does not have a casino.

reviews.title: Christmas Time Of Year In Las Vegas
reviews.text: The Desert Rose Resort was under renovation.  I was not told that before I arrived.  However the renovation did not interfere we our stay.  Our room was very good, but had not been renovated yet.  Our room was comfortable and my stay was pleasant.  Our one-bedroom suite was spacious with a fully-equipped kitchen.  During our four day stay we attended a wine reception that we were told that was held weekly on Thursdays which we did enjoy.  We were tempted to use the hot tub.  We did not use the Fitness Center, pool or Concierge Services, but we did take advantage of the Convenience Store, watched tv in the pool table area and used the Laundry Facilities. Desert Rose Resort is offered by Shell Vacations Club (SVC), Wyndham Vacation Ownership as one of their properties where members may choose to stay.  This was the first property that we have stayed at since we have become members of the SVC Discovery program.  The Desert Rose Resort can also be booked to nonmembers of this program.  My excitement of being a new member to the SVC Discovery program was part of our reason for why we decided to stay at the Desert Rose Resort, but the excellent location of being close to the MGM Grand Las Vegas and other amazing casinos on The Strip was a huge factor. We enjoyed our stay at the Desert Rose Resort and would enjoy the opportunity to stay here again in the future!

reviews.title: Not at all accommodating
reviews.text: This hotel was great for a family -- we had two bedrooms, living room, and a kitchen (not well stocked -- not one sauce pan to boil water for pasta).  Another benefit is that it was reasonably priced and near the strip.  The rooms are somewhat dated, but the kitchen had new counters.  The reason I rated this property poorly is that they were not accommodating.  We arrived early (10 am) and hoped for an early check-in.  They had rooms available -- we were allowed to check in early for $35.  Now if a room isn't ready and they hustle to get one ready I would expect to pay extra, but if a room is ready and sitting empty I think it would be good customer relations to not charge the guest extra.  We had several experiences like this with them -- things that would not have put them out at all and been great customer service had they elected to do them.  There are lots of hotels in Vegas -- I'll look elsewhere on our next trip.

reviews.title: Not much sleep
reviews.text: This was an updated unit.  Looked nice--the beds are good quality.  Found out the toilet didn't work well at all.  Had to move at 1AM to another unit.  No apologies what so ever.Chairs scraping the floor and the rolling luggages from the floor above sound like freight trains.   There were 4 females and we didn't sleep well. (And we have our earplugs....)  If you stay on the top floor and the plumbing works, you shoudn't have any issues.  Ask for 3rd floor!

reviews.title: Quiet and convenient
reviews.text: We spent two nights at Desert Rose Resort in Las Vegas. Overall, this hotel is great at its price. The rooms in each suite were clean and large. There was even a small balcony. We got two rooms facing the interior of our unit, where there is a small garden.The location was great. It is not too far away from the strip, but far enough to keep it quiet in the Las Vegas night. There is a <5 min walk from the hotel to the strip. It was not a bad idea walking if you do not want to look for parking spaces on the strip.The only two things I am not happy with the hotel is the air-conditioning and the power outlets. The air-conditioner was installed in the living room. As a result, it became much colder in the bedroom than in the living room once the door was shut at night. In addition, only on one side of the bed, there was a power outlet behind the cabinet. It was very inconvenient for charging smartphones overnight.

reviews.title: Still great place to stay, but Wyndham is pushy
reviews.text: We still love staying here. They are going through more renovations and there is a TV screen in the lobby showing what the rooms will eventually look like. What's interesting is that over the years I've only seen the lobby get renovated. Three times! The decor in the rooms hasn't changed. Well, the headboard behind the bed looks different. Still, the convenience of a full kitchen with stove and refrigerator is  great. You can bring home leftovers (Vegas portions are huge) and save money on meals. They no longer have the free breakfast buffet. We picked up eggs, bread and other breakfast foods. That way our only food cost was dinner. Instead of renting a car, we used Uber or Lyft and they always arrived within minutes. Great location.However...we are owners through Shell Vacations, which has been purchased by Wyndham. Shell was much nicer about pitching their timeshare program and knew how to take no for an answer. Wyndham has very pushy and short tempered sales people and if you agree to a presentation (which they call an "update") be prepared to be treated poorly if you don't jump for joy at the opportunity to plunk down "only" $10,000 to upgrade your membership. When I explained that I was told by the concierge that the presentation would not be a sales pitch, they scoffed and said it's ALWAYS a sales pitch and I should know better. Our sales woman then went into the room behind us and loudly berated the poor concierge for telling us that. Not even professional enough to shut the door or do it more discreetly. Then came back and still acted shocked that we wouldn't commit. Really? This is how you treat your owners? Are you that desperate to close a sale? We will gladly stay here again, but will never attend these so-called updates again. Avoid those at all costs.

reviews.title: Great stay for Vegas area
reviews.text: We did not stay in the renovated area of Desert Rose.  This is a simple, no nonsense resort/suites.  The price was good and the location isn't bad at all.  It is off the strip, but only 5 min walk to the monorail station in the MGM Grand.  The staff is polite and responsive.  A great breakfast place, Cocos, is only 5 min walk away.

reviews.title: insulted from the start.
reviews.text: we are owners in this outfit and had the worst stay here yet. We went the weekend after Thanksgiving with a few friends. We had been bragging about how nice it is and close to the strip. Well we all rode our Harleys there because it was a nice weekend and a good ride for our wives to try their trikes on.  When we arrived and checked in all was good, until we went to get our parking passes. Yes we were all dressed In our leathers from riding so I guess that means we are stupid?? The man working the concierge desk looked up at us and said well I can see you are not here for the math convention? I said what does that mean and all he did was laugh. For this man to stand there and insult my wife myself and our guest and then laugh about it is not a good promotion for the business. Our friends had been talking about maybe checking it out but after this RUDE man insulted them it was a done deal!! I have been an owner in shell for many years and have never been treated like this in any resort we have gone to. Then he got offended when I turned around and walked off, telling my wife that has never happened to him before. Well maybe he should think about what he said and there would be doubt in mind why we did it. I am  proud veteran as is my brother that was with me so in a way it was best if we did walk away after being called stupid by this man. Just because we rode up on bikes dressed in leather like we have done here before is not reason to be insulted and called dumb right as you walk into a place....it will be very hard for me to ever recommend this place to any of my fellow veterans that ride due to the treatment we received this last trip.

reviews.title: Clean and spacious
reviews.text: We stayed there for 4 nights. The room was clean and spacious, with a living area and a kitchenette. Bed was comfortable, but bathroom was a bit small. There wasn't cleaning services throughout our stay but they supplied with sufficient towels so it was ok. Weather was cold so we didn't use the pool but it looks decent (but please note that it is a small pool). Location is about 10-15mins walk to the strip, most Uber drivers know the place. Would consider to stay again if I am in Vegas.

reviews.title: James' 50th Birthday
reviews.text: We had an awesome time at the Desert Rose! The staff was helpful and accomidatiting, they went above and beyond and provided some appreciated surprises!  James had a wonderful 50th Birthday and a place were we could celebrate with family.  It's not luxurious but every time we stay we feel like we are home.  Everything we need, two bed, two bath apartment with a balcony and beautiful views.My only complaint is the timeshare sales at check-in and then the follow up call the next morning. This was our 4th time here and my favorite in Vegas to get away from the crazy casinos (many in walking distance) and enjoy time with everyone!  No casino but a great place to get together with friends and family from Colorado and California! Central and comfy!!!Thank you for making my husband's birthday super special!!!

reviews.title: Great place to stay.
reviews.text: Our experience of this resort was that it was clean, friendly, very convenient for walking to the strip. It was nice to have a kitchen and living area. It ment that we didn't have to eat out every night, and could easily relax, away from the bustle of the Strip. I would stay here again, and wil tell my friends.

reviews.title: Girls Weekend
reviews.text: Location to Strip was convenient but resort needs major improvements.  Not up to my standards and should not be rated high level resort in RCI even though it is a Wyndham Resort.  Staff was friendly and our checkin was easy.

reviews.title: Not up to standards
reviews.text: We own 3 time shares with Shell Vacations Club. This our 1st and last visit to this property. It is located south of the MGM off Tropicana. The resort is an older property. The rooms are small, the furniture is ratty and the king mattress was rock hard. The kitchen was adequate (one pull out drawer was broken, as the roller supporting piece was damaged). The room decor was standard. The bathroom was very small and plain. We were in a 1 bedroom unit described as a suite. It is very small for suite classification. The time share sales staff were very aggressive with their marketing. As usual with Shell a Shell property, after check in we were directed to the concierge for our parking pass. We declined as we utilized Uber/Lyft. The room phone 2x a day and messages were left for so called time share up dates. The resort staff were friendly. A plain resort, no frills with close proximity to the strip.

reviews.title: Comfortable
reviews.text: We were there for the National Finals Rodeo.  My father is an owner and we have stayed many times.  We love the proximity to The Thomas Mack Arena and the ability to walk to many of the casinos.  The resort is comfortable.  I love the beds in this resort.  I sleep very well and the pillows are great!  The one negative for me is the bathrooms.  There is a basin sink and a small glass shelf over the toilet.  There is no room for your personal and beauty items.  I have to place a box with my stuff on the closed toilet seat.  The staff is friendly and accommodating.  A great place to stay.

reviews.title: Solid choice for those who are looking for a suite
reviews.text: Desert Rose is a solid choice for the travelers who prefer to stay in a suite: these have fully-functional kitchen (microwave, stove, fridge, dishwasher). There are BBQs available outside near the pools area. Location is great: it is located on a quite street, but just a few minutes walking distance from the insanity of Strip.Rooms right now are renovated, so from one hand they are a bit dated, from another you can get some awesome special deals.

reviews.title: Quiet Location
reviews.text: This place is a time share resort and next to Hooters, but a distance from the strip. It's always an Uber ride to the strip. The place is dated and needs some improvement with furniture, carpeting, pop corn ceiling, etc. It is quiet and the staff very courteous and responsive to our needs. If improvements are made to the rooms, then this could be a premier place to stay in Vegas.

reviews.title: Very Good Place to Stay
reviews.text: I like this place, it is close to the strip as well to the airport, but the planes noise is minimal. Staff is friendly and helpful. They left us visit and choose between two rooms. The room was a suite with king size bed and a complete kitchen with all kitchen tools. We have two flat tv and huge selection of channels. Cleanness was good either in the bathroom as well in the kitchen. Keep in mind that it is a resort so no one come to clean and change your sheet, but if you need something you can ask to the desk 24 hours. Either there is not breakfast included, in the business room (free use of computers and printers) you can drink coffee and tea, as well lemonade, for free. I don't need to suggest it to my friends (they suggest it to me)

reviews.title: Such a disappointment
reviews.text: We have stayed here before and it was ok but never again.  The lobby has been remodeled but the room was terrible.  Not only just very trashed but dirty.  When I complained because I had to wipe the kitchen counter as it was so sticky, I was told that I would have to pay a fee to move because I had touched something.  The dining table had a huge scar where someone had put a hot pan on it.  The furniture was such that not even Goodwill would want it.  The bathroom door would not even close as it got hung up on the molding.  There is no where in the bathrooms to put anything.
