Just did not feel safe using the laundry room and it was not the cleanest.   Kids were running loose in the halls banging on the doors.  Security did respond immediately and that did stop.  This is a timeshare but rented to anyone that comes.  When I asked about that I was told that Wyndham would go bankrupt if the resort was not rented to everyone - REALLY.  Tells one never to buy a Shell Vacation Club ownership and to dump it if you have one. It is a great location and that is why we had decided to come back.  We had a 3 night reservation and left after one night. Such a let down.  Had friend with us and were so embarrassed that we had chosen this resort to stay.

reviews.title: Good family vacation
reviews.text: It's located very close to the Las Vegas strip. Staff is very friendly and help us to find daycare for my 8 year old daughter. The room, pool area and hotel in general were clean.All employees we encountered were friendly and helpful.

reviews.title: The calm place in Las Vegas.
reviews.text: Desert Rose in Las Vegas was a great place for our family to stay. It's located very close to the Las Vegas strip (5 mins walk). However the area was also surprisenly quiet, even with airport and casinos near by. They had a pool and a fitness center located right in the middle of the complex. Our one bedroom suite with kitchen was awesome. Conditioner worked great, which was a good thing when its 40`C outside. As a whole our stay was good. Recomended especially for families with kids looking for a nice, calm place in Las Vegas.The hotel staff however could be more welcoming and kind, some people didnt bother to be more patient and caring towards us as not native english speaking tourists. Also the elevator was broken when we arrived, and we had difficulties trying to find the stairs; other people that stayed in the hotel were looking for stairs with us but nobody could find them until one of the staff members showed us the way. They really need to put signs on walls

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: Close to the strip. Nice clean rooms. Spacious. Heated pool, complimentary coffee and lemonade in lounge and in rooms. Pool table and tv for the kids in the lounge. Rooms have everything you need so it made our visit nice. Employees were very nice too. This is our second time staying here and we will definitely stay again!

reviews.title: Renovation Can Not Come Too Soon !
reviews.text: Recently my husband and I stayed at the Desert Rose Resort for four nights. We chose the hotel based on location, size of the unit (two bedrooms), and reviews on Tripadvisor. On the plus side, the location was very close to the strip (south end). The rooms were a good size and the kitchen was well stocked. We also found the beds very comfortable. The staff was polite and friendly.The property is to undergo a major renovation. It can not come too soon. It is very tired looking. Popcorn ceilings, dated, dingy carpet, and cheap furnishing all made the place a bit depressing. I was really disappointed after a long, tiring day to discover that the water temperature in the shower never really got hot, even though I turned it up all the way. I was told by a staff member that it would be reported to maintenance, but I never got my hot shower. Upon checking into the resort, I was told there would be no maid service without paying an additional fee, but if I needed anything to just call the front desk. After two days, I called the front desk and requested a clean bath mat and towel. I also asked for the trash to be emptied. At this time I was told that this service could not be provided unless I stayed beyond four nights. Although the rooms were clean, there was a concern regarding the cleanliness of the master bedroom shower. The grout was dirty in about 1/3 of the shower. It really need a good scrubbing with bleach. Nothing is a bigger turn off, than a dirty shower!However, the my biggest complaint with the Desert Rose Resort was their attempt to get us to go to a time share meeting. We received a phone call offering us a complimentary breakfast and an American Express gift card as a way to get our return business after the renovation. Only later went I went down to the desk, did I discover that it was really an invitation to attend a time share sales meeting. I have nothing against these sale pitches, but please be upfront about it during the initial contact!I would consider giving this property another try after the renovation is complete. It is a nice refuge from the casinos and a good value for families or larger groups. I will just make it clear that I am not interested in the "free" breakfast.

reviews.title: Very good
reviews.text: We have been twice in this hotel, and we are very happy. Because they maintain the comfort of an apartment. The hotel is close to Blvd. La Vegas, close to gas station. And close to the famous hotels. We recommend it.

reviews.title: Nice property close to the strip
reviews.text: My second stay in Las Vegas, and this is closer to the strip than I stayed before, but not exactly on it.  As other reviews have said, it is nice not to have to fight the crowds and the smoke of a casino where you are staying. It is a little bit of a walk but you have a lot going on close by here, and the amenities are very good.If you don't rent a car, but want to do a lot in Las Vegas, this is a good place to stay.  Bus route (RTC) a few blocks away, MGM and Tropicana and New York all easy walks.  The Big Bus picks up at the Trop.  MGM is the largest of the hotels, and is like a city in itself, with every restaurant, food court, and amusement you could want.  Being female I had no interest in Hooters, which is next door and the concierge was trying to tell me is just a hotel and casino like all the rest.  Yeah, right.  Look at their ads. Not for me. I had a one bedroom suite, that was very nicely appointed, clean, and comfortable.  Full kitchen so I could make breakfast; as I was still on East Coast I could get a good early start on my day.  I was in building 2 with no view.  This didn't bother me, as I was glad I got a room before check in time. The concierge was a little obnoxious, as another review said, but that didn't really bother me.  They do what they do to get the presentations scheduled, and I got a show out of that.My only negative was when I called from the airport inquiring about check in and transportation.  I called before noon, and was told flatly there would be no room for me until 4 pm.  I was also told to rent a car or take a taxi to get to the resort.  Very rude snippy person.  I asked if I could drop my bags and come back.  You can inquire about that, she said. In other words, maybe or maybe not.  This was pretty disheartening, and completely unhelpful.  I looked around and found an airport shuttle (Bell Trans) that got me to the resort for about $8.  Why didn't that employee know that?  When I got to the resort, long before 4, I got a room right away and those employees were lovely to me.   At the end of my trip, when I couldn't get through to Bell Trans to book my shuttle back, another employee called for me and had no trouble getting through.  So most of them were very good, but they have one they need to retrain in hospitality.  Desert Rose has a bar, and a pool, use of laundry facilities and is very generous with clean towels and linen, soap and a nice welcome package.  Housekeeping comes in and freshens your room in the middle of the stay, something I don't see as often anymore in my timeshares.  I would definitely come again, although I do miss that Lazy River over at the Tahiti Village, and their free shuttle.  They all have their plusses and minuses.  Nice to have a choice, and this is certainly a nice stay too.

reviews.title: Great stay!
reviews.text: We booked at the Desert Rose based on the great reviews from other travelers, so I felt it was important to leave a review after my stay.  We were so pleased with the whole experience!  Check-in was easy and the staff was super friendly, even giving us our choice of rooms (and we were there for the Las Vegas Marathon so it was a very busy weekend).  Our room was great!  We were in building 1 and our balcony had a view of Excalibur and the Luxor, which were gorgeous lit up at night.  Yes the rooms are a little worn and older, but it was so clean and had plenty of amenities. We had a two bedroom, two bath and it was so roomy, homey, and comfortable.  The pool area was modern, clean, and very pretty, with super comfortable lounge chairs and a nice Jacuzzi (great for tired marathon muscles!).   The location was exactly what we wanted... just off the strip away from the noise and cigarette smoke (the casino hotels are SO SMOKEY!), but just across Tropicana Blvd. from MGM and the monorail stop, which we put to good use getting from one end of the strip to the other quickly and easily.  Not to mention, the hotel is less than a 5 minute drive from the airport, with no worries of getting stuck in strip traffic!  I would absolutely stay here again, and am in fact looking forward to it!

reviews.title: Wyndam Wannabe
reviews.text: The Desert Rose Resort is a Shell Vacations property (we have owned a Shell Vacations timeshare for about 15 years) which was purchased by Wyndam a few years ago.  Branding at the resort has begun, but as an owner, lending the Wyndam name to the Desert Rose is premature.  We stayed here in 2008 and it was acceptable at that time as a “value” property.  Wyndam has started a renovation of all the rooms, however, I doubt that it will be as nice as the Wyndam Grand Desert at the other end of the strip.The beds were comfortable and had about 6 fluffy pillows.  The towels were thick and bright white, however, we had no bathmat and had to use hand towels for a rug.  The small galley kitchen had been renovated and had granite countertops and beautiful cabinets - with “plain vanilla” appliances.  For example, most of the Shell properties have refrigerators with ice makers.There was a flat screen TV in the Living Room and both Bedrooms, however, no channel guide was with ANY of the televisions.  Why should an owner have to ask for something so simple?The location was perfect for the Rock n Roll Marathon/Half Marathon on November 13, 2016 – very close to the pre-party area and start corrals.  I called the resort directly to check on the pool area and hot tub prior to arrival and was told the pool area had been renovate and everything worked properly.  Unfortunately, after the Half Marathon the Hot Tub was broken and lukewarm.  There were about a dozen athletes on Sunday night that all needed the Hot Tub.  There could have been some “good will” if the staff would have arranged for us to go to the Wyndam Grand Desert timeshare property to use their hot tub, but the Desert Rose personnel do not have that type of service mindset.The “Concierge” / Sales people were obnoxious and VERY AGGRESSIVE.  I flat out told a male salesperson that we had just done a presentation a few days before, and he kept harassing us.  My husband was worn down and finally scheduled us for a presentation.  While getting ready for the half marathon, this jerk called to say I had to “come down and get our invitation.”  I told him we were busy; then told my husband I would not waste my time on another presentation.  End of Story?  No, on Tuesday morning at about 10:30 am we received a call from a female salesperson to try and talk us into the 10:45 am presentation!!!  Our TINY “master” bathroom had a view via the bedroom window that the curtains did not cover at the end – not a good thing.  We had no tub but the other bathroom for our guests had a tub/shower and was larger.  Wood furniture (coffee table, end tables, bed side tables, etc.) had stains, deep scratches and burn holes.  This is not the quality we expect from our timeshare company. Our balcony was VERY secure at night because we had a VERY BRIGHT LIGHT shining on it.  Only spent time on the dirty and worn balcony area during the day since we were lucky and had pretty good weather during our trip until the last day.The second bedroom had NO light switch and with no overhead light/fan.  There were two bedside lamps, and this was a rather dark room.  Most of our timeshare properties have overhead lights with fans.We had 2 blow dryers in the unit, but they were in the closet and we did not see them.  My husband called housekeeping and asked for 2 blow dryers, and the staff did not tell us to look in the closets, so we ended up with 4 hair dryers!  We needed a few more hangers and I called Housekeeping and was told to go to the front desk.  I went to the front desk because I could not get on the WIFi, and asked for hangers.  Front Desk personnel said they did not have hangers, and called Housekeeping to bring hangers to our unit.  My head was spinning from all the runaround.The resort has laundry rooms but the washers did not clean our clothes and somehow put holes and stains on shirts and shorts.  The old, small washing machines need to be updated.  The dryers are in poor condition and run hot.  We had two managers come up to our condo to see it and we received a late check out in “compensation”.  I’d rather have my points back in my timeshare account.  I was embarrassed to have our friends with us.Summary:   If you have a choice, wait until the renovations are complete before staying at the Desert Rose Resort.  Or just go to the Wyndam Grand Desert

reviews.title: Clean
reviews.text: Good location for walking the strip. Pool area clean and new furnishings. Clean grounds. Stayed before, hoping they'd update the furniture in our room, but still the same unfortunately. The air conditioner in the next room so loud in our bedroom slept on the couch, woukd pick another rm. than 4307. Thats why i gave it an average rating.

reviews.title: Great location with friendly staff
reviews.text: The location of this hotel is fantastic and the value for money is great; a two minute walk from the strip at a fraction of the prices you pay for the main hotels. I went with a large group and the staff were very friendly and accomodating. The room, pool area and hotel in general were clean and well looked after. I would definitely recommend this hotel to anyone who is visiting Las Vegas that only intends to sleep and swim at their hotel.

reviews.title: Good location and very clean property!
reviews.text: This resort/hotel is a Wyndham property and is located minutes from Hooters and the Tropicana off Tropicana Blvd.  Very clean and large rooms.  All employees we encountered were friendly and helpful. There was light remodeling going on but the rooms are very quiet and noise was not intrusive. Ice machine and laundry facility convenient!

reviews.title: Just Fine....needs some work to perk it up again
reviews.text: Second time here....not as good as the first time but that was 5 years ago so the place has had lots of wear and tear......they are starting to renovate as Wyndham seems to be taking over the property....so stay away from Building 1.....we were in Building 2 this time with a second floor 1 bed...looking at the pool....seemed nice to start but.....room had a funny smell...perhaps to cover up smoke....and you could not leave the bedroom window open as noise from the pool area as the outside gas/barbecue pits where there.....so be careful where you get a room.....tried to change but not luck as "full"....maybe not......room outdated and lots of wear....still we had a good time but came home with sore throats as left the AC on with the fan to keep the smell down...did tell the front desk manager about the smell issue...great parking if you have a car and really easy to get in and out of on Koval.....did our own breakfasts as full kitchen with all you could need....a real bonus.....pool was very nice with ungraded features....apparently "a girl at the front desk gave this tip"....phone the night before and tell where you want to be....like Building 3 or 4....top floor and maybe they will reserve one for you.....as we showed up at 4pm and had little to chose from....will I stay here again....sure....and will get one of the redone rooms for sure......

reviews.title: Pleasant stay!
reviews.text: My sister booked our room for her daughter's wedding.  Nice place to stay.  It's right behind Hooters so it's ver close to the strip.  Our room is clean.  The kitchen is an added bonus complete with everything you need to have a home cooked meal.  I would come back and stay here again.

reviews.title: Just what we were hoping for!
reviews.text: This hotel is nice if you want to avoid staying in the big casino hotels on the strip but want to still be right there next to it all. The MGM is across the street and New York, New York across from it. Our room was a nice size, like a suite, which felt like staying in a small apartment that was cozy with plenty of room. The small kitchen (with full size fridge and stove!) in the room was handy, the pool was nice and staff super friendly. This may be our go to place to stay in Vegas as long as prices stay reasonable. Overall very happy with the experience!.

reviews.title: Great resort with no draw backs
reviews.text: Great place to stay. JUST off the strip. Great access to the monorail. MGN just over the road. I can't think of the draw back to this resort. Maybe the lack of choice at the shop? but I mean come on its the last thing on your mind. Overall this was a great room which slept 6 easy.

reviews.title: Desert rose resort
reviews.text: This is close to the strip away from the busy streets.It has a nice pool area with bbqs.They are doing  renovations to the buildings.Walking across to the MGM then you are on the strip.The rooms are cleaned every other day.The communication with room service can be a challenge. Grocery store is not far from here (vons). I would stay here again.

reviews.title: Lovely property and great location
reviews.text: We have stayed here4 times now and it does not disappoint.  They have just started renovating and I must say I don't see anything wrong with the current digs, so I can't wait to come back and enjoy the renos!

reviews.title: Relaxing Vegas spot
reviews.text: Visited Vegas in 2014 and stayed next door st Hooters Casino while our friends stayed at the Desert Rose.  We were so impressed that when we went back to Vegas two years later we booked the Desert Rose.Got to the hotel around 9:30 am and they were able to immediately put us in a room - which was an awesome unexpected bonus!Had a one bedroom suite - plenty roomy for two people with a king bed, sectional sofa, and dining area and patio.  We didn't try to cook in the kitchen but appreciated the fridge to keep our drinks and restaurant leftovers cold. Pool area was nice with a hot tub and plenty of loungers.  Room was an excellent value and I wouldn't hesitate to go back.

reviews.title: Great value good location quality place
reviews.text: PositivesCleanSpaciousNot noisyGood staffPoor warmSecureGreat value 2 bedroom large roomTelevisions 3 of themComfortable living roomGood showers, bathLoads of amenitiesNegativeSlightly off strip but 10 min walk to MGM

reviews.title: Good value for money
reviews.text: We stayed at the Desert Rose for a week - 2 couples in a 2 bedroom suite with 2 bathrooms. The value for money is great when you compare it to the strip hotels however it is a different experience as it doesn't have a casino or loud pool parties etc etc. If you want the full on Vegas experience, this isn't it but it is really nice to get away from the craziness of Vegas and just relax. The pool is nice and relatively quiet and the rooms are clean and well stocked with all the amenities of home. The cleaning only happens once a week or so so be aware that you may need to pick up after yourself but there is a dishwasher and supplies plus you can ask for whatever you need from the front desk and they will provide it no problem. We were in Vegas for a convention at the MGM and it literally took us 14 minutes to walk from the Desert Rose to the Garden Arena or Convention Centre - probably less time than actually staying in the MGM Grand! Very easy and quick walk to the strip hotels (Excalibur, MGM, New York New York). Also, as it is a timeshare hotel, you can listen to a 1.5 hr presentation with free breakfast or lunch and they will give you tickets to a show or spending money!The only real negative for us was that there were room renovations going on at the time we were there and they blocked off routes from our building to the lobby so you had to walk outside through the parking lot to get to it or the pool. We had a few issues at checkin - but I think that was more due to a new team member that was still training as all the others seemed very nice, friendly and very competent!

reviews.title: Avoid Building 1 for now
reviews.text: This was not our favorite property in the time share system. We were in the building that is undergoing remodeling and it was noisy. Worse, our rooms were not clean. There were toenails on the carpet of our bedroom and there was no maid service all week. Although the two bedroom slept six, there weren't enough chairs to seat the five of us and the staff was unable to cough up another, which made family meals rather complicated.On the other hand, the staff was very pleasant, the pool and spa were nice and the place was within a quick walk of the Strip.

reviews.title: Nice resort
reviews.text: This was out second stay at the Desert Rose so we knew what to expect. The rooms /apartments have not yet been renovated but we heard some intermittent drilling when at the pool and saw signs saying the room renovations were starting. Our 1 bedroom apartment was fine, yes they are worn and tired but it was clean and had everything you could possibly need.The renovated pool area was nice and tidy, we spent a reasonable amount of time at the pool and it was never too busy or impossible to get a sun lounger. One night some drunk people had taken over the hot tub (about 13 of them) and their language was foul but we didn't report it. We felt that if it wasn't bothering the people there with children it wasn't worth complaining. Apart from this the pool area was relaxed and welcoming - it opens 8am - 11pm.The bar is shut on Wednesday and Thursday. It serves basic food and reasonable priced drinks, the bar man was friendly but I can't remember his name. On check in they were faffing about and asking us to go over and see some other people which made no sense to me - it was a long flight. I have no idea what this was all about (possibly time share crap) but I refused to spend time with them, just handed over a card the woman on check in gave us. There was a dead bird on our balcony with poop allover. It was taken away within 5 minutes but the poop was never cleaned up.Our AirCon broke - froze from being on full but the maintenance man sorted this out  really quickly.The cleaning was okay although our bedding was only changed one and not twice as it should have been. The actual cleaning of the resort was good.The staff were friendly and not overbearing which was a plus.It's a 10 minute walk to the strip which is nothing in the grand scheme of Vegas walking!I would happily come back and if we go to Vegas again I'm sure we will!

reviews.title: Comfortable but worn room
reviews.text: We stayed here while the front lobby was being renovated. t did not affect our check-in that was quick and easy. The staff here was very pleasant and helpful. Our room was on the third floor and a side street so it was quiet . The rooms are comfortable but in need of a remodel. The kitchen was well appointed with all we needed for cooking. The pool was redone before we got there and it was very nice. We would go back since the location is perfect. Close but in the middle of the noise from the strip.

reviews.title: Disappointing
reviews.text: The resort was to be finished with its remodeling project we were told about 2 years ago; however, to my displeasure it was NOT. The remodel on the front office is really modern, the pool is wonderful, the exterior paint change is disappointing...way to dark, the ground are well manicured and thankfully more lighting has been added which was desperately needed. The staff are friendly and helpful. The rooms are in an over due state of neglect. Fortunately, the remodel was to begin today, October 17, 2016. If nice rugs and updated rooms are what you are looking for...please call before you book so you know what you are getting. Overall the stay was great, but it had lots little to do with the accommodations.

reviews.title: Not As Good As Previous Visits
reviews.text: Pros- Updated pool area and furniture are wonderful / Revamped Check in area is lovely/ Front Desk Staff were great/ The response to request for extra towels etc. was excellent.Cons. The rooms have carpeting and in the 12 days we were there we did not see or hear a vacuum?/ On the 2nd Sat. we were there the pool was closed at 9:00pm when we really wanted to use the hot tub/ Fridge has water on the shelves everyday like something wasn't working correctly.Glad to see full room updates are starting!

reviews.title: Comfortable, but old & worn out
reviews.text: Stayed here a week and was comfortable, but not what you would expect to pay for this just off the strip accommodation. Stayed on the third floor and the road and airport noise was bad. They are renovating the place, but that didn't help for my stay. The Timeshare pitch you have to sit through to get show tickets was doable, but I probably wouldn't do it again. Our room had no view windows looked out to exterior wall of next room and outdated air conditioning. Average property overpriced with nice accommodating staff.

reviews.title: Great value and location just off
reviews.text: Booked this through a well,known booking site for hotels and the deal was great. Location was spot on for access to the strip. Feeling a bit dated however remodel is under way this year to revitalise facility.Staff really helpful and perfect spot to unwind from mega busy strip.

reviews.title: Excellent hotel
reviews.text: The Desert Rose is a great place to stay. The suites are really well equipped and very comfortable. The hotel is really well positioned for the Strip. Enjoyed the pool and spa.Be aware that there is no food available at the hotel, However the hotel is really set up for self catering and there are plenty of places to eat nearby and Walgreens or CVS on the Strip have a good selection of food available.

reviews.title: Can't wait to go back!!!!
reviews.text: Just got back from staying in this resort today, what a fab place nice and quiet,  yet 2 mins from the madness that is the strip the staff were all very polite and helpful the pool area is fab , it has a brilliant hot tub which is just the ticket after a very long day out & about . The room was clean and had everything we needed for our 10 days there . The cleaners came in twice but if u need to they will exchange towels . The bar prices for food and drinks was very reasonable , and there's  fresh coffee , and ice cold water and lemon juice 24/7 . The apartments are going to be refurbished starting next week which will make this place a 5**** as far as we re concerned and we can't wait to return to desert rose resort 😃

reviews.title: Thoroughly average.
reviews.text: Let's start with the debacle that is check in. After having to wait for a long time, we found out that we had been checked into another person's room and their belongings were still in it. After going back to check in and waiting another 20 mins that was sorted.This is a Wyndham property and lo and behold if they don't try to sign you up for their free presentation to get you to buy timeshare. Pushy or what! The rooms are just okay but definitely in need of refurbishment, which I think is supposed to happen in the fall of 2016. My husband had the unfortunate experience of being in the pool area without his hotel card and when he went to reception was asked for all manner of ID. Really, he's in his swimmers!Some serious staff training needed and an upgrade to the resort.No, I would not stay again.

reviews.title: Great location
reviews.text: Desert rose is an excellent base just off the strip so is a little quieter when sleep is needed clean well furnished and relaxed atmosphere. The reception has just undergone a refurbishment and looks fantastic, the gym has adequate equipment for holiday training sessions. The new bar is a fantastic addition

reviews.title: Perfect Place Just off the Strip
reviews.text: This was the perfect location, located just about a 10 minute walk to the strip.  The property is located right behind the Hooters Hotel & Casino and near the Tropicana.  Access to the MGM Grand, which has access to the monorail, helping you access the rest of The Strip is easy.  The area around Desert Rose seems fairly safe, at no point did I fear for my safety.  Our room was beautifully laid out with a sitting area and with a sofa and TV as well as a  well stocked kitchen with stove, microwave, full size refrigerator as well a dishwasher.  The bedroom was nice, and the bed was very comfortable.  The bathroom was small, but it was fine.I did not use the pool at all, but a no point did it seem crowded.  The small area to purchase some small snacks and drinks at the hotel was very well priced.Most importantly, the resort was quiet.  With the great access to The Strip, if you're looking for a quiet place to stay, perfect for families or people just looking to relax in after a long day in Vegas, the Desert Rose Resort is perfect for you.

reviews.title: Quiet little gem
reviews.text: Lovely spacious apartments within walking distance from the strip.  Peaceful & quiet.  Beautiful pool area with plenty of beds & parasol.  Pool warm & also hot tub.  Barbecue area with tables & chairs to use.  Bar serving good quality food.  Apartments about to be refurbished which look like they'll be even nicer!  Staff very friendly & helpful.  A wonderful stay.  Will definitely return.

reviews.title: Good "off the strip" place to stay
reviews.text: This property is less of a hotel or resort and more of a home away from home. You don't really get the whole "vegas resort" feelling here, and I really appreciated that. The rooms were clean, bigger than expected and well furnished. The full kitchen is a bonus for making your own meals or keeping 20+ room-beers cold. The staff was friendly and always eager to help. There was a bit of pressure from the staff to attend a time-share presentation, but overall they weren't too pushy about it. Based on my 1st stay at the desert rose, I'll definitely be back, and never stay on the strip again. One last thing, the rates for the nice, big rooms here were about half of the rates for a terrible room on the strip.

reviews.title: Fabulous location
reviews.text: We stayed for 5 nights late September.  The resort is in walking distance to the strip, but once we were inside and the sliding door to the balcony was closed the noise was blocked out.  We never found the noise really to be a problem even sitting outside. Great air conditioning and water pressure! The apartment was clean, spacious and very comfortable.  Had everything you needed. Beds and pillows excellent. Whilst we didn't have much of a view, that didn't matter.  The staff were very welcoming and extremely helpful. I split my knee open and they went out of their way to assist me with band-aids, antiseptic wipes and bandages.  I can't thank the staff enough for their help. We would be very happy to stay again if we were visiting Las Vegas again and would highly recommend to others.

reviews.title: Visiting Family
reviews.text: The resort is a nice place to stay. The staff is friendly and the rooms are spacious. I would recommend the resort to anyone. The resort has planned to renovate their property this fall, that is a plus. I plan to use this resort every time, I come to vegas. The only con is the 0900ish phone call  asking about participating in a timeshare presentation.  I understand they have a job to do, I respect that. It would be nice to minimize the phone calls. The persons making the calls were respectful and polite.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: 3rd visit to Las Vegas and thought we would try this resort , so glad we did , such a pleasant , clean and enjoyable place to stay , ideal location being just off the strip . No long walks through the huge hotels on the strip to get to your room, no hotel service charge , fantastic pool area with sun beds and comfortable chill out areas . Rooms are a really good size with kitchen facilities and comfortable sofa to relax on after all the sight seeing . Tropicana , Hooters  and MGM hotels within a 2 min walk . Supermarkets a bus drive away to help stock up the fridge .

reviews.title: "Hidden" gem - walking distance to the strip
reviews.text: Let me tell you, the location of this resort is too good to pass up. You can be on Las Vegas Blvd within 5-10 minutes from leaving your room, depending on the speed of your feet. The closest casinos are MGM and the Luxor. It was perfect for my friends and I who were needing to be near the festival grounds (located on LV Blvd), but didn't want to fork out those obnoxious resort fees that the big casinos would force upon us. The resort property is well kept and felt secure, even for being off the strip, which is a huge plus when walking back well after midnight hours. The kitchen was stacked with everything you would need for simple dinners, and the living room is large enough to be enjoyed by a full group. Pack a lot of clothes? There's a ridiculous amount of closet space throughout the apartment. My only two "cons" were the small patios and the very small bathrooms. But hey, not many places even offer patios, so it's better than nothing. Being only three stories and the way the grounds are laid out, don't expect a nice view. It'll most likely be your neighbor's wall. As for the bathrooms, the sink and mirror area to get ready is separate from the shower and toilet, but overall the space feels cramped. Especially the toilet/shower. Even for us short people, it felt like the walls were closing in on you. But as I always say, if you're spending most of your time in the restroom while on vacation, you've got bigger issues.Final line: We were fortunate enough to get a good deal on this property as they were running a limited time Fall special. This knocked down the price per night pretty significantly, so our 5 star experience was a no brainer. Looking at their normal prices for a busy weekend, I don't know that we'd automatically stay again simply because it was out of our personal budget. But I won't knock their rating because of it. I'm rating my experience and the property, not their pricing. If you can score a deal on this resort, or go during non-peak season, this is an excellent choice. No need to drive around Vegas or spend money on transport (maybe the monorail if you're wanting quick trips to north and south strip). Thanks to the friendly staff for a great stay!

reviews.title: Very Pleased
reviews.text: Originally we were going to stay at another hotel but heard some bad things about it. Changed at the last minute to the Desert Rose after reading some reviews, and it was a great decision.Upon arrival, we were greeted pleasantly by the staff, and given a folder full of things to do in the city and other helpful things.It was peaceful in the resort, and while not directly on the Strip, you are close enough to walk or take a short cab ride back. I thought it would be noisy with Hooters Hotel behind us, but no complaints at all.Rooms are slightly outdated, but nothing to complain about. Felt really cozy, and the kitchen was well equipped. Felt like our little home for a few days.Relaxing at the pool was also great and it wasn't crowded. If you have a rental car, parking is free. They will just give you a parking pass. Wifi was also free and speedy.We enjoyed our trip to Vegas, (even took off on a day trip to the Grand Canyon and Hoover Dam!) and staying at the Desert Rose made it that much better. we will be back to Vegas, and will strongly consider coming back and staying!

reviews.title: Even better
reviews.text: Last year I wrote a review on trip advisor entitled "superb again" well this year it's "even better" stayed for two weeks in August  ,family vacation, with two fifteen year old girls,our fourth time in five years ( says it all).Rooms are very spacious, we had a one bedroom suite which consisted off a fully equipped kitchen,oven,fridge freezer,microwave ,blender,dishwasher, etc and a full set of cutlery,crockery. A lovely dining area with table and chairs,with a sofa bed in the lounge,large flatscreen tv, plenty of drawers for clothing and also a iron and ironing board. The bedroom had a large double bed,walk in wardrobe, and another large flatscreen tv, nice bathroom/toilet (bath and shower) and plenty of mirror space for the girls.also in room safe and superb air con. Location is just off strip, 3 minute walk to main entrance of the MGM, 5 minutes to Tropicana, Excalibur, New York, New York, yet far enough away to lay by the pool in the evening and not hear a thing. The pool area as been totally refurbished, with barbecue facilities, and a brand new pool/lobby bar, which has made such an impact on an already awesome resort. Breakfast and light snacks are served at the bar. An amazing resort with amazing staff, all there to help with anything and always with a smile , in particular the bar staff, nikita and josh ( awesome people and awesome pina colada's). Congratulations  to the general manager, the lovely Lynne, on overseeing such a superb resort,with superb staff. See you in 2017.

reviews.title: Not the best choice for the Las Vegas experience
reviews.text: Located outside of the strip, but pretty close walking distance to MGM Grand. The resort is two story facility different from the  typical Las Vegas hotels with casinos. On the bright side this means that it has no resort fee. Check in was fast, no line at all. Upon arrival they gave us some discounts for North and South outlets. The hotel is situated in a place where the echo from the live concerts accelerates, so till 11:30 it was very loud on both Friday and Saturday night. It was also loud in the room. The room itself is very nice, clean and spacious. We had one bedroom suite, which we liked a lot. The kitchen has everything you can wish for. There is no housekeeping during the stay, however you can request some cleaning from the front desk. The pool looked ok, but we did not use it. Overall good hotel. No casino, no Las Vegas experience however.

reviews.title: Nice and relaxing..
reviews.text: If you want to stay away from the hustle and bustle of the big hotels, then this is the place. The setting is like an apartment building, either one or two bedroom with a balcony. There is no casino, however Hooters hotel/casino is next door and Tropicana/MGM are both a quick walk away. At night we did encounter a couple homeless people who frequent the corner near Hooters, so just be aware of your surroundings when walking at night.Another thing to point out is that after you check in, there is a table stand near entrance. They try to pitch you the timeshare thing. And they leave post cards at your door telling you to come by the table to claim your free tickets to a show. I didnt bother since I knew its a timeshare seminar which I would have to listen to in order to get the tickets.The resort is close to the airport as well. However, the sound of the airplanes were not an issue.The rooms are a good size however they could use an update, which I found out they are doing starting this month.There is no maid service unless you stay 4 days or more.Overall, not a bad place. I would stay again if I dont want the crazy long lines at check-in, etc.

reviews.title: Lovely Stay for a Family of Four
reviews.text: This business uses tools provided by Tripadvisor (or one of its official Review Collection Partners) to encourage and collect guest reviews, including this one.

reviews.title: Nice place, shame about the staff.
reviews.text: We loved the room but the view from most a lot of the balconies was a brick wall. We got locked out of our room on the first night (neither of our cards would open the door) which involved me going down to the front desk to get a new key which didn't work to then go back down to get security to override the door. The next day we ensured that the door was closed as we left and checked we could get back in with the cards. When I returned to the room a few hours later the door was left ajar. I asked reception to see who had been in the room as there is no room cleaning during the stay and we had made sure the door was closed. They ran the door and immediately said that I had left it open. I probably would have believed them if it wasn't for the previous nights problem and us checking the door was closed. To add to this when I was talking about it around the pool area the couple sitting next to me told me that they had been checked into someone else's room when they arrived. The front desk had no idea that that room was occupied. So overall, the hotel was nice, the pool area was great and the strip is walkable but the front desk aren't the brightest. Also they don't serve breakfast on Wednesdays and Thursdays with no notice anywhere about this.

reviews.title: what happened to breakfast
reviews.text: hiwe stayed desert rose 31 aug 2016 for two weeks.We have stayed here a few times and quite like it, however it seems to be changing ,we last stayed here in 2012 and i would say standards have changed in last few yearsMaid service is now twice a week(used to be daily) complimentary breakfast has gone,this was a real plus  for me sometimes its nice not to have to travel for breccythe washing facilities were very poor no pressure in sink taps water just trickled outOne day no waterlast day lift was being serviced just when i needed it for suitcaseswe will be looking elsewhere on next visit

reviews.title: Great location, clean rooms, friendly staff
reviews.text: The location was just off The Strip, but the property was quiet and felt very secure. The rooms are quite dated and the bathrooms are small with very little counter space. I believe I heard that they will be doing a remodel soon, so hopefully that will be addressed.  The staff was friendly and the pool area was nice. There was plenty of parking. I'd definitely try this property again after the remodel.

reviews.title: home from home
reviews.text: Just returned from a 11night stay at the desert rose resort, checked in within 5 minutes,had to give a $100 deposit,this was returned on departure.Front desk- always polite and very helpful and nothing was too much trouble for them.Room- we had a one bedroom apartment ( 4109 ) , large lounge,small fitted kitchen,good size bedroom which led onto the bathroom, we had everything that we needed, the room was very clean, the air con is a bit noisy but you get used to it, the rooms are starting to be updated from autumn this year.Pool- was only small but that didn't bother us,we never had any trouble getting a sun lounger, also there are large parasol's, there is also a hot tub, all very well maintained, there is no lifeguard on duty. There are also 4 large bar-b-quo's that you can use.Hotel lobby- there is a small bar that also serves snacks,a games room, a computer room, also there is free coffee, iced water and lemon juice available all day long just help yourself.Location-hotel was only a 10 min walk to the mgm and the vegas strip, with having the kitchen in the apartment we went to wall-mart which was about 3 miles away, the airport was about 2 miles away. If your looking for good accommodation and dont want the hassle of the large hotels dont look any further than the desert rose, you wont be disappointed, and we will definitely return.

reviews.title: Going downhill
reviews.text: My wife and I have stayed here for at least 10 years,    it used to be a good value with reasonable rates and the best breakfast buffet.   Recently they took the breakfast away and price has increased dramatically.  Rooms are in need of a major upgrade especially the loud air conditioners.  Still an awesome location and staff is always good!

reviews.title: Great Place to Stay for a Great Price.
reviews.text: Clean, huge suites, wonderful pool area.  This place checked all of the boxes for me.  Does it have a casino? No.  It sets right behind Hooters and feels like your own little community.  Would stay here again in a heartbeat.

reviews.title: Stay in las vegas
reviews.text: The hotel was perfect, staff were so friendly, especially the guy who filled the water and coffee machine in the mornings. He was so helpful when my phone went missing, sorry that I didn't take your name, but thanks again for your help. We will definatly be returning, good location and the price was good.

reviews.title: Great little gem
reviews.text: This resort made for an awesome stay in Vegas. It's just a few minute walk from the strip behind one of the major hotels. It was by far cheaper than any decent hotel on the strip. We shared our condo with another couple and we each had our own bedroom and bathroom, and shared a kitchen and living room. This is the way to do it, if you're staying with a couple especially. Even if we had not split the cost between couples, it would have been cheaper to stay here opposed to a hotel on the strip. Resort was quiet, cozy, and had a perimeter wall to keep the riff raff out! Pool was lovely. Room furnishings were a little outdated, but they informed us they are renovating soon. We had a great stay here. Will absolutely be back to stay here on our future Vegas  trips!!

reviews.title: A haven just off the Las Vegas strip.
reviews.text: I love travelling and staying at self catering resorts and the Desert Rose Resort makes it worthwhile.I brought my family to Las Vegas so as to be able to get to the Grand Canyon.  We love the lights of Vegas and the hotels are impressive, but all that noise isn't useful to me when I want to sleep.The Desert Rose gave me and my family exactly what we needed, a haven, just off the strip.  It has a lovely pool too. Recommended.

reviews.title: Still very good, cleaning so so
reviews.text: Have been here one time before for around 5 years ago, so i can compare a little bit to the past. The apartments was exactly the same as last time. I think the apartments still are great. you have everything you need, and even more. I will call it very high standard. Everything fresh and nice. Big fridge, coffemaker, free coffee, dishwasher, nice oven, nice tv, good wireless and good ac. Bathroom perfectly ok, nice soaps provided. Even a little patio with 2 chairs and a table. They have removed the free breakfast that was included last time, you can buy it as an option in the bar instead. They have also removed the free alcohol from last time. They had like 1-2 hours with free snack and drinks one or two nights in a week. Miss it ! Cleaning was so so. We found a big nasty toe nail on the bathroom floor and also a used bandage. ugly. Great staff all around, great pool area. Tovels provided. They had rebuilded the whole reception area and installed a bar there with some light meals as well. It was very modern. The layout is not for me, it was very minimalistic but i guess thats modern now. Anyway. The food and drinks was 100 %.Parking free and always enough free spots. Location is really good, takes 15 minutes walking to the strip. Security guards on duty all night, felt it very safe. All in all still highly recommended.

reviews.title: Disappointed and mixed feelings
reviews.text: I had heard mixed views on this resort. My wife and I went there this July. Found this to be quite a long walk away from the strip not just a couple of blocks away. Rooms weren't bad at all. It was clean and specious. We had a one bedroom suite. Well equipped but as we stayed for one week, in the midweek housekeeping they don't replenish the toiletries. There is still construction going on. Went to do laundry and diappointed to find machines not in use. They offered us to meet them for 90 minutes of presentation and breakfast. Found the presentation was very nice but the agent got very rude when wanted a couple of days to think.One morning I approached the front desk for some store where I could go buy some milk. Felt like I disturbed her. On a good note to end this front lobby always had cold ice water and lemonade and coffee ready.

reviews.title: Fully Equipped Kitchen, Clean, Great Staff!
reviews.text: The kitchen has everything you need to make breakfast, lunch, and dinner. With the fridge, you can always have cold beer and drinks! The rooms are spacious and the bathrooms are nice. Only issue is there isn't any daily room service but you can always ask for more towels. The pool area is also quite nice and we over heard that they give out free smoothies to people in the pool...although we were in there twice and never got any :( Overall, great place to stay, fully loaded kitchen, friendly staff and not too far from the strip.

reviews.title: Great family accommodation and at great price!
reviews.text: Great location, just a short walk to the monorail and the strip.Facilities were great and the apartment was great. Clean and comfortable with a fully equipped kitchen. Free parking. Laundry facilities for a small charge. Great security.Would highly recommend this resort, perfect for families.

reviews.title: Great Hotel, Great Rate
reviews.text: I loved having a kitchen so that I could eat most of my meals at the hotel.  I also loved the fact that it didn't feel like I was staying in Vegas but I was a quick 10 minute walk to the strip.  The bed was comfortable, the room was very clean, and the hotel was clean.  I will definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Great Condo at a Reasonable Rate!
reviews.text: We spent 5 days at the Desert Rose in August 2016. We loved having a full kitchen for those days we didn't want to eat out.. The beds were comfortable! The condo was very clean. We are senior citizens so we must look for the best bargain when traveling. The cost of the condo was reasonable and it met all our needs!  We would stay at the Desert Rose Resort again!

reviews.title: nice quiet apartment in vegas
reviews.text: the resort is not far from the strip just few minutes walk. we have 1 bedroom suites and fully equip kitchen and dining room. and it was very clean.bed is comfortable and the heating is awesome when outside is chilling temperature. wifi is very strong. customer service is helpful and nice. base on their knowledge. offer a great deal to watch some shows on the strips hotel. we didnt have the breakfast, i think they offered it but we didnt go. plenty of parking. laundry is downstair near the entrance just a few coins to run it. will come here again. a great cheap resort with a clean comfortable apartment.

reviews.title: My good time
reviews.text: I have spent very good time there in this hotel and also i had seen very good stuff they working very hard in the sand bar on the beCh ahmed gamal and hamdy abd el razik and also the manger Ahmed Ewies and also the animation team is the best team i seen my life in any resort they work very hard Spcial anoo and bebo and ahmed and Nastya and julia all of them

reviews.title: Lovely apartment
reviews.text: Great apartment with a very comfy bed and black out curtains, slept really well there. Pool area was nice and while resort was very clean. Family friendly and good if you don't want to be surrounded by stag parties! Only issue was that we were there a week and housekeeping only came once and we had to ask as they didn't come on the day we were told. Well stocked kitchen, big fridge, everything you need!

reviews.title: Fabulous place to stay in Vegas - perfect!
reviews.text: Stayed here in August 2016 for two nights after a week on the road, family of four.  It was great having a condo with full kitchen facilities and we found a grocery store 5 minutes away so were able to cook.  All the staff we met were so helpful.  Some reviews said these condos are dated but I didn't find them that way at all - I thought they were plush, clean with everything needed.  There is a nice sized pool with plenty of atmosphere but not so crowded you cannot get in it or find a sunbed - everyone seemed friendly.  Location was perfect just off the strip (we walked back from near MGM one day which was very close but a bit hot at 44 degrees!).  I was concerned that there might be a lot of airport noise but we didn't hear it at all. Desert Rose offered us sanity after the madness of the strip and the big hotels that we visited.  I would recommend this hotel to anyone going to Vegas.  P.S.  thanks to Trip Advisor for the advice on asking for quiet room away from Hooters hotel

reviews.title: Great stopover from/to Grand Canyon
reviews.text: We stayed here (family 5) following a visit to Grand Canyon. Stayed for 2 nights and found the apartment well suited to our needs.  2 lovely double rooms, 2 bathrooms and a well equipped kitchen.  We made use of the additional sofa bed in the lounge area which was also comfortable.  Vegas was very hot so the pool was lovely for an evening swim to cool down.  Close to The Strip and we found it t be quiet. We ate out at buffets both nights and the food was fatastic.  First night in The Bollagio and second evening at Planet Hollywood. We enjoyed both.  Nice place to stay in Vegas for a family. (Used Laundry facility here too).

reviews.title: For people who don't want the huddle and bustle of being on the strip
reviews.text: Been to Vegas twice first time stayed in the Monte Carlo although beautiful it's expensive . Got married in Vegas this time stayed at Desert Rose absolutely fabulous. Large apt with full kitchen , great price . Although it's near Hooters you can't hear any noise as I had read in previous reviews. Only 5 mins walk to strip if you go through MGM at rear . Staff were brilliant was also my 60th  birthday when we were there and was given the largest bottle of wine I had ever had . No restaurant in hotel but do get a free start to the day small breakfast of croissant coffee and fruit  which is ok till you go out. Going back for my husband's 60th definitely to this hotel . Freemont Street is must to go to see live bands for free if like us you are relatively youngish oldies .

reviews.title: Comfortable enough.
reviews.text: This resort is good  value if you don't want to eat out too often. The kitchen is well stocked with utensils and there is a large fridge / freezer. Tablets for the dishwasher are supplied. The beds and sofas are very comfortable. The resort is quiet, but we heard drilling going on some days. There is an ice machine in the hallway. The pool is fairly basic but is clean and has disabled access equipment .

reviews.title: away from glitter of las vegas
reviews.text: stayed here three nights, away from all that craziness of las vegas, for relax, nice room, and pool, 10 minute walk to main boulevard; there are mainly condos with kitchens, so you can bring some food for breakfast and lunch; what to do in las vegas??? just at night, walk and look at the people, bring some snacks and stand in front of belagio hotel and watch the water show, its free!!!

reviews.title: 2nd Time Visiting
reviews.text: This was our second time staying at the Desert Rose Resort. We booked the 2 bedroom suite and was happy to be there; however, there were maintenance issues in the room that fell short of our expectations. Unfortunately the massage shower did not work; the coffee pot cord was jammed so we couldn't really use it properly and the room smelled like someone smoked in it. But once we got the air on, the room smelled great.One word of important advice: Our family needed a scooter for one of our members due to an injury after booking. The facility did have scooters available for $25 a day which was awesome, but the darn thing didn't work properly. So, our family member ended up getting stuck in different places which became worrisome a few times. If you do get a scooter for a handicapped person, make sure they aren't giving you a lemon like we got.But it was a good trip and we will book with Desert Rose Resort again. Also, look under the beds...we found someones shoes!

reviews.title: Quite intimate family resort
reviews.text: I was so pleased with my stay at The Desert Rose Resort. Clean quite and friendly staff resort. Very close to the strip and freeway. Convenience of home away from home. If you are looking for a place that is of smaller scale compared to the large hotels this very well could be what you're looking for. I'm looking forward to going back soon

reviews.title: Baby had to sleep in a drawer
reviews.text: We confirmed our reservation the night before we went, and at that time reminded the staff that we needed a playpen or crib. When we arrived we were told one was in the room ready for us. It wasn't. We stopped in at the desk on our way to lunch and let them know, and were told that one would be sent up right away. When we returned after an hour or two, it still was not there. We called the front and again requested it be sent up. Again, we were told that it was on the way. When it hadn't arrived a couple of hours later, we called once more, only to be told "Oh, we gave it away to another family. Just put the baby on the floor to sleep". Gee... thanks. The carpet was old, stained, and really quite dirty, and there was no way I was putting my baby to sleep on it. So we found our own solution. The hotel staff didn't even apologize once, let alone make any sort of effort to help us out in any way. So despite the fact the the linens were all very clean, the room was quiet, and the air conditioning was amazing, I wouldn't stay there again and wouldn't recommend it to anyone else.

reviews.title: The Vegas part of our road trip.
reviews.text: We stayed at the Desert Rose resort for a week in August 16. We had a 2 bed apartment type room with 2 bathrooms and a small balcony. We have read the negative reviews about the condition of the rooms but we found ours to be in pretty good condition. I think I may have had a lick of paint to freshen it up before a planned refit. After a long and hectic road trip with the kids on the previous 2 weeks this section of the holiday was about chilling by the pool, eating out and having a stroll up the crazy strip now and then. The Desert Rose is in a grey location for the Strip. A short walk from the MGM, Luxor end of the strip. In general the clientele of the Desert Rose are families so it's pretty chilled. There was a large party arrived on our last weekend that had about 20 young kids that were  a bit wild but generally good fun. There is a small fitness room is used as it just too hot to run in Vegas. It's pretty well equipped but could definitely benefit from a bench to use the bum bells on. The receptions and pool area are very nice. Beds are available by the pool but don't go or early and place towels. You hotel doesn't like that and to be honest we didn't do it or need to do it. It is self catering but you either need to have a car or cab ride to the local supermarket which is not walking distance. Back to the room. My only compliant about the room would be the carpets. Although they look in good condition they are quite dirty! American seem to wear their shoes indoors all the time and the pavements are not cleanest in Vegas so that get transferred to the room. I would say they need to be cleaned more regularly than they are. But that is my only criticism of the room. I found it to be great apart from that. Not sure how they would fix this bit but the lifts are always busy! The stairs are not clearly marked out and look like they are a fire escape only. To be honest the lifts were mainly busy due to staff using them so I'd say a service lift may be an idea. But that's a big job so doubt it would be addressed. An idea would make the fire escape staircase more clearly signed as a regular access and egress point. Just a thought.  I would definitely recommend the Desert Rose for a visit and is ideal for families wanting a more chilled version of the insane Vegas! And I understand the rooms are being fully refitted soon which will make it even better especially if they clean the carpets more often!

reviews.title: Las Vegas 2016!!!
reviews.text: Was a bit worried selecting a spot off the strip but was pleasantly surprised! We stayed in a 2 bedroom/2bath condo style room, it had a great living room, fully stocked kitchen with working stove, microwave and refrigerator. Super spacious and really clean, the parking lot was secured at night and the gate at the entrance was also another security feature my family appreciated. I will definitely book this place again, it was a great room for 6 adults to stay in with plenty of room.

reviews.title: Great suites!
reviews.text: Had to go to Vegas for business at the Mandalay Bay convention center, it was literally 2 blocks away! So a perfect spot for off the strip but really close! We had a 2 bedroom suite. Very accommodating. Very convenient with a full fridge, dishwasher, oven/stove, dishes. Close to the grocery store, as well as MGM grand for the monorail. Next door to hooters! LolThe pool hours were nice, not closed until 11pm which beats a lot of the casino hotels. Bbqs by the pool too so you can have a yummy dinner without breaking the bank! Will probably be back! The only thing that was a downside was their door keys weren't working and we had to get some remade. And then the elevator trapped 15 people. Luckily we weren't in it- as the elevator ride is extremely uncomfortable!!! It's so hot and stifling in them, riding up 2 floors felt like forever!!

reviews.title: Pretty good value with some takeaways.
reviews.text: It's in a good spot behind the hooters hotel. The rooms were pretty comfortable and the staff was easy to deal with. No resort fees either! The only con is after 4 days (and if you don't have a car), walking to the strip can get pretty tiresome. It would take about 10 minutes walking to reach the Tropicana/MGM area. Other than that, the room was great and the kitchenette was a nice bonus.

reviews.title: Strip location without strip price. Great value
reviews.text: Our family of 4 stayed here. Room was clean. Free wifi was a hit and pool was great. Stayed close to strip without casino feel. Room is a little dated but decent. Lobby is nice and spacious. MGM is a 1min walk and Planet Hollywood was a $7 cab ride away. We were very happy with our stay. Would recommend to family and friends.

reviews.title: Pleasantly surprised! Very Nice!
reviews.text: After looking at some of the other reviews were didn't know quite what to expect when we arrived. My only small complaint was that check in was a little slow but the desk clerk was pleasant and nice. It appears that the major work in the lobby is done. They do have a small bar that serves reasonably priced beverages and the bartender was cool. They now have a small menu if you want a simple meal. It's super close to the strip and about a block to the MGM Grand where we had to go for a wedding. Parking is free. Our room must have been one that has been remodeled because it was lovely. Granite counters in kitchen and bath (however, you could really have extended that bathroom counter out another 6-8 inches, the counter is very small), all appliances worked. We had a stove, micro, coffee pot, toaster, full frig etc and enough service for 6. We had a ground floor room with a little patio. I hope they keep their pricing down once they have finished their remodel because it is definitely at the top of our Vegas choices for a room.

reviews.title: A good location.
reviews.text: A good location,glose to the Strip, but a bit tired, carpets in the appartment in need of a clean. But roomy and nice for a familie of six. Nice pool , hot and cold drinks free. Housekeeping only every other day.

reviews.title: Not the best start...
reviews.text: So the young man that assisted us as we checked into the resort was awesome. Very kind and attentive. However, the room that we were given was sad. The furnishings in it were old and worn. One of the closet doors was no longer aligned with the tracks to make it close so, it hung at a weird angle. The room overall was just dark. So, I called to ask to be relocated and was assured that was no problem...let them check on it. Long story shortened, after many calls and even a conversation with a manager, Kathryn (not the most empathetic), 4 HOURS later, we were moved! 4 hours! The room that we were moved to was relatively better (I am looking forward to staying there when the upgrades are done - hopefully, our overall experience will be better).

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort best family/group stay!!
reviews.text: Best experience ever!! Always book my hotel Desert Rose every time planning a trip to Las Vegas. Desert Rose resort only have one bedroom or two bedroom suites that comes with kitchen, living room, and balcony. This hotel is 5min walk to the strip or to MGM Grand and its in a quite place. Good for family, friends, or any type of groups. Service is great and never have a problem for the past 15times that I book here. Prices at Desert Rose is cheap and fair comparing to thousands of dollars for suites on the strip. Love this place! planning to book it again a few months.

reviews.title: Great for families and longer stays!
reviews.text: Great location, off the strip, but two blocks to MGM Grand and New York New York. Suites are clean and big, with full kitchens - a major plus considering Vegas food prices. There are also barbecue facilities and outdoor dining tables by the pool. Decor is a bit dated, but this is a great place considering the price and location. Coffee and water/lemonade in the lobby all day. Great pool and hot tub. Awesome, friendly staff. Free parking and wi-fi. Perhaps not a very romantic place for couples - it is a more a groups/family-oriented place.Newly-opened restaurant in the lobby serving basic, but well-priced breakfast and lunch.Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Fantastic stay
reviews.text: Stayed here Last year 1 bedroom suite clean room comfy bed, a lot better than just staying in a hotel room more comfortable, walking to the strip no problem.  We did however see a party trapped in the lift one night they were frantic, I could not believe it when they finally got out there were loads of them!  Take notice of lift occupancy.Would return and recommend

reviews.title: Basketball Tourney
reviews.text: We came for 6 days for a youth basketball tournament. This resort couldn't have been better. We had a one bedroom with sofa couch. The room was spacious, had all the amenities as if we were at home. Full kitchen with plates, knives, etc..  There are even BBQ's out by the pool for guests to use. The check-in staff, house services, security, even the maintenance folks were all very pleasant, respectful, and super accommodating. There is not a casino here (many nearby ;), but I was ok with that and I highly recommend this place if you need a peaceful, Vegas trip.

reviews.title: Great resort for family
reviews.text: Stayed here from 11 July for 4 days with family 4 kids. The resort staff were fantastic and helpful the place is clean and the rooms are good with its own facilities. Although a little bit outdated it is in the process of being upgraded.It is only about 10 mins walk to the south strip and close mgm,  york new york.It would stay again at this place

reviews.title: love desert rose!
reviews.text: Fantastic staff, fabulous apartment, security staff spot on, perfect location on the south end of the strip, quiet pool, comfy sunbeds, ace sized pool, brill air conditioning in rooms, easy car park, close to the rest of the massive hotels, constantly updating their amenities, will defo be going back to this hotel when we return to Vegas. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Worst place
reviews.text: Traveling halfway round the world to stay in a room overlooking the laundry area and its window facing the main corridor so that you cannot open a curtain !!!When other visitors paying the same money have proper rooms !!!! What is this ??😡

reviews.title: "Very good hotel and great value"
reviews.text: If you are looking for a place to stay at Las Vegas for not too much money I advice the Desert Rose Resort. Very nice building with very nice apartment, we stayed with my family and we've been very happy and we will definitely come back! The pool was totally cleaned and not too much noisy.The staff is very welcoming and smiling too everything has been wonderful! It is defo a place to relax and enjoy your stay. Thank you very much again

reviews.title: glad it only cost me points
reviews.text: Because I was silly enough to buy timeshare once, I had points I could use to stay here.  Glad I didn't pay actual money.First the pluses.  It has a kitchen.  Up to two bedrooms are available (good for larger families).  The beds are reasonably comfortable.  There is wi-fi, and it's free to timeshare people.  I don't know if they charge for non-timeshare people.  Everything worked.Minuses:  the kitchen was old, the dishwasher had rusty racks.  The shower was small and basic (like something you'd find in a motel).  Not many outlets so hard to find a place to charge your phone.Location is a "neutral".  It's across the road from the MGM Grand.  Probably a 10 minute walk to Las Vegas Blvd.  So not too far, but not really close either.  I figure the walk was good given how much one can eat in a buffet!!  But it may not be the safest walk (the sidewalk disappears by the Tropicana and you have to cross their driveway while avoiding taxis and such).Expect them to push attending a timeshare presentation.  That is very annoying, but just say "no".  Forcefully.I probably wouldn't stay again if I had a choice.

reviews.title: love desert rose
reviews.text: just had first 2 weeks in june at desert rose we 2 rooms 3 men on holiday so we decided we needed space but 1 room would have been okay pool small but great free tea and coffee all day rooms spacious and kept spotless 2 minute walk to hooters casino 10 minutes to mgm grand and new york new york we will be going back to desert rose feb 2017 cant wait

reviews.title: 4th of July Getaway
reviews.text: I don't usually stay in suites, but since I didn't make the reservations, I had no say.  My brother booked this suite for our 4th of July getaway and I was impressed.  Just like a little apartment, a home-away-from-home.  Fully stocked kitchenette, 2 bathrooms, TV's in both rooms, dining area, balcony with chairs, nice size swimming pool, on-site laundry, and super friendly staff.  There is not room service every day.  You need to call if you need service, extra towels, TP, etc.  We never had to call for service, as there were extra towels, TP, etc. in the closet.  There is no shuttle service.The hotel is located just behind Hooters.  For us, it was in walking distance to where we wanted to go. We were only a block from the airport, but I never heard a plane the whole time we were there. Very pleasant stay.  I think I will be reserving suites for family getaways.

reviews.title: Hidden gem
reviews.text: Just popped into the desert rose resort for a price check for an up and coming holiday, the lobby staff were very helpful and accommodating so we were happy with their service. We stayed here two years ago and had a great time. But it has just had a make over and looks in great shape so we will be definately staying in the near future

reviews.title: worst experience in a hotel - Don't leave anything valuable for the Staff Thieves to take
reviews.text: We are time share owners and we have stayed here before because, well its Vegas. We like having a kitchen and we like being off the strip.However we stayed Memorial Day weekend and we felt totally ripped off by the whole guest services staff. After checking out and leaving which was a mistake on my part, we realized we left a very valuable item in the room. We called the resort to let them know we were coming back to get it, they assured us the room had not been clean an no one had entered. Within 20 minutes  to my return, the room had been cleaned and my items were gone.The managers have a don't search the staff policy, we were not advised to file a police report. The nicest and most helpful person was the security guard, she was the one who told us to escalate the issue to a (real)  manager and to file an incident report. The front desk supervisor and the guest services Asst Manager offered no help.After speaking to LVPD they mentioned this type of thievery only happens at these kind of resorts and is unheard of at the big hotels. They also mentioned that the way the hotel handled the whole situation was very unprofessional, from not locking down the room or having all those that entered the room searched.A month later and we still have not received a response from anyone from either the resort or the parent companyGuest services is more like employee protection program.

reviews.title: Great Jem right off the Strip!
reviews.text: We stayed in two other Casino/Resort and were not very impressed with service and quality of our stay.  Desert Rose far exceeded our expectations!  The rooms are very large, two-room condo-style rooms that have more than adequate space.  Two bedrooms and two bathrooms.  DR is under renovations right now due to becoming part of the Wyndham group but this did not effect the comfort of our stay at all.  They will try to get you to do a 90 minute presentation for a time share but just say no and they don't bother you anymore.  There was no continental breakfast since the breakfast area was under construction.The pool is relatively small, but adequate.  Location is right off Koval and Duke Ellington, near the Luxor and Excalibur resorts.  The location allows easy access to the "back roads" that get you to the resorts all down the strip.  Another huge plus to DR, is when you check in they give you a folder with all the great little tips about the hotel and what is right around you; grocery stores, pizza places, some restaurants, etc... they also give you a list of known FREE shows in the strip area.  Addresses, phone numbers, everything is on the list.  I love it!  The other resorts give you nothing...

reviews.title: Great property off the stirp
reviews.text: This property is great for folks who want to avoid the hassle of Resort Casio Hotels (which is me for sure). The check in here is easy and quick, there is convenient free parking, no "resort" fee and the rooms are spacious with a full kitchen (not that I used it, but the microwave and full size fridge is nice).  It is about a .4 mile walk to the south strip where you can pick up a shuttle to get to where ever you need to go.There is only one downside I found and that is  no food on premises.  So, if you do not cook in the room you have to head down the street for breakfast,.  So, stop at a store and buy a few things for breakfast.Also, there is not daily housekeeping.  I was only here two days so I am not sure when they would come by again, but that needs to be considered.

reviews.title: A Hidden Diamond!
reviews.text: Our the two-bedroom suite had a full kitchen, dining area, living room, and patio and It is literally only a five minute walk from The Strip! Quiet, will be perfect stay for family with kids. because it is one of the hotels that doesn't have a casino. Fast cheek- in.

reviews.title: quiet place off of the strip
reviews.text: We were visiting our sons and therefore having a casino was not important to us.  Room was spacious and pool was very nice.  A short walk to the casino as well as various restaurants.  We would stay here again.  They were having construction to update the facility - but it wasn't any problem for us.

reviews.title: Brilliant
reviews.text: Stayed here last year in June during a heat wave in Vegas. This resort is brilliant. Tucked away behind the hustle and bustle. If you get a room at the rear like we did the view is stunning of the luxor, New York New York and other hotels and casinos.We had a car so plenty of car parking space and security made you feel safe. Very spacious 2 bed and 2 bathroom apartment with spacious living area, dining area and kitchen. Checking in and out was very easy and seamless. Swimming areas were clean and well kept. Maid service sufficient. Lovely quiet pleasing stay. I work in the hotel industry and was pleasantly surprised by the resort. Thank you and if I ever return to Vegas i will stay again. Few tips, if your driving down to Fremont part of Vegas park in the golden nugget car park, we ate here and it was brilliant if you eat they validate your parking as well. David Copperfield show was great in the mgm grand. Red rock canyon and Hoover damn are also wishing driving distance and I recommend the visits. The comedy show at the Tropicana was a hilarious evening with nationally famous comedians.

reviews.title: A hidden gem in Vegas
reviews.text: We stayed in the desert rose on two occasions while we were visiting the nellies air show, we wanted somewhere that was easy to get to the strip but far enough from the crowds.... This place suited our needs to a T.The rooms are large, have a full kitchen, dining area, lovely comfy bed and very clean.There is a pool and a barbi area outside, there is a free breakfast in the morning in one end of the lobby area, this was just enough to put you on before setting out for a day sightseeing.....All in all we had a fantastic time on both occasions we stayed and would recommend it to anyone who wants to go to Las Vegas but wants to stay in a more quiet area ..... It is only 5mins from the airport ,and 5mins to the strip.

reviews.title: Great for families.
reviews.text: Great place to stay with kids if in Las Vegas.  This is a non casino hotel. Full kitchen and all amenities.  Decent sized pool and hot tub. Best part is it is ONE block off the strip, near the MGM and right behind the Tropicana.  Hotel staff are friendly and very accommodating.

reviews.title: Great place just off the strip
reviews.text: I've stayed at the desert rose 2 times while in Las Vegas for business, you can't go wrong choosing this place to stay top notch service at great prices. Abs it is close enough to walk to the mgm or Luxor but back away from the strip for quite relaxing evenings

reviews.title: A quieter hotel, away from the Strip
reviews.text: I chose this hotel as it is away from the hustle and bustle of the Strip, and slightly cheaper. Although only 1 block back, it still seemed a long hot walk to get anywhere. First impressions were not good, as the lobby area was large, empty and plain - definitely not inviting. However, we checked in ok and were introduced to the helpful concierge. Our room was lovely - separate bedroom, with large lounge diner and a full kitchen.  I wished we were staying longer than 3 nights! A shame that we only looked out at another building though. We also loved the swimming pool, though more shade and umbrellas would have been welcome.

reviews.title: Holiday
reviews.text: Just over a ten minutes walk from the strip. The Desert rose is a great place to stay. The rooms are big and finished to a high standard and the kitchen has all the things you could  ask for. Found the staff to be very friendly.
