Although the resort is undergoing a makeover the workman are keeping noise to a minimum.  I would recommend staying here any time.

reviews.title: Going through updates
reviews.text: The idea of this place is good, off the strip (barely), with kitchen. Its literally on the other side of MGM so walking to strip is easy. What's wrong with it, is the pool is very tiny. If you like to go to Vegas with the idea of pool lounging and excitement of people watching, then this is not the place. We were here for 4 days and stared at the same retired people every day. The rooms are realllllly old. Like super old. I felt like I was in an old 80s apartment. Bathrooms sinks have zero counter space, so it was hard to get ready in there. The only plus was a kitchen. Though we didn't use it, I can imagine if someone didn't want to spend too much eating out, the kitchen is a great thing to have. It did have a regular size fridge, so bringing our leftovers home was a really nice option! They are remodeling, so hopefully they get to the guest rooms. The lobby looks like they are getting a little bar in it. I'm sure it will be better once its updated.

reviews.title: Enjoyed the room pool and location. Had a problem with the sales pitch and the Twenty dollar deposit for a breakfast we
reviews.text: Enjoyed the room pool and location. Had a problem with the sales pitch and the Twenty dollar deposit for a breakfast we

reviews.title: Recommended hotel for river rafting trips - not the best choice
reviews.text: We stayed here for a few days prior to a Grand Canyon River rafting excursion. The rafting outfitter recommended this hotel for convenience to the strip and because this is where the rafting trips pick up passengers in the early morning. The benefits end there.  The hotel is dated and a bit beat - the room was okay (includes small kitchen, fridge, microwave, blender), but I found myself cringing a bit at the quality of the housekeeping (i.e. barely clean bathrooms, sinks and mirrors) and the furnishings were very worn. Not awful, but for the price - and the proximity to hotels like MGM (across the street), New York/Luxor/Excalibur (a block away), Tropicana (next door) - travelers to Vegas can do much better.  I did some on-the-spot price comparisons and found a room at the MGM for the same price I was paying at the Desert Rose. I'll end here because I really don't like leaving negative reviews, but if you're headed to Vegas for a rafting trip and you're looking for a place to crash before or after, do yourself a favor and look around for some other options. The glitz and glam of Vegas isn't my cup of tea, but if I'm there, I don't want to feel like I'm staying in a sub-par outpost.

reviews.title: Wonderful Experience, Friendly Staff
reviews.text: Two recent stays at this resort and each occasion was excellent. Front Desk staff very courteous, cheerful and helpful. Room accommodations (1-bedroom suite) were clean and no operational issues. Nice kitchen, dining and living room area. Bedroom spacious. Highly recommend.

reviews.title: Nice Quiet Hotel
reviews.text: Such a nice change from the Mega hotel scenery. Offers relief from the noise, lights and chaotic life of Las Vegas. The one bedroom suite has a full kitchen and pull out couch.  Rooms are nice and clean.  Non smoking rooms really are non smoking! On one of the night we stayed, there was a rowdy group downstairs, but no more the next night so I guess things got solved, probably just an isolated incident. NICE, CLEAN retreat from the hectic life of Vegas. Will go again.

reviews.title: Short getaway
reviews.text: Third stay at this hotel. They are doing major renovations. Pool area and barbecue area are finished and looked pleasantly appealing. Lobby is under construction, but clutter is kept to a minimum so check in is quick. Once the lobby is finished they will have a food establishment so you can get some snacks , save having to leave the pool area. Rooms are nicely furnished, a little older decor, but they will be renovated by next year. Overall a nice place to stay, a short walk to the strip.

reviews.title: Thoroughly lovely stay
reviews.text: I really enjoyed being away from "the strip" with all the madness that the strip brings it was like a little oasis to comeback to the Desert Rose. Advice from previous tripadvisor reports came in handy as we asked for a "quiet room" and not by the gates ... that's what we got. The noise from the Hooters pool parties I was convinced would haunt our stay but we never heard them. Place was well set out comfortable and relaxing The pool was lovely and cool to chill after days averaging 115 degrees! would recommend this for couples with or without kids who don't want to spend half an hour trying to orientated through a casino to get out! We met a couple who said it took them half an hour to get to the front door from their room.

reviews.title: Mosquitoes
reviews.text: Good location for families.   Off the strip, but close to everything.   The rooms were good size, but a little dated.  Our main complaint was mosquitoes.   They seem to multiple in the bathroom at night.  Our youngest woke up with several bad bites each morning.

reviews.title: Our 4th Visit
reviews.text: This was our fourth visit to the Desert Rose,we had to wait nearly an hour for room in a noisy reception area,the room itself was good(4037)the only thing that spoilt it this time was it was so noisy all day and night due to a supposed air con unit on roof ?.We did speak to Jason in reception but never got back to us about it.Other than that would recommend Desert Rose to everybody and looking forward to returning in future and experiance the completed refurb.

reviews.title: Comfy, quiet suites, perfect for families
reviews.text: Desert Rose was quite a find in Las Vegas - absolutely perfect for young and old families looking for quiet and comfort just off the strip. And an especially great spot if you're in Vegas to head to the Grand Canyon rather than the strip! Beautiful pool and fully furnished and stocked kitchens in the cozy suites. Easy two block walk to the strip and super quick taxi ride to the airport. Only reason I didn't give them 5 stars was because bar service by the pool is not open yet, but a beautiful bar is being constructed and will be a delightful addition to the pool and reception area!

reviews.title: Spacious rooms
reviews.text: We stayed here for a week in the two bedroom appartements and were happy to. Keep in mind that on friday and saturday the pool can be noisy. We only got one cleaning in the week which is not enough. Wifi and free parking available. Very friendly and helpful staff.

reviews.title: Trip of a lifetime
reviews.text: Nice place to go we stayed for 7 days hot as Hell outside  but resort was nice the people was nice like my room free breakfast pool also gym and near all the casinos when I go back I'm staying here go tell them i sent you have fun

reviews.title: Good option for non-casino hotel
reviews.text: I chose this place becasue of their apt. suites as we were travelling with another couple. It is convenient to have a kitchenette and 2 private rooms with bathrooms. The pool was always busy but it was Memorial day weekends, so that was expected. Close to the strip, and off strip dining options. I would stay here again.

reviews.title: quiet and not far from the strip
reviews.text: Just back from 10 nights in a two bedroom apartment. The apartment was very good a little dated but Hey Hoo. All the facilities were excellent in the room even a small balcony that we looked over too the strip from.Had a good pool area still doing work in the reception area and no resort fees. Overall would definately go back.10 minutes walk from the strip.

reviews.title: Calm and peaceful stay in Vegas
reviews.text: We couldn't stand the smoky smelling casinos in those strip hotels but wanted easy access to the strip. This place doesn't have a casino and hence it's not crowded. It's so peaceful there which we really like. The hotel offers free parking and  has a pool, laundry  and a fitness center. There is no restaurant but we didn't need it since the coco's was close by on Tropicana avenue which offers great breakfast.The room was spacious, has very comfortable bed and a kitchen which we hardly used. The bathroom was nice and big and has a big bath tub.There is free wifi for upto 4 devices.  The house keeping was on every third day. so be sure to remove the do not disturb sign from the door on that day. Even if you miss it they will send you fresh towels and toiletries on request.If the cab driver has difficulty reaching this place, tell them it's right behind Hooters casino. It's walkable distance to the strip. Just walk towards tropicana avenue , cross the road and get to MGM grand casino and there is an exit to  las vegas blvd ( the strip).

reviews.title: Very Nice Room, Great Rate near Strip !
reviews.text: This apartment/condo hotel is one block off of the Strip.  The staff is welcoming & very helpful.  One bedroom suite with kitchen, kind bed & couch bed.  The rate that we got was very good.  It is within walking distance of MGM Grand, Hooter's Hotel, etc.

reviews.title: Smaller Resort
reviews.text: This is a small Wyndham managed resort, close to the airport.  They are in the process of remodeling - currently the lobby.  As most Wyndhams, it is clean and well equipped.  Currently it is a bit dated, but appears that they are updating it all.  The pool area is small, but nice.  Pretty family friendly (ie - no pool bar, etc).

reviews.title: Well located and well equipped
reviews.text: Spent 5 nights at this hotel as a part of a stay in Vegas for a business conference.  The hotel is very different to the large concept hotels you find in Vegas - both in terms of size and in terms of style.The hotel is well located near the strip - yet pretty tranquill. The rooms are large and the kitchen is well equipped. In fact, the rooms feels more like a small apartment than a hotel rooms. I would say however, that the interior of the hotel is pretty dated. Also, the aircon was way too noisy for my taste. There was some renovation going on in the reception at the time of my stay, but it wasn't a problem.Since I went on a trip paid by my employer I really can't comment on the value. ISo I end up rating the hotel as "average" as I felt it was.But I sense that value is a very big part of the attraction of this hotel. So if you are f.ex. travelling as a family to Vegas on budget you might easily rate the hotel higher.

reviews.title: Apartell right off the Strip
reviews.text: Desert Rose was right off the strip and had all the convenience of an apartment.  Clean, nice staff, full kitchen and everything worked.  Driving into Vegas for a convention at Mandalay Bay, this place was great for location and we could prepare our own meals or walk to the strip.  Nice

reviews.title: Reasonably Price Hotel off the strip
reviews.text: This is a a reasonably priced motel just a couple of blocks off the "strip." We stayed there since our Arizona River Runners trip recommended it.  It is close to a restaurant,Coco's.  The rooms are nice sized with a bedroom, living room and full kitchen that comes equipped with plates and silverware.  The staff is helpful and they provide a Las Vegas welcome packet, maps, brochure, discount coupons.  There is free WIFI, card keys are used, and the bathroom comes with soap, body lotion, shampoo, and conditioner.

reviews.title: Extraordinary value!
reviews.text: We've stayed at this little gem three times before, and it never fails to please us. Only a couple of hundred yards from the northern end of the strip, and a stones throw from the MGM Grand, the Desert Rose offers both fantastic value for money and a welcome oasis of calm. We are always both impressed and delighted at the level of detail paid to customer satisfaction - tiny details like washing-up liquid and paper towels in the fully equipped kitchen. In many respects it feels more like staying in a friend's apartment than a hotel suite. The space is comfortable, clean and well furnished, with plenty of wardrobe and drawers for clothes and storage. All the rooms are a good size, and provide a welcome opportunity to relax after marching the length of the strip, and taking in a show. Great bed too!  Outside there is a decent size swimming pool and hot tub, with towels ready and waiting in the suite. Two TVs (which we've never used!) and speedy, free internet service! Wyndham's are currently renovating the complex (which in no way impacted on our stay) and we look forward to seeing the results of their labour next year.

reviews.title: Hard to say
reviews.text: Stayed at the rose many times now and don't really like to moan as I'm conflicted but have my fingers crossed on this one, we arrived to see a lot of work going on in the lobby area so really glad to see an update which looks very nice unfortunately the downside was we had a great double room but greeted every morning with the sound of a commercial floor tile cutter right outside our room, very loud, anyone who reads my reviews will see I rarely moan, don't want to go on too much but know one asked when checking out if everything was ok I suspect I know why, also the pool area looks better now work in progress but guys get some parasols as there is no shade around the pool, also fingers crossed noticed what looks like a bar been built with the renovations for the pool, hope so as will be a plus for me, so all in all she's looking nice still great for families the free wifi is fine for basic stuff you can upgrade, staff are always polite, thank you Ron you were great, very secure and safe, no resort fees hopefully stays that way and plenty of easy parking, I only dropped my rating due to the noise at the time, back in September for 14nights so hope its done. Thanks Dave

reviews.title: A very homely place
reviews.text: For those who like home cooking, sitting at a family table or on a balcony for meals, this hotel is ideal. The fully equipped kitchen, dining table and balcony with chairs and a small table make it an ideal place to stay for those who have dietary requirements. The bedroom is equipped with TV, as well as the lounge, so if you are the type of family who like to separate when winding down for bedtime, or one of the party wants to sleep early, there is the facility to do so without  disturbing each other.The beds are comfortable and the linen is always clean and good quality. The bathroom is through the bedroom, so if you have anyone sleeping on the double sofa bed, they may have to disturb you in the night.There is a safe in the room for your valuables, inside the lounge closet. There is a coin operated laundrette for freshening your clothes mid holiday, and an iron and board in the bedroom closet, along with a wash basket to carry your laundry around.The staff are very friendly and approachable, and are happy to help with anything you require. The concierge service can recommend shows and trips, and will happily book them for you, although you may be able to get tickets much cheaper along the strip.The pool is a reasonable size, and not crowded. There are plenty of sun loungers and chairs, and even a picnic area with BBQ facility.The gym is quite small, but practical and well maintained.All in all, I found the property ideal for my holiday, having separate sleeping arrangements for me and my daughter, full amenities that I have at home, and being a very short walk from the strip.The downsides were being quite close to the airport and the refurbishment works that were taking place around the lobby. Fortunately, the works will be finished soon, and the rooms are due to be decorated, so it should be much better by summer 2016.I would definitely stay here again.

reviews.title: Not Expensive - Under Renovation
reviews.text: Nice little place close to the airport and a short walk to the Strip.  Stayed one night as part of the beginning of a rafting trip.  The lobby was under extensive renovation and there was an alternate front door.  Staff were very nice and very helpful. The room was set up with a small kitchen, plates etc.  Not that I used them.  The furnishings you could tell had seen a lot of use so I could see why the renovation is in progress.  But very clean and in good repair with comfy beds.  Will be a great location when done.

reviews.title: A family haven away from The Strip
reviews.text: We appreciated the 2 bedrooms and comfy large living space (apt 1317) having a teen daughter. Spent only late evenings hanging around the apt as we were sightseeing all day. Free wifi was at times slow but perfectly fine. Didn't use the pool. A cheap laundry was a god-send after a week of travelling. We were fine with the short walk to the Strip. Canyon Tours does pickup/drop off here. It's certainly not the Bellagio or MGM Grand and for $140 approx per night we were very happy. This property is obviously timeshare - simply politely decline if you don't want to attend the sales pitch. Yes they're doing renovations right now - check directly with mgmt the status if this may be a problem for you. Drive to close supermarket much appreciated after living on take-out food.

reviews.title: A work in progress but well worth it
reviews.text: I would actually give this 3 1/2 stars if I could. I am a Shell Owner and stayed here for the first time in April. We were there for a family wedding and I had a child with me and an older uncle, so we were not there to party or gamble. 1) The lobby is undergoing construction, yes, but it was only a minor inconvenience for the 10 minutes or less it took to check in. 2) As an owner I agreed to the time share presentation to learn about updates with the new Wyndham ownership. Have to tell you, it was probably the best one I've ever seen. Engaging and fun, and the sales people were actually personable and it wasn't an obnoxious hard sell like I've seen at other locations. Plus I learned something new - you can sign up for the Wyndham credit card to earn money to apply towards maintenance fees. The presentation included a real breakfast with eggs and bacon, and not just a continental breakfast which was great since i am gluten free. 3) It is in a quiet location. Very safe to walk during the day - we walked to NY NY easily. We had a car and drove at night, but came home around 1am after a wedding and felt perfectly safe. 4) we stayed in a 2 bedroom. Very clean and the (full) kitchen appliances looked like they'd never been used. The master bath is very small but functional. The beds ARE SUPER COMFORTABLE!  I have neck problems and slept extremely well. 5) We did not use the pool so can't speak to it but there were a lot of people using it the days we were there 6) one of two negatives - Rooms are in one 4 buildings surrounding the main lobby area and each is gated and the gates are difficult to open with the keys - they don't read correctly. our room was on the opposite side of the office/lobby building and we drove around to it. Our key wouldn't work the gate but someone coming out let us in but then it didn't work for our room door.   I tried walking through the central pool area to get back to the lobby, but actually got trapped between the pool which was gated and couldn't get back into my building since the door needed a key. Luckily an employee spotted me pretty quickly. But that is a problem that they need to work out! 7) second negative - our room was on the ground floor next to the gate into our building. AVOID THIS ROOM! People coming in late at night have trouble opening the gate plus it BANGS VERY LOUDLY AS IT CLOSES. I was awakened several times during the night due to this.

reviews.title: Very pleasantly surprised
reviews.text: I didn't have high expectations as price was cheap in comparison to Vegas strip hotels, so was very pleasantly surprised by the quality of the 2 bedroom suite, ovrlooking Luxor and Mandalay. I asked for a quiet suite, and was given one - again, was pleasantly surprised that considering the place is 5 minutes from airport, it was incredibly quiet, I must get some of the triple glazing for my own home!  Very spacious, excellent kitchen with all modcons (better than home!), great big TV with loads of channels (no TV channel guide, only criticism, as over 70 channels, and never did find a music channel - not that we spent much time watching TV).  This place is very close to the strip, in some ways more accessible than the hotels, as you don't have to walk miles through casinos just to see daylight. Hooters just around corner, easy access to Luxor, Mandalay, Excalibur, and MGM (we used MGM as cut=through to access strip where there are cheaper food courts very close by.)  Front desk staff were very nice, the only thing I had a problem with was getting lost once - they were decorating reception and had blocked off the route I knew to get to my building, and I have no sense of direction so got lost and tried to get into 'my' room in the wrong building.... I would come back here, (suite 4202 was quiet as promised)

reviews.title: Just off the strip with some wrinkles
reviews.text: One of the less spectacular places we have stayed with Shell Vacations. They are doing some remodeling finally.  Last time we stayed here about 4 years ago it was getting run down.They must have  security problems at times with high fences, 2 security guards etc.  However their security isn't very good if I found a menu for a take out pizza place under my door.  I guess anyone can get on the property without too much trouble.  Very close to some sketchy apartments on the next street over.Overpriced Wifi. $9.95 per day for premium.   The free wifi would only work for email and web browsing without dropping your connection. Property is allegedly no smoking but we woke up to a workman on Monday AM smoking a cigar right outside our patio that we had to close the door.On the plus side the rooms have full kitchens with most of the necessary items.  It is close to the monorail so you don't have to drive the strip. No gambling machines on the premises but you are right across the street from Hooters and MGM. Staff is pleasant at the front desk.  Just be sure you tell the pushy timeshare sales people you don't want to be bothered.  Don't fall for the 90 minute pitch. When you check in you have to get your parking pass from the Timeshare Sales people that they call the Concierge

reviews.title: Frequent user
reviews.text: Frankly, I'm a little surprised by the reviews that state that the facilities are in need of renovation (which they are), then complain about the construction,. Come on, folks. You can't have it both ways.  In defense of the facility, this total renovation has been in the works for sometime and has been in limbo due to the very slow permit process. I've stayed there many times and one of the things I love is the proximity to the strip without all the gambling hullabaloo. If you want to gamble, it's a very easy walk. I've NEVER felt the neighborhood was sketchy or unsafe. I've walked to the MGM and new York, New York many times.

reviews.title: Nice Place for Families
reviews.text: This is a family oriented resort, just off the strip, not as luxurious as other hotels on the strip such as the Venetian where we stayed last year for about the same price (although that was a good deal). Each suite has a complete kitchen. Ours was very clean and stocked with all the items you need to prepare a meal. The hotel itself is well used and in the process of renovations. We were somewhat unprepared for the timeshare marketing that was going on. To get our parking pass, we had to visit the timeshare table where we were encouraged to commit to a 90 minute pitch the next day in exchange for two tickets to Cirque du Soleil. When we arrived to hear the pitch the next day, we were told that the tickets were no longer available so we were offered an alternative gift, which we did not want. We ended going to the Cirque show (Zarkana) on its second to last night before closing and noted that there were plenty of seats available. The hotel is good for families but not necessarily for couples or solo travelers unless you want to cook your own meals.

reviews.title: Thanks
reviews.text: Great hotel , Great service ,room very nice, The time share presentation was a bit obnoxious, very very expensive and hard to understand their pricing /points system, but tolerable.The front desk staff was very helpful and professional

reviews.title: Desert Rose Resort, Las Vegas with Thomas Cook
reviews.text: Firstly not notified of renovation/construction work in main lobby and on going painting to pool area by Thomas Cook pre travel, so arrived at reception to drills whizzing and banging due to floors being laid, very noisy and dusty, difficult to check in with Kay who did her level best to try and communicate over the construction noise, ended up writing information down for Kay to enter on computer.  Apologies all round from Kay, Helen (Manager) and Conrad (Regional Manager) who guaranteed us a room where no construction noise could be heard.Happy with this.  Room quiet as always as 6th visit here.  Went to welcome meeting with Thomas Cook to resolve 2 issues, firstly not been told re construction and not being able to enjoy pool area due to noise, pool area being repainted and closure at times of pool area.  This was rectified immediately by Rep who provided 2 pool keys for the Luxor for the length of our stay which we were happy with.  Secondly we booked this holiday from the 1st edition brochure, stating continental breakfast provided, the Desert Rose no longer provide breakfasts.  So contractually Thomas Cook were bound to provide same, in subsequent brochures, self catering was stated.  This issue was resolved to our satisfaction in resort.  Thank you to the Thomas Cook, Las Vegas team who dealt with this efficiently and quickly after providing reference number and copies of booking contract.We will return to the Desert Rose again, which has friendly and efficient staff, who know you by name and do their upmost to help and make your stay as comfortable as possible.  Thank you to Desert Rose staff Kay, Jason, Dawson, Helen and Conrad.

reviews.title: " This Place is a : Tiny DUMP "
reviews.text: BEWARE !!!!!!  (WARNING) Do NOT stay in this TINY / DUMP. This motel/condo is a 1-star hotel that is located in a very unsafe area. BEWARE !!!!!!!!! DO NOT STAY here. Upon arrival we noticed how far behind the strip in an extremely unsafe area this motel is in. Once we went to the so called condo/room it was so tiny & out dated everything we thought we were in a third world country rather than Las Vegas.

reviews.title: Not Great!
reviews.text: The people were polite and friendly.The facility is under extreme renovation, and frankly, it is a complete mess.The gate to enter where I was staying often would not work for many tries - saw other people having the same problem.The sound proofing between floors was extremely poor - the family in the unit over me sounded like a heard of wild elephants both in the evening and in the morning.The renovation could be done much better - paint splatters on the bathroom floor do not add to the decor.Someone from the facility came knocking on my door one evening to see where the television was located?  Kind of strange - right where they left it.The location - right behind the Tropicana - is reasonably convenient, but the neighborhood on the other side is a bit run down.Wifi was quite unreliable!The 1 bedroom suite gave some nice space!

reviews.title: Hotel and rooms are very outdated and dark
reviews.text: The experience immediately walking in was bad. The construction in the lobby was very loud and a guest yelling at the front desk person about her laundry was awkward as I had to sit through it while my front desk person was getting my keys as she got involved in it. I don't know how they could have gotten around either of those things so I let it go as I just wanted to get into my room after a long day of business meetings. By the way asking a guest to go over to another desk to get their "special gift" was a really bad idea. All it was was a map and some literature that I never used and threw away. So wasteful. Why not ask the guest if they want this instead of making it seem like an award?After getting my "special gift," I had to walk to my room which was surprisingly a long walk. I passed by two kids smoking weed and then a drunk guy. It's Vegas so again I let that go and they seemed to be having a fun loud time. I thought this would have been a good place to stay back in college but for the price it would have been too much. I got into my room and this is where it really bothered me. The furniture was very outdated. It wasn't dirty just everything was dark and old. I honestly felt uncomfortable sitting on the coach. I wanted to watch some TV so I did sit over a towel. It was crunchy when I sat down on the couch. Looking around the room the furniture had to be at least 20 years old.I opened the blinds as my room was so dark at 4pm (very bright outside still) walking in and I had the not so lovely busy parking lot view. I decided I wanted to get online and of course the wifi code did not work. Luckily this place was a 10 minute walk from a bunch of nice hotels so I left as fast as I could and didn't come back till ready to sleep. To say I was disappointed was an understatement. I gave a 2 score not 1 because the bed was comfortable and the sheets seemed clean. For what I paid ($180) I could have spent a little more and gotten a real hotel room.

reviews.title: Older but plenty of room
reviews.text: We stayed at this resort for only 1 night. The furniture and carpet are getting a little worn and should get a facelift soon. The room had 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms which was nice and roomy. The king size bed was amazingly comfortable. We did not use the pool so can't comment on that.  The resort in itself was very quiet which was nice but the location isn't very far from the strip if you want that atmosphere. This is the 2nd time we have stayed here and will again in the future.

reviews.title: alot of construction
reviews.text: room was nice , very clean. the construction was constant - even early on the weekends.The front desk staff was very helpful and professional.The time share presentation was a bit obnoxious, very very expensive and hard to understand their pricing /points system, but tolerable.

reviews.title: I was impressed
reviews.text: I stayed here one night in late March.  I was pleasantly surprised. It was clean, nicely furnished, and spacious for two.  I didn't take the kiddos but if I ever take them to Vegas, this would be a great place to stay.  It was a one bedroom suite with full kitchen and dinette. The living room area had a fold out sleeper and big TV.  The bedroom also had a TV.  There was only one bathroom.  So if traveling with bigger family a two bedroom suite would be best because it offers two bathrooms.  It's close to the strip but not too close. The pool was small, but there were lots of sun bathing chairs.  The main lobby was under construction, but we were never in the lobby but to check in. Definitely a good family friendly place to stay near the strip.

reviews.title: Not Exceptable
reviews.text: We had reservation here but found it to be not what we expected. Lobby was under renovations and the pool looked dirty. It was a good two blocks from the strip and further away from the show we had booked. The room was small with very old, worn furniture. The entrance to the resort had what looked like derelicts in front of the resort. They would sneeze into their hands then open the resort main doors...not very nice! Needless to say we found another place.

reviews.title: Depends on why your traveling
reviews.text: If we were staying any amount of time would probably choose a different resort. Looks like lots of families stay here as the rooms have kitchens and living areas and decent pool area. Walking distance to strip. We stayed one night and it was fine. There is some remodeling going on.

reviews.title: Nice one night stay
reviews.text: The resort is great for only one or two nights but I could not see myself staying there for a week. It's great for families with kids. Close to the strip which makes it nice that you don't have to get a taxi. It can be very noisy at times due to the proximity of the strip and airport.

reviews.title: So far a great stay
reviews.text: Everything we need as a group is availiable, concierge is awesome, just call, and they give u what u need asap. Rooms clean, fully stocked kitchen.... the bed is soooo comfortable, many pillows on the bed, and perfect. I want to buy some just like them for home.  They are under remodeling right now, BBQ was closed, but so far, 2 nights into a 4 night stay, we rented 2 condos and love it here. The location is so convenient, too.will be back.

reviews.title: Returning for the 3rd time!
reviews.text: In 2014 attending a company training conference I was encouraged by other consultants to stay at the Desert Rose.  I had always stayed at the Signature but that year they were almost booked up and had crazy crazy prices!  Desert Rose has better pricing for sure.  I really enjoyed the clean room & kitchen set up at the Desert Rose, and most importantly I did not have a Casino or Cig smoke to deal with.  We had our conference at the MGM Garden Arena and the Desert Rose was a short walk to the conference there.  The Desert Rose is also a short walk to the Catholic Shrine/church, however the desk did not know that when I inquired, I located it on my own.In April 2015 I returned to the Desert Rose,  This time we had all kinds of trouble with the air conditioning, and Wi-Fi.  They were trying their best to resolve the issues, while I was forced to make calls (fairly long calls)  myself to the provider of the wifi.     At that time they were in the process of changing ownership and moving to Time shares/ condos....was never sure what because I was never asked if I was interested to learn more.  (bad move people)  Again the room was clean, and except for a few spots the carpet was fairly clean.  Price was pretty good again.For 2016: I really enjoy the quiet of the Desert Rose so I am returning there in one week.I am in a quandary about the pricing this year and don't understand how Sunday night is pretty high.  AND now you have to  pay for Maid Service...however free towels.  I feel that is pretty picky.  I personally don't request maid service often when I travel, but In the week I will be there $50 a day is too much.ps...I did like the pool very much.

reviews.title: Perfect for family!
reviews.text: This place is perfect for a family stay in Las Vegas!  It is just off the strip so it is not "in your face" as another reviewer put it but, close enough to be so convenient.  Our two bedroom apartment/suite included two bathrooms (yay!!), a living area with large sofa/chaise, a dining area and a fully equipped kitchen with full size fridge, stove/oven and dishwasher.  Also included toaster, coffeemaker and blender with all dish and cook and glass ware.  Wood surfaces maybe a touch worn but, I didn't have to worry about my three kids being the first to scratch or mar anything.  Three TVs if you are home long enough to watch.  Wifi was "iffy".  Suite was clean and cozy.  Swimming pool and spa were great and open late as opposed to the casino hotels that close early to keep you spending money inside!   Would definitely return here!

reviews.title: Great Place!
reviews.text: Very nice place.  Not new or fancy but clean and quiet - even when undergoing construction.  Rooms are a bit dated but clean and nice.  Smaller resort so was quaint and calming.  Very close to the strip - just a couple minute walk to the MGM grand which was nice.  All in all a place I would go to again.

reviews.title: Great if you don't want in your face las vegas
reviews.text: Me and my partner stayed here in September , I had never been to Las Vegas before and didn't know what to expect but knew I didn't want the loud hustle  and bustle of the strip 24/7 .The room we had was great and had everything and more that you would need whilst on holiday , the pool area was clean, tidy and relatively quiet so you could actually relax rather than party , but when you did want to party it was only a short walk to the strip and deuce stop .Yes the deco is a tad dated but who goes to Vegas to sit in your room looking at carpet ? Overall for the price , location and room amenities I think this place was excellent but if you want glitz , glamour and parties stay in one of the big hotels ! Oh and my partner has been to Las Vegas 5 times and said it was the best place he has stayed .

reviews.title: Great Location in Vegas
reviews.text: We just had a short stay here, We visited in March of 2016. Upon check in we observed major noise and jack hammering in the main check in area of the lobby. The noise was terribly loud but even through all of it the staff was very polite and welcoming- they must have horrible head aches by the end of the day! They allowed us to check in even though we were very early.The room was clean and spacious if a bit worn and outdated. However they are beginning renovations.The location is great however there is a lot of construction around the main entrance. Not a flashy Vegas condo but comfortable and spacious. It served our needs and the staff is VERY nice. No problems.We didn't go to the pool so not sure about that. Happy travels.

reviews.title: Great family escape spot.
reviews.text: Off the strip, great rooms and close to everything. The family had enough room to stretch out and relax and close enough to everything for us. Fully furnished room, kitchen utensils, beautiful property and kids loved it too.

reviews.title: Good hotel near the strip
reviews.text: Went here in January for our visit to the CES. Because prices at the strip rise high during the show we wanted to stay in a more value for price hotel. We found that at the Desert Rose Resort. They have nice appartements; they are a bit tired but still met our standards. We walked to the Luxor hotel in about 15 minutes. I would definitely stay here again on our next visit.

reviews.title: Great place to stay for a week in Vegas
reviews.text: This room was perfect for my husband and me for our wee-long trip to Las Vegas.  Since we were staying for eight days, we wanted a room with a kitchen.  That way we weren't forced to eat out for every meal.The kitchen was perfect.  It had full-sized appliances, including a dishwasher.  Nice granite countertops.  All the dishes, cookware, and utensils were supplied for us.The living/dining room was nice and large.  It had a dining table with 4 chairs, and a nice sectional couch and coffee table.The separate bedroom was nice, since I tend to wake up before my husband.  I could go into the living room and close the bedroom door and not wake him up.The only problem we encountered was the shower temperature.  The water temperature was inconsistent.  It was either too hot and no matter how far you turned the knob, it wouldn't cool down until it was too cold; or it was too cold and wouldn't warm up.  And it would fluctuate while you were in the shower.  That was really the only problem we had, though.The location was great.  It is only a couple blocks away from the Strip.  We could walk to the MGM Grand, New York, New York, and Excalibur.  Also, there is a good grocery store not too far away from the hotel, as well as a Walmart.  The pool was closed for renovations during our stay, but we were out and about so much, we probably wouldn't have used it anyway.Overall, we were very pleased with this hotel, and will probably stay there the next time we go to Vegas.

reviews.title: Cody place
reviews.text: I love this suites because it's homely. My husband andI were on vacation and we decided to stay in this hotel. Good proximity to strip provided you'll wear a comfortable foot wear. Safe area and close to Hooters Casino, MGM and Luxor.Highly recommended,my only concern is the hotel itself needs upgrading the decors are outdated.

reviews.title: Home away from home.
reviews.text: Live in San Antonio but never go out with work. Recently did Superbowl weekend couple friends we usually choose random weekends throughout the year and 1 pays hotel and we all hit up Vegas. Stayed all over strip but to me home is the Desert Rose. Last year think we stayed at DRR 4 times this year already once. Now my friends are choosing this resort, it's way better, then with Uber now just takes Vegas to another level. No long wait check in times, clean lobby, full kitchens, comfortable beds, clean property. Staff is amazing even security guards are all pretty cool, it's very safe. Wanna say thanks to manager Jason for always helping and desk clerk just met Katie for being a rockstar I was interested in adding another day and we had booked in advance on a sale she asked manager on duty to come to counter and asked can I give Adam room at same rate he's always here she didn't have to do that, much appreciated. Went from an idea to let's do it and enjoyed another day in paradise. Coming back to Vegas in 2 wks for some spring break staying at sister property Grand Desert but I may add a day or two and DRR just cause I miss home lol. This is the place.

reviews.title: Pleasantly average.
reviews.text: I stayed here with my parents and wife in a 2 bedroom apartment. Whilst I don't have any specific moans about the hotel, it didn't really light my fire either. The rooms were well equipped, clean and spacious enough for our needs but the furnishings were a touch dated.  The pool area was generally clean and we'll kept apart from me cutting my hand on a small piece of glass in the hot tub even after the area was shut for a day for cleaning ?? Reception was generally helpful and we'll staffed. The hotel was was just off the main strip which has the huge bonus of being quiet and exempt from the extortionate resort fee, charged by the main strip hotels.Overall, you won't go far wrong staying here.

reviews.title: Spacious room, close to the main street
reviews.text: The apartment is spacious and has a full kitchen with everything you need to cook. The hotel is close to the main street, where casinos and stores are located, and also close to the airport. Free parking is available.

reviews.title: Family
reviews.text: I stayed with family at the Desert Rose from the 28th Nov-5th December. We were in a 2 bed apartment facing towards the strip meaning we could see from Mandalay Bay to the Tropicana which was nice.The room itself was very clean but like other reviewers have said is a little worn however this didn't detract from our stay. Staff on site were very helpful and the strip was a 10 mins walk past ~Hooters to the Tropicana. We all enjoyed our stay and if the price was right we'd definitely stay again as we prefer to have the kitchen facilities and room to spread out that the Desert Rose offers.

reviews.title: Great location in need of TLC
reviews.text: Although we have visited Las Vegas several times, this was our first New Year's Eve. The location of this facility was perfect. We were able to easily walk to MGM, New York-New York, Tropicana, and Excalibur. They closed down Las Vegas Blvd and the fireworks were spectacular! The exterior of this facility is well kept as are all the other public spaces. However, the rooms are definitely in need of updating. We first stayed at this facility 8 years ago and not a signal thing has been replaced in their one-bedroom units since then. Neither of the telephones in our room functioned, our toilet paper holder was barely hanging on the wall, and when we used the garbage disposal, it flooded the kitchen. The worst thing was that the carpet was so dirty that if you walked around bare footed or with light color socks, you ended up with black feet. To be fair, we have stayed here many times and this was the only time it was below par. The kitchen is awesome and very well stocked with all the dishes and gadgets to make it possible for you to prepare meals and snacks and the beds are very comfortable. They have drawings posted in the lobby showing that they are planning to do some updates, but it only shows plans for the public areas, not the rooms. I hope I am wrong and they are planning to update the rooms as well!

reviews.title: Total Comfort
reviews.text: Our room was so clean and comfortable. I felt as if I was home and so relaxed. We had a full kitchen to cook and saved money. The pool was heated and everything was wonderful. We will be back for sure

reviews.title: Close to the strip and Good Value
reviews.text: The apartments have a separate bedroom from the lounge and fully equipped kitchen.We cooked meals and entertain a family of 10 on Christmas Day.Bathroom a little cramped but we loved the place and wpould definitely stay again.

reviews.title: Desert Rose - Las vegas
reviews.text: Very friendly staff & clean rooms, but the place is in dire need of upgrading. Carpet old & worn (most hotel chains replace after 7 yrs).  Furniture is old dinged up like you would expect to find at a Motel-6. Rooms do have flat screen tvs but the reception is terrible & many channels were snowy.. We had problems with the Wi-Fi (spent 20 min on phone with a tech that barely spoke English to resolve). small pool.. no beverage service like you would expect to find in Vegas. The property (I refuse to call it a resort) is located just behind the Tropicana so it is conveniently located walking distance from the south end of Strip. unfortunately it is also right by the airport & jet noise kept me up(newer double paned windows would solve the problem.  My wife & daughter did not feel safe going to the car after dark as there was No-Security & vagrants were constantly walking back & forth across the parking lots. In all.. very disappointed with our stay..  Definitely not up to what we are accustomed to from Wyndham.

reviews.title: Merely Good
reviews.text: We stayed here with two elderly people as well so we booked a two room suite and it was excellent looking at first but we did run into some problems. We checked in at 11pm so we were all ready to get some sleep. Our room was very close to the lobby and the receptionist was extremely helpful. The whole feeling of the resort felt like Cuba, a little run down but staying up none the less. We were there during the christmas holidays and it was a bit chilly so we didn't get a chance to use the pool and quickly hurried up the elevator and into the room. Our room was at the end of the hallway so it was generally quiet. First problem that occured was that the dishwasher was broken and the door wouldn't close. We called up an employee and they fixed it immediately, so it wasn't much of a problem. Second problem was the heater. We came into the room and it was pretty cold, so we decided to turn up the temperature to around 75 farenheit. After an hour there was no sense of heat in the room, so we turned it higher and that process continued for about 4h. None the less it got fixed eventually but took a while.

reviews.title: Overall Nice
reviews.text: Stayed in 2Bd unit with 2 bath. The units are nice, well maintained. However, heater/ac can be noisy at night. Placed is within walking distance to most places near strip. Very convenient. The resort itself does not have any slots, if that's what you are looking for.

reviews.title: Good for the price
reviews.text: We stayed 5 nights. If you don't mind a 5-10 minute walk to get to the strip and on a budget this is the place for you. Our room was clean and well maintained. It's is positioned on a side street from Hooters, so the first night I was a little weary about walking home at night. We walked home ever night after being on the strip and didn't have any issues.

reviews.title: Only stayed for a few hours
reviews.text: The photos on this place looked great but our experience was very different. When we arrived, our ground floor room was dirty and the furniture was so worn the cushion covers were split. When my wife turned on the extractor fan in the bathroom, it dumped out a bunch of dust. We told the hotel and they tried to move us to a room that was slightly better but by then the damage was done. We left and checked into another hotel.

reviews.title: Disappointed Owner!
reviews.text: We are owners of this timeshare and this is our 2nd visit. 1st visit was in 2007 and it was great. We had two rooms this time. Both of them had a old smell to them. The furniture was scratched dented. The headboard in the bedroom was stained and looked very gross. The carpet was worn. The bathroom looked more updated. When taking a shower it would not properly drain. I felt like I was at a Motel 6 and not a Resort. It looked clean but with all the scratched up furniture it gave off the appearance of being dirty. I was really disapointed. The only positive thing was the staff was pleasant. Won't be returning.

reviews.title: Old resort in need of upgrades
reviews.text: The Desert Rose is an older property that is dark and outdated.  The one bedroom that can sleep four people is not really convenient for four. The one and only bathroom is in the bedroom.  Guests have to go thru the bedroom to use the bathroom.   No privacy for anyone. The sheets don't fit the bed.  They are too small and kept coming off. The staff is very friendly and helpful. They have hot coffee and water in the lobby. This hotel is near NY,NY and next to Hooters and Tropicana.  There is plenty of free parking.  They have a heated outdoor pool and hot tub. The website says free breakfast ----they don't have that!

reviews.title: Great Christmas Gift
reviews.text: This place was very, very nice.  I loved the quietness in the middle of all the hustle and bustle.  it was well situated, not very far from the strip and right across from the famous MGM and right in back of the Hooters hotel.  It was awesome to have a full kitchen and a balcony.  We were welcomed and treated very well, all our questions and concerns were addressed with politeness and respect. We didn't even have to rent a car since we were within walking distance to all the fun and excitement. We will most defiantly come back to this hotel again, we plan to come with the whole family and it will be a safe and fun place to stay.

reviews.title: Just off the beaten path, near the strip
reviews.text: We spent recently spent 5 nights at Desert Rose in a one bedroom unit. The room was good size. The kitchen had everything that we needed, including all major appliances, cooking utensils and dishes for 4 people. The bathroom was a bit small. There were laundry facilities on the property, but none in our unit. We did laundry one day and it worked fine. There is free wifi in the rooms.Check in was quick. The desk clerk told us that there would soon be some major renovations that would include adding a restaurant, which would be nice. After check in they sent us across the lobby to get our parking pass. At that time they also gave us coupons and asked us to visit a timeshare for a gift card or tickets to shows. We did go to the tour, but I had forgotten my id in one of my other bags, so we weren't allowed to participate. It was supposed to be a 90 minute time period, so I was fine not doing it. We were never pressured again after that. There is a pool and hot tub. It was unusually warm while we were there, but not warm enough for the pool, although I did see people in the hot tub.The resort is located about 2 blocks off the strip directly behind Hooters. There was construction near the resort, so it was a little bit noisy during the day, but was very quiet at night. It was never a problem. We did have a rental car. Parking at the resort was easy and always available. You could be fine without a car, because it's close to the strip and there is great public transportation. There was a cab stand at Hooters, buses nearby and also the monorail. Las Vegas offers great shopping on the strip and off. If you're looking for a short day trip take a drive through Red Rock Canyon. It's beautiful and great for hiking. We have stayed at Desert Rose a few times in the past, and I'm sure we'll return.

reviews.title: PERFECT FOR A FEW CAYS IN VEGAS
reviews.text: Nice quiet timeshare off the strip.  Reasonable price for a 1 bedroom suite with everything you could needfor a few days.  Kitchen with dw, guest laundry, nice outdoor pool and more.  I understand a major reno is taking place in 2016 so might not be so quiet them.

reviews.title: Quiet resort, about 10-15 minutes walk to the strip
reviews.text: We had a great time here. We chose this resort as a place to spend a few days to relax by the pool without the bustle you find at the resorts located on the strip. We weren't disappointed. The rooms are very large, clean and have a well-equipped kitchen. On the downside: the balcony is rather small and the room that we initially got had quite some A/C noise. The A/C's are located on top of the main building, so if you're a light sleeper make sure you get a room that's located elsewhere. There was just one thing that really annoyed us, and that were the room keys. They kept getting demagnetized. Not a big deal if that happens once or twice, but it get's annoying if every time when you go from the swimming pool to your room you have to return to the front desk because your card doesn't work anymore.  Aside from this small nuisance we had a great time here and would definitely recommend this hotel if you're looking for a nice and quiet place to stay just outside the strip.

reviews.title: Handy for the strip
reviews.text: We had a comfortable stay at the Desert Rose, but not before we had to overcome a problem.  On our first of three nights we were disturbed by a very noisy air conditioning unit above the ceiling of our bedroom, on the roof. None of the staff on duty appeared sympathetic or were able to resolve the problem, until we encountered Paul who was concerned and agreed the noise was intolerable.  Paul personally organised a move to another room and helped us relocate. In this new room we enjoyed a peaceful and comfortable remainder of our stay, thank you again, Paul. Rooms are spacious, clean, well equipped and nicely presented. There's plenty of space to park your car near your room and best of all the Strip (and MGM hotel) is just a short walk.  We are sorry to say there was one other problem at Desert Rose which visitors from out with the USA need to note.  The concierge tried to book a show for us and offered us a great price for two tickets, however was then unable to take our card as payment (as we don't have a US zip code) nor could she accept cash!  Luckily the concierge at MGM booked tickets for us, made other helpful suggestions and completed our payment without any further problems.

reviews.title: Vegas Retreat
reviews.text: Staying at this quiet, small resort so close to the strip was a highlight for us.  We came for the marathon and picked this location due to the proximity to the start line and that it had a kitchen.  The room was better than expected and at check in they asked us our preference for building or floor.  The kitchen was well stocked with dishes and the dishwasher was a nice surprise.  I wish recycling options were more prominent in the room and throughout the resort, though I'm not sure if this is a resort thing or a Vegas thing.  I did discover recycling blue bags under the sink towards the end of our stay, but there wasn't info on how to use them.  Staff were extremely helpful and cheery. I really like the 24 hr coffee/tea service in the lobby and on Tuesday night there were hot appetizers available to guests.  The pool was lovely and had an added bonus of a hot tub and a cool therapy tub - great for runners and walkers after a long day roaming Vegas.  I would definitely stay here again!

reviews.title: Great for Families
reviews.text: Only 1 block from the strip, next door to Hooters and VERY close to Tropicana and an easy walk to MGM, New York New York, Luxor and Excalibur, this quiet non smoking condo complex has 2 beds and 2 bath options cheap! Free wifi, free parking, pool, hot tub, a ground floor option, all rooms have balconies. These are NOT fancy Vegas rooms, they are clean, functional and have full kitchens, dining room, large den with lcd TV in both bedrooms.  No restaurant, or bar, no daily room cleaning.

reviews.title: Jenny gets Married!
reviews.text: What a beautiful place to stay. The pool is gorgeous. The rooms are cozy. Full amenities. So much better than a hotel room. We were close enough to hear the country music festival from our bark porch.

reviews.title: Awesome place for a group!
reviews.text: A group of girls going to Vegas for a bachelorette party stayed at the Desert Rose Resort from Oct 10-13. We had a two bedroom condo which was the perfect amount of space for the six of us. Beds were comfortable, kitchen was awesome, and the location was great. We enjoyed the pool and hot tub a lot and found it to be a really great size. We had so much fun lounging by the pool, even playing some games which I think most people enjoyed. Staff was great and we had no issues whatsoever with check-in. The problem I found was that the wi-fi didn't work most of the time. I recommend this place for groups who want to be together in a room and enjoy a nice poolside condo while in vegas!

reviews.title: Excellent value & great for families
reviews.text: I stayed here with 3 family members and needed a wheelchair friendly room. The suite we were given was absolutely perfect .. a 2 bedroom unit with large living and dining area and a fully-equipped kitchen with standard stove, fridge, and dishwasher .. all the comforts of home. The weather at this time of the year was a little cooler than usual but we did manage to fit in a day poolside with some lounge time in the hot tub. If intending to BBQ, expect to wait for the hotel staff to come to light them.  For the exercise crowd there is a fully-equippped fitness room. Free coffee is offered in the reception area and there are laundry facilities for the extended stay.  The resort is a little dated and the reception lounge could use some new furniture but overall it was very clean and quiet .. just off the strip but within easy walking distance. The only complaint we had was the excessive amount of time spent waiting on taxi service.  Other than that, we had a wonderful full week in Vegas and will definitely recommend this resort to others.

reviews.title: Las Vegas
reviews.text: If ur in Las Vegas the Desert Rose Resort is the right place to stay the room are very clean,  area  is  nice and safe about 1/2 mile to the Las Vegas strip.  I enjoy staying the this resource. Customer Service ppl  are very Courteous. Great place to stay.

reviews.title: A Good Place to Stay if you don't want a casino hotel
reviews.text: We have been to Las Vegas many, many times, and this time we were staying for an entire week and wanted a roomy, non-casino place to stay. The two of us rented a one bedroom unit at Desert Rose, and were very pleased with the entire stay. The property was clean,  the unit was clean, the pool area was nice. Parking was always available very near our entrance. The security was always present, and the staff was always pleasant. Very easy walking distance to Hooters or Tropicana Casinos, very easy driving distance to others. Staying for a week, we appreciated the availability of a laundry room on property. It was clean and coin operated with no problem. We had a birthday party gathering with eleven people attending, and all were able to park and fit comfortably in the room. The kitchen had plenty of plates, glasses, cups, utensils, etc. -- enough that we could feed eleven people birthday cake and put all in the dishwasher afterwards. The only complaint we have is that the  (free) Wi-Fi was pretty slow.

reviews.title: great stay
reviews.text: Booked this location to attend the pbr finals at Thomas Mack. Was an easy walk, save taking a cab. 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and full kitchen. Conveniently located near the Las Vegas strip with free transportation to the strip. staff very friendly and helpful.. Will stay there again. Within walking distance to Hard Rock and Brauhause.

reviews.title: Nice
reviews.text: When we visit Las Vegas this is our hotel of choice. We have been coming here since 2006 and we have celebrated our son's 21st birthday, our daughter's wedding and other smaller get away trips throughout the years.  Without exception, our rooms have been emaculate, the staff friendly and helpful and we have had a great experience. The hotel is convenient to the strip. If you like to walk, it's location is perfect. It is close to the MGM Grand monorail station so it is not necessary to have to rent a car. The location is very convenient to the airport. One thing to know is that the planes begin taking off around 6 am and it does become a little noisy.  The location, which is about a block from the strip is more quiet and does not get a lot of noise from the traffic.  I would suggest requesting a room opposite the front entrance of the resort I do have to mention that the rooms could use a little refurbishing or repair. Our carpet was rippling and wood furniture scratched. However, with that being said everything else was great. The kitchen is well stocked with dishes and utensils, along with appliances that are in excellent condition and match. The towels are ample and new ones can be requested at any time. Definitely give this hotel a serious consideration!

reviews.title: Perfect price and location
reviews.text: Accommodations were as expected. Very clean and well stocked. One block off the strip but an easy and safe walk. Staff were very pleasant and helpful. Would definitely be a repeat guest. A very safe environment.

reviews.title: Great stay
reviews.text: 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and full kitchen.  Conveniently located near the Las Vegas strip.  Nice place for a family vacation.  Will stay there again. Not sure about pets. No restaurants within walking distance.

reviews.title: Crummy rooms let this 'resort' down.
reviews.text: We stayed here a week through a timeshare swap with Interval International, which gives this place a 'Premier Resort' status. That it ain't, at least not if you go by the size and quality of the rooms. Our 1-bedroom 'suite' had a tiny kitchen, a single toilet/bathroom barely large enough to swing a cat (you pretty much had to step into the bath to close the door) and a lounge/dining area straight from the 60's. More of a studio than a 'suite'. We have contacted II to complain about misleading advertising. At the very least, they need to remove the un-deserved Premier Resort status until these rooms are refurbished. Even then, the single-bedroom accommodation should be designated as a 'studio with kitchenette'...
